source_text: in the beginning god created the heavens and the earth,
target_text: uru-uru tèka, ama lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha.

source_text: and the earth was formless and void, and darkness was on the face of the deep, and the spirit of god was fluttering on the face of the waters,
target_text: lod'o rai-haha j'aj'i mèka, aa'i-aa'i dhae mèci mèka. dhu abhu, èi. aa maroga aatu-aatu saguru nare ne. ka roh lamatua lela ètu dedha èi èèna.

source_text: and god says, let light be; and light is.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka, hud'i ku dènge saraa. ropa peka nare sèmi ne'e, ka saraa j'aj'i dènge ka.

source_text: and god sees that the light is good, and god separates between the light and the darkness,
target_text: ropa nèdhi saraa ne, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a. hèia na hag'e eele saraa nèti maroga, sèna ka èci-èci ka dènge taa na.

source_text: and god calls the light day, and the darkness he has called night; and there is an evening, and there is a morning-day one.
target_text: ka pangare saraa ne ‘mèu', aa maroga na ‘mèda'. ne'e ne, lod'o ka èci kèna.

source_text: and god says, let an expanse be in the midst of the waters, and let it be separating between waters and waters. and god makes the expanse, and it separates between the waters which are under the expanse, and the waters which are above the expanse: and it is so.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua lii hari, na peka, hud'i dènge ku era talele, sèna ka hag'e eele èi. nèti èèna ka, èi re dedha, aa abhu kahèi èi re haha. ropa peka nare sèmi èèna, hèia èi b'agi dènge mi dua.

source_text: and god calls the expanse heavens; and there is an evening, and there is a morning-the second day.
target_text: ka na pangare èi re dedha na, ‘liru'. ne'e ne, lod'o ka dua kèna.

source_text: and god says, let the waters under the heavens be collected to one place, and let the dry land be seen: and it is so.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka hari, aku nèngu na, èi re haha hud'i pakaboko ku mi ca era, sèna ka abhu rai kamango. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, j'aj'i dènge ka rai mango.

source_text: and god calls the dry land earth, and the collection of the waters he has called seas; and god sees that it is good.
target_text: ka era rai mango, na pangare na ‘rai-dedha'; aa era èi dhu kaboko èèna, na pangare na ‘dhasi'. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i ne, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: and god says, let the earth yield tender grass, herb sowing seed, fruit-tree whose seed is in itself making fruit after its kind, on the earth: and it is so.
target_text: ka ama lamatua lii hari, peka na, rai hud'i pamamuri ku rupa-rupa ana aaj'u. sèna ka abhu aj'u dhu hua, dhu dènge lamusi, aa dhu dènge rèu mangèru. sèna ka aj'u-aj'u se, hua-hela madhutu rupa rèngu. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, j'aj'i dènge ka ana aaj'u aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and the earth brings forth tender grass, herb sowing seed after its kind, and tree making fruit whose seed is in itself after its kind; and god sees that it is good;
target_text: ètu dedha-rai, ana aaj'u se hua-hela ka madhutu rupa rèngu. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: and there is an evening, and there is a morning-the third day.
target_text: ne'e ne, lod'o ka tèlu kèna.

source_text: and god says, let luminaries be in the expanse of the heavens, to make a separation between the day and the night, then they have been for signs, and for appointed times, and for days and years, and they have been for luminaries in the expanse of the heavens to give light on the earth: and it is so.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua lii hari, aku nèngu na, re bèka dedha, hud'i abhu ku mèdha dhu saraa, ho pasaraa rai-haha ne. hud'i abhu mèdha dhu pasaraa re mèu, aa abhu kahèi dhu pasaraa re mèda. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, j'aj'i tadha, ho sèna ka bisa ige lod'o, hèru, dènge tèu. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, mèdha dhu heo aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i dènge ka.

source_text: and god makes the two great luminaries, the great luminary for the rule of the day, and the small luminary-and the stars-for the rule of the night;
target_text: ka na tao ka mèdha kapai dua dhu pasaraa rai-haha. dhu kapai risi, pasaraa re mèu; aa dhu ako ana iiki, pasaraa re mèda. aa na tao hua-hètu kahèi.

source_text: and god gives them in the expanse of the heavens to give light on the earth,
target_text: na tèke mèdha dhu saraa sèra ètu dedha-liru, sèna ka loti mai asa rai-haha.

source_text: and to rule over day and over night, and to make a separation between the light and the darkness; and god sees that it is good;
target_text: ka mèdha se, pasaraa ka re mèu, aa pasaraa re mèda. dènge j'ara ne'e, na hag'e eele saraa nèti maroga. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: and there is an evening, and there is a morning-the fourth day.
target_text: ne'e ne, lod'o ka èpa kèna.

source_text: and god says, let the waters teem with the teeming living creature, and let the bird fly above the earth on the face of the expanse of the heavens.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua padhai lii hari, peka na, hud'i abhu ku ae-ae dhu mamuri ètu d'ara èi. dènge hud'i abhu ku rupa-rupa manu-bhui dhu lela ètu dedha rai-haha ne.

source_text: and god creates the great dragons, and every living creature that is creeping, which the waters have teemed with, after their kind, and every bird with wing, after its kind, and god sees that it is good.
target_text: ka na tao ka i'a aa'i-aa'i dènge badha kapai dhu mamuri ètu d'ara èi. na paj'aj'i kahèi manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: and god blesses them, saying, be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let the bird multiply in the earth:
target_text: ka na padhai lii ho sèna ka hia berkat mi aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, peka na, i'a se, hud'i laa bèba-kacanga sèna ka papènu èi ètu mia-mia. aa manu-bhui, asa tabha kahèi.

source_text: and there is an evening, and there is a morning-the fifth day.
target_text: ne'e ne, lod'o ka lèmi kèna.

source_text: and god says, let the earth bring forth the living creature after its kind, livestock and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after its kind: and it is so. and god makes the beast of the earth after its kind, and the livestock after their kind, and every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, and god sees that it is good.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka hari, na, hud'i abhu ku rupa-rupa badha dhu mamuri ètu rai-dedha. sèmi: badha-manu dhu ani, badha hui, dènge badha dhu rod'o, èci-èci ka dènge rupa na. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, badha aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i dènge ka. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: and god says, let us make man in our image, according to our likeness, and let them rule over the fish of the sea, and over the bird of the heavens, and over livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that is creeping on the earth.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka hari, aku nèngu na, hua iia, mai ta paj'aj'i dhèu, madhutu rupa èdhi. hud'i laa ra leru dènge ator i'a aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara dhasi, manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ètu dedha-liru, badha-manu dhu ani, dènge badha leo aa'i-aa'i ra dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and god creates the man in his image; in the image of god he created him, a male and a female he created them.
target_text: hèia na paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha ne madhutu rupa na. na paj'aj'i si, dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni.

source_text: and god blesses them, and god says to them, be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the earth, and subdue it, and rule over the fish of the sea, and over the bird of the heavens, and over every living thing that is creeping on the earth.
target_text: ka na padhai lii ho sèna ka hia berkat mi rèngu, aku nèngu na, miu hud'i bèba-kacanga ku, sèna ka pea papènu rai-haha ne, ho mi ator ne. ja'a hia miu koasa, sèna ka mi ator i'a, manu-bhui, dènge badha-manu aa'i-aa'i ra ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and god says, behold, i have given to you every herb sowing seed, which is on the face of all the earth, and every tree in which is the fruit of a tree sowing seed, to you it is for food;
target_text: mi nanene paie-iie! ja'a hia miu rupa-rupa nganga'a ètu rai-haha ne'e. sèmi: ana aaj'u dhu dènge hua, dhu dènge lamusi, aa dhu dènge rèu mangèru.

source_text: and to every beast of the earth, and to every bird of the heavens, and to every creeping thing on the earth, in which is breath of life, every green herb is for food: and it is so.
target_text: ja'a hia rupa-rupa ana aaj'u kahèi sèna ka j'aj'i nganga'a badha. nganga'a hia badha-manu dhu ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, dènge manu-bhui. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, nganga'a badha sèra aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i dènge ka.

source_text: and god sees all that he has done, and behold, it is very good; and there is an evening, and there is a morning-the sixth day.
target_text: ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a. ne'e ne, lod'o ka èna kèna.

source_text: and the heavens and the earth are completed, and all their host;
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, ama lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru, rai-haha, dènge isi ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and god completes by the seventh day his work which he has made, and ceases by the seventh day from all his work which he has made.
target_text: ropa na sab'a èle, asa bèli èèna, lèke dènge lod'o ka pidhu. hèia na ae nèti sasab'a-la'a na.

source_text: and god blesses the seventh day, and sanctifies it, for in it he has ceased from all his work which god had created for making.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, na tao lod'o ka pidhu ne, lod'o dhu kapai risi nèti lod'o dhu leo sèra. na tao sèmi èèna, lula na pa'èle aa'i le sasab'a na, ka ètu d'ara lod'o ka pidhu na, na ae.

source_text: these are the generations of the heavens and of the earth in their being created, in the day of yhwh god's making the earth and the heavens;
target_text: d'ai sange ne'e ka, lii lolo ama lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne. lod'o ama lamatua heka paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha èèna,

source_text: and no shrub of the field is yet in the earth, and no herb of the field yet sprouts, for yhwh god has not rained on the earth, and there is not a man to serve the ground, and a mist goes up from the earth, and has watered the whole face of the ground.
target_text: dhae abhu mèka ana aaj'u, lula na papuru mèka èj'i. taa èèna, dhoka sèb'u èi di, mai nèti d'ara rai ho pabasa rai re dedha. aa abhu mèka dhèu rai-haha dhu tao oka-tedhe.

source_text: and yhwh god forms the man-dust from the ground, and breathes into his nostrils breath of life, and the man becomes a living creature.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua nare rai ciki, ka na paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha. hèia na tiu a'ae na asa d'ara sahènga dhèu na, ka na mamuri dènge ka.

source_text: and yhwh god plants a garden in eden, at the east, and he sets there the man whom he has formed;
target_text: hèia ama lamatua bhoke oka cue ètu rai eden, re bèka dhimu. hèia na hia dhèu ne pea ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: and yhwh god causes to sprout from the ground every tree desirable for appearance, and good for food, and the tree of life in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
target_text: ètu d'ara oka èèna, na pamamuri rupa-rupa aj'u dhu be'a, dhu dhèu bisa ra'a. aa na pamamuri kahèi aj'u dua kapua ètu talora aae oka èèna. ladhe dhèu ra'e hua nèti aj'u èci, na mamuri taa-taa. aa ladhe dhèu ra'e hua nèti aj'u èci hari, ne'a hag'e mia dhu be'a, aa mia dhu karehe.

source_text: and a river is going out from eden to water the garden, and from there it is parted, and has become four chief rivers;
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu loko èci dhu hae nèti d'ara oka èèna. loko èèna, èpa kacanga.

source_text: the name of the first is pison, it is that which is surrounding the whole land of havilah where the gold is,
target_text: kacanga ka èci na, ngara na pison. nèngu ka dhu hae pale-lème rai hawila dhu abhu hualaa ae-ae.

source_text: and the gold of that land is good; the bdellium and the shoham stone are there;
target_text: ètu era èèna ka, abhu poe-pai, aj'u dhu raa na hèu mèngi, dènge hadhu kale'e.

source_text: and the name of the second river is gihon, it is that which is surrounding the whole land of cush;
target_text: kacanga ka dua, ngara na gihon. kacanga ne, hae pale-lème rai kus.

source_text: and the name of the third river is hiddekel, it is that which is going east of asshur; and the fourth river is the euphrates.
target_text: kacanga ka tèlu, ngara na tigris. kacanga ne'e ka, j'aj'i mi too rai asyur re ca bèka dhimu. kacanga ka èpa, ngara na efrat.

source_text: and yhwh god takes the man, and causes him to rest in the garden of eden, to serve it and to keep it.
target_text: ka ama lamatua hia dhèu pea ètu d'ara eden, ho na ladhe-leru oka èèna.

source_text: and yhwh god lays a charge on the man, saying, from every tree of the garden eating you eat;
target_text: hèia na hia paredha mi dhèu ne, aku nèngu na, hua aaj'u aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara oka ne, èu bisa mu'a.

source_text: but from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, you do not eat from it, for in the day of your eating from it-dying you die.
target_text: te ngaa èci dhu èu bisa boe mu'a. nuka hua nèti aj'u dhu ne'a hag'e mia dhu be'a, aa mia dhu karehe. ladhe mu'a, èu madhe dènge.

source_text: and yhwh god says, it is not good for the man to be alone; i make him a helper as his counterpart.
target_text: ka ama lamatua tuhu haru lii na, aku nèngu na, babe'a na aad'o, ladhe dhèu ne mamuri mesa na. de ja'a neo paj'aj'i hia ne, anga ca dhèu dhu pamèci dènge ne.

source_text: and yhwh god forms from the ground every beast of the field, and every bird of the heavens, and brings them to the man, to see what he calls it; and whatever the man calls a living creature, that is its name. and the man calls names to all the livestock, and to bird of the heavens, and to every beast of the field; but for man a helper has not been found as his counterpart.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama lamatua nare rai ciki, ka na tao rupa-rupa badha dènge manu-bhui. hèia na pangèd'u si asa dhèu ne, sèna ka na pangare si. ka dhèu ne pangare badha se dènge manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ra, èci-èci ka dènge ngara ra. te ngaa dhèu ne abhu mèka anga dhu pamèci dènge nèngu.

source_text: and yhwh god causes a deep sleep to fall on the man, and he sleeps, and he takes one of his ribs, and closes up flesh in its stead.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua pabhèj'i luu dhèu ne'e. ropa na bhèj'i, ama lamatua nare rui karasa na calaa, ka na pakateme hari nu'a deo na.

source_text: and yhwh god builds up the rib which he has taken out of the man into a woman, and brings her to the man;
target_text: nèti rui ne, na paj'aj'i bhèni ca dhèu. hèia na pangèd'u bhèni ne mi dhèu èèna.

source_text: and the man says, this at last! bone of my bone, and flesh of my flesh! for this is called woman, for this has been taken from man;
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi bhèni ne, ka dhèu na peka, aku nèngu na, waaa! ne'e ne ku! sèmi ne'e ku, heka pamèci dènge ja'a kèna! rui na, sama èci èèna ka dènge rui ja'a. aa isi na, sama kahèi dènge isi ja'a. lula nèngu ne, j'aj'i nèti dhèu mone, nèti èèna ka ja'a pangare ne, ‘dhèu bhèni'.

source_text: therefore a man leaves his father and his mother, and has cleaved to his wife, and they have become one flesh.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone hud'i tèke eele ku ina-ama na, ho la'e mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na, lula dua ra, j'aj'i le èci.

source_text: and both of them are naked, the man and his wife, and they are not ashamed of themselves.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dua ra dhu dènge boe mèdha-papake, te ngaa ra makae boe.

source_text: and the serpent has been cunning above every beast of the field which yhwh god has made, and he says to the woman, is it true that god has said, you do not eat from every tree of the garden?
target_text: nèti badha aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne, mege ka dhu mèu risi kapod'e-kabèli. ca lod'o, mege karèi bhèni na, aku nèngu na, tare'a, do? ama lamatua kai miu baku mi'a hua aaj'u aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara oka ne'e.

source_text: and the woman says to the serpent, from the fruit of the trees of the garden we eat, but from the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, god has said, you do not eat of it, nor touch it, lest you die.
target_text: ka bhèni na b'ala, aad'o! ji'i bisa nga'a! dhodhoka aj'u ca kapua ètu talora oka ne, ama lamatua kai, baku nga'a hua na. na peka na, ji'i baku nga'a, aa baku g'ag'e hua èèna kahèi, te aad'o na, ji'i madhe!

source_text: and the serpent says to the woman, dying, you do not die,
target_text: te ngaa mege na dhaa, aku nèngu na, waa! sèmi boe èèna! miu se madhe boe!

source_text: for god knows that in the day of your eating of it-your eyes have been opened, and you have been as god, knowing good and evil.
target_text: ama lamatua mema kai tare'a sèmi èèna, lula dhu ne'a le, ladhe mi'e hua aaj'u èèna, miu j'aj'i d'èlu-mèu sèmi nèngu. ho èèna na me'a mia dhu be'a, aa mia dhu karehe.

source_text: and the woman sees that the tree is good for food, and that it is pleasant to the eyes, and the tree is desirable to make one wise, and she takes from its fruit and eats, and also gives some to her husband with her, and he eats;
target_text: aa bhèni ne ladhe na aj'u ne be'a titu kèna, dènge hua na ele boe kee. na ngee, ladhe ja'a ku'a hua aj'u ne'e, ja'a d'èlu-mèu. hèia puu nare ka hua aj'u èèna, ka na'e. na'e nare, nèti hia dhèu èmu na, ka na'a kahèi.

source_text: and the eyes of them both are opened, and they know that they are naked, and they sew fig-leaves, and make girdles for themselves.
target_text: ra'a rare ka, heka re'a na rèngu dhu pake boe mèdha dhu hutu ua rèngu. nèti èèna ka, ra lui rèu aj'u ho pa'abhe era makae rèngu.

source_text: and they hear the sound of yhwh god walking up and down in the garden at the breeze of the day, and the man and his wife hide themselves from the face of yhwh god in the midst of the trees of the garden.
target_text: d'ai lod'o nihia, dua ra tadèngi lii core haga ama lamatua ètu d'ara oka èèna. ka dua ra rai lasi lu'u asa ca bèka aj'u, sèna ka lamatua baku nèdhi si.

source_text: and yhwh god calls to the man and says to him, where are you?
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua paroa mi dhèu mone èèna, aku nèngu na, adam! èu ètu mia?

source_text: and he says, i have heard your sound in the garden, and i am afraid, for i am naked, and i hide myself.
target_text: hèia mone na dhaa, ja'a tadèngi lii lamatua ètu ne'e. te ngaa ja'a makae, lula ja'a pake boe mèdha ètu ua. nèti èèna ka, ja'a rai pahuni iisi.

source_text: and he says, who has declared to you that you are naked? have you eaten from the tree of which i have commanded you not to eat?
target_text: ka lamatua peka na, cee ka dhu peka, na èu dhu pake boe mèdha-papake? de tasamia? tatu èu mu'a le hua aj'u dhu ja'a kai na, sina ma?

source_text: and the man says, the woman whom you placed with me-she has given to me from the tree, and i eat.
target_text: ka na b'ala, peka na, bhèni dhu èu hia ho pa'anga dènge ja'a èèna, ka dhu hia ja'a ku'a!

source_text: and yhwh god says to the woman, what is this you have done? and the woman says, the serpent has caused me to forget, and i eat.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka dènge bhèni na, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka, èu ad'u madha j'ara èèna? ka bhèni ne dhaa, peka na, te mege ne ka dhu ag'o ja'a! nèti èèna ka, ja'a ku'a.

source_text: and yhwh god says to the serpent, because you have done this, cursed are you above all the livestock, and above every beast of the field: on your belly you go, and dust you eat, for all days of your life;
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua dhoo mege èèna, aku nèngu na, ja'a huku èu, lula tatao èu. nèti badha aa'i-aa'i, dhoka èu di dhu abhu huku sèmi ne'e. mulai nèti deo ne'e toke èu madhe, èu dhoka rod'o dènge kakara, aa mu'a ètu rai di.

source_text: and i put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; he bruises your head, and you bruise his heel.
target_text: ja'a tao sèna ka, èu loe boe pamusu dènge bhèni ne. aa ana-èpu miu dua mi sèmi èèna kahèi. ana-èpu èu, èèna na kadhi hui tèdhu dhèu. te ngaa ca dhèu nèti ana-èpu bhèni ne, èèna na dhedhe palaho kètu èu.

source_text: to the woman he said, multiplying i multiply your sorrow and your conception; you will bear children in sorrow, and your desire is toward your man or husband, and he or he will rule over you.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua peka dènge bhèni ne, èèna na, ja'a pasusa tabha èu, ropa èu dènge babia; lod'o mora iisi, èu asa tabha j'èra. masi ka sèmi èèna, d'ara èu d'èi taruu dhèu èmu èu, aa nèngu ka dhu ator èu.

source_text: and to the man he said, because you have listened to the voice of your wife, and eat from the tree concerning which i have charged you, saying, you do not eat of it, cursed is the ground on your account; in sorrow you eat of it for all days of your life,
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge mone ne, èu madhutu boe lii paredha ja'a, te ngaa èu nanene dhoka lii dhèu èmu èu di, ka èu mu'a hua aj'u dhu ja'a kai èèna. nèti èèna ka, èu abhu huku kahèi. aa rai lèke huku kahèi. nèti deo ne'e, toke d'ai èu madhe, hud'i èu kabèli rai, heka èu abhu nganga'a kèna. dènge sab'a bia sèmi ne'e ka, èu heka mamuri kèna.

source_text: and it brings forth thorn and bramble for you, and you have eaten the herb of the field;
target_text: masi ka èu sèle rupa-rupa hini èèna ka, te ngaa dhu muri mai dhodhoka dhudhu-sete di.

source_text: by the sweat of your face you eat bread until your return to the ground, for you have been taken out of it, for dust you are, and to dust you return.
target_text: hud'i èu èi kabhèsu haa ku, heka rai hia èu nganga'a kèna. èu hud'i sab'a bia sèmi èèna ku, toke d'ai lod'o èu madhe. èu ne, ja'a paj'aj'i nèti rai. de ladhe èu madhe, èu j'aj'i hari rai.

source_text: and the man calls his wife's name eve, for she has been mother of all living.
target_text: èle èèna ka, adam pangare dhèu èmu na ‘hawa' dhu sasoa na ‘dhu mamuri', te nèngu ka j'aj'i ina nèti dhèu dhu mamuri aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and yhwh god makes coats of skin for the man and his wife, and clothes them.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua tao mèdha-papake nèti ka'uri badha, ka papake dua ra.

source_text: and yhwh god says, behold, the man was as one of us, as to the knowledge of good and evil; and now, lest he send forth his hand, and has also taken from the tree of life, and eaten, and lived for all time.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka, limuri ne, dhèu re'a le, mia dhu be'a dènge mia dhu karehe, sèmi èdhi kahèi. de mage dhoka, rèngu ra'a hua aj'u dhu èci hari na, dhu hia mamuri taa-taa.

source_text: yhwh god sends him forth from the garden of eden to serve the ground from which he has been taken;
target_text: èle èèna ka, na babèga eele si nèti d'ara oka eden èèna, ho lasi asa era leo, sèna ka ra mamuri dènge sab'e oka-tedhe. lula dhèu j'aj'i nèti rai, de mamuri kahèi nèti rai.

source_text: indeed, he casts out the man, and causes the cherubim to dwell at the east of the garden of eden with the sword of flame whirling around to guard the way of the tree of life.
target_text: babège nare si, ka lamatua paredha ana pajuu na nèti sorga, dhu dènge èla, ho lasi j'aga oka èèna re ca bèka dhimu. rèngu dènge samala dhu heo ha'a-ha'a, dhu seru la'e-mai. lamatua pua si bèdho eele j'ara la'e sa d'ara, te nèngu d'èi boe dhèu puu rare hua aj'u dhu hia ra mamuri taa-taa èèna.

source_text: and the man knew his wife eve, and she conceives and bears cain, and says, i have acquired a man by yhwh;
target_text: hèia adam j'unu dènge dhèu èmu na, hawa. ka bhèni ne dènge babia. hèia nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a abhu le ana mone ca dhèu, lula ama lamatua soru nare le ja'a. ka na pangare ana ne, kaen dhu sasoa na ‘abhu'.

source_text: and she adds to bear his brother, even abel. and abel is feeding a flock, and cain has been servant of the ground.
target_text: hèia hawa nara iisi hari ana mone èci. ka na pangare ne habel. dua ra kapai ka, habel j'aj'i dhèu madhenge badha. aa a'a na kaen, sab'a oka-tedhe.

source_text: and it comes to pass at the end of days that cain brings from the fruit of the ground a present to yhwh;
target_text: ca lod'o, kaen nèti isi rai na cahag'e, ka hia lamatua.

source_text: and abel, he has brought, he also, from the female firstlings of his flock, and from their fat ones; and yhwh looks to abel and to his present,
target_text: habel nèti ana-ana uuru kahib'i-kalèbho na. na roro kahib'i-kalèbho se, ka nèti sisi dhu be'a hia lamatua. d'ara ama lamatua karej'e ropa ladhe nèdhi korban nèti habel ne.

source_text: and to cain and to his present he has not looked; and it is very displeasing to cain, and his countenance is fallen.
target_text: te ngaa na d'èi boe korban unu kaen. hèia kaen nasa bia, ka rèhu na mare boe.

source_text: and yhwh says to cain, why do you have displeasure? and why has your countenance fallen?
target_text: ka lamatua lii dènge kaen, aku nèngu na, kaen! nga tao ka èu nasa sèmi èèna, ka rèhu èu mare boe?

source_text: is there not, if you do well, acceptance? and if you do not do well, sin or a sin-offering is lying at the opening, and its or his desire is for you, and you rule over it or by him.
target_text: ladhe tatao èu be'a, na ja'a sèmi èu dènge hua iia. de mu pangee uuru ku! ladhe èu tao bhelu, na bhabhelu èèna na'e hari èu, sama sèmi meo neo pacèli maraho. de sèmi èu neo tao bhabhelu, be'a risi core eele ka!

source_text: and cain says to his brother abel, let us go into the field; and it comes to pass in their being in the field, that cain rises up against his brother abel, and slays him.
target_text: ca tèka, kaen gale habel, na peka na, mai lati ngad'o oka, we. ropa dua ra d'ai d'ara oka, kaen kalabhe pamadhe ari na.

source_text: and yhwh says to cain, where is your brother abel? and he says, i have not known; am i my brother's keeper?
target_text: ka lamatua karèi kaen, aku nèngu na, kaen! ari mu ka mia? hèia kaen dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ke'a boe na ètu mia! èu ngee na, ja'a dhèu kèpe haga na, do?

source_text: and he says, what have you done? the voice of your brother's blood is crying to me from the ground;
target_text: ka lamatua b'ala, nga tao ka èu bhelu sèmi èèna? baku pangee na, èu pahuni more le raa ari èu ètu d'ara rai, te ja'a dhu kèdhi aa'i-aa'i le!

source_text: and now, cursed are you from the ground, which has opened her mouth to receive the blood of your brother from your hand;
target_text: de lii dhoo lèke le mi dedha èu. lod'o èu pamadhe ari èu, rai sakid'o nare raa na. de limuri ne, rai bisa heka nèti mamuri mi èu.

source_text: when you till the ground, it will not add to give its strength to you-a wanderer, even a trembling one, you are in the earth.
target_text: de ladhe èu sab'a oka-tedhe, rai ne hia heka èu ngaa-ngaa. nèti deo ne'e, èu lu'u sa haa-sa dhimu, sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe era paleo-palu'u.

source_text: and cain says to yhwh, my punishment is too great than to bear;
target_text: te ngaa kaen b'ala lamatua, aku nèngu na, haii! ama lamatua, ee! lamatua dhoo ja'a bia titu kèna, de ja'a pasae mèke boe nga.

source_text: behold, you have driven me today from off the face of the ground, and from your face i am hid; and i have been a wanderer, even a trembling one, in the earth, and it has been-everyone finding me will slay me.
target_text: lula lamatua bège eele ja'a nèti era ne'e, ja'a kaj'èu nèti ama lamatua. ja'a kako lole-laa asa mia-mia. de ladhe paraga dènge dhèu, èèna na ra pamadhe ja'a.

source_text: and yhwh says to him, therefore, of any slayer of cain it is required sevenfold; and yhwh sets to cain a token that none finding him will slay him.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua dhaa na, aad'o sèmi èèna! dhèu cee dhu pamadhe èu, èèna na ja'a huku ne, babia na pidhu hari risi nèti èu. hèia lamatua tao tadha mi kaen, sèna ka dhèu re'a ho baku pamadhe ne.

source_text: and cain goes out from before yhwh, and dwells in the land, moving about east of eden;
target_text: hèia kaen tèke eele dènge era èèna. la'e pakaj'èu nèti lamatua, asa era èci, ètu bèka dhimu oka eden. era ne'e, ngara na nod dhu sasoa na, ‘lole-laa'. ka na pea ètu era èèna.

source_text: and cain knows his wife, and she conceives, and bears enoch; and he is building a city, and he calls the name of the city, according to the name of his son-enoch.
target_text: hèia kaen leo-èmu, ka dhèu èmu na dènge babia. ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, dhu pangare na henok. hèia kaen patitu rae cue, ngara na henok, madhutu ngara ana na.

source_text: and born to enoch is irad; and irad has begotten mehujael; and mehujael has begotten methusael; and methusael has begotten lamech.
target_text: ka henok matana irad. hèia irad matana mehuyael. mehuyael matana metusael. aa ana metusael, lamek.

source_text: and lamech takes to himself two wives, the name of the first adah, and the name of the second zillah.
target_text: dhèu èmu lamek, dhèu dua. èci ngara na ada, aa ca dhèu hari, ngara na sila.

source_text: and adah bears jabal, he has been father of those inhabiting tents and having purchased livestock;
target_text: ana ada, ngara na yabal. ana-èpu na, j'aj'i dhèu piara badha. mamuri ra ètu boe ca era, aa ra pea dhoka ètu d'ara paleo di.

source_text: and the name of his brother is jubal, he has been father of everyone handling harp and pipe.
target_text: ari yabal, ngara na yubal. ana-èpu yubal, j'aj'i dhèu gai sasadhu, dènge tiu sakino.

source_text: and zillah, she also bears tubal-cain, an instructor of every craftsman in bronze and iron; and a sister of tubal-cain is naamah.
target_text: dhèu èmu lamek èci hari, sila, nara iisi tubal kaen. ana-èpu na j'aj'i tuka bèsi, ka ra tuku mèdha ae-ae tao nèti bèsi, dènge tabaga. ana hèni tubal kaen, ngara na na'ama.

source_text: and lamech says to his wives: adah and zillah, hear my voice; wives of lamech, give ear to my saying: for i have slain a man for my wound, || even a young man for my hurt;
target_text: ca tèka, lamek padedha iisi na ètu madha dhèu èmu dua ra, peka na, mi nanene, ee! deo na, ana mone ngèru èci neo game ja'a. te ngaa ja'a dhadhedhe ne, toke madhe.

source_text: for sevenfold is required for cain, || and for lamech seventy-sevenfold.
target_text: dhèu dhu pamadhe kaen, abhu huku pidhu hari. te ngaa cee ka dhu neo b'ala ho pamadhe ja'a, abhu huku pidhu nguru pidhu hari.

source_text: and adam again knows his wife, and she bears a son, and calls his name seth, for god has appointed for me another seed instead of abel: for cain had slain him.
target_text: ka hawa nara iisi hari ana mone ca dhèu. hèia ra pangare ne, set dhu sasoa na, ‘hia', lula aku hawa na, ama lamatua hia ja'a ana ne, sèna ka gati madha habel, dhu kaen pamadhe ne.

source_text: and to seth, to him also a son has been born, and he calls his name enos; then a beginning was made of preaching in the name of yhwh.
target_text: pe d'ai nèbhu ku, set abhu ana mone ca dhèu, dhu pangare na enos. tèu èèna, dhèu mulai manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua.

source_text: this is an account of the generations of adam. in the day of god's creating man, in the likeness of god he has made him; a male and a female he has created them, and he blesses them, and calls their name man, in the day of their being created.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha, na tao si sama sèmi rupa nèngu. na paj'aj'i si, dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni. ka na pangare si ‘dhèu rai-haha', aa na hia si berkat. dhèu dhu uru, ngara na adam. ana-èpu adam, nuka sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: and adam lives one hundred and thirty years or two hundred and thirty years, and begets a son in his likeness, according to his image, and calls his name seth.
target_text: lod'o adam d'ai ca ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, dhu rèhu na nare adam. ka pangare na, set.

source_text: and the days of adam after his begetting seth are eight hundred years or seven hundred years, and he begets sons and daughters.
target_text: ka adam mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu tèu, hèia na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of adam which he lived are nine hundred and thirty years, and he dies.
target_text: umur adam ceo ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: and seth lives one hundred and five years or two hundred and five years, and begets enos.
target_text: lod'o set d'ai ca ngasu lèmi tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na enos.

source_text: and seth lives after his begetting enos eight hundred and seven years or seven hundred and seven years, and begets sons and daughters.
target_text: ka set mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu pidhu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of seth are nine hundred and twelve years, and he dies.
target_text: umur set ceo ngasu canguru dua tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: and enos lives ninety years or one hundred and ninety years, and begets cainan.
target_text: lod'o enos mamuri d'ai ceo nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na kenan.

source_text: and enos lives after his begetting cainan eight hundred and fifteen years or seven hundred and fifteen years, and begets sons and daughters.
target_text: ka enos mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu canguru lèmi tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of enos are nine hundred and five years, and he dies.
target_text: umur enos ceo ngasu lèmi tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: and cainan lives seventy years or one hundred and seventy years, and begets mahalaleel.
target_text: lod'o kenan d'ai pidhu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na mahalalel.

source_text: and cainan lives after his begetting mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years or seven hundred and forty years, and begets sons and daughters.
target_text: ka kenan mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu èpa nguru tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of cainan are nine hundred and ten years, and he dies.
target_text: umur kenan ceo ngasu canguru tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: and mahalaleel lives sixty-five years or one hundred and sixty-five years, and begets jared.
target_text: lod'o mahalalel d'ai èna nguru lèmi tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na yared.

source_text: and mahalaleel lives after his begetting jared eight hundred and thirty years or seven hundred and thirty years, and begets sons and daughters.
target_text: ka mahalalel mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of mahalaleel are eight hundred and ninety-five years, and he dies.
target_text: umur mahalalel aru ngasu ceo nguru lèmi tèu, heka na madhe kèna.

source_text: and jared lives one hundred and sixty-two years, and begets enoch.
target_text: lod'o yared d'ai cangasu èna nguru dua tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na henok.

source_text: and jared lives after his begetting enoch eight hundred years, and begets sons and daughters.
target_text: ka yared mamuri d'ai aru ngasu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of jared are nine hundred and sixty-two years, and he dies.
target_text: umur yared ceo ngasu èna nguru dua tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: and enoch lives sixty-five years or one hundred and sixty-five years, and begets methuselah.
target_text: ropa henok mamuri d'ai èna nguru lèmi tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na metusalak.

source_text: and enoch habitually walks with god after his begetting methuselah three hundred years or two hundred years, and begets sons and daughters.
target_text: ele èèna, henok mamuri d'ara èci dènge ama lamatua d'ai tèlu ngasu tèu. ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of enoch are three hundred and sixty-five years. and enoch habitually walks with god, and he is not, for god has taken him.
target_text: na mamuri d'ara èci dènge ama lamatua. hèia lod'o na d'ai tèlu ngasu èna nguru lèmi tèu, ka na ele, lula ama lamatua paca'e ne sa dedha.

source_text: and methuselah lives one hundred and eighty-seven years, and begets lamech.
target_text: lod'o metusalak d'ai cangasu aru nguru pidhu tèu, na matana ana mone èci, ngara na lamek.

source_text: and methuselah lives after his begetting lamech seven hundred and eighty-two years, and begets sons and daughters.
target_text: èle èèna ka, metusalak mamuri hari d'ai pidhu ngasu aru nguru dua tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of methuselah are nine hundred and sixty-nine years, and he dies.
target_text: umur metusalak ceo ngasu èna nguru ceo tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: and lamech lives one hundred and eighty-two years or one hundred and eighty-eight years, and begets a son,
target_text: lod'o lamek mamuri d'ai ca ngasu aru nguru dua tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: and calls his name noah, saying, this one comforts us concerning our work, and concerning the labor of our hands, because of the ground which yhwh has cursed.
target_text: lamek pangare ne noh dhu sasoa na ‘pakarej'e d'ara', lula na peka na, ana ne, èèna na pakarej'e d'ara èdhi nèti sasab'a dhu bia, ètu rai dhu ama lamatua dhoo le.

source_text: and lamech lives after his begetting noah five hundred and ninety-five years or five hundred and sixty-five years, and begets sons and daughters.
target_text: ka lamek mamuri taruu d'ai lèmi ngasu ceo nguru lèmi tèu, aa na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of lamech are seven hundred and seventy-seven years or seven hundred and fifty-three years, and he dies.
target_text: umur lamek pidhu ngasu pidhu nguru pidhu tèu, heka na madhe kèna.

source_text: and noah is a son of five hundred years, and noah begets shem, ham, and japheth.
target_text: lod'o noh mamuri d'ai lèmi ngasu tèu, na matana ana mone dhèu tèlu, sem, yafet dènge ham.

source_text: and it comes to pass that mankind has begun to multiply on the face of the ground, and daughters have been born to them,
target_text: taa èèna, dhèu rai-haha, asa bèba-kacanga. ka ra papala-palème rai-haha. dhèu se matana kahèi ana-ana bhèni.

source_text: and the sons of god see that they, the daughters of men, are beautiful, and they take women for themselves of all whom they have chosen.
target_text: ana-ana mone nèti lamatua ladhe rèdhi ana bhèni nèti dhèu rai-haha se, bhèni iia hua. ka lasi todhe rare ana bhèni mia dhu ra d'èi.

source_text: and yhwh says, my spirit does not strive in man for all time, for indeed, he is flesh, but his days have been one hundred and twenty years.
target_text: ka lamatua peka na, ja'a roca le dènge tatao dhèu dhu lèke-lèke boe se. roh ja'a dhu pamamuri rèngu sa, d'èi heka hia ra mamuri manèro. hud'i rèngu madhe ku. de èèna na, mamuri rèngu se dhoka d'ai ca ngasu dua nguru tèu di.

source_text: the giants were in the earth in those days, and even afterward, when sons of god come in to the daughters of men, and they have borne to them those who were the mighty from of old, the men of renown.
target_text: taa èèna, dènge taa-tebho dhu limuri nèti èèna hari, abhu le dhèu raksasa ètu rai-haha ne. ropa ana mone nèti lamatua leo rare ana bhèni dhèu rai-haha se, ka rara iisi dhèu kapai, nuka: kapala musu, dhèu re'a madhutu lii lolo uru-uru sèra.

source_text: and yhwh sees that the wickedness of man is abundant in the earth, and every imagination of the thoughts of his heart is only evil every day;
target_text: taa èèna, lamatua ladhe nèdhi bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu rai-haha dhu seli-kolane. d'ara rèngu pangee dhoka bhabhelu di.

source_text: and yhwh regrets that he has made man in the earth, and he grieves himself-to his heart.
target_text: ka lamatua manyasa, lula na paj'aj'i le rèngu se ho pea ètu rai-haha ne. tatao rèngu ne'e ka dhu papèd'a d'ara lamatua.

source_text: and yhwh says, i wipe away man whom i have created from off the face of the ground, from man to beast, to creeping thing, and to bird of the heavens, for i have regretted that i have made them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na peka na, dènge tatao rèngu sèmi èèna na, ja'a huku pamadhe dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i dhu paj'aj'i kore si le. manu-bhui dènge badha leo sèra, ja'a palaho aa'i si kahèi. te ja'a manyasa, nèti ja'a ka paj'aj'i si.

source_text: and noah found grace in the eyes of yhwh.
target_text: te ngaa noh di dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: these are the generations of noah: noah is a righteous man; he has been perfect among his generations; noah has habitually walked with god. and noah begets three sons: shem, ham, and japheth.
target_text: lii lolo noh sèmi ne'e ka: ana mone na, dhèu tèlu, nuka sem, yafet dènge ham. noh mamuri dènge mola, koe-kapengo boe. taa èèna, nèngu di dhu mamuri mola. d'ara na dhodhoka ètu ama lamatua.

source_text: and the earth is corrupt before god, and the earth is filled with violence. and god sees the earth, and behold, it has been corrupted, for all flesh has corrupted its way on the earth.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu leo se, ama lamatua ladhe ra bhelu aa'i mèu-mèu. ètu mia-mia èèna ka, j'ara mamuri dhèu se ele iie aa'i. ama lamatua nèdhi dhodhoka bhabhelu di, ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and god said to noah, an end of all flesh has come before me, for the earth has been full of violence from their presence; and behold, i am destroying them with the earth.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka dènge noh, aku nèngu na, ja'a kèdhi dhoka bhabhelu dhèu di, dhu pale-lème rai-haha ne. ka ja'a pama'ète kore le, sèna ka ja'a palaho aa'i rai-haha ne dènge isi na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: make an ark of gopher-wood for yourself; you make rooms within the ark, and you have covered it from inside and from outside with pitch;
target_text: de sèmi ne'e, noh! èu tao kapa aae cue, dhu tao nèti aj'u adhu. re d'ara roa na, èu bagi mi kama-kama. aa re d'ara dènge li'u kapa, èu lame dènge èi dama.

source_text: and this is how you do it: three hundred cubits is the length of the ark, fifty cubits its breadth, and thirty cubits its height;
target_text: mu sab'e kapa na, madhera na ca ngasu tèlu nguru tèlu meter; bhabhèla na dua nguru dua meter; dènge katitu na canguru tèlu meter.

source_text: you make a window for the ark, and you finish it to a cubit from above; and you put the opening of the ark in its side; you make it with lower, second, and third stories.
target_text: èu tao èmu ètu dedha kapa na. te ngaa paconga ca laa ai nèti kadidhi re dedha. èu bagi kapa ne mi tèlu tad'a. aa re karasa na, tao babèdho èci.

source_text: and i, behold, i am bringing in the flood of waters on the earth, to destroy from under the heavens all flesh in which is a living spirit; all that is in the earth expires.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! bèli-camèd'a, ja'a papuru èi aae lala, ho pacène eele rai-haha ne, sèna ka pamadhe aa'i dhu mamuri.

source_text: and i have established my covenant with you, and you have come into the ark-you, and your sons, and your wife, and your son's wives with you;
target_text: te ngaa ja'a pa'èki lii pajaji dènge èu. èèna na, èu maso d'ara kapa èèna, mèti dènge dhèu èmu èu, ana-ana èu, dènge dhèu èmu ana-ana èu.

source_text: and of all that lives, of all flesh, you bring two from every kind into the ark, to keep alive with you; they are male and female. from the bird after its kind, and from the livestock after its kind, and from every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every kind they come to you, to keep alive.
target_text: badha aa'i-aa'i ra, èu hag'e more ca pasa-ca pasa, eo mèti asa d'ara kapa, ho ra abhu mamuri dènge èu kahèi. sèmi: badha ani, manu-bhui, dènge badha dhu rod'o, sèna ka ra abhu mamuri.

source_text: and you, take for yourself from all food that is eaten; and you have gathered it to yourself, and it has been for you and for them for food.
target_text: èu hud'i mèti dènge nganga'a-nganginu, pala miu dènge pala badha sèra hèi.

source_text: and noah does according to all that god has commanded him; so he has done.
target_text: ka noh sab'e madhutu sèmi lii paredha ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: and yhwh says to noah, come, you and all your house, into the ark, for i have seen you are righteous before me in this generation;
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua peka dènge noh, ja'a ladhe le palème, te ngaa abhu dhoka èu di dhu d'ara mola. nèti èèna ka, èu dènge bhèni-ana niki èu, lami ka asa d'ara kapa.

source_text: you take seven pairs from all the clean beasts to yourself, a male and its female; and of the beasts which are not clean-two, a male and its female; also, seven pairs from each bird of the heavens, a male and a female, to keep alive seed on the face of all the earth;
target_text: mèti dènge badha-badha dhu bisa mi'a, aa bisa hia ja'a kahèi, de mèti pidhu-pidhu pasa asa d'ara kapa. mèti kahèi rupa-rupa manu-bhui pidhu-pidhu pasa. te ngaa badha dhu leo, mèti dhoka ca pasa-ca pasa di. sèna ka badha dènge manu-bhui se, j'aj'i hini, ho baku ma'ète.

source_text: for after seven more days i am sending rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, and have wiped away all the substance that i have made from off the face of the ground.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie, oo! di pidhu lod'o ka, ja'a papuru èj'i aae mai dhu bhoka boe ca lod'o sa, toke d'ai èpa nguru lod'o mèu-mèda. dènge sèmi ne'e, ja'a pamadhe aa'i ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri ètu dedha-rai, dhu ja'a paj'aj'i kore le.

source_text: and noah does according to all that yhwh has commanded him.
target_text: ka noh tao aa'i sèmi lii paredha lamatua.

source_text: and noah is a son of six hundred years, and the flood of waters has been on the earth.
target_text: lod'o èi aae lala, umur noh èna ngasu tèu.

source_text: and noah goes-and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him-into the ark, out of the presence of the waters of the flood;
target_text: noh dènge dhèu èmu na, dènge ana niki na, aa dènge dhèu èmu ana ra di, lasi asa d'ara kapa, ho ra abhu mamuri.

source_text: from the clean beast, and from the beast that is not clean, and from the bird, and of everything that is creeping on the ground, they have come to noah two by two into the ark, a male and a female, as god has commanded noah.
target_text: madhutu lii paredha lamatua, ka noh pamaso manu-bhui dènge badha leo sèra, èci-èci ka dènge pasa na, nèti dhu bisa ra'a, dènge dhu bisa boe ra'a.

source_text: and it comes to pass, after seven days, that waters of the flood have been on the earth.
target_text: ropa èle pidhu lod'o, cag'ag'a laa èi aae lala, ka rai-haha ne, mulai cène.

source_text: in the six hundredth year of the life of noah, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on this day all the fountains of the great deep have been broken up, and the network of the heavens has been opened,
target_text: lèke dènge umur noh èna ngasu tèu, risi dua hèru, canguru pidhu lod'o, ka mulai èi aae lala. lod'o èèna, sèmi babèdho liru dhu bhoke eele sa, ka èi na tao sabhori mai. aa èi madha-èi madha ètu rai-haha sabhoka, ka sèmi tao sabhuu sa dedha.

source_text: and the shower is on the earth for forty days and forty nights.
target_text: ka èj'i bhori mai loe boe èpa nguru lod'o mèu-mèda.

source_text: on this very same day noah, and shem, and ham, and japheth, sons of noah, and noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, went into the ark-
target_text: te ngaa lod'o èèna, noh dènge dhèu èmu na, dènge ana mone na dhèu tèlu: sem, yafet dènge ham, dènge dhèu èmu ra, maso lasi asa d'ara kapa.

source_text: they, and every living creature after its kind, and every beast after its kind, and every creeping thing that is creeping on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind every bird, every wing.
target_text: lasi palere dènge badha aa'i-aa'i ra, sèmi: badha ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, manu-bhui, dènge badha-badha leo dhu dènge èla sèra.

source_text: and they come to noah, into the ark, two by two of all the flesh in which is a living spirit; and they that are coming in, male and female of all flesh, have come in as god has commanded him, and yhwh closes it for him.
target_text: ca pasa-ca pasa nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, lasi asa d'ara kapa palere dènge noh, madhutu sèmi lii paredha ama lamatua. ropa aa'i-aa'i ra d'ai d'ara kapa, lamatua bèdho babèdho kapa èèna.

source_text: and the flood is on the earth for forty days, and the waters multiply and lift up the ark, and it is raised up from off the earth; and the waters are mighty and multiply exceedingly on the earth; and the ark goes on the face of the waters. and the waters have been very, very mighty on the earth, and all the high mountains are covered which are under the whole heavens;
target_text: èj'i aae puru ma'ète boe d'ai èpa nguru lod'o. hèia kapa èèna taleb'o. èi ca'e loe boe toke hutu nare kolo ledhe dhu dedha aae.

source_text: the waters prevailed from above the mountains, and cover them fifteen cubits;
target_text: èi ca'e taruu, ka marèma na seli èpa rèpa risi nèti kolo ledhe sèra.

source_text: and all flesh expires that is moving on the earth, among bird, and among livestock, and among beast, and among every teeming thing which is teeming on the earth, and all mankind; all in whose nostrils is breath of a living spirit-of all that is in the dry land-have died. and all the substance that is on the face of the ground is wiped away-from man to beast, to creeping thing, and to bird of the heavens; indeed, they are wiped away from the earth, and only noah is left, and those who are with him in the ark;
target_text: dènge j'ara èèna, ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri ètu dedha-rai sèra, madhe aa'i mèu-mèu. nuka: dhèu, badha ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, dènge manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ra. ate dhoka noh dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu dedha kapa.

source_text: and the waters are mighty on the earth for one hundred and fifty days.
target_text: èi na, kura boe toke ca ngasu lèmi nguru lod'o.

source_text: and god remembers noah, and every living thing, and all the livestock which are with him in the ark, and god causes a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters subside,
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, ama lamatua bhèlu boe noh si dènge badha-manu aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu dedha kapa. hèia na hia ngèlu g'oro, ka èi na kura ka noo-noo.

source_text: and the fountains of the deep and the network of the heavens are closed, and the shower is restrained from the heavens.
target_text: na katange èi madha aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, aa na taha èj'i kahèi.

source_text: and the waters return from off the earth, going on and returning; and the waters are lacking at the end of one hundred and fifty days.
target_text: ka èi kura noo-noo ka. d'ai cangasu lèmi nguru lod'o, èi marèma heka.

source_text: and the ark rests, in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on mountains of ararat;
target_text: lèke dènge hèru ka pidhu, risi canguru pidhu lod'o, kapa eta ètu kolo ledhe aae èci, ngara na ararat.

source_text: and the waters have been going and decreasing until the tenth month; in the tenth month, on the first of the month, the heads of the mountains appeared.
target_text: èi kura taruu toke lod'o ka èci, hèru ka canguru, ka kolo-kolo ledhe cèu noo-noo.

source_text: and it comes to pass, at the end of forty days, that noah opens the window of the ark which he made,
target_text: risi nèti èpa nguru lod'o, hèia noh bhoke jendela èci.

source_text: and he sends forth the raven, and it goes out, going out and turning back until the drying of the waters from off the earth.
target_text: ka na patalale lakaa ci'u. manu-bhui ne lela la'e-mai, toke èi puru. ka na lèpa heka asa kapa.

source_text: and he sends forth the dove from him to see whether the waters have been lightened from off the face of the ground,
target_text: hèia noh patabuli hari, koro j'aha ci'u, sèna ka neo ne'a èi na puru le, do dhae.

source_text: and the dove has not found rest for the sole of her foot, and she turns back to him, to the ark, for waters are on the face of all the earth, and he puts out his hand, and takes her, and brings her in to him, into the ark.
target_text: te ngaa, lula èi hutu nare dedha-rai era, ka koro ne abhu boe era tèka. ka lèpa hari asa kapa. hèia noh j'ole ai na, kèpe nare, ka na pamaso hari asa d'ara kapa.

source_text: and he stays yet seven more days, and adds to send forth the dove from the ark;
target_text: ka noh tatae hari d'ai pidhu lod'o, hèia na patabuli hari koro j'aha deo na.

source_text: and the dove comes to him at evening, and behold, an olive leaf is torn off in her mouth; and noah knows that the waters have been lightened from off the earth.
target_text: d'ara lod'o nihia sa, koro ne lèpa hari la'e asa noh, tutu nèti dènge rèu saitun ca rèu dhu heka tutu nare kèna. nèti èèna ka, noh heka ne'a kèna, èi na dhu puru le tare'a di.

source_text: and he stays yet seven more days, and sends forth the dove, and it did not add to return to him anymore.
target_text: ka na mate hari d'ai pidhu lod'o, hèia na patalale hari koro j'aha ca hari ni. te ngaa ca tèka ne, koro ne lèpa heka.

source_text: and it comes to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first month, on the first of the month, the waters have been dried from off the earth; and noah turns aside the covering of the ark, and looks, and behold, the face of the ground has been dried.
target_text: lod'o noh mamuri d'ai èna ngasu ca tèu, lèke lod'o ka èci hèru èci, èi mèti aa'i le. hèia noh bhoke jendela, ka na ladhe palème, nèdhi rai dhu mango le.

source_text: and in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth has become dry.
target_text: d'ai hèru ka dua, lod'o ka dua nguru pidhu, dedha-rai ne dhu mango meto le.

source_text: and god speaks to noah, saying, go out from the ark, you, and your wife, and your sons, and your sons' wives with you;
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge noh,

source_text: every living thing that is with you, of all flesh, among bird, and among livestock, and among every creeping thing which is creeping on the earth, bring out with you;
target_text: noh! aa'i-aa'i mi puru ka nèti dedha kapa èèna.

source_text: and they have teemed in the earth, and been fruitful, and have multiplied on the earth.
target_text: papuru aa'i badha-manu sèra! nuka: badha ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, dènge manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ra. hud'i si, sèna ka ra bèba, papènu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and noah goes out, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him; every beast, every creeping thing, and every bird; every creeping thing on the earth, after their families, have gone out from the ark.
target_text: èle èèna ka, noh dènge dhèu èmu na, dènge ana-ana na, aa dènge dhèu èmu ana na sèra, aa'i-aa'i ra puru nèti dedha kapa èèna. badha se, aa'i-aa'i ra, kalua ka madhutu anga ra èci-èci.

source_text: and noah builds an altar to yhwh, and takes from every clean beast and from every clean bird, and causes burnt-offerings to ascend on the altar;
target_text: hèia noh pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban hia lamatua. nèti badha-badha dhu bisa ra'a sèra, noh nare ci'u-ci'u, ka na roro, tunu ètu dedha mei deo na, ho j'aj'i mi tadha makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: and yhwh smells the refreshing fragrance, and yhwh says to his heart, i do not continue to disfavor the ground because of man anymore, though the imagination of the heart of man is evil from his youth; and i do not continue to strike all living anymore, as i have done;
target_text: ropa lamatua sangèd'u nare hèu gèmu korban deo na, d'ara na karej'e. ka na ngee na, nèti deo ne'e ne, ja'a huku heka rai-haha ne, lula bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu. masi ka rèngu dhoka ngee bhabhelu di, ja'a pa'ele iie heka ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri, sèmi dhu ja'a heka tao kore èèna.

source_text: during all the days of the earth, seed-time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night never cease.
target_text: lod'o rai-haha ne era, hèru dènge tèu, kako madhutu atora. sèmi: hèru sèla dènge hèru puu-g'ètu, hèru pacuhi dènge hèru sagoro, hèru hadhu dènge hèru èj'i lai, mèu dènge mèda.

source_text: and god blesses noah and his sons, and says to them, be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the earth;
target_text: hèia ama lamatua pala-bagi berkat mi noh dènge ana-ana na, peka na, miu matana pa'ae-ae, sèna ka papènu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and your fear and your dread is on every beast of the earth, and on every bird of the heavens, on all that creeps on the ground, and on all fishes of the sea-into your hand they have been given.
target_text: ladhe èèna na, badha hui, manu-bhui dènge i'a aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u dènge miu. miu ka dhu ator si.

source_text: every creeping thing that is alive, to you it is for food; as the green herb i have given to you the whole;
target_text: sisi badha aa'i-aa'i, miu bisa mi'a, sèmi dhu mi'a hua-hela, dènge rèu ana aaj'u se. aa'i-aa'i se, ja'a hia miu.

source_text: only flesh in its life-its blood-you do not eat.
target_text: dhoka sisi dhu dènge raa era, miu madha mèu mi'a, lula samanga badha ètu raa na.

source_text: and only your blood for your lives do i require; from the hand of every living thing i require it, and from the hand of man, from the hand of every man's brother i require the life of man; whoever sheds man's blood, by man is his blood shed: for in the image of god has he made man.
target_text: ja'a paj'aj'i dhèu madhutu raropa ja'a. nèti èèna ka, baku pamadhe dhèu. ladhe abhu dhèu, do badha, dhu pamadhe dhèu, na, pamadhe ne kahèi. ne'e, lii paredha nèti ja'a.

source_text: and you, be fruitful and multiply, teem in the earth, and multiply in it.
target_text: miu se hud'i matana pa'ae-ae ku, sèna ka papènu hari rai-haha ne.

source_text: and god speaks to noah, and to his sons with him, saying,
target_text: ka ama lamatua tuhu hari lii padhai lii na,

source_text: and i, behold, i am establishing my covenant with you, and with your seed after you,
target_text: de ne'e ne, ja'a pajaji dènge miu, toke d'ai lai ana lai èpu.

source_text: and with every living creature which is with you, among bird, among livestock, and among every beast of the earth with you, from all who are going out of the ark-to every beast of the earth.
target_text: lii pajaji ne, lèke kahèi mi aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, sèmi: badha ani, badha hui, dènge manu-bhui. peka ka laa, lèke aa'i-aa'i dhu kalua palere-lere dènge miu nèti dedha kapa.

source_text: and i have established my covenant with you, and all flesh is not cut off anymore by waters of a flood, and there is not a flood to destroy the earth anymore.
target_text: lii pajaji ja'a sèmi ne'e: ja'a hia heka èi aae lala, ho pamadhe aa'i ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri, aa dènge pa'ele iie rai-haha ne.

source_text: and god says, this is a token of the covenant which i am giving between me and you, and every living creature that is with you, to continuous generations; my bow i have given in the cloud, and it has been for a token of a covenant between me and the earth;
target_text: ja'a pasa saroo ètu dedha-liru, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha pasanèd'e lii pajaji ja'a dhu ma'ète boe dènge miu, dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, aa dènge rai-haha ne.

source_text: and it has come to pass in my sending a cloud over the earth that the bow has been seen in the cloud, and i have remembered my covenant which is between me and you, and every living creature among all flesh, and the waters no longer become a flood to destroy all flesh; and the bow has been in the cloud, and i have seen it-to remember the perpetual covenant between god and every living creature among all flesh which is on the earth. and god says to noah, this is a token of the covenant which i have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.
target_text: ladhe abhu ra'i-liru, ho saroo cèu, èèna na pasanèd'e ja'a nèti lii pajaji èèna. na peka na, èi aae pa'ele iie heka aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri. dènge j'ara ne'e ne ka, lii pajaji ja'a dhu ma'ète boe, pa'èki tèke le dènge miu, aa dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri.

source_text: and the sons of noah who are going out of the ark are shem, and ham, and japheth; and ham is father of canaan.
target_text: ana-ana noh dhu puru nèti dedha kapa, sem, yafet dènge ham ham èèna, ama kana'an.

source_text: these three are sons of noah, and from these has all the earth been overspread.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ètu rai-haha ne, j'aj'i nèti ana noh dhèu tèlu sèra.

source_text: and noah remains a man of the ground, and plants a vineyard,
target_text: noh èèna, dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe. nèngu ka dhu uru j'ara tao oka anggor.

source_text: and drinks of the wine, and is drunken, and uncovers himself in the midst of the tent.
target_text: ca tèka, na ninu èi anggor, ka na mahu titu kèna. hèia na puru eele mèdha-papake nèti ua na. ka na j'unu lega-loli dènge boe mèdha-papake ètu d'ara paleo na.

source_text: and ham, father of canaan, sees the nakedness of his father, and declares to his two brothers outside.
target_text: ropa ham ladhe nèdhi era makae ama na, ka rai li'u la'e, lolo dènge a'a na, sem dènge yafet.

source_text: and shem takes-japheth also-the garment, and they place on the shoulder of them both, and go backward, and cover the nakedness of their father; and their faces are backward, and their father's nakedness they have not seen.
target_text: hèia dua ra rare sig'i-kalolo ca bèla, ka ra bhoke mema ètu kabela-kao ra. ka dua ra kako kabodho lasi asa d'ara paleo ama ra, sèna ka ra pahutu mi ngi'u na. dènge sèmi èèna, rèdhi boe era makae ama ra. èle èèna ka, ra kalua sa li'u.

source_text: and noah awakens from his wine, and knows that which his young son has done to him,
target_text: ropa noh mase'a, na ne'a tatao nèti ana limuri na, ham.

source_text: and says: cursed is canaan, || servant of servants he is to his brothers.
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, he! ama kana'an! ja'a dhoo èu! èu ne, èèna na j'aj'i ènu nèti a'a mu si!

source_text: and he says: blessed of my god yhwh is shem, || and canaan is servant to him.
target_text: koa-kio lamatua, lula sem! te ngaa kana'an j'aj'i ènu sem.

source_text: god gives beauty to japheth, || and he dwells in tents of shem, || and canaan is servant to him.
target_text: hud'i laa, ama lamatua pataleo rai unu yafet. aa ana-èpu na mamuri mera-milu dènge ana-èpu sem. te ngaa hud'i kana'an j'aj'i ènu yafet.

source_text: and noah lives after the flood three hundred and fifty years;
target_text: nèti èle èi aae lala, noh mamuri era d'ai tèlu ngasu lèmi nguru tèu.

source_text: and all the days of noah are nine hundred and fifty years, and he dies.
target_text: umur noh d'ai ceo ngasu lèmi nguru tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: and these are the generations of the sons of noah, shem, ham, and japheth: and sons are born to them after the flood.
target_text: èle èi aae, ka ana-ana noh abhu ana-èpu. nuka ana-èpu nèti sem, yafet, dènge ham.

source_text: sons of japheth are gomer, and magog, and madai, and javan, and tubal, and meshech, and tiras. and sons of gomer are ashkenaz, and riphath, and togarmah. and sons of javan are elishah, and tarshish, kittim, and dodanim. by these the islands of the nations have been parted in their lands, each by his tongue, by their families, in their nations.
target_text: ana-èpu yafet, nuka: gomer, magog, madai, yawan, tubal, mesek dènge tiras. èci-èci ka dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra. ana-èpu gomer, ka: askenas, rifat dènge togarma. ana-èpu yawan, ka: elisa, tarsis, dhèu kitim, dènge dhèu dodanim dhu pea ètu sebhe dhasi.

source_text: and sons of ham are cush, and mitzraim, and phut, and canaan.
target_text: ana-èpu ham, ka: kus, misraim, put, dènge kana'an.

source_text: and sons of cush are seba, and havilah, and sabtah, and raamah, and sabtechah; and sons of raamah are sheba and dedan.
target_text: ana-èpu kus, ka: seba, hawila, sabta, raema dènge sabteka. ana-èpu raema, ka: syeba dènge dedan.

source_text: and cush has begotten nimrod;
target_text: ana mone kus, ka, nimrod. nèngu ne, kapala musu dhu uru tèka, aa èra.

source_text: he has begun to be a hero in the land; he has been a hero in hunting before yhwh; therefore it is said, as nimrod the hero in hunting before yhwh.
target_text: a'èra na mai nèti lamatua, aa nèngu kahèi j'aj'i dhèu dhu èra bia magèla badha. nèti èèna ka, dhèu biasa peka na, sèna ka èu more dhèu dhu èra bia magèla badha, sèmi nimrod, dhu abhu a'èra nèti lamatua.

source_text: and the first part of his kingdom is babel, and erech, and accad, and calneh, in the land of shinar;
target_text: era na, mulai uru nèti rae babel, erek akad, toke kalne. rae se aa'i-aa'i ra, ètu rai sinear.

source_text: from that land he has gone out to asshur, and builds nineveh, even the broad places of the city, and calah,
target_text: nèti era sèra, na nare hari asyur. ka na patitu kota niniwe, rehobot-ir, kala,

source_text: and resen, between nineveh and calah; it is the great city.
target_text: dènge resen, ètu talora aae niniwe dènge kala. aa'i-aa'i sèra, kota-kota kapai hua.

source_text: and mitzraim has begotten the ludim, and the anamim, and the lehabim, and the naphtuhim,
target_text: ana-èpu misraim, ka: dhèu ludim, dhèu ananim, dhèu lehabim, dhèu naftuhim,

source_text: and the pathrusim, and the casluhim from where have come out philistim, and the caphtorim.
target_text: dhèu patrusim, dhèu kasluhim, dènge dhèu kaftorim. dhèu kasluhim nuka bèi-baki nèti dhèu pilistin.

source_text: and canaan has begotten sidon his firstborn, and heth,
target_text: ana uuru kana'an, nuka, sidon. kana'an j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu het,

source_text: and the jebusite, and the amorite, and the girgashite,
target_text: dhèu yebusi, dhèu amori, dhèu girgasi,

source_text: and the hivite, and the arkite, and the sinite,
target_text: dhèu hiwi, dhèu arki, dhèu sini,

source_text: and the arvadite, and the zemarite, and the hamathite; and afterward the families of the canaanite have been scattered.
target_text: dhèu arwadi, dhèu semari, dènge dhèu hamati. ana-èpu kana'an se, pea palème d'ai era dhu kaj'èu,

source_text: and the border of the canaanite is from sidon, in your coming toward gerar, to gaza; in your coming toward sodom, and gomorrah, and admah, and zeboim, to lasha.
target_text: toke too rai rèngu mulai nèti sidon taruu asa gerar, d'ai gasa. nèti èèna, la'e d'ai sodom, gomora, adma dènge seboim, d'ai kota lasa.

source_text: these are sons of ham, by their families, by their tongues, in their lands, in their nations.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i sèra, ana-èpu ham. èci-èci dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra.

source_text: as for shem, father of all sons of eber, the older brother of japheth, he has also begotten.
target_text: sem, a'a yafet, nèngu ka j'aj'i bèi-baki dhèu eber.

source_text: sons of shem are elam, and asshur, and arphaxad, and lud, and aram.
target_text: ana-èpu sem, ka: elam, asyur, arpaksad, lud dènge aram.

source_text: and sons of aram are uz, and hul, and gether, and mash.
target_text: ana-èpu aram ka: dhèu us, dhèu hul, dhèu geter, dènge dhèu mas.

source_text: and arphaxad has begotten salah, and salah has begotten eber.
target_text: ana arpaksad ka, sela. ana sela ka, eber.

source_text: and two sons have been born to eber; the name of the first is peleg for in his days the earth has been divided, and his brother's name is joktan.
target_text: ana eber, mone dhèu dua. ana uuru, ngara na pelek dhu sasoa na ‘palème era', lula taa èèna dhèu pea palème ètu rai-haha ne. ngara ari na, yoktan.

source_text: and joktan has begotten almodad, and sheleph, and hazarmaveth, and jerah,
target_text: ana-èpu yoktan, ka: almodad, selef, hasar-mawet, yera,

source_text: and hadoram, and uzal, and diklah,
target_text: hadoram, usal, dikla,

source_text: and obal, and abimael, and sheba,
target_text: obal, abimael, syeba,

source_text: and ophir, and havilah, and jobab; all these are sons of joktan;
target_text: ofir, hawila, dènge yobab. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu yoktan.

source_text: and their dwelling is from mesha, in your coming toward sephar, a mountain of the east.
target_text: era pea rèngu, mulai nèti mesa, taruu d'ai sefar, nuka era dhu kabhuku re sebhe dhimu.

source_text: these are sons of shem, by their families, by their tongues, in their lands, by their nations.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu sem. èci-èci ka dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra.

source_text: these are families of the sons of noah, by their generations, in their nations, and by these the nations have been parted in the earth after the flood.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu noh, èci-èci ka dènge suku ra. ropa èi aae lala èle, rèngu se'e ka pea papènu lème rai-haha ne.

source_text: and the whole earth is of one language, and of the same words,
target_text: uru-uru tèka na, dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, dhoka lii èci di.

source_text: and it comes to pass, in their journeying from the east, that they find a valley in the land of shinar and dwell there;
target_text: lod'o rèngu cahag'e lasi asa ca bèka dhimu, ra d'ai era mera ètu sinear, ka ra pea ètu èèna.

source_text: and they each say to his neighbor, give help, let us make bricks, and burn them thoroughly: and the brick is to them for stone, and the bitumen has been to them for mortar. and they say, give help, let us build for ourselves a city and tower with its head in the heavens, and make for ourselves a name, lest we be scattered over the face of all the earth.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i rare lii èci, aku rèngu na, a'ari, ee! mai ta patitu kota kapai aae cue. ti tao hadhu bata; ti tunu pa'adhu. èèna na, èdhi pudhi sa dedha, ho ti tape dènge èi dama. ho èèna na, ti patitu manara dedha aae èci, dhu kolo nèngu na d'ai dedha-liru, sèna ka èdhi abhu kolongara kapai. ho sèna ka èdhi j'aj'i ca kabarai aae, dhu pahag'a ia ka.

source_text: and yhwh comes down to see the city and the tower which the sons of men have built;
target_text: hèia lamatua puru mai laladhe kota dènge manara dhu ra patitu èèna.

source_text: and yhwh says, behold, the people is one, and one language is to them all, and this it has dreamed of doing; and now, nothing is restrained from them of that which they have purposed to do.
target_text: ka na peka na, dhèu rai-haha se, aa'i-aa'i ra ca kabarai, dènge lii èci di. ngaa dhu rèngu tao ne, heka mulai kèna. bèli-camèd'a ladhe rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i mi èci sèmi ne'e, èèna na, ngaa dhu rèngu neo tao, j'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: give help, let us go down there and confuse their language, so that a man will not understand the language of his companion.
target_text: de be'a risi, èdhi puru lati ho tao lii si baka-leo, ho sèna ka èci ne'a boe lii èci.

source_text: and yhwh scatters them from there over the face of all the earth, and they cease to build the city;
target_text: hèia lamatua puru, ka kakeho lii ra. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, na pacèri si palème rai-haha ne. ka ra pakèd'i taruu heka kota deo na.

source_text: therefore one has called its name babel, for there yhwh has confused the language of all the earth, and from there yhwh has scattered them over the face of all the earth.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra pangare kota na, babel dhu sasoa na ‘pab'ingu', lula lamatua kakeho lii ra, aa pacèri eele si palème rai-haha ne.

source_text: these are the generations of shem: shem is a son of one hundred years, and begets arphaxad two years after the flood.
target_text: se'e se, ana-èpu sem. ropa èle èi aae lala dua tèu sa, sem mamuri cangasu tèu kèna, ka na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na arpaksad.

source_text: and shem lives after his begetting arphaxad five hundred years, and begets sons and daughters.
target_text: ka sem mamuri hari d'ai lèmi ngasu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and arphaxad has lived thirty-five years or one hundred and thirty-five years, and begets salah.
target_text: lod'o umur arpaksad d'ai tèlu nguru lèmi tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na sela.

source_text: and arphaxad lives after his begetting salah four hundred and three years or four hundred and thirty years, and begets sons and daughters.
target_text: ka arpaksad mamuri hari d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and salah has lived thirty years or one hundred and thirty years, and begets eber.
target_text: lod'o umur sela d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na eber.

source_text: and salah lives after his begetting eber four hundred and three years or three hundred and thirty years, and begets sons and daughters.
target_text: ka sela mamuri hari d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and eber lives thirty-four years or one hundred and thirty-four years, and begets peleg.
target_text: lod'o umur eber d'ai tèlu nguru èpa tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na pelek.

source_text: and eber lives after his begetting peleg four hundred and thirty years or three hundred and seventy years, and begets sons and daughters.
target_text: ka eber mamuri era d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and peleg lives thirty years or one hundred and thirty years, and begets reu.
target_text: lod'o umur pelek d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na rehu.

source_text: and peleg lives after his begetting reu two hundred and nine years, and begets sons and daughters.
target_text: ka pelek mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu ceo tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and reu lives thirty-two years or one hundred and thirty-two years, and begets serug.
target_text: lod'o umur rehu d'ai tèlu nguru dua tèu, na abhu ana mone èci, ngara na seruk.

source_text: and reu lives after his begetting serug two hundred and seven years, and begets sons and daughters.
target_text: ka rehu mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu pidhu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and serug lives thirty years or one hundred and thirty years, and begets nahor.
target_text: lod'o umur seruk d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na nahor.

source_text: and serug lives after his begetting nahor two hundred years, and begets sons and daughters.
target_text: ka seruk mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and nahor lives twenty-nine years or seventy-nine years, and begets terah.
target_text: lod'o umur nahor d'ai dua nguru ceo tèu, na abhu ana mone èci, ngara na tera.

source_text: and nahor lives after his begetting terah one hundred and nineteen years or one hundred and twenty-nine years, and begets sons and daughters.
target_text: ka nahor mamuri era d'ai cangasu canguru ceo tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and terah lives seventy years, and begets abram, nahor, and haran.
target_text: lod'o umur tera d'ai pidhu nguru tèu risi, na abhu ana mone, dhèu tèlu: abram, nahor, dènge haran.

source_text: and these are the generations of terah: terah has begotten abram, nahor, and haran; and haran has begotten lot;
target_text: ana-èpu tera, sèmi ne'e: ana mone na, ka: abram, nahor, dènge haran. haran abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na lot.

source_text: and haran dies in the presence of terah his father, in the land of his birth, in ur of the chaldees.
target_text: haran madhe ètu rae èta-èsu na, ngara na ur, rai dhèu kasdim. lod'o èèna, ama na tera mamuri era.

source_text: and abram and nahor take to themselves wives; the name of abram's wife is sarai, and the name of nahor's wife is milcah, daughter of haran, father of milcah, and father of iscah.
target_text: abram madhèdi dènge sarai. nahor leo dènge ana bhèni haran, ngara na milka. haran abhu ana mone èci kahèi, ngara na yiska.

source_text: and sarai is barren-she has no child.
target_text: te ngaa sarai dènge boe ana.

source_text: and terah takes his son abram, and lot, son of haran, his son's son, and his daughter-in-law sarai, wife of his son abram, and they go out with them from ur of the chaldees, to go toward the land of canaan; and they come to haran, and dwell there.
target_text: ca tèka, tera nèti ana na abram, dènge sarai dhèu èmu abram, dènge èpu na lot, lasi tèke eele rae ur, neo lasi asa rai kana'an. te ngaa lasi d'ai rae haran, rèngu pea ka ètu èèna.

source_text: and the days of terah are two hundred and five years, and terah dies in haran.
target_text: tera madhe ètu èèna, dènge umur na dua ngasu lèmi tèu.

source_text: and yhwh says to abram, go for yourself, from your land, and from your family, and from the house of your father, to the land which i show you.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lamatua peka le dènge abram, peka na, abram! èu pakèd'i nèti era èu ne, tèke eele ina-ama èu, èmu ina-ama mu, dènge rae-lesa èu. lamu asa era èci, dhu pe ja'a peka dènge èu.

source_text: and i make you become a great nation, and bless you, and make your name great; and be a blessing.
target_text: èèna na, ja'a hia mèngi-nale mi èu. aa ana-èpu èu, èèna na, bèba-kacanga, j'aj'i suku dhu kapai, toke dhèu tadhe kolongara èu. ho bèli-camèd'a, èu j'aj'i berkat hia dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: and i bless those blessing you, and i curse him who is cursing you, and all families of the ground have been blessed in you.
target_text: èèna na, ja'a hia berkat mi dhèu dhu hia berkat mi èu. te ngaa ja'a huku dhèu cee dhu dhoo èu. nanene paie! pe èèna na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne abhu berkat lula èu.

source_text: and abram goes on, as yhwh has spoken to him, and lot goes with him, and abram is a son of seventy-five years in his going out from haran. and abram takes his wife sarai, and his brother's son lot, and all their substance that they have gained, and the persons that they have obtained in haran; and they go out to go toward the land of canaan; and they come to the land of canaan.
target_text: lod'o èèna, umur abram pidhu nguru lèmi tèu. na nèti dhèu èmu na sarai, aa dènge ana ari na, lot, dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i, aa dènge dhèu sab'a na aa'i-aa'i dhu na abhu ètu kota haran. hèia abram si lasi ka, tèke eele kota haran, asa era dhu lamatua peka le dènge ne. ka ra kako taruu, d'ai rai èci, ngara na kana'an.

source_text: and abram passes over into the land, to the place of shechem, to the oak of moreh; and the canaanite is then in the land.
target_text: d'ai era èèna, abram kako palème rai ne, toke d'ai padètu dènge rae èci, ngara na sikem. ka ra pea taha ètu èèna, padètu dènge aj'u aae ca kapua ètu more. lod'o èèna, dhèu kana'an dhu pea ètu èèna era.

source_text: and yhwh appears to abram and says, to your seed i give this land; and there he builds an altar to yhwh, who has appeared to him.
target_text: ètu era èèna ka, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi abram, peka na, èèna na, ja'a hia ana-èpu èu rai ne'e ne. ka abram pudhi hadhu tao mei korban hia lamatua dhu pad'elo iisi na dènge nèngu ètu era èèna.

source_text: and he removes from there toward a mountain at the east of beth-el, and stretches out the tent beth-el at the west, and hai at the east, and he builds an altar to yhwh there, and preaches in the name of yhwh.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abram si pidha hari asa ledhe re balèu. ka ra pea taha ètu talora rae betel dènge rae ai. ètu èèna, na patitu mei korban èci ho na mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: and abram journeys, going on and journeying toward the south.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na pidha-pidha era, d'ai rai negeb re ca bèka balèu nèti rai kana'an.

source_text: and there is a famine in the land, and abram goes down toward egypt to sojourn there, for the famine is grievous in the land;
target_text: ca tèka, rai kana'an lèke manganga aae. nèti èèna ka, abram si lasi asa bèka balèu, ka ra d'ai rai masir. ka ra manubha taha ètu nèi.
