source_text: and it comes to pass as he has drawn near to enter egypt, that he says to his wife sarai, now behold, i have known that you are a woman of beautiful appearance;
target_text: ropa oe d'ai masir, abram peka dènge dhèu èmu na, sarai, aku nèngu na, sarai, èu bhèni iia, nia boe.

source_text: and it has come to pass that the egyptians see you, and they have said, this is his wife; and they have slain me, and you they keep alive:
target_text: de ladhe dhèu masir rèdhi èu bhèni iia sèmi ne'e, mage dhoka ra pamadhe ja'a, lula ja'a dhèu èmu-kamali èu. dènge sèmi èèna, ra parame rare èu.

source_text: please say you are my sister, so that it is well with me because of you, and my soul has lived for your sake.
target_text: de be'a risi, èu peka dènge ra, na ja'a ne, ana mone èu. dènge sèmi èèna ka, rèngu pamadhe boe ja'a, aa ra be'a-be'a dènge ja'a, lula èu ne.

source_text: and it comes to pass, at the entering of abram into egypt, that the egyptians see the woman that she is exceedingly beautiful;
target_text: ropa abram si d'ai masir, dhèu ètu èèna, ladhe laa na, sarai ne bhèni iia titu kèna.

source_text: and princes of pharaoh see her, and praise her to pharaoh, and the woman is taken to pharaoh's house;
target_text: ropa dhèu sab'a dhèu aae sèra ladhe rèdhi ne, aa ra koa bhabhèni iia na ètu madha dhèu aae. ka rèti bhèni ne, asa èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: and to abram he has done good because of her, and he has sheep and oxen, and male donkeys, and menservants, and handmaids, and female donkeys, and camels.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae be'a-be'a ka dènge abram, lula sarai. ka na parasee abram mèdha rupa-rupa. nuka badha sèmi: kahib'i-kalèbho, kahib'i-ka'ia, sapi, keled'ei, dènge onta. na parasee kahèi, ènu dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni.

source_text: and yhwh plagues pharaoh and his house-great plagues-for the matter of sarai, abram's wife.
target_text: lula na nare dhèu èmu dhèu asa d'ara èmu na, nèti èèna ka, lamatua hia huku rupa-rupa mi dhèu aae dènge isi èmu na.

source_text: and pharaoh calls for abram and says, what is this you have done to me? why have you not declared to me that she is your wife?
target_text: hèia dhèu aae masir paroa abram, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu ne tao tasamia mi ja'a ne? nga tao ka èu peka boe na, bhèni ne dhèu èmu èu?

source_text: why have you said, she is my sister, and i take her to myself for a wife? and now, behold, your wife, take and go.
target_text: te ngaa aku èu na, nèngu ne ana hèni èu! nèti èèna ka, ja'a oe kore ne j'aj'i dhèu èmu ja'a! dhèu èmu èu ka ne'e! more hari ka, aa pakaj'èu ka nèti madha ja'a!

source_text: and pharaoh charges men concerning him, and they send him away, and his wife, and all that he has.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae paredha dhèu sab'a na sèra, babège eele abram, dhèu èmu na, rèti dènge dhèu aa mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra, kalua nèti rai èèna.

source_text: and abram goes up from egypt he and his wife, and all that he has, and lot with him toward the south;
target_text: ka abram si tèke eele masir, lasi asa rai negeb. la'e dènge dhèu èmu na, aa dènge dhèu aa mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra. ana ari na lot madhutu ra kahèi.

source_text: and abram is exceedingly wealthy in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
target_text: abram èèna, kaja ae titu kèna. badha-manu na, mèdha hualaa dènge mèdha hualaa-pudhi na, ae titu kèna.

source_text: and he goes on his journeys from the south, even to bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the commencement, between bethel and hai-
target_text: nèti negeb, ra pidha-pidha era, ka d'ai hari talora rae betel dènge rae ai. dhu uru èèna, ra pea rèdhi le ètu era èèna.

source_text: to the place of the altar which he made there at the first, and there abram preaches in the name of yhwh.
target_text: aa dhu abram patitu le kahèi mei korban, ho na mangaj'i mi lamatua ètu era èèna.

source_text: and also to lot, who is going with abram, there has been sheep and oxen and tents;
target_text: lot dhu madhutu abram èèna, unu badha-manu dènge dhèu sab'a ae kahèi.

source_text: and the land has not permitted them to dwell together, for their substance has been much, and they have not been able to dwell together; and there is a strife between those feeding abram's livestock and those feeding lot's livestock; and the canaanite and the perizzite are then dwelling in the land.
target_text: te ngaa era èèna taleo boe, ho abram dènge lot aa dènge kakaja ra bisa pea pa'èci. nèti èèna ka, ana madhenge badha abram dènge lot sèra j'aj'i patao-palaha, lula j'u'u ètu era èèna d'ai boe hia badha rèngu. lod'o èèna, dhèu kana'an dènge dhèu feris, dhu pea ètu èèna era.

source_text: and abram says to lot, please let there not be strife between me and you, and between my shepherds and your shepherds, for we are men-brothers.
target_text: ka abram peka dènge lot, aku nèngu na, èdhi se, pa'a'ari. mage dhoka èdhi, èci dènge èci be'a boe, lula dhèu sab'a èdhi se patao-palaha taruu.

source_text: is not all the land before you? please be parted from me; if to the left, then i to the right; and if to the right, then i to the left.
target_text: de hua iia dua ti pahag'a ka laa. rai ne, taleo. de ladhe èu d'èi rai ca bèka kariu na, ja'a abhu re ca bèka g'ana. te ngaa ladhe èu d'èi re ca bèka g'ana, na ja'a re ca bèka kariu.

source_text: and lot lifts up his eyes, and sees the whole circuit of the jordan that it is all a watered country before yhwh's destroying sodom and gomorrah, as yhwh's garden, as the land of egypt, in your coming toward zoar,
target_text: hèia lot ladhe palème. ka na ladhe nèdhi rai taleo ètu sebhe loko yarden dhu madha èi ae, toke d'ai rae soar. era ne, rai hèu mèngi sama sèmi oka lamatua, dènge rai masir kahèi. lod'o èèna, lamatua dhae huku mèka kota sodom dènge kota gomora. de rai èèna, be'a era.

source_text: and lot chooses for himself the whole circuit of the jordan; and lot journeys from the east, and they are parted-a man from his companion;
target_text: hèia lot pili nare era sebhe loko yarden èèna. ka dua ra pahag'e ka. de lot la'e sa ca bèka dhimu.

source_text: abram has dwelt in the land of canaan, and lot has dwelt in the cities of the circuit, and moves his tent to sodom;
target_text: te ngaa abram pea taruu ètu rai kana'an. aa lot la'e pea ètu rae-rae dhu padètu dènge kota sodom ètu sebhe loko yarden.

source_text: and the men of sodom are evil, and sinners before yhwh exceedingly.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu-dhèu sodom sèra bhelu-katub'a titu kèna. rèngu ro'o boe nanene lamatua.

source_text: and yhwh said to abram, after lot's being parted from him, now lift up your eyes and look from the place where you are, northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward;
target_text: ropa lot pacèri dènge abram, ka lamatua padhai lii dènge abram, peka na, èu ladhe palème aa'i ku, rai aa'i-aa'i nèti era titu èu èèna. ladhe paie re madha, re kabodho, re ca bèka g'ana, dènge ca bèka kariu mu.

source_text: for the whole of the land which you are seeing, i give it to you and to your seed for all time.
target_text: rai aa'i-aa'i dhu èu ladhe mèdhi sèi, bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia mi èu, dènge ana-èpu èu, sèna ka j'aj'i pusaka ra, toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and i have set your seed as dust of the earth, so that, if one is able to number the dust of the earth, even your seed is numbered;
target_text: èèna na ja'a paj'aj'i ana-èpu èu ae sama sèmi salae dhasi, toke dhèu ige rare boe.

source_text: rise, go up and down through the land, to its length, and to its breadth, for to you i give it.
target_text: de lamu kako palème madhutu madhera dènge bhabhèla na. te rai se aa'i-aa'i ra, ja'a hia mi èu.

source_text: and abram moves his tent, and comes, and dwells among the oaks of mamre, which are in hebron, and builds there an altar to yhwh.
target_text: hèia abram si lèpa hari asa era pea ra, dhu dètu dènge aj'u-aj'u aae ètu mamre, dhu padètu dènge hebron. èle èèna ka, na pudhi hadhu tao mei korban ho na mangaj'i lamatua ètu èèna.

source_text: and it comes to pass in the days of amraphel king of shinar, arioch king of ellasar, chedorlaomer king of elam, and tidal king of nations,
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu aae èpa dhu pa'èci. rèngu se ka: amrafel, dhèu aae rai sinear. ariok, dhèu aae rai elasar, kedarlaomer, dhèu aae rai elam. dènge tideal, dhèu aae rai goyim.

source_text: they have made war with bera king of sodom, and with birsha king of gomorrah, shinab king of admah, and shemeber king of zeboim, and the king of bela, which is zoar.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae leo dhèu lèmi, pa'èci kahèi. nuka: bera, dhèu aae rai sodom. birsa, dhèu aae rai gomora. sinab, dhèu aae rai adema. semeber, dhèu aae rai seboim. dènge bela, dhèu aae rai soar. ka èpa dhèu aae se, lasi pamusu dènge lèmi dhèu aae sèra.

source_text: all these have been joined together to the valley of siddim, which is the salt sea;
target_text: dhèu aae, dhèu lèmi sèra pakaboko dènge sordad'u ra, ètu d'ara mamoo sidim, dhu limuri ne, ngara na dhasi madhe.

source_text: for twelve years they served chedorlaomer, and the thirteenth year they rebelled.
target_text: j'aj'aj'i pamusu na, sèmi ne'e ka: uru èèna, dhèu aae, dhèu lèmi se dhu ta'alo mi dhèu aae kedarlaomer, canguru dua tèu kèna. te d'ai tèu ka canguru tèlu, ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra lab'a ne.

source_text: and in the fourteenth year came chedorlaomer, and the kings who are with him, and they strike the rephaim in ashteroth karnaim, and the zuzim in ham, and the emim in shaveh kiriathaim,
target_text: ka maso tèu ka canguru èpa, kedarlaomer dènge angalai na dhèu aae dhèu tèlu sera, mai dènge sordad'u ra. hèia ra pamusu ka, ka ra segi pèri-pèri rai. nuka: dhèu refaim ètu rai asterot-karnaim; dhèu susim ètu rai ham; dhèu emim ètu rai sawe-kiryataim,

source_text: and the horites in their mount seir, to el-paran, which is by the wilderness;
target_text: dènge dhèu hori dhu ètu ledhe seir, d'ai sebhe mamoo el paran.

source_text: and they turn back and come to en-mishpat, which is kadesh, and strike the whole field of the amalekite, and also the amorite who is dwelling in hazezon-tamar.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lèpa hari asa en mispat dhu limuri ne ngara na kades. ka ra segi rai dhèu amalek, dènge dhèu amori dhu pea ètu rae haseson-tamar.

source_text: and the king of sodom goes out, and the king of gomorrah, and the king of admah, and the king of zeboim, and the king of bela, which is zoar; and they set in array for battle with them in the valley of siddim, with chedorlaomer king of elam, and tidal king of nations, and amraphel king of shinar, and arioch king of ellasar; four kings with the five.
target_text: hèia, lèmi dhèu aae se ator sordad'u ra ètu d'ara mamoo sidim, ka lasi pamusu dènge dhèu aae dhèu èpa sèra.

source_text: and the valley of siddim is full of bitumen-pits; and the kings of sodom and gomorrah flee, and fall there, and those left have fled to the mountain.
target_text: ètu d'ara mamoo èèna, dhu abhu mananga èi dama pèri-pèri. ropa ra pamusu, dhèu aae sodom dènge dhèu aae gomora dènge sordad'u ra, rai. ka cahag'e manahu asa d'ara mananga èi dama se. aa cahag'e hari rai asa ledhe lasi.

source_text: and they take the whole substance of sodom and gomorrah, and the whole of their food, and go away;
target_text: ka èpa dhèu aae dhu segi se, lasi parame rèti mèdha-panyau dènge nganga'a-nginu nèti sodom dènge gomora. èèna ka, ra lèpa dènge ka.

source_text: and they take lot, abram's brother's son seeing he is dwelling in sodom, and his substance, and go away.
target_text: te ngaa lot, ana ari abram, dhu pea ètu sodom. ka èpa dhèu aae sèra, ère rèti lot si, dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and one who is escaping comes and declares to abram the hebrew, and he is dwelling among the oaks of mamre the amorite, brother of eshcol, and brother of aner, and they are abram's allies.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èci rai nèti era èèna. ka la'e lolo dènge abram, dhèu ibrani èèna. lod'o èèna, dhèu amori èci, ngara na mamre. aa abram pea dètu dènge aj'u-aj'u aae unu mamre. a'ari mamre dhèu dua, ngara na eskol dènge aner. rèngu se dhu pa'anga dènge abram.

source_text: and abram hears that his brother has been taken captive, and he draws out his trained servants, three hundred and eighteen, and pursues to dan.
target_text: ropa abram tadèngi na dhèu kèpe rèti le lot, ana ari na, ka abram pakaboko nare dhèu-dhèu sab'a na dhu re'a pamusu. aa'i-aa'i ra tèlu ngasu canguru aru dhèu. ka lasi magèla èpa dhèu aae sèra, asa badae aae lasi d'ai rae dan.

source_text: and he divides himself against them by night, he and his servants, and strikes them, and pursues them to hobah, which is at the left of damascus;
target_text: ètu era èèna, abram hag'e dhèu na sèra, mi pèri-pèri kaboko. d'ara mèda èèna kahèi, lasi age si, dènge j'ara pa'oke. ka abram si lasi bate dhèu se d'ai rae hoba, ètu bèka badae kota damsik.

source_text: and he brings back the whole of the substance, and he has also brought back his brother lot and his substance, and also the women and the people.
target_text: hèia abram abhu hari lot, dènge dhèu-dhèu nèngu, aa dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i. na abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu leo.

source_text: and the king of sodom goes out to meet him after his turning back from the striking of chedorlaomer, and of the kings who are with him, to the valley of shaveh, which is the king's valley.
target_text: ropa abram segi nare dhèu aae èpa sèra, ka na lèpa. hèia dhèu aae sodom mai soru ne ètu d'ara mamoo sawe dhu dhèu biasa peka na, mamoo dhèu aae.

source_text: and melchizedek king of salem has brought out bread and wine, and he is priest of god most high;
target_text: tèu èèna, melkisedek, j'aj'i dhèu aae kota salem. aa nèngu ne j'aj'i kahèi ama agama nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele. na mai soru abram, nèti roti dènge èi hua anggor.

source_text: and he blesses him and says, blessed is abram to god most high, possessing the heavens and earth; and blessed is god most high, who has delivered your adversaries into your hand; and he gives to him a tenth of all.
target_text: ka na padhai lii ho hia berkat mi abram, aku nèngu na, ja'a sanao sèna ka ama lamatua, dhu dedha risi eele èèna, dhu paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne, hia mèngi-nale mi dedha èu. koa-kio ama lamatua dhu hia le èu segi musu. èle èèna ka, abram bagi hia melkisedek ca pala nèti canguru pala mèdha-panyau dhu na abhu hari sèra.

source_text: and the king of sodom says to abram, give to me the persons, and take the substance to yourself,
target_text: hèia dhèu aae sodom èèna pahaha iisi na mi abram, peka na, ama. mèdha-panyau dhu èu abhu hari nèti musu ja'a sèra, hud'i laa ama ku abhu aa'i si. te ngaa dhu ja'a manèngi hari, dhoka dhèu-dhèu ja'a sèra.

source_text: and abram says to the king of sodom, i have lifted up my hand to yhwh, god most high, possessing the heavens and earth-
target_text: hèia abram b'ala ne, peka na, ja'a subha ètu madha ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele, dhu tao dedha-liru dènge rai-haha,

source_text: from a thread even to a shoe-strap i do not take of anything which you have, that you do not say, i have made abram rich;
target_text: na, ja'a kore boe mèdha-panyau èu, masi ka ciki èèna ka. masi ka loa hèngu ca'èta sa, ja'a kore boe. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, èu baku peka na, ‘kakaja abram sèra mai nèti ja'a. '

source_text: save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who have gone with me-aner, eshcol, and mamre-they take their portion.
target_text: ja'a parluu boe ngaa-ngaa. dhoka mia dhu dhèu ja'a se pake le, sèra èle le, ale ia ka. aa hud'i laa, angalai ja'a dhèu tèlu se: aner, eskol dènge mamre, hag'e rare unu rèngu di.

source_text: after these things the word of yhwh has been to abram in a vision, saying, do not fear, abram, i am a shield to you, your reward is exceedingly great.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi abram. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, abram! èu baku madha'u. lula ja'a ka dhu j'aj'i mi tami ho bhiri èu nèti musu. aa ja'a hia a'oto mi dedha èu.

source_text: and abram says, lord yhwh, what do you give to me, and i am going childless? and an acquired son in my house is demmesek eliezer. and abram says, behold, to me you have not given seed, and behold, a servant will be my heir.
target_text: te ngaa, aku abram na, masi ka ama lamatua hia ae-ae èèna ka, j'aj'i boe mi ngaa sa èci. lula ja'a ne dènge boe ana matana, ho hia ja'a ana-èpu. de dhu neo unu ae-ae sèmi èèna, tao mi ngaa? neu-neu ka, noto mi ènu ja'a elieser, dhèu damsik èèna. nèngu ka dhu sèmi nare aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and behold, the word of yhwh is to him, saying, this one will not be your heir; but he who comes out from your bowels, he will be your heir;
target_text: te ngaa lamatua dhaa na, j'ara na sèmi boe èèna! ana d'èlu èu ku, dhu unu pusaka sèra. ènu èu abhu boe.

source_text: and he brings him out outside and says, now look attentively toward the heavens and count the stars, if you are able to count them; and he says to him, thus is your seed.
target_text: hèia nèti abram asa li'u, ka na peka, èu ladhe ku asa dedha-liru nèi. ladhe paie ku hua-hètu sèi. bisa iga more, do aad'o? bèli-camèd'a, ana-èpu èu sama sèmi hua-hètu sèi!

source_text: and he has believed in yhwh, and he reckons it to him-righteousness.
target_text: ka abram sèmi nare lii padhai lamatua. aa lamatua tadhe ne, dhèu mola, lula abram lèka ne.

source_text: and he says to him, i am yhwh who brought you out from ur of the chaldees, to give to you this land to possess it;
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua tuhu hari lii na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua. ja'a ka dhu lere kèti èu nèti rae ur, ètu rai dhèu kasdim sèra. aa rai ne'e ne, ja'a hia èu, sèna ka j'aj'i pusaka mu.

source_text: and he says, lord yhwh, whereby do i know that i possess it?
target_text: te ngaa abram karèi, aku nèngu na, tasamia, lamatua? dènge j'ara sa mia ka ho ja'a ke'a na, rai ne j'aj'i pusaka ja'a?

source_text: and he says to him, take for me a heifer of three years, and a female goat of three years, and a ram of three years, and a turtle-dove, and a young bird;
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! mai ti tao madha j'ara èci, dhu pa'èki lii padhai lii ja'a deo na. de lamu more sapi rena ci'u, kahib'i rena ci'u, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho mone ci'u. aa'i-aa'i sèra hud'i dhu umur tèlu tèu. aa mèti kahèi koro iia ci'u, dènge koro j'aha ci'u.

source_text: and he takes all these to him, and separates them in the midst, and puts each piece opposite its fellow, but the bird he has not divided;
target_text: ka abram la'e nare badha sèra. hèia na kacèb'e bagi mi dua, sapi, kahib'i, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho sèra. ka na pale sisi se mi rai, dhu èci patangara dènge èci, j'aj'i mi dua b'aris. te ngaa na kacèb'e boe manu-bhui sèra.

source_text: and the ravenous birds come down on the carcasses, and abram causes them to turn back.
target_text: ka manu-bhui dhu tema ra'a sisi sèra, mai ho neo ra'a sisi se'e. te ngaa abram bhabhoo eele si.

source_text: and the sun is about to go in, and deep sleep has fallen on abram, and behold, a terror of great darkness is falling on him;
target_text: ropa lod'o cèna, abram bhèj'i luu. na nii, kuri na maroga mai sarimu nare nèngu, ka na madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: and he says to abram, knowing-know that your seed is a sojourner in a land not theirs, and they have served them, and they have afflicted them four hundred years, and the nation also whom they serve i judge, and after this they go out with great substance; and you come to your fathers in peace; you are buried in a good old age;
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge ne, abram! èèna na èu mamuri toke heka bhoro, aa madhe dènge be'a, ka ra padhane èu dènge be'a. te ngaa ana-èpu èu, èèna na j'aj'i dhèu tao mai ètu kabarai dhèu. ho èèna na, dhèu isi rai sèra, tao si sèmi ènu sa, ka ra ènyi aa paj'èra si, toke èpa ngasu tèu. te, ladhe èèna na, ja'a huku si. ho èèna na, ja'a kèti hari ana-èpu èu nèti era èèna, aa dènge mèdha-panyau ra ae-ae.

source_text: and the fourth generation turns back here, for the iniquity of the amorite is not yet complete.
target_text: aa èèna na, ja'a ator ho ana-èpu èu dhu ka lèmi kèti hari si asa ne'e mai. limuri ne, dhèu amori dhu pea ètu rai ne'e. dhèu se'e dhèu bhelu, te ngaa dhae bhelu iia mèka. ladhe ana-èpu èu sèra lèpa hari asa era ne'e, ja'a neo pake si ho huku palaho dhèu amori sèra. lula d'ai taa èèna, bhabhelu ra asa hino.

source_text: and it comes to pass-the sun has gone in, and thick darkness has been and behold, a furnace of smoke, and a lamp of fire, which has passed over between those pieces.
target_text: ropa d'ai mèda sa, cag'ag'a laa ètu era èèna, abhu èru rai èci dhu sèb'u poka-poka, dènge badhu ai èci dhu heo, kako re sasanga sisi dua baris se.

source_text: in that day has yhwh made with abram a covenant, saying, to your seed i have given this land, from the river of egypt to the great river, the euphrates river,
target_text: lod'o èèna, lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dènge abram. na peka na, ja'a jaji mema èu kèna, bèli-camèd'a ja'a pangèd'u mi ana-èpu èu rai ne'e ne, mulai nèti loko masir, d'ai loko efrat,

source_text: with the kenite, and the kenizzite, and the kadmonite,
target_text: dènge rai dhèu keni, dhèu kenas, dhèu kadmon,

source_text: and the hittite, and the perizzite, and the rephaim,
target_text: dhèu het, dhèu feris, dhèu refaim,

source_text: and the amorite, and the canaanite, and the girgashite, and the jebusite.
target_text: dhèu amori, dhèu kana'an, dhèu girgasi, dènge dhèu yebus.

source_text: and sarai, abram's wife, has not borne to him, and she has a handmaid, an egyptian, and her name is hagar; and sarai says to abram, now behold, yhwh has restrained me from bearing, please go in to my handmaid; perhaps i am built up from her; and abram listens to the voice of sarai. and sarai, abram's wife, takes hagar the egyptian, her handmaid, at the end of the tenth year of abram's dwelling in the land of canaan, and gives her to her husband abram-to him for a wife,
target_text: tèu èèna, abram lèpa hari le nèti masir, ka na pea le canguru tèu ètu kana'an. dhèu èmu na sarai abhu mèka kolo. sarai dènge ènu bhèni ca dhèu nèti masir, ngara na hagar. ca lod'o, sarai peka dènge abram, aku nèngu na, a'a. lamatua hia boe ja'a ana. de hua iia, lamu j'unu dènge ènu ja'a, hagar, sèna ka na hia ja'a ana. ka abram madhutu lii dhèu èmu na. ka sarai hia hagar j'aj'i dhèu èmu ka dua abram.

source_text: and he goes in to hagar, and she conceives, and she sees that she has conceived, and her mistress is lightly esteemed in her eyes.
target_text: hèia abram j'unu dènge hagar, ka na dènge babia. ropa hagar ne'a nèngu dènge babia le, ka na padedha iisi na, aa na pahae heka sarai.

source_text: and sarai says to abram, my violence is for you; i have given my handmaid into your bosom, and she sees that she has conceived, and i am lightly esteemed in her eyes; yhwh judges between me and you.
target_text: ka sarai peka dènge abram, aku nèngu na, ja'a ka dhu hia nèngu mi èu j'aj'i dhèu èmu ka dua. te ngaa ropa na dènge babia, na pusi pahae heka ja'a! ne'e ne, sala èu! de hud'i laa, sèna ka lamatua ka dhu pama'ète lii èdhi dua ti! heka èu me'a kèna!

source_text: and abram says to sarai, behold, your handmaid is in your hand, do to her that which is good in your eyes; and sarai afflicted her, and she flees from her presence.
target_text: ka abram dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e, wee! èu ne, dhèu èmu uru. aa nèngu, dhèu èmu limuri. de èu ne dhu mèd'u paredha. de èu neo tao ne tasamia, èèna ètu èu na! ka sarai mulai tao sakaa hua dènge hagar, hèia na rai.

source_text: and the messenger of yhwh finds her by the fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to shur,
target_text: na rai d'ai d'ara mamoo. hèia ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga ca dhèu, rage ne dètu dènge madha èi, ètu j'ara la'e asa sur.

source_text: and he says, hagar, sarai's handmaid, from where have you come, and to where do you go? and she says, from the presence of sarai, my mistress, i am fleeing.
target_text: ka na lii, aku nèngu na, èu ne hagar, ènu sarai. nga tao ka èu ètu ne'e? èu mai nèti mia, aa lamu mia? hèia hagar dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a rai nèti d'ara èmu lamatua ja'a.

source_text: and the messenger of yhwh says to her, return to your mistress, and humble yourself under her hands;
target_text: ka ana pajuu èèna pamako ne, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! be'a risi, èu lèpa hari asa adhe-aai sarai, lamatua èu. masi ka na tao èu tasamia èèna ka, sèmi la.

source_text: and the messenger of yhwh says to her, multiplying i multiply your seed, and it is not numbered from multitude;
target_text: baku madha'u. bèli-camèd'a, ja'a pabèba ana-èpu èu pa'ae-ae, toke dhèu ige rare boe.

source_text: and the messenger of yhwh says to her, behold you are conceiving, and bearing a son, and have called his name ishmael, for yhwh has listened to your affliction;
target_text: èu dhu dènge babia. nèbhu heka, èu mora iisi ana mone ca dhèu. èèna na mu pangare ne ismael dhu sasoa na ‘lamatua tadèngi', lula lamatua tadèngi le lii roma iisi èu.

source_text: and he is a wild-donkey man, his hand against everyone, and everyone's hand against him-and before the face of all his brothers he dwells.
target_text: ropa ana ne kapai, na mamuri pakaj'èu nèti a'ari na. lula nèngu ne, sama sèmi jara hui dhu d'èi boe nanene lii paredha. sad'i dhèu cee èèna ka, na sisu. aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i lab'a ne kahèi.

source_text: and she calls the name of yhwh who is speaking to her, you are, o god, my beholder; for she said, even here have i looked behind my beholder?
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hagar ngee ka ètu d'ara na, aku nèngu na, ja'a kèdhi le lamatua, dhu ladhe-leru aa madhenge ja'a. hèia na hia ngara mi lamatua, lamatua dhu ladhe-leru ja'a.

source_text: therefore has one called the well, the well of the living one, my beholder; behold, between kadesh and bered.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu pangare madha èi na, beer lahai roi, dhu sasoa na madha èi nèti nèngu dhu mamuri, dhu ladhe-leru ja'a. era na, ètu talora aae nèti rae kades dènge rae beret. madha èi ne, abhu era toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: and hagar bears a son to abram; and abram calls the name of his son, whom hagar has borne, ishmael;
target_text: èle èèna ka, hagar lèpa hari. hèia nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. abram pangare ne ismael.

source_text: and abram is a son of eighty-six years in hagar's bearing ishmael to abram.
target_text: lod'o hagar nare iisi ismael, umur abram aru nguru èna tèu kèna.

source_text: and abram is a son of ninety-nine years, and yhwh appears to abram, and says to him, i am god almighty, habitually walk before me, and be perfect;
target_text: ropa umur abram d'ai ceo nguru ceo tèu, lamatua mai pad'elo iisi dènge ne. ka na peka dènge abram, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele. èu hud'i madhutu taruu dad'èi ja'a, dènge j'ara mamuri èu hud'i mola.

source_text: and i give my covenant between me and you, and multiply you very exceedingly.
target_text: ja'a neo pa'èki lii pajaji dènge èu. aa ja'a neo pabèba kacanga ana-èpu èu.

source_text: and abram falls on his face, and god speaks with him, saying,
target_text: hèia abram patitu kètu urutuu, ka na pacud'u kètu d'ai rai. ka ama lamatua tuhu hari lii padhai lii na, aku nèngu na,

source_text: i-behold, my covenant is with you, and you have become father of a multitude of nations; and your name is no longer called abram, but your name has been abraham, for father of a multitude of nations have i made you;
target_text: lii pajaji ja'a dènge èu sèmi ne'e ka: èèna na, èu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae. nèti èèna ka, èu pake ia ka ngara èu abram dhu sasoa na ‘ama dhu dhèu tadhe', te ngaa abraham dhu sasoa na ‘bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae'.

source_text: and i have made you exceedingly fruitful, and made you become nations, and kings go out from you.
target_text: ja'a neo pabèba kacanga ana-èpu èu ae-ae. ja'a paj'aj'i si suku ae-ae. aa ja'a ded'e dhèu aae ae nèti rèngu sèra.

source_text: and i have established my covenant between me and you, and your seed after you, throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant, to become god to you, and to your seed after you;
target_text: ja'a sanèd'e taruu lii pajaji ja'a dènge èu, aa dènge ana-èpu èu sèra. lii pajaji ne ma'ète boe toke taa-taa, lula ja'a ne'e ka ama lamatua nèti èu dènge ana-èpu mu.

source_text: and i have given to you, and to your seed after you, the land of your sojournings, the whole land of canaan, for a continuous possession, and i have become their god.
target_text: rai kana'an ne aa'i-aa'i, bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu. ne'e ne, èu dhoka pea manubha di ètu ne'e. te ngaa èèna na, j'aj'i mi unu ana-èpu èu toke taa-taa. aa ja'a j'aj'i ama lamatua rèngu sèra kahèi.

source_text: and god says to abraham, and you keep my covenant, you and your seed after you, throughout their generations; this is my covenant which you keep between me and you, and your seed after you: every male of you is to be circumcised;
target_text: te ngaa èu dènge ana-èpu èu sèra, hud'i kèpe pa'èra lii pajaji ne, dènge d'ara kateme ku. dhèu mone aa'i-aa'i ra, hud'i suna ku.

source_text: and you have circumcised the flesh of your foreskin, and it has become a token of a covenant between me and you. and a son of eight days is circumcised by you; every male throughout your generations, born in the house, or bought with money from any son of a stranger, who is not of your seed; he is certainly circumcised who is born in your house, or bought with your money; and my covenant has become in your flesh a perpetual covenant;
target_text: ne'e ne, mone aa'i-aa'i hud'i suna, mulai nèti umur aru lod'o. a'ari èu, dhèu-dhèu sab'a èu, dènge ènu dhu èu hèli more nèti rai leo, aa'i-aa'i ra hud'i suna si. suna na j'aj'i tadha mi ngi'u miu, dhu pa'èki èdhi taa-taa.

source_text: and an uncircumcised one, a male, the flesh of whose foreskin is not circumcised, indeed, that person has been cut off from his people; my covenant he has broken.
target_text: mone mia dhu suna boe, rèngu sèra maso boe ètu d'ara lii pajaji ja'a ne, aa rèngu sèra j'aj'i boe dhèu ja'a kahèi.

source_text: and god says to abraham, sarai your wife-you do not call her name sarai, for sarah is her name;
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua peka hari, aku nèngu na, nèti deo ne'e ne, èu paroa ia ka ngara dhèu èmu mu sarai, te ngaa sara.

source_text: and i have blessed her, and have also given to you a son from her; and i have blessed her, and she has become nations-kings of peoples are from her.
target_text: èèna na ja'a hia mamèngi ae-ae mi sara, sèna ka nara iisi hia èu, ana mone ca dhèu. tare'a! bèli-camèd'a, sara j'aj'i bèi nèti suku ae-ae. aa èèna na, ja'a ded'e dhèu aae ae-ae nèti ana-èpu nèngu.

source_text: and abraham falls on his face, and laughs, and says in his heart, is one born to the son of one hundred years? or does sarah-daughter of ninety years-bear?
target_text: hèia abraham patitu kètu urutuu ka pacud'u kètu d'ai rai. te ngaa na mari ètu d'ara. na pangee, na, mone heka bhora dhu cangasu tèu sama sèmi ja'a ne, bisa abhu ana era? aa sara dhu heka gagoo-gagehu ne, dhu ceo nguru tèu kèna, nara iisi hari sa mia?

source_text: and abraham says to god, o that ishmael may live before you;
target_text: ka na peka dènge lamatua, aku nèngu na, hud'i ka laa, ismael ka dhu abhu pusaka ja'a èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: and god says, your wife sarah is certainly bearing a son to you, and you have called his name isaac, and i have established my covenant with him, for a perpetual covenant, to his seed after him.
target_text: te ngaa aku ama lamatua na, aad'o sèmi èèna! bèli-camèd'a, dhèu èmu mu sara, nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. pangare ne isak. lii jaji ja'a ne, lèke mi nèngu dènge ana-èpu na toke mia-mia.

source_text: as for ishmael, i have heard you; behold, i have blessed him, and made him fruitful, and multiplied him, very exceedingly; twelve princes does he beget, and i have made him become a great nation;
target_text: ja'a tadèngi le ngaa dhu èu manèngi kahèi, hia ismael. nèti èèna ka, ja'a hia berkat mi nèngu kahèi, aa hia ana-èpu na tabha ae. bèli-camèd'a ana-èpu ismael ne, j'aj'i mi canguru dua kapala suku. aa ana-èpu na suku èci dhu kapai.

source_text: and my covenant i establish with isaac, whom sarah does bear to you at this appointed time in the next year;
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, lii pajaji ja'a ne, lèke dhoka mi ana mu isak di. tèu mai ni, hèru sèmi ne'e kahèi, sara nara iisi le.

source_text: and he finishes speaking with him, and god goes up from abraham.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, ka ama lamatua tèke eele abraham.

source_text: and abraham takes his son ishmael, and all those born in his house, and all those bought with his money-every male among the men of abraham's house and circumcises the flesh of their foreskin, in this very same day, as god has spoken with him. and abraham is a son of ninety-nine years in the flesh of his foreskin being circumcised; and his son ishmael is a son of thirteen years in the flesh of his foreskin being circumcised; in this very same day abraham has been circumcised, and his son ishmael; and all the men of his house-born in the house, and bought with money from the son of a stranger-have been circumcised with him.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, abraham tao dènge ka, madhutu sèmi lii paredha ama lamatua. ka na suna. na suna ana na, ismael, dènge dhèu mone aa'i-aa'i dhu pea dènge ne. lod'o èèna, umur abraham ceo nguru ceo tèu le, aa ismael canguru tèlu tèu.

source_text: and yhwh appears to him among the oaks of mamre, and he is sitting at the opening of the tent, about the heat of the day;
target_text: ca tèka, abraham pea padètu dènge aj'u aae canau ètu mamre. lamatua mai pad'elo iisi na mi nèngu ètu era èèna. lii lolo na sèmi ne'e ka: lod'o èèna, sagoro ae titu kèna, ka abraham madhèdi ètu hèb'a paleo na, sèna ka abhu ngèlu g'oro ciki.

source_text: and he lifts up his eyes and looks, and behold, three men standing by him, and he sees, and runs to meet them from the opening of the tent, and bows himself toward the earth,
target_text: ropa abraham boti kètu na, ladhe nèdhi dhèu tèlu dhu titu kaj'èu boe nèti era èèna. hèia na rai la'e soru nare si. ropa na d'ai madha si, na patitu kètu urutuu na,

source_text: and he says, my lord, if now i have found grace in your eyes, please do not pass on from your servant;
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ama si. mai dhuli ku ho minu èi ciki.

source_text: please let a little water be accepted, and wash your feet, and recline under the tree;
target_text: ama si ae ciki mi mamaho ne'e. ho ana-ana iiki rèti èi, sèna ka rasa haga miu.

source_text: and i bring a piece of bread, and support your heart; afterward pass on, for therefore you have passed over to your servant; and they say, so may you do as you have spoken.
target_text: pe ja'a laku lalau nganga'a-nginu ho ama si mi'a ciki, sèna ka ako kadhii ciki, heka lami taruu kèna. te ja'a karej'e bisa lalau ama si. ka ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ooo. ji'i dhuli.

source_text: and abraham hurries toward the tent, to sarah, and says, hurry three measures of flour-meal, knead, and make cakes;
target_text: hèia abraham pamèri sa d'ara paleo, la'e peka dènge sara, aku nèngu na, mèri! more tarigu dhu be'a risi, ca saku, ho tao roti!

source_text: and abraham ran to the herd, and takes a son of the herd, tender and good, and gives to the young man, and he hurries to prepare it;
target_text: ka rai la'e hari asa era sapi na, hèia kèpe ana sapi kabèb'u ci'u. ka na pua dhèu sab'a na sa, pare.

source_text: and he takes butter and milk, and the son of the herd which he has prepared, and sets before them; and he is standing by them under the tree, and they eat.
target_text: hèia la'e nare susu, keju dènge sisi dhu heka nasu èèna, nèti hia tamu sèra ra'a. abraham titu taruu ètu mamaho aj'u, ho na lalau si.

source_text: and they say to him, where is sarah your wife? and he says, behold-in the tent;
target_text: hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, dhèu èmu mu sara, ka mia? na dhaa, aku nèngu na, nuka d'ara paleo èèna.

source_text: and he says, returning i return to you, about the time of life, and behold, to sarah your wife a son. and sarah is listening at the opening of the tent, which is behind him;
target_text: ka ca dhèu nèti rèngu se padhai lii, aku nèngu na, pe d'ai tèu mai nèi, ja'a lèpa hari mai. lod'o èèna, dhèu èmu èu sara nare iisi le ana mone ca dhèu. ropa rèngu padhai lii èèna, sara nanene nèti kabodho babèdho.

source_text: and abraham and sarah are aged, entering into days-the way of women has ceased to be to sarah;
target_text: lod'o èèna, abraham dènge sara dhu heka bhoro le, ngaa hari sara dhu abhu heka hèru.

source_text: and sarah laughs in her heart, saying, after i have waxed old have i had pleasure? my lord is also old!
target_text: ropa sara tadèngi padhue-padhai rèngu se, ka na mari kèmu. na pangee na, ja'a dhu heka roto-roto sèmi ne'e ne, aa dhèu èmu ja'a dhu roe nia heka. tasamia ji'i bisa tao sèmi ana ngèru dhu leo-èmu hiu, ho abhu ana?

source_text: and yhwh says to abraham, why is this? sarah has laughed, saying, is it really true-i bear-and i am aged?
target_text: ka lamatua peka dènge abraham, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka sara mari? ele boe na ngee na, lii padhai ja'a ne j'aj'i boe, lula nèngu heka le.

source_text: is anything too wonderful for yhwh? at the appointed time i return to you, about the time of life, and sarah has a son.
target_text: ja'a ne, lamatua! abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu ja'a bisa boe tao. sanèd'e paie. tèu mai, ladhe ja'a lèpa hari mai, sara dhu nara iisi le, ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: and sarah denies, saying, i did not laugh; for she has been afraid; and he says, no, but you did laugh.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii èèna, sara j'aj'i madha'u. ka na pasili, aku nèngu na, ja'a mari boe, nga! te ngaa lamatua b'ala, na, deo na, èu mari, nga.

source_text: and the men rise from there, and look on the face of sodom, and abraham is going with them to send them away;
target_text: èle ka, dhèu tèlu se pakèd'i neo lasi asa kota sodom. ka abraham lere si d'ai talora j'ara. nèti era èèna, ladhe rèdhi kota sodom.

source_text: and yhwh said, am i concealing from abraham that which i am doing,
target_text: ka lamatua ngee ètu d'ara na, hua iia ja'a peka dènge abraham, ja'a neo palaho kota sodom.

source_text: and abraham certainly becomes a great and mighty nation, and blessed in him have been all nations of the earth?
target_text: te ladhe èèna na, ana-èpu na asa tabha ae, aa suku dhu kapai. aa nèngu ne, èèna na, j'aj'i berkat mi suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: for i have known him, that he commands his children, and his house after him and they have kept the way of yhwh, to do righteousness and judgment, that yhwh may bring on abraham that which he has spoken concerning him.
target_text: ja'a hag'e kore le nèngu, ho na nori ana-èpu na dènge dhèu leo, sèna ka madhutu taruu j'ara lamatua, ho ra mamuri dènge mola. ladhe rèngu mamuri sèmi èèna, ja'a tao aa'i lii dhu ja'a pajaji dènge abraham.

source_text: and yhwh says, the cry of sodom and gomorrah-because great; and their sin-because exceedingly grievous:
target_text: hèia lamatua peka dènge abraham, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! ja'a tadèngi le, lii roma iisi dhèu ae, peka na, dhèu kota sodom dènge gomora bhabhelu ra seli-kolane.

source_text: i go down now, and see whether according to its cry which is coming to me they have done completely-and if not-i know;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a puru madha ku mai, sèna ka kèdhi unu ku, ngaa dhu ja'a tadèngi sèra, tare'a, do aad'o. ladhe aad'o, pe ja'a ke'a unu ku.

source_text: and the men turn from there, and go toward sodom; and abraham is yet standing before yhwh.
target_text: ropa lamatua padhai lii era dènge abraham, dhèu dua se lasi taruu sa kota sodom.

source_text: and abraham draws near and says, do you also consume righteous with wicked?
target_text: hèia abraham la'e padètu dènge lamatua, ka na pamako na, peka na, tasamia? ama neo pamadhe aa'i dhèu-dhèu be'a pa'èci dènge dhèu-dhèu bhelu, do?

source_text: perhaps there are fifty righteous in the midst of the city; do you also consume, and not bear with the place for the sake of the fifty righteous who are in its midst?
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu lèmi nguru dhu be'a ètu d'ara kota èèna, ama pamadhe si hèi? do, ama palaho heka kota sèra, lula rèngu se'e, do?

source_text: far be it from you to do according to this thing, to put to death the righteous with the wicked; that it has been-as the righteous so the wicked-far be it from you; does the judge of all the earth not do justice?
target_text: ama baku tao sèmi èèna! mage dhoka, dhèu be'a sèra madhe hèi, lula ama neo pamadhe dhèu bhelu sèra. ama ka dhu pama'ète lii ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. de ama ku unu mu dhu me'a j'ara èèna adil boe.

source_text: and yhwh says, if i find in sodom fifty righteous in the midst of the city, then have i borne with all the place for their sake.
target_text: ka lamatua dhaa, peka na, ladhe abhu dhèu be'a lèmi nguru dhèu ètu kota sodom, ja'a huku boe kota èèna, lula rèngu.

source_text: and abraham answers and says, now behold, i have willed to speak to the lord, and i am dust and ashes;
target_text: hèia abraham padhai lii hari, aku nèngu na, ama, ja'a manèngi abho, lula ja'a neo padhai lii hari ciki. ja'a ne dhoka dhèu goa di, dhu ke'a boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: perhaps there are lacking five of the fifty righteous-do you destroy for five the whole of the city? and he says, i do not destroy it, if i find there forty-five.
target_text: sèmi d'ai boe dhèu lèmi nguru dhu be'a, te ngaa dhoka èpa nguru lèmi di, tasamia? kura dhoka dhèu lèmi di, na ama neo palaho eele kota èèna, do? ka lamatua b'ala, aku nèngu na, ladhe ja'a abhu dhèu be'a èpa nguru lèmi, ja'a palaho boe kota èèna.

source_text: and he adds again to speak to him and says, perhaps there are found there forty? and he says, i do not do it, because of the forty.
target_text: ka abraham pamako hari, na, sèmi abhu dhoka èpa nguru dhèu be'a di, tasamia, ama? ka na dhaa, ladhe ja'a abhu èpa nguru dhèu be'a, ja'a huku boe si.

source_text: and he says, please let it not be displeasing to the lord, and i speak: perhaps there are found there thirty? and he says, i do not do it, if i find there thirty.
target_text: abraham pamako hari, aku nèngu na, ama baku nasa. te abhu dhoka tèlu nguru dhèu be'a di, na tasamia? hèia na dhaa, ladhe ja'a abhu tèlu nguru dhèu be'a, ja'a huku boe si.

source_text: and he says, now behold, i have willed to speak to the lord: perhaps there are found there twenty? and he says, i do not destroy it, because of the twenty.
target_text: hèia abraham peka hari, ama mage nasa ladhe ja'a karèi hari ciki. sèmi abhu dhoka dhèu dua nguru di dhu be'a, na tasamia? ka na dhaa hari, aku nèngu na, sèmi abhu dhèu dua nguru di dhu be'a, ja'a palaho eele boe kota èèna.

source_text: and he says, please let it not be displeasing to the lord, and i speak only this time: perhaps there are found there ten? and he says, i do not destroy it, because of the ten.
target_text: ka abraham katange lii padhai na, aa na karèi, peka na, ama! ja'a padhai lii hari ca tèka, te ngaa baku nasa dènge ja'a. tasamia, ladhe abhu dhoka canguru dhèu di dhu be'a? hèia na dhaa, ladhe ja'a abhu canguru dhèu dhu be'a ètu era èèna, ja'a palaho boe kota èèna.

source_text: and yhwh goes on, when he has finished speaking to abraham, and abraham has turned back to his place.
target_text: padhai lii èle sèmi èèna, lamatua la'e dènge ka, aa abraham lèpa kahèi.

source_text: and two of the messengers come toward sodom at evening, and lot is sitting at the gate of sodom, and lot sees, and rises to meet them, and bows himself-face to the earth,
target_text: ètu d'ara lamatua dhu padhue-padhai era dènge abraham, ana pajuu na dhèu dua, lasi le asa kota sodom. d'ai nèi, lod'o oe cèna kèna. ka lot dhu madhèdi ètu hèb'a tedhe kota. ropa nèdhi dhèu dua se, la'e soru nare si. ka na patitu kètu urutuu, aa pacud'u kètu ètu madha ra.

source_text: and he says, now behold, my lords, please turn aside to the house of your servant, and lodge, and wash your feet-then you have risen early and gone on your way; and they say, no, but we lodge in the broad place.
target_text: ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, mai lati dhuli ku èmu ja'a la. sèna ka ama si rase haga, aa j'unu ètu èmu ja'a. pe bèli mad'ae, heka ama si kako hari kèna. ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, makasi. te ngaa repo ia ka. hud'i laa ji'i j'unu ètu d'ara lapa.

source_text: and he presses on them greatly, and they turn aside to him, and come into his house; and he makes a banquet for them, and has baked unleavened things; and they eat.
target_text: te ngaa lot pamako si loe boe, ka lasi manubha asa èmu na. ka lot si tunu roti, lalau mei, ka ra'a-rinu pa'èci.

source_text: before they lie down, the men of the city-men of sodom-have surrounded the house, from young even to aged, all the people from the extremity;
target_text: dhu dua ra lasi mèka j'unu, cag'ag'a laa, dhèu mone sodom aa'i-aa'i, ana mone ngèru toke d'ai mone heka, mai reo rare èmu lot.

source_text: and they call to lot and say to him, where are the men who have come to you tonight? bring them out to us, and we know them.
target_text: dhèu se'e pa'oo-parodha, peka mi lot, aku rèngu na, he, lot! mone dua deo sa, ètu mia? bhabhodho si mai, sèna ka ji'i j'unu dènge ra!

source_text: and lot goes out to them, to the opening, and the door has shut behind him,
target_text: hèia lot li'u la'e, ka na bèdho hari èmu.

source_text: and says, please, my brothers, do not do evil;
target_text: ka na lii, aku nèngu na, a'ari, ee! baku miu tao bhelu mi tamu ja'a se.

source_text: now behold, i have two daughters who have not known anyone; please let me bring them out to you, and do to them as is good in your eyes; only do nothing to these men, for therefore they have come in within the shadow of my roof.
target_text: mi nanene ku ja'a laa! ana bhèni ja'a, dhèu dua. dua ra dhu pa'èci mèka dènge dhèu mone. ja'a hia miu. mere, ho mi tao tasamia èèna ka, sad'i madhutu dad'èi miu. sad'i miu baku tao karehe mi tamu ja'a dhèu dua se. lula madhutu ad'a èdhi, ja'a ka dhu hud'i j'aga si.

source_text: and they say, come near here; they also say, this one has come to sojourn, and he certainly judges! now, we do evil to you more than to them; and they press against the man, against lot greatly, and come near to break the door.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, dhèu sodom se pa'oo ma'ète boe, aku rèngu na, èu ne, baku patabha! te èu ne, dhèu tao mai ètu kabarai ji'i ne! de èu dènge boe hak ho kai ji'i. hua iia, èu pakaj'èu nèti era ne'e. te, ladhe lamu boe, ji'i tao èu bia risi nèti dhèu dua se'e! ka ra tule eele lot, hèia aa'i-aa'i ra rai lasi j'èje babèdho èmu.

source_text: and the men put forth their hand, and bring in lot to them, into the house, and have shut the door;
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dua se soro kacui-aai ra, ère pamaso lot, ka ra patèke èmu nèti d'ara.

source_text: and the men who are at the opening of the house they have struck with blindness, from small even to great, and they weary themselves to find the opening.
target_text: dua ra tao pabèdhu ana madha dhèu sodom aa'i-aa'i ra, ka rèdhi heka ngaa-ngaa. ra gogo tenge babèdho, te ngaa abhu boe.

source_text: and the men say to lot, whom have you here still? son-in-law, your sons also, and your daughters, and all whom you have in the city, bring out from this place; for we are destroying this place, for their cry has been great before the face of yhwh, and yhwh does send us to destroy it.
target_text: hèia tamu dhèu dua se, peka dènge lot, aku rèngu na, lamatua ne'a le, bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu sodom se. nèti èèna ka, na paleha ji'i dua mi mai, sèna ka palaho eele kota ne. de èu dhu dènge a'ari leo dhu ètu d'ara kota ne, do aad'o? ladhe dènge ana mone, do ana bhèni, do dhèu èmu ana èu, do, sad'i cee èèna ka, lamu more si, ho rai ka nèti d'ara kota ne lai-lai!

source_text: and lot goes out and speaks to his sons-in-law, those taking his daughters, and says, rise, go out from this place, for yhwh is destroying the city; and he is as one mocking in the eyes of his sons-in-law.
target_text: hèia lot la'e paraga dènge ana mone dhèu dua, dhu lii d'ai ana bhèni na. ka na peka, dua mi nanene paie! rai ka nèti d'ara kota ne, te lamatua neo palaho eele ne! te ngaa ra pangee na, lot padhai lii paleko di.

source_text: and when the dawn has ascended, then the messengers press on lot, saying, rise, take your wife, and your two daughters who are found present, lest you are consumed in the iniquity of the city.
target_text: bèli mad'ae aae era, ana pajuu lamatua dhèu dua se, pakaseti lot si, ho lasi karohe asa era kaj'èu. ra peka na, lami ka! ère mèti dhèu èmu mu, dènge ana bhèni èu dhèu dua sèra, ho rai ka. tèke eele kota ne'e! mage dhoka miu madhe aa'i palere-lere dènge kota ne.

source_text: and he lingers, and the men lay hold on his hand, and on the hand of his wife, and on the hand of his two daughters, through the mercy of yhwh to him, and they bring him out, and cause him to rest outside the city.
target_text: te ngaa lot neka-neka era, masi ka lamatua neo hia ne mamuri. nèti èèna ka, tamu dhèu dua se nuni lot, dhèu èmu na, dènge ana bhèni dhèu dua sèra, rèti asa li'u kota.

source_text: and it comes to pass, when he has brought them outside, that he says, escape for your life; do not look behind you, nor stand in all the circuit; escape to the mountain, lest you are consumed.
target_text: hèia ca dhèu nèti tamu dhèu dua sèra paredha si, peka na, rai palasa, sèna ka abhu sod'a! mage mi kabib'a kabodho! baku ae ètu d'ara mamoo! rai taruu, asa ledhe nèi, sèna ka miu baku madhe!

source_text: and lot says to them, oh not so, my lord;
target_text: te ngaa lot peka, aku nèngu na, iraa ee! baku sèmi èèna!

source_text: now behold, your servant has found grace in your eyes, and you make great your kindness which you have done with me by saving my life, and i am unable to escape to the mountain, lest the evil cleave to me and i have died;
target_text: mema ama si pamamuri le ji'i se. te ngaa ledhe nèi kaj'èu bia nèti ne'e! mage dhoka ji'i d'ai mèka nèi, j'aj'èra dhu magee nare le ji'i èèna, ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: now behold, this city is near to flee there, and it is little; please let me escape there is it not little? that my soul may live.
target_text: ama ladhe ku laa. rae iiki cue dhu kaj'èu boe nèti era ne'e. rae nèi dhu kolongara aad'o. ladhe ama d'èi, ji'i la'a pasoru iisi asa nèi!

source_text: and he says to him, behold, i have also accepted your face for this thing, without overthrowing the city for which you have spoken;
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, oo! lami ka! te èèna na, ja'a palaho boe rae nèi.

source_text: hurry, escape there, for i am not able to do anything until your entering there; therefore he calls the name of the city zoar.
target_text: de rai karohe ka, lami asa nèi! te ja'a tao mèka ngaa-ngaa, ladhe miu d'ai mèka era nèi. karèi nèti lod'o èèna, dhèu pangare rae ne soar, dhu sasoa na ‘ana iiki-iiki'.

source_text: the sun has gone out on the earth, and lot has entered into zoar,
target_text: ropa lod'o rea, lot si d'ai soar.

source_text: and yhwh has rained on sodom and on gomorrah brimstone and fire from yhwh, from the heavens;
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, lamatua sadutu ai dènge èi nasu nèti dedha-liru asa sodom dènge gomora.

source_text: and he overthrows these cities, and all the circuit, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which is shooting up from the ground.
target_text: lamatua pakèpu-ladhu ai kota dènge rae aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara rai èèna, dènge ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri ètu èèna, nuka: dhèu, badha-manu, dènge ana aaj'u.

source_text: and his wife looks from behind him, and she becomes a pillar of salt!
target_text: lod'o rèngu rai, dhèu èmu lot kabib'a kabodho. cag'ag'a laa, na j'aj'i agarii masi.

source_text: and abraham rises early in the morning to the place where he has stood before the face of yhwh;
target_text: asa bèli èèna, dhu mad'ae aae era, abraham la'e asa era dhu med'a na, na pamako lamatua.

source_text: and he looks on the face of sodom and gomorrah, and on all the face of the land of the circuit, and sees, and behold, the smoke of the land went up as smoke of the furnace.
target_text: hèia na ladhe sa haha asa sodom dènge gomora, aa asa d'ara mamoo èèna. na ladhe la'a na, sèb'u poka-poka sèna, dhu ca'e asa dedha-liru. aa ai na'e aa'i le ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and it comes to pass, in god's destroying the cities of the circuit, that god remembers abraham, and sends lot out of the midst of the overthrow in the overthrowing of the cities in which lot dwelt.
target_text: ama lamatua patalale lot si nèti hahuku èèna, ropa na pakèpu-ladhu ai kota-kota sèra, lula na ngee nèdhi lii pajaji na dènge abraham.

source_text: and lot goes up out of zoar, and dwells in the mountain, and his two daughters with him, for he has been afraid of dwelling in zoar, and he dwells in a cave, he and his two daughters.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lot madha'u pea taruu ètu rae soar. nèti èèna ka, nèngu dènge ana bhèni na dhèu dua sèra, lasi asa ledhe ka ra pea ètu d'ara loe cue.

source_text: and the firstborn says to the younger, our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in to us, as is the way of all the earth;
target_text: ca lod'o, ana bhèni uru èèna, peka dènge ari na, aku nèngu na, ètu era ne'e ne, abhu boe dhèu mone ca dhèu sa, dhu bisa leo dènge èdhi se. aa ama èdhi asa heka, de ladhe èèna na, na bisa heka abhu ana.

source_text: come, we cause our father to drink wine, and lie with him, and preserve a seed from our father.
target_text: de be'a risi, ti hia ne ninu mahu, sèna ka èdhi dua ti j'unu dènge ne, ho ti abhu kolo hia ama èdhi.

source_text: and they cause their father to drink wine on that night; and the firstborn goes in and lies with her father, and he has not known in her lying down or in her rising up.
target_text: ka ropa d'ai mèda, dua ra hia ama ra ninu èi anggor toke mahu. hèia ana bhèni uru èèna, la'e j'unu dènge ama na. lula ama na dhu mahu ae, ka ne'a boe nèngu dhu j'unu dènge ana na.

source_text: and it comes to pass, on the next day, that the firstborn says to the younger, behold, i have lain with my father last night: we also cause him to drink wine tonight, then go in, lie with him, and we preserve a seed from our father.
target_text: hèia asa bèli èèna, a'a na peka dènge ari na, aku nèngu na, mèda deo na, ja'a j'unu le dènge ama èdhi. de mèda ne'e, èu kèna. èdhi hia ne hari ninu mahu, ho lamu j'unu dènge ne. sèna ka èdhi dua ti abhu ana, ho hia ana-èpu mi ama èdhi.

source_text: and they cause their father to drink wine on that night also, and the younger rises and lies with him, and he has not known in her lying down or in her rising up.
target_text: ka d'ara mèda na, dua ra hia hari ama ra ninu mahu. ka ana bhèni limuri ne, la'e ka j'unu dènge ama na. te ngaa, lula ama ra dhu mahu titu kèna, nèti èèna ka, ne'a boe ngaa dhu nèngu tao mi dedha ana bhèni na.

source_text: and the two daughters of lot conceive from their father,
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e ne ka, dua ra dènge babia nèti ama d'èlu rèngu.

source_text: and the firstborn bears a son and calls his name moab: he is father of moab to this day.
target_text: hèia ana bhèni uru èèna nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka na pangare na moab dhu sasoa na ‘mai nèti ama'. ana ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu moab.

source_text: as for the younger, she has also born a son and calls his name ben-ammi: he is father of the sons of ammon to this day.
target_text: ka ana bhèni limuri ne, nara iisi ana mone èci kahèi. na pangare na ben ami dhu sasoa na ‘mai nèti dhèu ja'a'. ana ne ka dhu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu amon.

source_text: and abraham journeys from there toward the land of the south, and dwells between kadesh and shur, and sojourns in gerar;
target_text: èle èèna, ka abraham nèti mamre, pidha asa rai negeb, dhu ètu re balèu, ka na pea ètu talora rae kades, dènge rae syur. te ngaa na pea nèbhu boe, ka pidha hari asa rae gerar.

source_text: and abraham says concerning his wife sarah, she is my sister; and abimelech king of gerar sends and takes sarah.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, sara ne, ana hèni ja'a. nèti èèna ka, abimelek dhèu aae gerar, pua dhèu lasi lii d'ai sara. ka nèti ne mai asa d'ara èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: and god comes to abimelech in a dream of the night and says to him, behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken-and she married to a husband.
target_text: d'ara ca mèda sa, ama lamatua pad'elo iisi na dènge dhèu aae ètu d'ara nii. na peka, mamadhe èu ne dètu kèna! lula èu more dhèu èmu dhèu.

source_text: and abimelech has not drawn near to her, and he says, lord, do you also slay a righteous nation? has he not himself said to me, she is my sister! and she, even she herself, said, he is my brother; in the integrity of my heart, and in the innocence of my hands, i have done this.
target_text: hèia abimelek dhaa, peka na, lamatua! ja'a dhae pa'èci mèka dènge bhèni na. aa ja'a sasala aad'o. abraham unu na ka dhu peka, bhèni na, ana hèni nèngu! aa bhèni na dhaa sèmi èèna kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a hia dhèu lasi lii d'ai ne, dènge d'ara mola. de lamatua baku pad'ui ja'a sasala!

source_text: and god says to him in the dream, indeed, i have known that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and i withhold you, even i, from sinning against me, therefore i have not permitted you to come against her;
target_text: ka lamatua dhaa, peka na, tare'a. mema ja'a ke'a d'ara èu mola. nèti èèna ka, ja'a ka dhu taha èu, ho baku pa'èci dènge ne. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, èu tao boe sala mi ja'a hèi.

source_text: and now send back the man's wife, for he is inspired, and he prays for you, and you live; and if you do not send back, know that dying you die, you and all that you have.
target_text: de èu mèti hari ka bhèni ne, lèpa sa dhèu èmu na. mone na ka dhu nèti lii padhue-padhai ja'a. de lamu manèngi ne, sèna ka na sabaj'a hia èu, ho èu baku madhe. sanèd'e paie! ladhe èu hia boe bhèni na lèpa, èu dènge kabarai èu madhe aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: and abimelech rises early in the morning, and calls for all his servants, and speaks all these words in their ears; and the men fear exceedingly;
target_text: bèli mad'ae aae èèna, dhèu aae pakaboko nare dhèu-dhèu kapai na aa'i-aa'i, ka na lolo lii nii na. hèia aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u.

source_text: and abimelech calls for abraham and says to him, what have you done to us? and what have i sinned against you, that you have brought on me, and on my kingdom, a great sin? works which are not done you have done with me.
target_text: ka dhèu aae paroa abraham. na karèi, aku nèngu na, ja'a tao sala ngaa mi èu, ka èu neo paj'èra ja'a dènge kabarai ja'a? èu ne ele-ho'a ka dènge tao madha j'ara sèmi ne'e ne.

source_text: abimelech also says to abraham, what have you seen that you have done this thing?
target_text: ngangee èu tasamia ka, mu tao sèmi ne'e ne?

source_text: and abraham says, because i said, surely the fear of god is not in this place, and they have slain me for the sake of my wife;
target_text: ka abraham dhaa, peka na, ama dhèu aae! ja'a pangee na, miu aa'i-aa'i mi, kabarai ne dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. de ele boe cahag'e neo pamadhe ja'a, sèna ka parame rare dhèu èmu ja'a.

source_text: and also, she is truly my sister, daughter of my father, only not daughter of my mother, and she becomes my wife;
target_text: mema ja'a dhu peka tare'a, nèngu ne, ana hèni ja'a. lula ji'i dua mi ca ama, te ngaa ina baka-leo. nèti èèna ka, ji'i dua mi paleo.

source_text: and it comes to pass, when god has caused me to wander from my father's house, that i say to her, this is your kindness which you do with me: at every place to where we come, say of me, he is my brother.
target_text: ka ropa ama lamatua pua ji'i ho tèke eele era paleo-palu'u ji'i, lod'o èèna ja'a peka dènge dhèu èmu ja'a, aku ja'a na, ‘ladhe èdhi lati asa era leo, ho dhèu karèi èu, dhu èdhi se dhèu èmu-kamali, ladhe èu dhu sue ja'a, na dhaa la, peka na èdhi se, dua ti pa'a'ari. '

source_text: and abimelech takes sheep and oxen, and servants and handmaids, and gives to abraham, and sends back his wife sarah to him; and abimelech says, behold, my land is before you, where it is good in your eyes, dwell; and to sarah he has said, behold, i have given one thousand pieces of silver to your brother; behold, it is to you a covering of eyes, to all who are with you; and by all this she is reasoned with.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae abimelek pangèd'u hari sara la'e asa abraham. ka na peka dènge sara, èèna na, ja'a hia ana mone mu doi iia ca riho, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha ja'a tao boe sala ngaa-ngaa mi èu. ho hud'i sène, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra re'a! hèia dhèu aae peka dènge abraham, aku nèngu na, kabarai ja'a ne, dhu bhoke tèke hia èu. èu neo pea mi era mia èèna ka, ja'a hia èu. ka abimelek hia abraham sapi, kahib'i-ka'ia, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho. na hia kahèi ènu dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni.

source_text: and abraham prays to god, and god heals abimelech and his wife, and his handmaids, and they bear: for yhwh restraining had restrained every womb of the house of abimelech, because of sarah, abraham's wife.
target_text: uru èèna, lula abimelek nare dhèu èmu abraham, ka lamatua hutu eele era ana nèti bhèni aa'i-aa'i dhu pea ètu kabarai dhèu aae èèna. te ngaa ropa abimelek hia sara lèpa hari sa dhèu èmu na, ka abraham sabaj'a ho lamatua bhoke hari era ana nèti bhèni se. ka ra abhu hari ana.

source_text: and yhwh has looked after sarah as he has said, and yhwh does to sarah as he has spoken; and sarah conceives, and bears a son to abraham, to his old age, at the appointed time that god has spoken of with him; and abraham calls the name of his son who is born to him, whom sarah has borne to him-isaac; and abraham circumcises his son isaac, being a son of eight days, as god has commanded him. and abraham is a son of one hundred years in his son isaac being born to him, and sarah says, god has made laughter for me; everyone who is hearing laughs for me. she also says, who has said to abraham, sarah has suckled sons, that i have born a son for his old age?
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua hia sara mèngi-nale madhutu lii pajaji na. lod'o sara dènge babia, abraham dhu heka le. ropa sara nara iisi, umur abraham d'ai cangasu tèu kèna. lod'o sara d'ai hèru, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka abraham pangare ne, isak dhu sasoa na ‘na mari'. sara peka hèi, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua tao ja'a mari, lula ja'a karej'e. dhèu ae ka dhu pangee na, ja'a ètu d'ara heka sèmi ne'e ne, abhu heka ana. masi ka dhèu èmu ja'a heka bhoro le, te ja'a bisa kora iisi ana hia ne. èèna na, ladhe dhèu tadèngi j'ara ne'e, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra mari kahèi dènge ja'a ne. ropa isak d'ai aru lod'o, abraham suna ne, madhutu paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: and the boy grows, and is weaned, and abraham makes a great banquet in the day of isaac's being weaned;
target_text: isak kapai ka noo-noo. ropa oe d'ai lod'o luri susu, abraham tao tatao aae.

source_text: and sarah sees the son of hagar the egyptian, whom she has borne to abraham, mocking, and she says to abraham, cast out this handmaid and her son; for the son of this handmaid has no possession with my son-with isaac.
target_text: ca tèke, sara ladhe nèdhi ismael, ana nèti dhèu èmu limuri abraham, padadisi dènge isak. ropa nèdhi sèmi èèna, sara peka dènge dhèu èmu na, bège eele ènu masir nèi dènge ana na! te, ja'a ko'o boe ana ènu èèna unu pusaka, masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka. dhoka ana ja'a isak di, dhu abhu sèra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and the thing is very wrong in the eyes of abraham, for his son's sake;
target_text: ropa abraham tadèngi lii padhai sara ne, ka d'ara na ako be'a boe, lula ismael ne, ana d'èlu na kahèi.

source_text: and god says to abraham, let it not be wrong in your eyes because of the youth, and because of your handmaid: all that sarah says to you-listen to her voice, for in isaac is a seed called to you.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua lii dènge abraham, peka na, abraham! èu baku ngee pa'ae dhèu èmu limuri èu, dènge ana na. madhutu la dad'èi sara ne, lula bèli-camèd'a, èu abhu ana-èpu dhu ja'a moa tèke èèna, nèti isak ne'e ka.

source_text: as for the son of the handmaid also, for a nation i set him, because he is your seed.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a hia kahèi mèngi-nale mi ana nèti dhèu èmu limuri mu, lula nèngu ne, ana d'èlu èu kahèi. bèli-camèd'a, ana-èpu na j'aj'i suku èci kahèi.

source_text: and abraham rises early in the morning, and takes bread, and a bottle of water, and gives to hagar placing it on her shoulder, also the boy, and sends her out; and she goes on, and goes astray in the wilderness of beer-sheba;
target_text: bèli mad'ae aae èèna, abraham tao gee j'ara hia hagar, aa na kadhoe èi d'ara babo'i cue mi kabela-kao na. hèia na patabuli ka bhèni ne dènge ana na ismael, ho lasi. ka ra kako palème d'ara mamoo dhu dètu dènge beer-syeba.

source_text: and the water is consumed from the bottle, and she places the boy under one of the shrubs.
target_text: ropa èle èi rinu ra, hagar tèke eele ana na ètu d'ara mamaho aj'u iiki ca kapua.

source_text: and she goes and sits by herself opposite him, far off, about a bow-shot, for she said, do not let me look on the death of the boy; and she sits opposite him, and lifts up her voice, and weeps.
target_text: ka na pangee ètu d'ara na, d'ara ja'a la'e boe, ladhe ja'a kèdhi mamadhe ana ja'a. ka na madhèdi ako kaj'èu nèti ana na, pe d'ai lèmi nguru meter sa. ka na tangi dènge lii roma iisi.

source_text: and god hears the voice of the youth; and the messenger of god calls to hagar from the heavens and says to her, what to you, hagar? do not fear; for god has listened to the voice of the youth where he is;
target_text: lula ama lamatua dhu tadèngi lii tangi ismael, ka ana pajuu na mai nèti sorga, ka paroa hagar, aku nèngu na, hagar! nga tao ka, èu j'èra ae sèmi ne'e ne? baku madha'u ia ka, te lamatua tadèngi le lii tangi ana èu.

source_text: rise, lift up the youth, and lay hold on him with your hand, for i set him for a great nation.
target_text: de kèd'i lamu more ana nèi. pa'èra d'ara na, te bèli-camèd'a ja'a paj'aj'i ana-èpu na, suku èci dhu kapai.

source_text: and god opens her eyes, and she sees a well of water, and she goes and fills the bottle with water, and causes the youth to drink;
target_text: ka ama lamatua pasaraa musi madha na. cag'ag'a laa nèdhi dènge, èi ca madha ètu era èèna. hèia la'e soli èi asa d'ara babo'i, ka na panginu ana na ismael.

source_text: and god is with the youth, and he grows, and dwells in the wilderness, and is an archer; and he dwells in the wilderness of paran, and his mother takes for him a wife from the land of egypt.
target_text: ka ismael dènge ina na hagar pea dènge ka ètu d'ara mamoo paran. ismael asa na kapai, aa ne'a mèu kataki. ka ina na paleo ne dènge ana bhèni masir ca dhèu. se'e se j'aj'i, lula ama lamatua bera-bera dènge ismael.

source_text: and it comes to pass at that time that abimelech speaks-phichol also, head of his host-to abraham, saying, god is with you in all that you are doing;
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae abimelek dènge kètu kapai sordad'u na, fikol, mai pangad'o dènge abraham. hèia dhèu aae padhai lii, ka na peka, abraham! ji'i se nge'a ama lamatua bera-bera dènge èu. nèti èèna ka, sad'i èu ad'u ngaa sa èci, j'aj'i dènge be'a.

source_text: and now, swear to me by god here: you do not lie to me, or to my continuator, or to my successor; according to the kindness which i have done with you-do with me, and with the land in which you have sojourned.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi, sèna ka èu subha ètu katanga madha ama lamatua, dhu peka na, èu bisa boe kapod'e-kabèli ja'a, dènge ana-èpu ja'a aa'i-aa'i ra. sèmi dhu ja'a tao le be'a mi èu, na, èu hud'i tao be'a kahèi mi ja'a dènge kabarai ja'a.

source_text: and abraham says, i swear.
target_text: ka aku abraham na, ooo! ja'a subha.

source_text: and abraham reasoned with abimelech concerning the matter of a well of water which abimelech's servants have violently taken away,
target_text: te ngaa èle èèna ka, abraham lapor dènge dhèu aae, aku nèngu na, dhèu-dhèu ama dhèu aae parame rare èi ja'a ca madha.

source_text: and abimelech says, i have not known who has done this thing, and even you did not declare to me, and i also, i have not heard except today.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia na peka, waa! ja'a heka tadèngi kèna j'ara ne'e ne. tasamia ka karèi nèti ca hari ni, èu peka boe dènge ja'a? ja'a dhae ke'a mèka, ne'e ne tatao cee ka ne.

source_text: and abraham takes sheep and oxen, and gives to abimelech, and they make, both of them, a covenant; and abraham sets seven lambs of the flock by themselves.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abraham dènge abimelek pa'èki lii pajaji. ka abraham hia abimelek sapi dènge kahib'i-kalèbho. èle èèna ka, abraham hag'e nare hari kahib'i-kalèbho èni pidhu ngi'u.

source_text: and abimelech says to abraham, what are they-these seven lambs which you have set by themselves?
target_text: hèia dhèu aae karèi ne, peka na, nga tao ka èu tao sèmi èèna?

source_text: and he says, for-the seven lambs you accept from my hand, so that it becomes a witness for me that i have dug this well;
target_text: ka abraham peka, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae. sèmi la kalèbho èni pidhu ngi'u se, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha dhu ama peka le na, ja'a ka dhu kèi èi na.

source_text: therefore he has called that place beer-sheba, for both of them have sworn there.
target_text: lula dua ra dhu pa'èki le soo-subha ètu èèna, ka era na ra pangare na beer-syeba dhu sasoa na, ‘madha èi soo-subha'.

source_text: and they make a covenant in beer-sheba, and abimelech rises-phichol also, head of his host-and they return to the land of the philistines;
target_text: ropa pasubha èle, ka dhèu aae dènge kètu kapai sordad'u na lèpa ka, asa era rèngu, rai dhèu pilistin.

source_text: and abraham plants a tamarisk in beer-sheba, and preaches there in the name of yhwh, the perpetual god;
target_text: èle èèna ka, abraham sèle aj'u tamareska ca kapua ètu beer syeba. karèi nèti lod'o èèna, aj'u ne pasanèd'e abraham, lula ètu era èèna ka, nèngu mangaj'i lamatua dhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and abraham sojourns in the land of the philistines many days.
target_text: ka abraham pea dènge ka ètu talora dhèu pilistin sèmi dhèu tao mai.

source_text: and it comes to pass after these things that god has tried abraham and says to him, abraham; and he says, here i am.
target_text: nèbhu boe, hèia lamatua sèku neo ne'a d'ara abraham. neo ne'a abraham madhutu lamatua, do aad'o. ka lamatua paroa ne, aku nèngu na, abraham! hèia na dhaa, peka na, ooo, lamatua.

source_text: and he says, now take your son, your only one, whom you have loved, even isaac, and go for yourself to the land of moriah, and cause him to ascend there for a burnt-offering on one of the mountains of which i speak to you.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge ne, mu nanene paie-iie! more ana pasue èu mone mesa na. mèti ne asa rai moria, ho tao ne j'aj'i korban tunu hia ja'a. pe d'ai nèi, ja'a heka paj'uj'u era dhu ètu ledhe èci.

source_text: and abraham rises early in the morning, and saddles his donkey, and takes two of his young men with him, and his son isaac, and he cleaves the wood of the burnt-offering, and rises and goes to the place of which god has spoken to him.
target_text: d'ai bèli mad'ae aae na, abraham sèg'i aj'u sèna ka tao kadhèna. na èki, ka na hue asa dedha keled'ei. ka dua ra dènge isak, aa dènge dhèu sab'a na dhèu dua, pakèd'i asa era dhu lamatua peka dènge ne.

source_text: on the third day-abraham lifts up his eyes, and sees the place from afar;
target_text: ra kako taruu, ka d'ai camèd'a èèna, abraham nèdhi le era èèna nèti kaj'èu.

source_text: and abraham says to his young men, remain by yourselves here with the donkey, and i and the youth go over there and worship, and return to you.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge dhèu dua sèra, aku nèngu na, dua mi mate taha mi ne'e dènge keled'ei ne. ja'a dènge ana ja'a la'a asa dedha nèi, ho mangaj'i ama lamatua. ladhe èle na, ji'i lèpa hari mai.

source_text: and abraham takes the wood of the burnt-offering, and places on his son isaac, and he takes in his hand the fire, and the knife; and they go on both of them together.
target_text: ka abraham nare kadhèna dhu neo tunu korban, ka na tao mi kabela-kao isak. aa nèngu nèd'u tud'i, dènge suu ai. ropa dua ra palere lasi,

source_text: and isaac speaks to his father abraham and says, my father, and he says, here i am, my son. and he says, behold, the fire and the wood, and where the lamb for a burnt-offering?
target_text: hèia isak paroa ama na, aku nèngu na, ama! ka abraham dhaa, aku nèngu na, nga tao, ana? hèia isak karèi, aku nèngu na, èdhi neo lati tunu korban. de ai dènge kadhèna ka se'e le. te ngaa ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu èdhi pake j'aj'i korban, ka mia?

source_text: and abraham says, god provides for himself the lamb for a burnt-offering, my son; and they go on both of them together.
target_text: te ngaa, aku abraham na, pe ama lamatua unu na ka dhu hia ana kalèbho, sèna ka j'aj'i mi korban. ka dua ra ca'e lasi taruu.

source_text: and they come to the place of which god has spoken to him, and there abraham builds the altar, and arranges the wood, and binds his son isaac, and places him on the altar above the wood;
target_text: ropa dua ra d'ai era dhu lamatua peka èèna, ka abraham pudhi hadhu ho tao mei korban. hèia na paloko kadhèna ètu dedha mei korban ne. ka kèpe ana na isak, èki patarenga ne ètu dedha kadhèna.

source_text: and abraham puts forth his hand, and takes the knife-to slaughter his son.
target_text: ka nare tud'i, ho neo kèj'i pamadhe ana na.

source_text: and the messenger of yhwh calls to him from the heavens and says, abraham, abraham; and he says, here i am;
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu lamatua lii nèti dedha-liru, peka na, abraham! mata ku! ka abraham dhaa, aku nèngu na, nga tao, lamatua?

source_text: and he says, do not put forth your hand to the youth, nor do anything to him, for now i have known that you are fearing god, and have not withheld your son, your only one, from me.
target_text: ka na peka hari, na, baku pamadhe ana èèna! baku tao ngaa-ngaa mi nèngu. ja'a ke'a le, èu ne tare'a-re'a madhutu dad'èi lamatua. lula èu dènge d'ara kateme hia ana èu ca dhèu mesa èèna, sèna ka j'aj'i mi korban hia ne.

source_text: and abraham lifts up his eyes, and looks, and behold, a ram behind, seized in a thicket by its horns; and abraham goes, and takes the ram, and causes it to ascend for a burnt-offering instead of his son;
target_text: hèia abraham ladhe nèdhi kahib'i-kalèbho mone ci'u, dhu tadhu na pakai nare dadana aaj'u dhu karoki. ka na la'e kèpe nare, ho tunu j'aj'i mi korban hia ama lamatua, gati ana na.

source_text: and abraham calls the name of that place yhwh-jireh, because it is said this day in the mountain, yhwh provides.
target_text: ka abraham pangare era èèna, na, ‘lamatua sadia tèke ngaa dhu parluu. ' nèti èèna ka, d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu peka na, ètu ledhe lamatua èèna, na sadia tèke ngaa dhu parluu.

source_text: and the messenger of yhwh calls to abraham a second time from the heavens,
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu lamatua lii hari nèti dedha-liru, peka na,

source_text: and says, i have sworn by myself-a declaration of yhwh-that because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only one,
target_text: lamatua unu na, peka, ‘ja'a subha dènge kolongara ja'a mesa ku, sèmi ne'e: èu sadia le hia ja'a ana mu ca dhèu mone mesa na ho j'aj'i mi korban. nèti èèna ka,

source_text: that blessing i bless you, and multiplying i multiply your seed as stars of the heavens, and as sand which is on the seashore; and your seed possesses the gate of his enemies;
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, ja'a pala-bagi èu dènge ana-èpu èu mèngi-nale ae-ae. èèna na, ra bèba-kacanga, toke dhèu ige rare boe, sèmi hua-hètu ètu dedha-liru, aa salae ètu sebhe dhasi. ana-èpu èu sèra, èèna na, segi aa'i musu rèngu sèra.

source_text: and all nations of the earth have blessed themselves in your seed, because you have listened to my voice.
target_text: nèti ana-èpu èu, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne abhu mèngi-nale lula èu madhutu le lii paredha ja'a. '

source_text: and abraham turns back to his young men, and they rise and go together to beer-sheba; and abraham dwells in beer-sheba.
target_text: èle hèia, abraham dènge isak, lèpa hari asa era dhu dhèu sab'a na sèra. ka lasi palere asa beer-syeba. d'ai nèi, abraham si pea dènge ka.

source_text: and it comes to pass after these things that it is declared to abraham, saying, behold, milcah has borne, even she, sons to your brother nahor:
target_text: ca lod'o, abraham tadèngi na, dhèu èmu ari na nahor, dhu ngara na milka, nara iisi ana na.

source_text: his firstborn huz, and his brother buz; and kemuel father of aram,
target_text: ana uru, ngara na us. ari na, bus. èle ka, nara iisi hari kemuel dhu j'aj'i ama aram.

source_text: and chesed, and hazo, and pildash, and jidlaph, and bethuel;
target_text: ka na abhu hari kesed, haso, pildas, yidlaf, dènge betuel.

source_text: and bethuel has begotten rebekah; milcah has borne these eight to nahor, abraham's brother;
target_text: betuel èèna, ama nèti ribka.

source_text: and his concubine, whose name is reumah, she also has borne tebah, and gaham, and tahash, and maachah.
target_text: nahor abhu ana kahèi nèti bhèni piara na, ngara na reuma. ana reuma, nuka: teba, gaham, tahas, dènge maaka.

source_text: and the life of sarah is one hundred and twenty-seven years-years of the life of sarah; and sarah dies in kirjath-arba, which is hebron, in the land of canaan, and abraham goes to mourn for sarah, and to lament her.
target_text: lod'o sara madhe, umur na ca ngasu dua nguru pidhu tèu le. lod'o na madhe èèna, abraham si pea ètu rae kiryat-arba nuka hebron, ètu rai kana'an. ka abraham beke aa tangi dhèu èmu na dènge d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: and abraham rises up from the presence of his dead, and speaks to the sons of heth, saying,
target_text: hèia abraham kèd'i la'e paraga dènge dhèu-dhèu het. ka na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na,

source_text: a sojourner and a settler i am with you; give to me a possession of a burying-place with you, and i bury my dead from before me.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu tao mai ètu talora miu se. ja'a dhu dènge boe rai ca kasib'i sa, sèna ka padhane dhèu èmu ja'a. de ladhe miu sue ja'a, ja'a hèli kore rai miu d'ai ca kasib'i sa, ho tao era padhane ne.

source_text: and the sons of heth answer abraham, saying to him,
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na,

source_text: hear us, my lord; a prince of god are you in our midst; in the choice of our burying-places bury your dead: none of our burying-places do we withhold from you, from burying your dead.
target_text: sèmi ne'e, ama! nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ji'i se tadhe le ama, dhu sama sèmi ca dhèu, dhèu heka dhu ji'i pakab'ua. de sad'i ama d'èi rai mia dhu be'a, dhu pamèci dènge dad'èi ama. ji'i se dhoka ngo'o di; dhèu èci sa dhu magee boe.

source_text: and abraham rises and bows himself to the people of the land, to the sons of heth,
target_text: hèia abraham pacud'u iisi ho hia hormat mi lamatua rai, dhèu het sèra.

source_text: and he speaks with them, saying, if it is your desire to bury my dead from before me, hear me, and meet for me with ephron, son of zoar;
target_text: ka na padhai lii, peka na, ladhe miu sèmi lii ja'a na, ja'a manèngi ho peka dènge ana mone sohar, dhu ngara na efron.
