source_text: and he gives to me the cave of machpelah, which he has, which is in the extremity of his field; for full money does he give it to me, in your midst, for a possession of a burying-place.
target_text: peka dènge ne, ladhe na d'èi, na pahia dènge ja'a loe na, makpela, dhu ètu karasa oka na. na manèngi ca ngaa èèna ka, ja'a tihe. ja'a neo tihe pama'ète kab'ua na, ètu madha miu aa'i-aa'i mi, sèna ka rai èèna j'aj'i unu ja'a. ja'a neo tao era èèna, j'aj'i mi ro'a dhèu madhe ji'i.

source_text: and ephron is sitting in the midst of the sons of heth, and ephron the hittite answers abraham in the ears of the sons of heth, of all those entering the gate of his city, saying,
target_text: lod'o èèna, efron madhèdi ètu era èèna kahèi, dènge dhèu-dhèu het sèra. ka na tadèngi kahèi lii padhai lii abraham deo na. hèia na kèd'i titu, ka na b'ala abraham ètu madha dhèu heka aa'i-aa'i ra ètu sèra, aku nèngu na,

source_text: no, my lord, hear me: the field i have given to you, and the cave that is in it, to you i have given it; before the eyes of the sons of my people i have given it to you-bury your dead.
target_text: baku sèmi èèna, ama! sèmi ne'e ka laa! oka dènge loe makpela èèna, ja'a hia iia ama. sèna ka mu padhane dhèu èmu èu mi èèna. ja'a pangèd'u rai èèna mi ama, ètu madha dhèu-dhèu ja'a se. sèna ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i sakasii!

source_text: and abraham bows himself before the people of the land,
target_text: ka abraham pacud'u kètu hari mi dhèu het se.

source_text: and speaks to ephron in the ears of the people of the land, saying, only-if you would hear me-i have given the money of the field-accept from me, and i bury my dead there.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge efron, aku nèngu na, sèmi èèna oo, be'a kahèi. te ngaa miu nanene lii ja'a, la ma. ja'a neo hèli pama'ète rai na, sèna ka j'aj'i era padhane dhèu-dhèu ja'a.

source_text: and ephron answers abraham, saying to him, my lord, hear me: the land-four hundred shekels of silver; between me and you, what is it? bury your dead.
target_text: hèia, aku efron na, rai èèna, kab'ua na, dhoka èpa ngasu doi pudhi di. guna ngaa èdhi dua ti padhue kab'ua rai ciki oo'e èèna, dhu sasoa na aad'o. de lamu ka, ho mèti dhèu madhe na, sèna ka padhane ne ètu nèi.

source_text: and abraham listens to ephron, and abraham weighs to ephron the silver which he has spoken of in the ears of the sons of heth, four hundred silver shekels, passing with the merchant.
target_text: ka abraham d'èi kahèi dènge kab'ua na sange èèna, madhutu sèmi lii efron. hèia ètu madha dhèu ae-ae sèra, na ige nare doi pudhi èpa ngasu, tihe kab'ua rai èèna mi efron.

source_text: and established are the field of ephron, which is in machpelah, which is before mamre, the field and the cave which is in it, and all the trees which are in the field, which are around all its border, to abraham by purchase, before the eyes of the sons of heth, among all entering the gate of his city. and after this abraham has buried his wife sarah at the cave of the field of machpelah before mamre which is hebron, in the land of canaan;
target_text: de dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, abraham abhu dènge rai ne nèti efron, j'aj'i mi unu na. rai na nuka ètu makpela, padètu dènge mamre nuka hebron. na hèli pama'ète rai ne dènge oka na, dènge loe na, aa dènge aj'u aa'i-aa'i ra. dhèu-dhèu heka nèti suku het, aa'i-aa'i ra ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii, peka na, rai èèna dènge isi aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i le unu abraham. èle èèna ka, abraham la'e padhane sara ètu d'ara loe èèna, ètu rai kana'an.

source_text: and established are the field, and the cave which is in it, to abraham for a possession of a burying-place, from the sons of heth.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, dhu uru èèna oka dènge loe na unu dhèu het, limuri ne j'aj'i le rai unu abraham. ka na tao j'aj'i mi era udhu rui ra.

source_text: and abraham is old, he has entered into days, and yhwh has blessed abraham in all things;
target_text: tèu-tèu mamuri abraham madhera titu kèna. lamatua ladhe-leru ne dènge be'a, aa hia ne mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: and abraham says to his servant, the eldest of his house, who is ruling over all that he has, please put your hand under my thigh, and i cause you to swear by yhwh, god of the heavens and god of the earth, that you do not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the canaanite, in the midst of whom i am dwelling;
target_text: abraham dhu dènge dhèu èci dhu na lèka ho ladhe-leru mèdha-panyau na. ca lod'o, abraham paroa nare, ka peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, mu pasa dhilu èu paie-iie! ja'a manèngi sèna ka èu subha madhe dènge kolongara lamatua. nèngu ka, ama lamatua dhu tao dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne. dhu peka na, èu bisa boe more ana bhèni nèti dhèu kana'an, ho paleo dènge ana ja'a isak.

source_text: but to my land and to my family you go, and have taken a wife for my son, for isaac.
target_text: te ngaa èu hud'i lamu ku asa rai èta-èsu ja'a, asa a'ari ja'a. ho tenge ètu rèngu sèi, ana bhèni ca dhèu, ho mu paleo dènge ana ja'a ne.

source_text: and the servant says to him, it may be the woman is not willing to come after me to this land; do i at all cause your son to return to the land from where you came out?
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a ne karèi abraham, aku nèngu na, be'a, ama! te ngaa, sèmi ana bhèni na d'èi boe mai asa ne'e, na tasamia? ladhe sèmi èèna, hud'i ja'a kèti ana ama ku, ho hia ne leo-èmu ètu nèi, do tasamia?

source_text: and abraham says to him, take heed to yourself lest you cause my son to return there;
target_text: hèia, aku abraham na, èu nanene paie! masi ka tasamia èèna ka, mage èu mèti ana ja'a ne, asa nèi kahèi!

source_text: yhwh, god of the heavens, who has taken me from the house of my father, and from the land of my birth, and who has spoken to me, and who has sworn to me, saying, to your seed i give this land, he sends his messenger before you, and you have taken a wife for my son from there;
target_text: mu sanèd'e, te lamatua dhu nèd'u koasa ètu dedha-liru, ka dhu lere ja'a nèti rai èta-èsu ja'a, asa dedha-rai ne'e ne. aa dhu na pa'èki le lii pajaji dènge ja'a, dhu peka na, ‘èèna na, ja'a hia rai ne aa'i-aa'i mi ana-èpu èu. ' de èu baku madha'u. sad'i lamu. te èèna na, lamatua pua ana pajuu na nèti sorga, mai bhoke j'ara hia èu, sèna ka èu paraga dènge ana bhèni, dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu ana ja'a.

source_text: and if the woman is not willing to come after you, then you have been acquitted from this my oath: only you do not cause my son to return there.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ana bhèni na d'èi boe mai asa ne'e, lii soo-subha ne lèke boe èu. masi ka tasamia na, èu bisa boe mèti ana ja'a asa nèi.

source_text: and the servant puts his hand under the thigh of abraham his lord, and swears to him concerning this matter.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne, ded'e subha dènge abraham, ka na peka, èèna na, nèngu tao madhutu dad'èi abraham aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and the servant takes ten camels of the camels of his lord and goes, also of all the goods of his lord in his hand, and he rises, and goes to aram-naharaim, to the city of nahor;
target_text: ka dhèu èèna pili nare badha onta canguru ngi'u. hèia na hua rupa-rupa mèdha dhu kab'ua asa dedha onta se. hèia la'e ka asa kota nahor, ètu rai mesopotamia.

source_text: and he causes the camels to kneel at the outside of the city, at the well of water, at evening, at the time of the coming out of the women who draw water.
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu ka mone ne d'ai kota èèna. hèia na ae kabhèsu dènge onta sèra ètu sebhe kota èèna, dètu dènge madha èi èci. na ae èèna d'ara lod'o nihia le, ropa ana bhèni-ana bhèni kota èèna mai rara èi ètu madha èi èèna.

source_text: and he says, yhwh, god of my lord abraham, please cause to meet before me this day-and do kindness with my lord abraham;
target_text: hèia dhèu ne sabaj'a, peka na, lamatua, èu ka dhu j'aj'i ama lamatua nèti lamatua ja'a, abraham. bhoke j'ara hia ja'a, sèna ka kakako ja'a ne dènge kab'ua. pad'elo sasue èu mi lamatua ja'a, aa baku bhèlu lii pajaji ne dènge ja'a. de hia la ja'a paraga dènge ana bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak.

source_text: behold, i am standing by the fountain of water, and daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water;
target_text: lamatua, ja'a ka titu ètu karasa madha èi ne. aa ana bhèni-ana bhèni nèti kota ne, mai rara èi ètu ne'e.

source_text: and it has been, the young person to whom i say, please incline your pitcher and i drink, and she has said, drink, and i also water your camels-her whom you have decided for your servant, for isaac; and by it i know that you have done kindness with my lord.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ja'a padhai lii dènge ana bhèni èci, peka na, ‘ana, ee! papuru ku èru èi èu hia ja'a kinu. ' ho ladhe na dhaa, peka na, ‘ama, minu la! aa, pe ja'a hia dènge onta ama, rinu hèi! ' j'ara ne'e ne j'aj'i tadha dhu peka na, ana bhèni ne ka dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u, j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu isak! dènge tadha sèmi ne'e, ja'a ke'a na lamatua pad'elo le babe'a mi abraham, lamatua ja'a èèna.

source_text: and it comes to pass, before he has finished speaking, that behold, rebekah who was born to bethuel, son of milcah, wife of nahor, brother of abraham is coming out, and her pitcher on her shoulder, and the young person is of very good appearance, a virgin, and a man has not known her; and she goes down to the fountain, and fills her pitcher, and comes up.
target_text: dhu na sabaj'a nare mèka, ana bhèni ca dhèu mai. ngara na ribka. nèngu ne, èpu nèti ari abraham, nuka nahor, dènge dhèu èmu na, milka. ama ribka, ngara na betuel. ribka ne, bhèni iia nia boe, aa pa'èci nèdhi mèka dènge mone. d'ai era èèna, puru asa d'ara èi la'e, ka na isi èru èi na. nèbhu boe, ka ca'e mai sa dedha.

source_text: and the servant runs to meet her and says, please let me swallow a little water from your pitcher;
target_text: ropa nare dedha, ka dhèu sab'a abraham èèna, la'e padètu dènge ne. hèia na manèngi, peka na, ana. hia ku ja'a kinu ciki.

source_text: and she says, drink, my lord; and she hurries, and lets down her pitcher on her hand, and gives him drink.
target_text: ka na dhaa, minu la, ama! hèia na papuru ka èru èi na, ka na hia dhèu ne ninu.

source_text: and she finishes giving him drink and says, also for your camels i draw until they have finished drinking;
target_text: ropa ninu èle, ka ana bhèni ne peka na, pe ja'a laku dhui hari èi, sèna ka hia onta ama se, rinu toke bècu.

source_text: and she hurries, and empties her pitcher into the drinking-trough, and runs again to the well to draw, and draws for all his camels.
target_text: ka la'e bhori èi dhu risi, asa d'ara karab'a badha. hèia na ca'e-la'e mai pèri-pèri hari, dhui èi, ho hia onta se rinu toke bècu.

source_text: and the man, wondering at her, remains silent, to know whether yhwh has made his way prosperous or not.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a abraham, titu ka mau-mau, na taru kira ka ana bhèni ne sab'a. ka na pangee ètu d'ara na, aku nèngu na, ele boe nèngu èèna ka ne'e, dhu lamatua paj'uj'u.

source_text: and it comes to pass, when the camels have finished drinking, that the man takes a golden ring whose weight is a bekah, and two bracelets for her hands whose weight is ten bekahs of gold,
target_text: onta se rinu toke bècu. hèia dhèu ne nare kadheli sahènga, dènge kanau ca pasa. mèdha se dhu tao nèti hualaa. ka na pasa mi sahènga dènge pasaluu mi ai kariu dènge g'ana ana bhèni ne.

source_text: and says, whose daughter are you? please declare to me, is the house of your father a place for us to lodge in?
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu ne karèi ne, aku nèngu na, ana, ama mu, ngara na cee? ladhe mo'o, na ja'a manubha taha ètu èmu ama mu.

source_text: and she says to him, i am daughter of bethuel, son of milcah, whom she has borne to nahor.
target_text: hèia na dhaa, ngara ama ku, na betuel. aa ngara baki ku, nahor. dènge ngara bèi ku, milka.

source_text: she also says to him, both straw and provender are abundant with us, also a place to lodge in.
target_text: ètu èmu ji'i, era j'unu ae, de d'ai miu j'unu. aa j'u'u ae kahèi, ho hia badha miu se ra'a.

source_text: and the man bows, and pays respect to yhwh,
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a ne pahaha iisi ho mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: and says, blessed is yhwh, god of my lord abraham, who has not left off his kindness and his truth with my lord-i being in the way, yhwh has led me to the house of my lord's brothers.
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, koa-kio kolongara lamatua! ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara hia ja'a, ka ja'a paraga le dènge a'ari lamatua ja'a abraham ètu kabarai ne'e. dènge j'ara ne'e, lamatua pad'elo sasue na mi lamatua ja'a, abraham, aa tao madhutu sama sèmi lii pajaji na dènge ja'a.

source_text: and the young person runs, and declares to the house of her mother according to these words.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana bhèni ne rai la'e asa èmu, na lolo dènge isi èmu na ngaa dhu j'aj'i le èèna.

source_text: and rebekah has a brother, and his name is laban, and laban runs to the man who is outside, to the fountain; indeed, it comes to pass, when he sees the ring, and the bracelets on the hands of his sister, and when he hears the words of his sister rebekah, saying, thus has the man spoken to me, that he comes to the man, and behold, he is standing by the camels by the fountain.
target_text: ana mone ribka, ngara na laban. ropa laban ladhe nèdhi mèdha hualaa se, aa na tadèngi lii lolo ana hèni na, ka rai asa li'u la'e. la'e soru dhèu sab'a abraham dhu titu era dènge onta ra ètu madha èi.

source_text: and he says, come in, o blessed one of yhwh! why do you stand outside-and i have prepared the house and place for the camels?
target_text: hèia laban peka, aku nèngu na, ama! lamatua ka dhu lere miu mai dènge karej'e-karae d'ai ne'e. de baku titu mi li'u ne! mai lati sa èmu ji'i, te ji'i lalau ngare le kama. nganga'a hia badha se, dhu tesa.

source_text: and he brings in the man into the house, and looses the camels, and gives straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the feet of the men who are with him:
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a abraham ne, madhutu dènge ka laban, lasi èmu betuel. ka laban si papuru mèdha-panyau nèti dedha onta se. èle èèna ka, ra panga'a onta se. rèti èi, hia dhèu sab'a dènge anga na se, ho rase haga.

source_text: and sets before him to eat; but he says, i do not eat until i have spoken my word; and he says, speak.
target_text: ropa lalau rare nganga'a-nginu ètu dedha mei, dhèu sab'a ne padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ji'i neo nga'a ne, te ngaa ja'a lole uuru ku, mamai ja'a ne. ka laban dhaa, peka na, ama, mu padhai lii ngaa, na peka ka laa.

source_text: and he says, i am abraham's servant;
target_text: hèia dhèu èèna peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu sab'a nèti baki miu abraham.

source_text: and yhwh has blessed my lord exceedingly, and he is great; and he gives to him flock, and herd, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and donkeys;
target_text: lamatua hia abraham, lamatua ja'a èèna, mèngi-nale ae titu kèna, ka na kaja-su'i. lamatua pala-bagi ne doi hualaa pudhi dènge hualaa iia; ènu dhèu bhèni dènge dhèu mone, dènge badha-manu ae-ae, sèmi: sapi, onta, keled'ei, kahib'i-ka'ia, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho.

source_text: and sarah, my lord's wife, bears a son to my lord, after she has been aged, and he gives to him all that he has.
target_text: lod'o lamatua ja'a se, bhèni-mone d'ai heka ku, ka sara nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. nèngu ka dhu bèli-camèd'a unu aa'i pusaka ama na.

source_text: and my lord causes me to swear, saying, you do not take a wife to my son from the daughters of the canaanite, in whose land i am dwelling.
target_text: ka abraham pua ja'a subha, peka na, ‘mage èu more ana bhèni kana'an kahèi, ho paleo dènge ana ja'a, isak.

source_text: if not-to the house of my father you go, and to my family, and you have taken a wife for my son.
target_text: te ngaa èu hud'i more ana bhèni nèti a'ari ja'a unu ku, ho sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. '

source_text: and i say to my lord, it may be the woman does not come after me;
target_text: hèia ja'a karèi ne, aku ja'a na, ‘tasamia, ladhe ana bhèni ne, no'o boe madhutu ja'a mai sa ne'e? '

source_text: and he says to me, yhwh, before whom i have habitually walked, sends his messenger with you, and has prospered your way, and you have taken a wife for my son from my family, and from the house of my father;
target_text: ka na peka, ‘lamatua dhu ja'a madhutu dad'èi na, pe na paleha ana pajuu na nèti sorga, mai bhoke j'ara hia èu, sèna ka èu abhu ana bhèni ca dhèu nèti a'ari ja'a unu ku, ho j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu ana ja'a.

source_text: then you are acquitted from my oath, when you come to my family; and if they do not give one to you, then you have been acquitted from my oath.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe a'ari ja'a se'e ro'o boe ana bhèni na mai asa ne'e, lii subha na lèke boe mi dedha èu ne. '

source_text: and i come to the fountain today, and i say, yhwh, god of my lord abraham, now if you are making prosperous my way in which i am going-
target_text: ka deo na, ropa ja'a d'ai madha èi èèna, ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara, peka na, ‘lamatua nèti lamatua ja'a abraham. bhoke ku j'ara hia ja'a, sèna ka mamai ja'a ne dènge kab'ua. ho sèna ka ja'a abhu ana bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak.

source_text: behold, i am standing by the fountain of water, then the virgin is coming out to draw, and i have said to her, please let me drink a little water from your pitcher,
target_text: lamatua, ja'a titu ètu sebhe madha èi ne. aa ana bhèni-ana bhèni nèti d'ara kota ne mai rara èi ètu ne'e. de ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ja'a peka dènge ana bhèni èci, aku ja'a na, ana, ee! papuru ku èru èi èu, ho ja'a kinu èi ciki.

source_text: and she has said to me, both drink, and i also draw for your camels-she is the woman whom yhwh has decided for my lord's son.
target_text: ho ladhe na dhaa na, oo. minu! aa èle na, ja'a panginu badha ama se kahèi! ladhe j'aj'i madhutu sèmi lii ja'a ne, na èèna ka dhu j'aj'i tadha, ana bhèni ne ka dhu lamatua paj'uj'u nare hia ana lamatua ja'a. '

source_text: before i finish speaking to my heart, then behold, rebekah is coming out, and her pitcher is on her shoulder, and she goes down to the fountain and draws; and i say to her, please let me drink,
target_text: ja'a dhu dhae èle mèka manèngi-mangaj'i, te ribka dhu nare le era èèna nèti dènge èru èi na. ropa na ca'e mai nèti d'ara èi, ja'a lii dènge ne, aku ja'a na, ‘ana, ee! hia ku ja'a kinu èi ciki. '

source_text: and she hurries and lets down her pitcher from off her and says, drink, and i also water your camels; and i drink, and she has also watered the camels.
target_text: ka na papuru dènge ka èru èi na, ka na peka, ‘oo. minu! aa pe ja'a panginu onta ama se kahèi. ' hèia ja'a kinu, aa onta ja'a se oo rinu kahèi.

source_text: and i ask her, and say, whose daughter are you? and she says, daughter of bethuel, son of nahor, whom milcah has borne to him, and i put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands,
target_text: ka ja'a karèi ne, ‘ama mu, ngara na cee? ' ka na dhaa, peka na, ‘ama ku, ngara na betuel. aa baki ku, ngara na nahor. dènge ngara bèi ku, milka. ' hèia ja'a papake ne kadheli mi sahènga na, dènge pasaluu kanau hualaa ca pasa mi ai kariu dènge ai g'ana na.

source_text: and i bow, and pay respect before yhwh, and i bless yhwh, god of my lord abraham, who has led me in the true way to receive the daughter of my lord's brother for his son.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a pacud'u kètu ho mangaj'i mi lamatua, ka ja'a peka na, ‘koa-kio kolongara lamatua! lamatua bhoke le j'ara hia ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ja'a paraga le dènge a'ari lamatua ja'a abraham ètu era ne'e ne. aa paraga le kahèi dènge ana bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak! '

source_text: and now, if you are dealing kindly and truly with my lord, declare to me; and if not, declare to me; and i turn to the right or to the left.
target_text: de ne'e ne, ladhe ama si neo pad'elo sasue mi lamatua ja'a abraham, na mi peka pamèu dènge ja'a. te ngaa ladhe aad'o, peka la mola-mola dènge ja'a. ho ja'a ke'a, sèna ka tao hari ngaa.

source_text: and laban answers-bethuel also-and they say, the thing has gone out from yhwh; we are not able to speak to you bad or good;
target_text: ropa dhèu sab'a ne padhai lii nare, ka laban dènge betuel dhaa, aku rèngu na, ladhe lamatua dhu ad'u nare le madha j'ara ne, ji'i peka lii ngaa hari.

source_text: behold, rebekah is before you, take and go, and she is a wife to your lord's son, as yhwh has spoken.
target_text: ribka ka ne'e ne. more ho mèti, sèna ka na j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu ana abraham, madhutu sèmi dhu lamatua ator èèna.

source_text: and it comes to pass, when the servant of abraham has heard their words, that he bows himself toward the earth before yhwh;
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare, dhèu sab'a ne pacud'u kètu d'ai rai, ka na manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: and the servant takes out vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and gives to rebekah; precious things also he has given to her brother and to her mother.
target_text: èle èèna ka, nare mèdha nèti hualaa iia dènge hualaa pudhi sèra, dènge mèdha-papake dhu saraga, ka na hia mi ribka. aa na hia kahèi mi ana mone na dènge ina na, mèdha-mèdha dhu kab'ua aae.

source_text: and they eat and drink, he and the men who are with him, and lodge all night; and they rise in the morning, and he says, send me to my lord;
target_text: èle aa'i ka, heka dhèu sab'a ne dènge anga na madhèdi ra'a-rinu aa'i-aa'i ra. ka ra j'unu ètu èèna. bèli mad'ae èèna, dhèu sab'a ne palangu lii dènge lamatua èmu se, aku nèngu na, hia ka ja'a ho lèpa la asa lamatua ja'a abraham.

source_text: and her brother says-her mother also, let the young person abide with us a week or ten days, afterward she goes.
target_text: te ngaa ana mone dènge ina ana bhèni na, peka na, te neo hari lèpa lai-lai, tao ngaa ne? hud'i ribka pea hari ku dènge ji'i d'ai canguru lod'o sa laa ma, heka lami kèna.

source_text: and he says to them, do not delay me, seeing yhwh has prospered my way; send me away, and i go to my lord;
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a èèna dhaa, peka na, waa! baku kai ja'a! te lamatua sue le ja'a, ka toke ja'a rage le bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak. de patabuli ka ji'i se, la'a peka ku dènge lamatua ji'i abraham.

source_text: and they say, let us call for the young person, and inquire of her mouth;
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, sèmi ne'e ka laa! mai ti karèi ribka, sèna ka te'a dad'èi na tasa mera mia?

source_text: and they call for rebekah, and say to her, do you go with this man? and she says, i go.
target_text: hèia ra paroa ne, aku rèngu na, ribka! di aku èu kèna. èu neo lamu dènge ka dènge dhèu ne'e do, tasamia? ka ribka dhaa, peka na, ja'a ko'o.

source_text: and they send away their sister rebekah, and her nurse, and abraham's servant, and his men; and they bless rebekah, and say to her, you are our sister; become thousands of myriads, and your seed possesses the gate of those hating it.
target_text: hèia ra hia ribka dènge bhèni dhu leru ne karèi nèti ana iiki ka, ho lasi palere dènge dhèu sab'a abraham sèra. ka ra hia ribka mèngi-nale, aku rèngu na, ji'i sanao-maena sèna ka ama lamatua hia èu mora iisi ana ae-ae, ho ana-èpu mu d'ai riho-kehi. aa ji'i sanao kahèi, sèna ka ana-èpu èu sèra segi aa'i musu rèngu sèra!

source_text: and rebekah and her young women arise, and ride on the camels, and go after the man; and the servant takes rebekah and goes.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ribka dènge bhèni dhu leru nèngu na lalau ka mèdha ra, ka ra ca'e onta, pakèd'i dènge ka, madhutu dhèu sab'a abraham sèra.

source_text: and isaac has come in from the entrance of the well of the living one, my beholder; and he is dwelling in the land of the south,
target_text: isak pea ètu rai negeb. lod'o èèna, na heka lèpa kèna nèti madha èi beer lahai roi.

source_text: and isaac goes out to meditate in the field, at the turning of the evening, and he lifts up his eyes, and looks, and behold, camels are coming.
target_text: d'ara lod'o nihia ca lod'o, na kalua nèti d'ara paleo na, la'e pasiar ciki. ropa na boti kètu, na ladhe laa na onta-onta kako mai asa era nèngu na.

source_text: and rebekah lifts up her eyes, and sees isaac, and comes down off the camel;
target_text: ropa ribka ladhe nèdhi isak, hèia na puru lai-lai nèti dedha onta.

source_text: and she says to the servant, who is this man who is walking in the field to meet us? and the servant says, it is my lord; and she takes the veil, and covers herself.
target_text: ka na karèi dhèu sab'a abraham, aku nèngu na, dhèu mone cee ka mai nèi? ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, nèngu na, ana lamatua ja'a kèna. hèia ribka nare salalu na, pa'abhe rèhu na.

source_text: and the servant recounts to isaac all the things that he has done,
target_text: ka dhèu sab'a ne lolo dènge isak, aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: and isaac brings her into the tent of his mother sarah, and he takes rebekah, and she becomes his wife, and he loves her, and isaac is comforted after the death of his mother.
target_text: hèia isak todhe nèti ka ribka lasi asa d'ara paleo ina na, ka dua ra paleo ka èmu. lula isak sue seli eele ribka, ka na susa heka dènge mamadhe ina na.

source_text: and abraham adds and takes a wife, and her name is keturah;
target_text: ka abraham leo hari èmu dènge bhèni èci, ngara na ketura.

source_text: and she bears to him zimran, and jokshan, and medan, and midian, and ishbak, and shuah.
target_text: hèia ketura matana ana hia ne. ana se, ngara ra: simran, yoksan, medan, midian, isbak, dènge sua.

source_text: and jokshan has begotten sheba and dedan; and the sons of dedan were asshurim, and letushim, and leummim;
target_text: ana yoksan ka: seba dènge dedan. ana-èpu dedan nuka, dhèu asyur, dhèu letus, dènge dhèu leum.

source_text: and the sons of midian are ephah, and epher, and enoch, and abidah, and eldaah: all these are sons of keturah.
target_text: ana midian ka: efa, efer, henok, abida dènge eldaa. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu ketura.

source_text: and abraham gives all that he has to isaac; and to the sons of the concubines whom abraham has, abraham has given gifts, and sends them away from his son isaac in his being yet alive eastward, to the east country.
target_text: lod'o dhu abraham mamuri era, na hag'e nare le mèdha-panyau hia ana hagar dènge ana-ana ketura, èci-èci ka dènge unu na. èle èèna ka, abraham pua si lasi pea re bèka dhimu rai kana'an, sèna ka ra pakaj'èu nèti ana na isak. ka pusaka na aa'i-aa'i, na pangèd'u mi ana na isak.

source_text: and these are the days of the years of the life of abraham, which he lived, one hundred and seventy-five years; and abraham expires, and dies in a good old age, aged and satisfied, and is gathered to his people.
target_text: lod'o umur abraham d'ai ca ngasu pidhu nguru lèmi tèu, na madhe.

source_text: and his sons isaac and ishmael bury him at the cave of machpelah, at the field of ephron, son of zoar the hittite, which is before mamre- the field which abraham bought from the sons of heth-there abraham has been buried, and his wife sarah.
target_text: ka ana na, isak dènge ismael, padhane ne ètu d'ara loe makpela, dhu padètu dènge mamre. rai ne, dhu uru èèna, abraham hèli nare nèti efron, ana sohar, dhèu het. ka dhu uru èèna, ra padhane le sara ètu d'ara loe èèna.

source_text: and it comes to pass after the death of abraham, that god blesses his son isaac; and isaac dwells by the well of the living one, my beholder.
target_text: èle madha abraham, ka ama lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi isak, ka na mamuri mera-milu. lod'o èèna, isak pea dètu dènge madha èi beer lahai roi.

source_text: and these are the generations of ishmael, abraham's son, whom hagar the egyptian, sarah's handmaid, has borne to abraham;
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lolo nèti mamuri ismael. nèngu ne, ana abraham dènge dhèu èmu limuri na, hagar, dhu j'aj'i ènu sara nèti masir.

source_text: and these are the names of the sons of ishmael, by their names, according to their births: firstborn of ishmael, nebajoth; and kedar, and adbeel, and mibsam, and mishma, and dumah, and massa, hadar, and tema, jetur, naphish, and kedemah: these are sons of ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their towers; twelve princes according to their peoples.
target_text: ana-ana ismael, mone dhèu canguru dua. ngara ra dhu madhutu nèti dhu uru tèka d'ai ana limuri tèka, nuka: nebayot, kedar, adbeel, mibsam, misma, duma, masa, hadad, tema, yetur, nafis, dènge kedma. ana-ana sèra ka, j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti canguru dua suku, dhu èci-èci ka dènge kabarai ra. ra pangare kabarai ra èci-èci, madhutu ngara bèi-baki ra.

source_text: and these are the years of the life of ishmael, one hundred and thirty-seven years; and he expires, and dies, and is gathered to his people;
target_text: ropa umur ismael d'ai cangasu tèlu nguru pidhu tèu, ka na madhe.

source_text: and they dwell from havilah to shur, which is before egypt, in your going toward asshur; in the presence of all his brothers has he fallen.
target_text: te ngaa ana-èpu na sèra, èci pamusu dènge èci. ka ra pea pahag'a, mulai nèti rai hawila d'ai rai syur, dhu palane dènge rai masir, toke d'ai rai asyur.

source_text: and these are the generations of isaac, abraham's son: abraham has begotten isaac;
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lolo nèti mamuri isak, ana abraham.

source_text: and isaac is a son of forty years in his taking rebekah, daughter of bethuel the aramean, from padan-aram, sister of laban the aramean, to him for a wife.
target_text: lod'o isak madhèdi dènge ribka, umur na èpa nguru tèu le. ama ribka, ngara na betuel. ana mone ribka, ngara na laban. rèngu se, dhèu aram, nèti padan aram.

source_text: and isaac makes plea to yhwh before his wife, for she is barren: and yhwh accepts his plea, and his wife rebekah conceives,
target_text: ribka dhu dènge mèka ana. nèti èèna ka, isak manèngi-mangaj'i mi lamatua, sèna ka na bhoke era ana ribka. hèia lamatua tadèngi lii manèngi isak, ka ribka dènge babia.

source_text: and the children struggle together within her, and she says, if it is right-why am i thus? and she goes to seek yhwh.
target_text: te ngaa ana dhu ribka kad'o ne, dhèu dua. aa ana se paliku taruu ètu d'ara kabake ina ra. ka ribka ngee ka ètu d'ara na, nga tao ka ana dua se, sèmi ne'e? hèia na pakarèi dènge lamatua.

source_text: and yhwh says to her, two nations are in your womb, and two peoples from your bowels are parted; and the one people is stronger than the other people; and the older serves the younger.
target_text: ka lamatua dhaa, peka na, ètu d'ara kabake èu na, abhu dua suku, dhu èèna na loe boe dènge pamusu. dhu limuri èra risi nèti dhu uru. ka a'a na, lalau-lalo'o ari na.

source_text: and her days to bear are fulfilled, and behold, twins are in her womb;
target_text: ropa lod'o d'ai, ribka nara iisi ana mone dhèu dua.

source_text: and the first comes out all red as a hairy robe, and they call his name esau;
target_text: dhu a'a, isi na mea, dènge ngi'u na pènu dènge rèu. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare ne, esau dhu sasoa na ‘dènge rèu'.

source_text: and afterward his brother has come out, and his hand is taking hold on esau's heel, and one calls his name jacob; and isaac is a son of sixty years in her bearing them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ari na heka kalua kèna. te ngaa dhu na kèpe hui tèdhu a'a na. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare ne, yakob dhu sasoa na ‘hui tèdhu'. lod'o ribka nara iisi ana na se, umur isak èna nguru tèu kèna.

source_text: and the youths grew, and esau is a man acquainted with hunting, a man of the field; and jacob is a plain man, inhabiting tents;
target_text: lod'o ana dua se kapai, esau dhu ne'a mèu kasiro badha hui. ae ka dhu na pea ètu d'ara j'ami. te ngaa yakob dhu mau-mau, dhu d'èi dhoka pea ètu d'ara èmu di.

source_text: and isaac loves esau, for his game is in his mouth; and rebekah is loving jacob.
target_text: isak d'èi na'a sisi badha hui. nèti èèna ka, na sue risi esau. te ngaa ribka sue risi yakob.

source_text: and jacob boils stew, and esau comes in from the field, and he is weary;
target_text: ca lod'o, yakob dhu tao bubur kab'ui, aa esau heka lèpa nèti kasiro badha hui kèna. na lèpa dènge manganga, ka roe titu kèna.

source_text: and esau says to jacob, please let me eat some of this red-red thing, for i am weary; therefore one has called his name edom;
target_text: ka na peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, ari, ee! hia ku ja'a bubur kab'ui mea ciki ètu d'ara èru èèna, ho ja'a ku'a! te ja'a manganga bia. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare na, edom, dhu sasoa na ‘mea'.

source_text: and jacob says, sell your birthright to me today.
target_text: ka, aku yakob na, be'a a'a. te ngaa pasilu ku dènge hak a'a èèna!

source_text: and esau says, behold, i am going to die, and what is this to me-a birthright?
target_text: hèia esau dhaa, aku nèngu na, hak a'a ne, ngaa kèna, hud'i nèngu sèna! neo more, na more la. te ja'a manganga bia. sod'e mèti bubur èèna lai-lai mai, te ja'a taha heka.

source_text: and jacob says, swear to me today: and he swears to him, and sells his birthright to jacob;
target_text: te ngaa, aku yakob hari na, mata ku a'a! èu subha uuru ku, dhu peka na, èu pangèd'u le hak a'a èèna mi ja'a ne. ka esau ded'e subha sèmi dhu yakob peka.

source_text: and jacob has given bread and stew of lentils to esau, and he eats, and drinks, and rises, and goes; and esau despises the birthright.
target_text: hèia yakob sod'e dènge ka hia ne bubur kab'ui deo na dènge roti. ropa na'a-ninu nare, ka la'e dènge ka. dènge j'ara ne'e ka, esau pusi boe dènge hak a'a na.

source_text: and there is a famine in the land, besides the first famine which was in the days of abraham, and isaac goes to abimelech king of the philistines, to gerar.
target_text: ca tèka, ètu d'ara rai èèna, lèke tèu manganga, èci èèna ka dènge tèu abraham mamuri era. ka isak la'e manèngi abimelek, dhèu aae pilistin, sèna ka na pea ètu gerar.

source_text: and yhwh appears to him and says, do not go down toward egypt, dwell in the land concerning which i speak to you,
target_text: na tao sèmi èèna, lula lamatua dhu pad'elo le iisi na mi nèngu, peka na, mage lamu ka asa masir hèi. pea la mi era dhu èèna na ja'a paj'uj'u hia èu.

source_text: sojourn in this land, and i am with you, and bless you, for to you and to your seed i give all these lands, and i have established the oath which i have sworn to your father abraham; and i have multiplied your seed as stars of the heavens, and i have given to your seed all these lands; and all nations of the earth have blessed themselves in your seed;
target_text: ladhe èu manubha ètu era èèna, ja'a sama-sama dènge èu, aa pala-bagi èu mèngi-nale rupa-rupa. èèna na, ja'a pabèba ana-èpu èu sama sèmi hua-hètu ètu dedha-liru. aa ja'a hia kateme rai ne mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu. nèti ana-èpu èu ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne abhu mèngi-nale. dènge j'ara ne'e, ja'a tao madhutu lii pajaji dhu ja'a pa'èki le dènge ama mu abraham.

source_text: because that abraham has listened to my voice, and keeps my charge, my commands, my statutes, and my laws.
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi ne'e ne, lula ama mu madhutu dad'èi ja'a, paredha ja'a, dènge atora ja'a.

source_text: and isaac dwells in gerar;
target_text: ka isak pea taha ètu gerar.

source_text: and men of the place ask him of his wife, and he says, she is my sister: for he has been afraid to say, my wife-lest the men of the place kill me for rebekah, for she is of good appearance.
target_text: ribka ne, bhèni iia titu kèna. ka ropa dhèu ètu gerar ladhe rèdhi ne, ra pakarèi. te ngaa isak peka na, ribka ne, ana hèni ja'a. na madha'u, ladhe na peka na dhèu èmu nèngu, dhèu se pamadhe ne, aa ribka parame rare.

source_text: and it comes to pass, when the days have been prolonged to him there, that abimelech king of the philistines looks through the window, and sees, and behold, isaac is playing with his wife rebekah.
target_text: isak dhu pea nèbhu le ètu nèi, hèia ca lod'o, dhèu aae nèdhi nèti ro'a jendela na, ladhe laa na isak dènge ribka dhu pa'ango.

source_text: and abimelech calls for isaac and says, behold, she is surely your wife; and how could you have said, she is my sister? and isaac says to him, because i said, lest i die for her.
target_text: ka na pua dhèu lasi paroa isak, hèia na peka, isak! ja'a dhu ke'a le, bhèni ne dhèu èmu èu! te ngaa tasamia ka, èu peka na, nèngu ne ana hèni èu? hèia isak dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e ama! ja'a ne madha'u, ladhe ja'a peka na nèngu ne dhèu èmu ja'a, mage dhoka dhèu pamadhe ja'a.

source_text: and abimelech says, what is this you have done to us? as a little thing one of the people had lain with your wife, and you had brought on us guilt;
target_text: ka dhèu aae dhaa, peka na, sèmi dhèu ètu se'e j'unu dènge dhèu èmu èu, tatu èu pasala ji'i! tasamia ka, èu ad'u j'ara ne'e mi dedha ji'i se?

source_text: and abimelech commands all the people, saying, he who comes against this man or against his wife, dying does die.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae abimelek pasanèd'e ana kabarai na, aku nèngu na, miu nanene paie-iie! cee ka dhu bani gagu dhèu ne'e, do dhèu èmu na, èèna na ja'a huku pamadhe ne.

source_text: and isaac sows in that land, and finds in that year a hundredfold, and yhwh blesses him;
target_text: tèu èèna, isak sèle hini ètu dedha rai dhèu se'e. lod'o d'ai puu-g'ètu, ka na abhu isi rai cangasu hari, lula lamatua hia ne mamèngi.

source_text: and the man is great, and goes on, going on and becoming great, until he has been very great,
target_text: lula mèdha-panyau na asa ae, ka na kaja titu kèna.

source_text: and he has possession of a flock, and possession of a herd, and an abundant service; and the philistines envy him,
target_text: badha-manu na sèmi sapi, kahib'i-kalèbho asa tabha ae. dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, ae kahèi. nèti èèna ka, dhèu pilistin tèka d'ara dènge ne.

source_text: and all the wells which his father's servants dug in the days of his father abraham, the philistines have stopped them, and fill them with dust.
target_text: uru èèna, abraham, ama isak, dhu kèi èi ae-ae. te ngaa limuri ne, dhèu pilistin dhènu eele aa'i si dènge rai.

source_text: and abimelech says to isaac, go from us; for you have become much mightier than we;
target_text: ka dhèu aae abimelek peka dènge isak, aku nèngu na, isak! be'a risi èu pakèd'i ka nèti kabarai ne'e. lula koasa èu, risi eele le nèti ji'i se.

source_text: and isaac goes from there, and encamps in the valley of gerar, and dwells there;
target_text: èle èèna ka, isak pakèd'i nèti era èèna, ka lasi pea hari ètu d'ara mamoo gerar.

source_text: and isaac turns back, and digs the wells of water which they dug in the days of his father abraham, which the philistines have stopped after the death of abraham, and he calls to them names according to the names which his father called them.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, ra kèi hari madha èi dhu uru èèna, dhèu pilistin dhènu eele aa'i si. ka na pangare madha èi se madhutu ngara dhu ama na pangare.

source_text: and isaac's servants dig in the valley, and find there a well of living water,
target_text: ropa dhèu sab'a isak se kèi èi ètu d'ara mamoo gerar, hèi lèke èi madha dhu sabhoka mai.

source_text: and shepherds of gerar strive with shepherds of isaac, saying, the water is ours; and he calls the name of the well strife, because they have striven habitually with him;
target_text: lula madha èi ne'e ka, dhèu-dhèu madhenge badha nèti gerar, patao dènge dhèu madhenge badha isak. dhèu se peka na, ne'e ne, madha èi ji'i! nèti èèna ka, isak pangare madha èi na esek, dhu sasoa na ‘patao-palaha'.

source_text: and they dig another well, and they strive also for it, and he calls its name hatred.
target_text: hèia dhèu-dhèu isak se, kèi hari èi leo ca madha. te ngaa ra patao-palaha hari, lula èi èèna. nèti èèna ka, isak pangare na sitna, dhu sasoa na ‘palab'a'.

source_text: and he removes from there, and digs another well, and they have not striven for it, and he calls its name enlargements, and says, for-now has yhwh given enlargement to us, and we have been fruitful in the land.
target_text: èle èèna ka, isak tèke eele era èèna, la'e kèi hari èi èci. d'ai ne'e ne, ra patao-palaha heka. ka isak pangare madha èi ne rehobot, dhu sasoa na ‘era taleo'. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, limuri ne, lamatua hia le èdhi pea ètu era taleo. ho ètu era ne'e ne, èdhi asa bèba-kacanga.

source_text: and he goes up from there to beer-sheba,
target_text: ka nèti era ne'e, isak si lasi hari era pea asa beer syeba.

source_text: and yhwh appears to him during that night and says, i am the god of your father abraham, do not fear, for i am with you, and have blessed you, and have multiplied your seed, because of my servant abraham;
target_text: ka mèda na, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi isak, hèia na peka, isak! ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti ama mu abraham. de mage mu madha'u, te ja'a ladhe-leru èu. èèna na, ja'a pala-bagi èu mèngi-nale. aa ana-èpu èu asa bèba-kacanga. ja'a ad'u madha j'ara ne'e, lula lii pajaji ja'a dènge ama mu.

source_text: and he builds there an altar, and preaches in the name of yhwh, and stretches out there his tent, and there isaac's servants dig a well.
target_text: hèia isak pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban ètu èèna. ka na manèngi makasi mi lamatua. hèia, na pea ètu era èèna, ka dhèu sab'a na kèi hari èi.

source_text: and abimelech has gone to him from gerar, and ahuzzath his friend, and phichol head of his host;
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae abimelek mai nèti gerar. angalai na ahusat, dènge kètu kapai sordad'u na, fikol, mai dènge ne, ho paraga dènge isak.

source_text: and isaac says to them, why have you come to me, and you have hated me, and you send me away from you?
target_text: ka isak karèi, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae! uru èèna, miu se dhu babège eele ja'a nèti kabarai miu. de ne'e ne, miu se mai tao ngaa hari?

source_text: and they say, we have certainly seen that yhwh has been with you, and we say, now let there be an oath between us, between us and you, and let us make a covenant with you;
target_text: hèia ra peka na, sèmi ne'e. ji'i dhu nge'a le, lamatua dhu j'aga pa'ère èu. nèti èèna ka, ji'i pangee, hua iia èdhi dua ti pa'èki lii pajaji dhu peka sèmi ne'e: èu j'oka subha, peka na,

source_text: do no evil with us, as we have not touched you, and as we have only done good with you, and send you away in peace; you are now blessed of yhwh.
target_text: miu se baku tao karehe dènge ji'i, aa ji'i kahèi baku tao karehe dènge miu. mema ji'i se d'ara be'a dènge miu. nèti èèna ka, ca hari ni, miu se lami dènge mera-milu nèti kabarai ji'i ne. ji'i dhu nge'a le, lamatua ka dhu pala-bagi mèngi-nale mi miu.

source_text: and he makes a banquet for them, and they eat and drink,
target_text: èle èèna ka, isak tao pesta, ka ra'a-rinu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and rise early in the morning, and swear to one another, and isaac sends them away, and they go from him in peace.
target_text: ka asa bèli mad'ae èèna, rèngu j'oka lii soo-subha. hèia isak patalala si lèpa dènge dame.

source_text: and it comes to pass during that day that isaac's servants come and declare to him concerning the circumstances of the well which they have dug, and say to him, we have found water;
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, dhèu sab'a isak mai peka lula-nèti èi dhu rèngu kèi, na, ama! ji'i rage le èi.

source_text: and he calls it shebah, oath, therefore the name of the city is beer-sheba, well of the oath, to this day.
target_text: hèia isak pangare madha èi ne syeba dhu sasoa na ‘subha'. ka ra pangare kota èèna beer syeba, toke sange ne'e.

source_text: and esau is a son of forty years, and he takes a wife, judith, daughter of beeri the hittite, and bashemath, daughter of elon the hittite,
target_text: ropa umur esau d'ai èpa nguru tèu, na leo dènge bhèni dhèu dua nèti suku het. bhèni èci, ana nèti beeri, ngara na yudit. èci hari, ana elon, ngara na basmat.

source_text: and they are a bitterness of spirit to isaac and to rebekah.
target_text: bhèni dhèu dua se, papèd'a d'ara isak dènge ribka.

source_text: and it comes to pass that isaac is aged, and his eyes are too dim for seeing, and he calls for his older son esau and says to him, my son; and he says to him, here i am.
target_text: ropa isak manahu asa d'ara heka, nèdhi heka ngaa-ngaa, lula musi madha na ahu le. ka na paroa ana uuru èèna, dhu na sue risi èèna, peka na, esau. mai ku sa ne'e! hèia esau dhaa, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ama?

source_text: and he says, now behold, i have become aged, i have not known the day of my death;
target_text: ka isak peka hari, sèmi ne'e! ja'a ne, ètu d'ara heka le. ke'a boe, pèri lod'o ja'a ne madhe.

source_text: and now, please take up your instruments, your quiver, and your bow, and go out to the field, and hunt provision for me,
target_text: de more rèka èu, lamu kataki mèti badha hui ci'u hia ja'a.

source_text: and make tasteful things for me, such as i have loved, and bring them to me, and i eat, so that my soul blesses you before i die.
target_text: mu pananasu pabe'a-be'a, madhutu dad'èi ja'a, ho mèti mai hia ja'a. ladhe ku'a-kinu kora, ja'a hia mema èu mèngi-nale. sad'i èu unu le mèngi-nale èèna, ja'a madhe èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao heka.

source_text: and rebekah is listening while isaac is speaking to his son esau; and esau goes to the field to hunt game-to bring in;
target_text: hèia esau la'e dènge ka, kataki badha hui. te ngaa ribka dhu tadèngi kahèi lii padhai isak deo na.

source_text: and rebekah has spoken to her son jacob, saying, behold, i have heard your father speaking to your brother esau, saying,
target_text: ka ribka la'e peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, yakob! èu nanene ku! deo na, ja'a tadèngi ama mu pua esau sèmi ne'e:

source_text: bring game for me, and make tasteful things for me, and i eat, and bless you before yhwh before my death.
target_text: ‘lamu kataki more ku badha hui ci'u, mai mu pananasu pabe'a-be'a hia ja'a. ladhe ku'a-kinu kora, ja'a hia èu mèngi-nale ètu katanga madha lamatua. '

source_text: and now, my son, listen to my voice, to that which i am commanding you:
target_text: de mu nanene paie-iie! mu madhutu mola-mola lii paredha ja'a ne.

source_text: now go to the flock, and take for me two good kids of the goats from there, and i make them tasteful things for your father, such as he has loved;
target_text: de lamu ka asa era badha èdhi sèi, ho kèpe more kalèbho èni dhu kabèb'u dua ngi'u. roro ho mèti sisi mai asa ja'a. pe ja'a pananasu madhutu dad'èi ama mu.

source_text: and you have taken them to your father, and he has eaten, so that his soul blesses you before his death.
target_text: ladhe panasu kore, mèti hia ama mu na'a. ho èle na, na hia èu mèngi-nale, heka na madhe kèna. dènge sèmi ne'e ka, èu ka dhu abhu mèngi-nale èèna. a'a mu abhu boe.

source_text: and jacob says to his mother rebekah, behold, my brother esau is a hairy man, and i am a smooth man,
target_text: te ngaa yakob peka dènge ina na, ina! a'a ku esau, ngi'u na dhu pènu dènge rèu, te ngaa ja'a ne, isi dhu milu aadha-aadha!

source_text: it may be my father feels me, and i have been in his eyes as a deceiver, and have brought on me disapproval, and not a blessing;
target_text: mage dhoka ama ku g'ag'e isi ja'a, ladhe na ne'a na ja'a dhu leko-monya na. hèia na dhoo ja'a!

source_text: and his mother says to him, on me your disapproval, my son; only listen to my voice, and go, take for me.
target_text: ka ina na dhaa, aku nèngu na, èu baku cag'ag'a! hud'i laa ina ka dhu ator! ladhe ama mu dhoo èu, pe ina ka pasae! mu mate ia ka, la more ka kahib'i sèra.

source_text: and he goes, and takes, and brings to his mother, and his mother makes tasteful things, such as his father has loved;
target_text: ka yakob la'e nare kahib'i dua ngi'u sèra, hèia na roro, ka nèti hia ina na. hèia ribka pananasu madhutu dad'èi isak.

source_text: and rebekah takes the desirable garments of esau her older son, which are with her in the house, and puts them on jacob her younger son;
target_text: ka ribka la'e nare mèdha-papake esau dhu be'a, ho na papake mi yakob.

source_text: and she has put the skins of the kids of the goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck,
target_text: hèia na pahutu kahèi kacui-aai dènge ladhe goro yakob, pake ka'uri kahib'i deo sa.

source_text: and she gives the tasteful things, and the bread which she has made, into the hand of her son jacob.
target_text: ka na pangèd'u yakob nganga'a dhu pananasu nare deo na, dènge roti dhu tunu nare.

source_text: and he comes to his father and says, my father; and he says, here i am; who are you, my son?
target_text: hèia yakob ded'e nèti nganga'a se'e, hia ama na na'a. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, ama. ja'a mai hari le. hèia isak dhaa, peka na, hee! èu ne, cee?

source_text: and jacob says to his father, i am esau your firstborn; i have done as you have spoken to me; please rise, sit and eat of my game, so that your soul blesses me.
target_text: ka yakob dhaa, peka na, ja'a, esau ana mone uuru ama ku! ja'a sab'e le, madhutu sèmi dhu ama pua deo na. kèd'i, ho mu'a-minu ka. lula ja'a pananasu kore le sisi badha hui dhu ja'a kèti nèti d'ara j'ami. mu'a, ho èle na, ama pala-bagi ja'a mèngi-nale.

source_text: and isaac says to his son, what is this you have hurried to find, my son? and he says, that which your god yhwh has caused to come before me.
target_text: hèia isak peka, aku nèngu na, èu ne, bia tai nga! abhu malai titu kèna, badha hui èèna! hèia yakob dhaa, ja'a abhu le, lula lamatua dhu èu mangaj'i èèna, ka dhu tulu ja'a.

source_text: and isaac says to jacob, please come near, and i feel you, my son, whether you are he, my son esau, or not.
target_text: ka isak paroa yakob, aku nèngu na, padètu ku asa ne'e mai, sèna ka ja'a g'ag'e sèku èu. èu ne, tare'a ana ja'a esau, do aad'o?

source_text: and jacob comes near to his father isaac, and he feels him, and says, the voice is the voice of jacob, and the hands hands of esau.
target_text: hèia yakob la'e padètu-dètu dènge ama na, ka ama na g'ag'e ne. ka isak peka, lii ne, sèmi lii yakob! te ngaa kacui-aai na, kacui-aai esau.

source_text: and he has not discerned him, for his hands have been hairy, as the hands of his brother esau, and he blesses him,
target_text: te ngaa isak dhu tadhe iia boe yakob, lula kacui-aai na rèu sèmi esau. ka ropa na neo hia mèngi-nale mi yakob,

source_text: and says, you are he-my son esau? and he says, i am.
target_text: na karèi hari era, aku nèngu na, èu ne, tare'a-re'a esau, do? hèia yakob dhaa, peka na, tare'a-re'a ama. ja'a ne, esau!

source_text: and he says, bring it near to me, and i eat of my son's game, so that my soul blesses you; and he brings it near to him, and he eats; and he brings wine to him, and he drinks.
target_text: ka isak peka na, na, j'ole ka sisina mai, sèna ka ja'a ku'a. èle ku, pe ja'a hia èu mèngi-nale. hèia yakob hia sisi dènge èi anggor hia ama na na'a-ninu.

source_text: and his father isaac says to him, please come near and kiss me, my son;
target_text: na'a nare ka, isak lii, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! mai padètu asa ne'e, ho mu uu ku ja'a laa.

source_text: and he comes near, and kisses him, and he smells the fragrance of his garments, and blesses him, and says, see, the fragrance of my son is as the fragrance of a field which yhwh has blessed;
target_text: ka ropa yakob padètu dènge ne, ho uu ne, isak sangèd'u nare hèu mèdha-papake esau. hèia na padhai lii hia mèngi-nale mi yakob, aku nèngu na, hèu ana ja'a tare'a-re'a sèmi hèu j'u'u ètu d'ara pad'a, dhu abhu mamèngi nèti lamatua.

source_text: and god gives to you of the dew of the heavens, and of the fatness of the earth, and abundance of grain and wine;
target_text: hud'i laa ama lamatua patiri èi paringi nèti dedha-liru, sèna ka oka-tedhe èu j'aj'i mi rai hèu mèngi. hud'i laa na hia èu are dhu udhu sobhu-sobhu, dènge hua anggor dhu pènu ako-pènu èru.

source_text: peoples serve you, and nations bow themselves to you, be mighty over your brothers, and the sons of your mother bow themselves to you; those who curse you are cursed, and those who bless you are blessed.
target_text: suku-suku j'aj'i mi ènu èu, aa dhèu-dhèu leo pahaha iisi mi dedha èu. èu j'aj'i mi lamatua nèti a'ari èu. aa rèngu patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha èu. dhèu cee dhu dhoo èu, rèngu abhu dhoo kahèi. aa dhèu cee dhu hia mèngi-nale mi èu, rèngu abhu mèngi-nale kahèi.

source_text: and it comes to pass, as isaac has finished blessing jacob, and jacob is only just going out from the presence of his father isaac, that his brother esau has come in from his hunting;
target_text: ropa isak hia nare mèngi-nale mi yakob, ka heka bhodho li'u la'e tèke eele ama na, cag'ag'a laa esau lèpa nèti kataki badha hui.

source_text: and he also makes tasteful things, and brings to his father, and says to his father, let my father arise, and eat of his son's game, so that your soul blesses me.
target_text: hèia la'e pananasu, ka sod'e nèti hia ama na. ka na parèi ama na, aku nèngu na, ama, kèd'i mu'a. ja'a lalau kore le sisi badha dhu ja'a kataki kore. mu'a more ku, pe hia ja'a berkat.

source_text: and his father isaac says to him, who are you? and he says, i am your son, your firstborn, esau;
target_text: te ngaa isak malaa, ka na karèi, hee! te èu ne, cee hari ne? hèia esau dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne'e, esau! ana uuru ama ku.

source_text: and isaac trembles a very great trembling and says, who, now, is he who has provided game, and brings to me, and i eat of all before you come in, and i bless him? indeed, he is blessed.
target_text: ka isak cag'ag'a, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, deo na cee ka dhu hia ja'a sisi, ka ja'a ku'a èèna? ka ja'a hia ne mèngi-nale. aa mèngi-nale èèna, bisa heka ère hari.

source_text: when esau hears the words of his father, then he cries a very great and bitter cry, and says to his father, bless me, me also, o my father;
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, esau roe ai ca palèpa, ka na tangi d'ara pèd'a dènge roma iisi, aku nèngu na, tasamia ne, ama, ee! bagi hia ja'a berkat hèi ma.

source_text: and he says, your brother has come with subtlety, and takes your blessing.
target_text: hèia isak peka, ari mu ka monya ja'a, ka parame nare berkat dhu pala èu di.

source_text: and he says, is it because he whose name is called jacob takes me by the heel these two times? he has taken my birthright; and behold, now he has taken my blessing; he also says, have you not kept back a blessing for me?
target_text: ka aku esau na, nèngu na leko-monya ja'a dua hari kèna. uru èèna, parame nare hak a'a. ka ne'e ne, parame nare hari berkat dhu madhutu iia-iia na unu ja'a. nèka na, ngara na ‘yakob' te ngaa ele boe ama dhu dènge berkat era, ho hia ja'a. do, aad'o heka? yakob sasoa na ‘kèpe hui tèdhu', te ngaa sasoa dhu leo ‘tuka leko-monya'.

source_text: and isaac answers and says to esau, behold, a mighty one have i set him over you, and all his brothers have i given to him for servants, and with grain and wine have i sustained him; and for you now, what will i do, my son?
target_text: hèia isak dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhu ded'e le nèngu, j'aj'i lamatua èu. aa a'ari na aa'i-aa'i ra, j'aj'i mi ènu na. ja'a hia na le, unu are pènu soka-pènu karo, dènge hua anggor pènu ako-pènu èru. de ana, ee! mamèngi tasamia hari, dhu ja'a ne pala-bagi mi èu?

source_text: and esau says to his father, one blessing have you my father? bless me, me also, o my father; and esau lifts up his voice, and weeps.
target_text: masi ka tadèngi nare le sèmi èèna, te ngaa esau loe boe dènge pamako ama na, peka na, mamèngi na dhodhoka èci di, do? tatu ama dènge hari mamèngi dhu leo hia ja'a. masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka, sad'i ja'a ne abhu! ka esau tangi hari dènge d'ara laho mae-mae.

source_text: and his father isaac answers and says to him, behold, of the fatness of the earth is your dwelling, and of the dew of the heavens from above;
target_text: ka isak b'ala ne, peka na, mamuri èu ne, èèna na kaj'èu nèti oka-tedhe dhu hèu mèngi, lula èi paringi patiri boe nèti dedha-liru mai, ho pabasa rai èu.

source_text: and by your sword you live, and your brother serves you; and it has come to pass, when you rule, that you have broken his yoke from off your neck.
target_text: èu ne, mamuri dhoka nèti samala èu di. aa tasa mera mia èèna ka, èu ne j'aj'i ènu ari mu. dhodhoka ladhe bèli-camèd'a, èu bani lab'a ne, èèna na èu heka rai eele nèti d'ara adhe-aai na.

source_text: and esau hates jacob, because of the blessing with which his father blessed him, and esau says in his heart, the days of mourning for my father draw near, and i slay my brother jacob.
target_text: lula j'ara sèmi ne'e ne ka, esau tèke d'ara dènge ari na yakob, lula parame nare mamèngi na. ka esau pangee na, nèbhu heka, ama ku madhe. de hud'i laa, pe d'ai ku lod'o. ladhe èle beke, ja'a pamadhe ne!

source_text: and the words of esau her older son are declared to rebekah, and she sends and calls for jacob her younger son, and says to him, behold, your brother esau is comforting himself in regard to you-to slay you; and now, my son, listen to my voice, and rise, flee for yourself to my brother laban, to haran,
target_text: ropa ribka tadèngi esau dhu neo ad'u j'ara karehe, ka na peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, èu nanene ku lii ne! a'a mu neo b'ala d'ara pèd'a na, de na neo pamadhe èu. de be'a risi, èu ne rai lai-lai asa to'o mu laban, ètu kota haran.

source_text: and you have dwelt with him some days, until your brother's fury turns back,
target_text: lamu asa nèi, pea ako nèbhu, toke èle nanasa a'a mu.

source_text: until your brother's anger turns back from you, and he has forgotten that which you have done to him, and i have sent and taken you from there; why am i bereaved even of you both the same day?
target_text: ladhe na bhèlu eele ku tatao èu ne, pe ja'a pua dhèu dhiu paroa èu, sèna ka èu lèpa hari mai. lula ja'a ko'o boe, sèna ka ana ja'a dua-dua mi ele parènga d'ara ca lod'o èèna ka.

source_text: and rebekah says to isaac, i have been disgusted with my life because of the presence of the daughters of heth; if jacob takes a wife of the daughters of heth, like these-from the daughters of the land-why do i live?
target_text: hèia ribka roma iisi dènge isak, peka na, ja'a ru'a le dènge dhèu èmu esau, dhèu het se! de ladhe yakob todhe nare hari kahèi ana bhèni nèti dhèu het se, hua iia ja'a madhe ka laa.

source_text: and isaac calls to jacob, and blesses him, and commands him, and says to him, you must not take a wife of the daughters of canaan;
target_text: hèia isak paroa nare yakob, ka hia ne mèngi-nale aa holo ne, peka na, sanèd'e paie! èu mage leo ka dènge ana bhèni kana'an hèi.

source_text: rise, go to padan-aram, to the house of your mother's father bethuel, and take for yourself a wife from there, from the daughters of your mother's brother laban;
target_text: de lamu ka asa padan aram, asa baki mu betuel. lamu madhèdi dènge ana bhèni to'o mu laban ca dhèu.

source_text: and god almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and you have become an assembly of peoples;
target_text: hud'i laa ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele na, hia èu mamèngi, sèna ka ana-èpu èu bèba-kacanga, ho nèti rèngu ka j'aj'i suku ae-ae dhu kapai.

source_text: and he gives to you the blessing of abraham, to you and to your seed with you, to cause you to possess the land of your sojournings, which god gave to abraham.
target_text: hud'i laa, lii pajaji ama lamatua dènge abraham èèna, noto mi dedha èu ne, dènge ana-èpu èu. sèna ka èu unu rai dhu ama lamatua jaji tèke le mi abraham.

source_text: and isaac sends jacob away, and he goes to padan-aram, to laban, son of bethuel the aramean, brother of rebekah, mother of jacob and esau.
target_text: padhai lii nare, ka isak hia yakob la'e asa padan aram, asa èmu to'o na laban, dènge baki na betuel.

source_text: and esau sees that isaac has blessed jacob, and has sent him to padan-aram to take to himself from there a wife-in his blessing him that he lays a charge on him, saying, you must not take a wife from the daughters of canaan-
target_text: esau dhu tadèngi le kahèi, dhu peka na isak hia yakob mamèngi, aa kai ne sèna ka baku leo dènge bhèni kana'an. aa na tadèngi hèi, dhu isak hia yakob leo dènge ana bhèni to'o na laban ètu padan aram.

source_text: that jacob listens to his father and to his mother, and goes to padan-aram-
target_text: ka yakob madhutu lii paredha ina dènge ama na, ka pakèd'i la'e asa padan aram.

source_text: and esau sees that the daughters of canaan are evil in the eyes of his father isaac,
target_text: aa esau dhu ne'a le kahèi, ama na d'èi boe dhèu èmu na, bhèni kana'an dua sèra.

source_text: and esau goes to ishmael, and takes mahalath, daughter of ishmael, abraham's son, sister of nebajoth, to his wives, to himself, for a wife.
target_text: hèia na la'e asa ama aae na ismael, ka leo hari èmu dènge ana bhèni ismael ca dhèu, ngara na mahalat. mahalat ne, ana mone na ka nebayot.

source_text: and jacob goes out from beer-sheba, and goes toward haran,
target_text: ka yakob tèke eele beer syeba, la'e asa haran.

source_text: and he touches at a certain place, and lodges there, for the sun has gone in, and he takes of the stones of the place, and makes them his pillows, and lies down in that place.
target_text: ropa lod'o cèna, yakob d'ai era èci, ka na j'unu ètu era èèna. na neo j'unu, nare hadhu cue, tao lalaka kètu na.

source_text: and he dreams, and behold, a ladder set up on the earth, and its head is touching the heavens; and behold, messengers of god are going up and coming down by it;
target_text: d'ara mèda èèna, na nii. na ladhe nèdhi langa èci dhu patitu ètu rai, suu na d'ai dedha-liru. ka ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga, ca'e-puru ètu dedha langa èèna.

source_text: and behold, yhwh is standing on it, and he says, i am yhwh, god of your father abraham, and god of isaac; the land on which you are lying, to you i give it, and to your seed;
target_text: ètu d'ara nii na, yakob ladhe nèdhi lamatua dhu titu ètu karasa nèngu, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne lamatua, ama lamatua nèti baki mu abraham, dènge ama mu isak. èèna na, ja'a hia rai ne mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu.

source_text: and your seed has been as the dust of the land, and you have broken forth westward, and eastward, and northward, and southward, and all families of the ground have been blessed in you and in your seed.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, ana-èpu èu ae-ae, sama sèmi ahu rai ne. rèngu se, èèna na, pea palème era-era ètu rai-haha ne. nèti ana-èpu èu ka, suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, abhu mèngi-nale.

source_text: and behold, i am with you, and have kept you wherever you go, and have caused you to return to this ground; for i do not leave you until i have surely done that which i have spoken to you.
target_text: mage mu bhèlu! èu ne ètu mia èèna ka, ja'a bera-bera dènge èu. ladhe èèna na, ja'a lere kèti hari èu mai asa dedha-rai ne'e. ja'a bhera boe èu. aa èèna na, ja'a tao aa'i madhutu sèmi lii pajaji ja'a dènge èu.

source_text: and jacob awakens out of his sleep and says, surely yhwh is in this place, and i did not know;
target_text: ropa yakob kèd'i nèti bhèj'i, na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a heka ke'a kèna, lamatua dhu ètu era ne'e kahèi.

source_text: and he fears and says, how fearful is this place; this is nothing but a house of god, and this a gate of the heavens.
target_text: na madha'u, ka na pangee, na, boo! era ne'e ne pamadha'u ja'a, nga. tatu èmu ama lamatua ètu era ne'e ne! aa era ne'e ne, j'aj'i hèb'a babèdho sorga.

source_text: and jacob rises early in the morning, and takes the stone which he has made his pillows, and makes it a standing pillar, and pours oil on its top,
target_text: d'ara mad'ae aae era, yakob kèd'i le èèna. ka nare hadhu dhu na tao lalaka deo na. hèia na patitu j'aj'i mi tadha. ka na bhori èi mènyi asa dedha hadhu èèna, hèia na mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: and he calls the name of that place bethel, house of god, and yet, luz is the name of the city at the first.
target_text: ka na pangare era ne betel, dhu sasoa na ‘èmu lamatua'. uru èèna, era ne ngara na lus.

source_text: and jacob vows a vow, saying, seeing god is with me, and has kept me in this way which i am going, and has given to me bread to eat, and a garment to put on-
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob ded'e subha, aku nèngu na, ladhe ama lamatua dhu dènge ja'a, aa j'aga ja'a ètu d'ara kakako ja'a ne, aa panga'e dènge papake ja'a,

source_text: when i have turned back in peace to the house of my father, and yhwh has become my god,
target_text: toke ja'a lèpa dènge sod'a, èèna na lamatua j'aj'i mi ama lamatua ja'a.

source_text: then this stone which i have made a standing pillar is a house of god, and all that you give to me-tithing i tithe to you.
target_text: hadhu dhu ja'a patitu ne, j'aj'i mi era sogo-tagu mi ama lamatua. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua pala-bagi mi ja'a, ja'a hia na ca pala nèti canguru pala.

source_text: and jacob lifts up his feet, and goes toward the land of the sons of the east;
target_text: hèia yakob kako hari ka asa bèka dhimu.

source_text: and he looks, and behold, a well in the field, and behold, there are three droves of a flock crouching by it, for they water the droves from that well, and the great stone is on the mouth of the well.
target_text: ca lod'o, ladhe nèdhi èi ca madha, dètu dènge rae cue. padètu-dètu dènge madha èi èèna, abhu tèlu kaboko kahib'i-kalèbho, dhu mate rinu èi. te ngaa hadhu aae cue dhu ra pasaguru mi hèb'a èi na.

source_text: when all the droves have been gathered there, and they have rolled the stone from off the mouth of the well, and have watered the flock, then they have turned back the stone on the mouth of the well to its place.
target_text: dhu tema le, ladhe kahib'i tesa aa'i-aa'i ra, ana-ana madhenga kahib'i se, lasi bhoke hadhu na, heka ra dhui kèna, panginu kahib'i si. panginu rare na, ra katange hari hadhu na la'e.

source_text: and jacob says to them, my brothers, where are you from? and they say, we are from haran.
target_text: ka yakob kako la'e asa madha dhèu madhenge kahib'i se, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, miu se, dhèu mia? hèia ra dhaa, ji'i se, nèti rae haran ne'e.

source_text: and he says to them, have you known laban, son of nahor? and they say, we have known.
target_text: ka yakob karèi hari, aku nèngu na, miu tadhe to'o ja'a, laban, do? nèngu na, ana nahor. ka ra dhaa, ji'i tadhe ne.

source_text: and he says to them, does he have peace? and they say, peace; and behold, his daughter rachel is coming with the flock.
target_text: hèia yakob karèi hari, aku nèngu na, na be'a-be'a, sina ma? ka ra peka, oo, na be'a-be'a. ladhe, ana bhèni na ka nèi. ngara na, rahel. nuka eo nèti kahib'i ama na mai sa ne'e, ho hia rinu ètu ne'e. mate ne.

source_text: and he says, behold, the day is still great, it is not time for the livestock to be gathered; water the flock, and go, delight yourselves.
target_text: hèia yakob peka hari, loo nètu era. de be'a risi, badha mia ètu se'e le, panginu ka si. sèna ka lere mèti hari asa d'ara pad'a, ho ra'a hari j'u'u.

source_text: and they say, we are not able, until all the droves be gathered together, and they have rolled away the stone from the mouth of the well, and we have watered the flock.
target_text: te ngaa ra peka, we, j'ara na aad'o sèmi èèna! ji'i mate toke tesa aa'i ku, heka ji'i pakeso hadhu ne, heka panginu badha se kèna.

source_text: he is yet speaking with them, and rachel has come with the flock which her father has, for she is shepherdess;
target_text: yakob padhai lii era, rahel d'ai le era èèna dènge kahib'i ama na. nèngu ka dhu biasa ladhe-leru si.

source_text: and it comes to pass, when jacob has seen rachel, daughter of his mother's brother laban, and the flock of his mother's brother laban, that jacob comes near and rolls the stone from off the mouth of the well, and waters the flock of his mother's brother laban.
target_text: ropa yakob nèdhi rahel dènge kahib'i sèra, la'e dènge ka pa'eso eele hadhu dhu saguru hèb'a èi na. ka na panginu badha to'o na sèra.

source_text: and jacob kisses rachel, and lifts up his voice, and weeps,
target_text: èle ka, la'e uu rahel, dènge tangi.

source_text: and jacob declares to rachel that he is her father's brother, and that he is rebekah's son, and she runs and declares it to her father.
target_text: ka na lolo dènge rahel, aku nèngu na, ari! ja'a ne, ana nèti ribka, ana hèni ama mu. hèia rahel rai sa èmu la'e, peka dènge ama na.

source_text: and it comes to pass, when laban hears the report of his sister's son jacob, that he runs to meet him, and embraces him, and kisses him, and brings him into his house; and he recounts to laban all these things,
target_text: ropa laban tadèngi lii lolo rahel, dhu peka na yakob ana nèti ana hèni na ribka, ka la'e dènge ka, soru nare yakob. ropa na d'ai, liku nare yakob, ka na uu, hèia gale nèti dènge ka, lasi asa èmu na. ka yakob lolo aa'i-aa'i dènge to'o na.

source_text: and laban says to him, you are surely my bone and my flesh; and he dwells with him a month of days.
target_text: hèia laban lii, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a! èdhi dua ti dhu pa'a'ari. ropa yakob pea dènge rèngu d'ai ca hèru,

source_text: and laban says to jacob, is it because you are my brother that you have served me for nothing? declare to me what your hire is.
target_text: laban padhai lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, yakob! ja'a ko'o boe, sèna ka èu sab'a hia ja'a dènge iia-iia d'ara, lula èdhi se dhu pa'a'ari. de èu neo sèna ka rui-j'aj'èra èu ja'a b'ae ca ngaa?

source_text: and laban has two daughters, the name of the older is leah, and the name of the younger rachel,
target_text: laban ne, dhu dènge ana bhèni dhèu dua. dhu uru, ngara na lea. aa ari na, ngara na rahel.

source_text: and the eyes of leah are tender, and rachel has been beautiful of form and beautiful of appearance.
target_text: lea ne, musi madha na ako ahu. te ngaa rahel, rèhu na bhèni iia, aa ngi'u na saraga bia.

source_text: and jacob loves rachel and says, i serve you seven years for rachel your younger daughter:
target_text: yakob d'èi risi rahel. ka na peka dènge laban, ladhe to'o ku mo'o, ja'a sab'a hia to'o ku pidhu tèu, sad'i to'o ku hia ja'a madhèdi dènge rahel.

source_text: and laban says, it is better for me to give her to you than to give her to another man; dwell with me;
target_text: hèia laban dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ko'o! be'a risi, ja'a paleo èu dènge rahel, lula èdhi dua ti dhu a'ari. mage dhoka na madhèdi dènge dhèu leo. de mu pea mi ne'e, sèna ka sab'a hia ja'a.

source_text: and jacob serves for rachel seven years; and they are in his eyes as some days, because of his loving her.
target_text: ka yakob sab'a hia laban pidhu tèu, sèna ka na bisa madhèdi dènge rahel. lula na d'èi madhe-madhe rahel, nèti èèna ka, pidhu tèu èèna, na pangee nuka sèmi pèri-pèri lod'o di.

source_text: and jacob says to laban, give up my wife, for my days have been fulfilled, and i go in to her;
target_text: ropa risi nèti pidhu tèu, ka na pasanèd'e laban, aku nèngu na, to'o! ja'a sab'a le hia to'o ku pidhu tèu, de paleo ka ja'a dènge rahel.

source_text: and laban gathers all the men of the place, and makes a banquet.
target_text: hèia laban tao tatao, ka na nèru aa'i rae lesa ètu rae èèna.

source_text: and it comes to pass in the evening, that he takes his daughter leah, and brings her to him, and he goes in to her; and laban gives his maidservant zilpah to her, to his daughter leah, for a maidservant. and it comes to pass in the morning, that behold, it is leah; and he says to laban, what is this you have done to me? have i not served with you for rachel? and why have you deceived me? and laban says, it is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn; fulfill the period of seven for this one, and we also give to you this one, for the service which you serve with me yet seven other years.
target_text: ropa d'ai mèda èèna, laban hia boe rahel, te ngaa na pua lea maso asa d'ara paleo yakob. ka yakob j'unu dènge ne. asa bèli èèna, yakob heka ne'a kèna, nèngu dhu leo dènge lea di. hèia yakob la'e patao dènge laban, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka, to'o pasèru ja'a sèmi ne'e? ja'a sab'a sèmi ènu pidhu tèu kateme hia mi èu, sèna ka bisa abhu rahel! nga tao ka to'o pasilu dènge lea? ka laban dhaa, baku nasa ku! madhutu ad'a ji'i ètu rai ne'e, ari bisa boe leo uuru èmu nèti a'a. de be'a risi sèmi ne'e! èu mate hari ku pidhu lod'o, d'ai èle tatao ne, heka èu abhu rahel kèna. sad'i èu sab'a hari hia ja'a pidhu tèu. hèia laban pangèd'u dènge ènu bhèni èci, hia mi lea. ngara na silpa.

source_text: and jacob does so, and fulfills the period of seven for this one, and he gives his daughter rachel to him for a wife for him;
target_text: lii padhai laban deo na, yakob d'èi kahèi. nèti èèna ka, èle tatao ne pidhu lod'o, ka laban pamadhèdi hari yakob dènge rahel.

source_text: and laban gives his maidservant bilhah to his daughter rachel for a maidservant for her.
target_text: ka laban hia ènu na dhèu bhèni èci, ngara na bilha, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ènu rahel.

source_text: and he also goes in to rachel, and he also loves rachel more than leah; and he serves with him yet seven other years.
target_text: hèia yakob pa'èci ka dènge rahel. na d'èi risi rahel nèti lea. ka yakob sab'a hari hia to'o na pidhu tèu.

source_text: and yhwh sees that leah is the hated one, and he opens her womb, and rachel is barren;
target_text: te ngaa lamatua ne'a le, yakob sue risi rahel nèti lea. nèti èèna ka, na hia lea nara iisi ana. te ngaa rahel abhu boe ana.

source_text: and leah conceives, and bears a son, and calls his name reuben, for she said, because yhwh has looked on my affliction; because now does my husband love me.
target_text: hèia lea dènge babia, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. na pangare ne, ruben dhu sasoa na ‘mèdhi si, abhu ana', lula na peka na, lamatua ladhe nèdhi le sasusa ja'a. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne, dhèu èmu ja'a tao madha-dhilu mi ja'a.

source_text: and she conceives again, and bears a son, and says, because yhwh has heard that i am the hated one, he also gives to me even this one; and she calls his name simeon.
target_text: ka lea dènge hari babia, hèia nara iisi hari ana mone èci. na pangare ne, simeon dhu sasoa na, ele boe ‘dhèu tadèngi le', lula na peka na, lamatua dhu ne'a na, dhèu èmu ja'a sue boe ja'a. tu d'ai èèna ka, na hia ja'a ana dhèu èci hari.

source_text: and she conceives again and bears a son, and says, now is the time, my husband is joined to me, because i have born to him three sons, therefore has one called his name levi.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lea kad'o hari ana èci, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. na pangare na lewi, lula na peka na, dènge ana ne'e ne, èle dènge lii langu ja'a. d'ara dhèu èmu ja'a, pa'èki dènge ja'a, lula ja'a matana hia ne ana mone, dhèu tèlu kèna.

source_text: and she conceives again and bears a son, and this time says, i praise yhwh; therefore has she called his name judah; and she ceases from bearing.
target_text: ka lea dènge hari babia ca tèka, hèia nara iisi ana mone èci. na pangare na, yahuda dhu sasoa na ele boe ‘koa-kio', lula na peka na, dènge j'ara ne'e ne, ja'a neo koa-kio lamatua! èle ka, lea dènge heka ana.

source_text: and rachel sees that she has not borne to jacob, and rachel is envious of her sister, and says to jacob, give me sons, and if there is none-i die.
target_text: te ngaa rahel dhu abhu mèka ana. nèti èèna ka, nèngu tèke d'ara dènge a'a na. hèia na peka dènge dhèu èmu na, a'a! hia ku ja'a ana laa, ma. ladhe aad'o, be'a risi ja'a madhe ka laa.

source_text: and jacob's anger burns against rachel, and he says, am i in stead of god who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?
target_text: te ngaa yakob jèke ne, aku nèngu na, èu ngee na, ja'a ne, lamatua, ho bisa hia èu ana! ?

source_text: and she says, behold, my handmaid bilhah, go in to her, and she bears on my knees, and i am built up, even i, from her;
target_text: ka rahel b'ala na, sèmi ne'e: hua iia èu more bilha, ènu ja'a na. j'unu dènge ne, sèna ka na matana hia ja'a ana.

source_text: and she gives bilhah her maidservant to him for a wife, and jacob goes in to her;
target_text: hèia na pangèd'u bilha mi dhèu èmu na. ka yakob j'unu dènge ne.

source_text: and bilhah conceives, and bears a son to jacob,
target_text: ka bilha dènge babia, hèia nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: and rachel says, god has decided for me, and has also listened to my voice, and gives a son to me; therefore she has called his name dan.
target_text: hèia rahel padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua nanene le lii manèngi-mangaj'i ja'a. nèti èèna ka, na hia ja'a ana mone ca dhèu. ama lamatua pama'ète le, lii langu ja'a dènge mola-mola. ka na pangare ana ne, dan dhu sasoa na ‘pama'ète lii'.

source_text: and bilhah, rachel's maidservant, conceives again, and bears a second son to jacob,
target_text: èle èèna ka, bilha dènge hari babia, ka nara iisi ana mone èci.

source_text: and rachel says, with wrestlings of god i have wrestled with my sister, indeed, i have prevailed; and she calls his name napthali.
target_text: ka rahel peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a limuri ne pa'uji dènge a'a ku, ka ja'a segi. nèti èèna ka, na pangare ana na, naftali dhu sasoa na ‘pa'uji', do ‘pa'ère'.

source_text: and leah sees that she has ceased from bearing, and she takes zilpah her maidservant, and gives her to jacob for a wife;
target_text: ropa lea ne'a na nèngu ne dènge heka ana, ka na paleo ènu na silpa dènge yakob.

source_text: and zilpah, leah's maidservant, bears a son to jacob,
target_text: ka silpa nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: and leah says, a troop is coming; and she calls his name gad.
target_text: hèia lea peka na, kalua ja'a, mèngi le. ka na pangare na, gad dhu sasoa na ‘kalua mèngi'.

source_text: and zilpah, leah's maidservant, bears a second son to jacob,
target_text: ka silpa nara iisi hari ana mone èci.

source_text: and leah says, because of my happiness, for daughters have pronounced me blessed; and she calls his name asher.
target_text: hèia lea padhai lii, peka na, waa! limuri ne, ja'a heka karej'e kèna! mi laladhe ee, te bèli-camèd'a, dhèu bhèni aa'i-aa'i ra, peka na ja'a ne oto bia. nèti èèna ka, na pangare ana ne, aser dhu sasoa na ‘karej'e'.

source_text: and reuben goes in the days of wheat-harvest, and finds love-apples in the field, and brings them to his mother leah, and rachel says to leah, please give to me of the love-apples of your son.
target_text: ca lod'o, lèke dènge hèru puu-g'ètu are, ruben la'e asa d'ara j'ami. na rage ana aaj'u ca kapua dhu j'aj'i sèmi èi na'i ho hia dhèu bhèni abhu kolo. ka ruben nèti hia ina na lea. ropa rahel nèdhi, ka na peka dènge lea, aku nèngu na, a'a! bagi ku ja'a ciki, èi na'i dhu ruben nèti èèna.

source_text: and she says to her, is your taking my husband a little thing, that you have also taken the love-apples of my son? and rachel says, he therefore lies with you tonight, for your son's love-apples.
target_text: te ngaa lea b'ala, aku nèngu na, wee! èu ne seli-kolane! parame more le dhèu èmu ja'a. te ngaa roca mèka na. mu neo hari unu aj'u èi na'i èèna nèti ana ja'a? me'a heka makae d'ara! te ngaa rahel dhaa, sèmi ne'e, a'a! ladhe ja'a abhu èi na'i na, mèda ne'e èu pa'èci dènge yakob. ka lea d'èi kahèi.

source_text: and jacob comes in from the field at evening; and leah goes to meet him and says, you come in to me, for in hiring i have hired you with my son's love-apples; and he lies with her during that night.
target_text: ka pe d'ai loo nihia sa, yakob lèpa nèti d'ara oka. lea la'e soru nare ne, ka na peka, a'a! mèda ne, èu j'unu dènge ja'a! lula ja'a dhu hèli kore le èu, dènge kab'ua èi na'i ana ja'a! ka mèda na, yakob j'unu dènge lea.
