source_text: and god listens to leah, and she conceives, and bears a son to jacob, a fifth,
target_text: ka ama lamatua tadèngi lii manèngi-mangaj'i lea. nèti èèna ka, na dènge babia, hèia nara iisi ana mone ka lèmi.

source_text: and leah says, god has given my hire, because i have given my maidservant to my husband; and she calls his name issachar.
target_text: hèia lea pangare ana na, isaskar, dhu sasoa na, ‘b'ae j'aj'èra', lula na peka na, ama lamatua b'ae-baj'a le j'aj'èra ja'a, lula ja'a hia le silpa madhèdi dènge dhèu èmu ja'a.

source_text: and leah conceives again, and she bears a sixth son to jacob,
target_text: èle èèna ka, lea dènge babia hari, hèia nara iisi ana mone ka èna.

source_text: and leah says, god has endowed me-a good dowry; this time my husband dwells with me, for i have borne six sons to him; and she calls his name zebulun;
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua parasee ja'a mèdha dhu be'a. ka limuri ne, dhèu èmu ja'a hud'i pakab'ua ku ja'a, lula ja'a matana hia ne ana mone dhèu èna. nèti èèna ka, na pangare ana ne, sebulon dhu sasoa na ‘pakab'ua'.

source_text: and afterward she has borne a daughter, and calls her name dinah.
target_text: ka lea nara iisi hari, te ngaa ana bhèni, ka na pangare na, dina.

source_text: and god remembers rachel, and god listens to her, and opens her womb,
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua dhu bhèlu boe rahel, ka sèmi lii manèngi-mangaj'i na. nèti èèna ka, na bhoke era ana na.

source_text: and she conceives and bears a son, and says, god has gathered up my reproach;
target_text: hèia rahel dènge babia, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka na peka, ama lamatua saku eele le d'ara makae ja'a.

source_text: and she calls his name joseph, saying, yhwh is adding to me another son.
target_text: hèia na pangare ana na yusuf dhu sasoa na ele boe ‘hud'i laa na hia tabha hari', lula aku nèngu na, ja'a manèngi, sèna ka ama lamatua hia ja'a ana mone ca dhèu hari.

source_text: and it comes to pass, when rachel has borne joseph, that jacob says to laban, send me away, and i go to my place, and to my land;
target_text: lod'o rahel nara iisi yusuf, yakob peka dènge laban, aku nèngu na, to'o! ladhe mo'o, ja'a neo lèpa asa rai ètu-èsu ja'a.

source_text: give up my wives and my children, for whom i have served you, and i go; for you have known my service which i have served you.
target_text: ja'a neo laku dènge ana-dhèu èmu ja'a. to'o, èu dhu me'a le, ja'a ne sab'a tèu-tèu nèti mad'ae d'ai loo nihia. de ja'a b'ae pama'ète le rèngu se. nèti èèna ka, rèngu se, j'aj'i le unu ja'a ka teme aae.

source_text: and laban says to him, now if i have found grace in your eyes-i have observed diligently that yhwh blesses me for your sake.
target_text: hèia, aku to'o na, ana, ee! èu nanene ku lii ja'a laa! madhutu lii malare dhu ja'a abhu, lamatua hia ja'a mamèngi lula èu.

source_text: he also says, define your hire to me, and i give.
target_text: de èu neo manèngi ca ngaa, peka, sèna ka ja'a b'ae! sad'i èu baku tèke eele ja'a, te ngaa sab'a taruu hia ja'a.

source_text: and he says to him, you have known that which i have served you in, and that which your substance was with me;
target_text: ka yakob peka, to'o! èu mèdhi unu mu le, sasab'a-la'a ja'a. nèti èèna ka, badha-manu to'o se, bèba-kacanga.

source_text: for it is little which you have had at my appearance, and it breaks forth into a multitude, and yhwh blesses you at my coming; and now, when do i make, i also, for my own house?
target_text: lod'o dhu ja'a dhae mai mèka, mèdha-panyau to'o ku ae èèna mèka. te ngaa limuri ne, to'o kaja le. lamatua pala-bagi le to'o ku mamèngi, lula sasab'a-la'a ja'a ka. te d'ai le lod'o na, sèna ka ja'a sab'a hia ana-dhèu èmu ja'a.

source_text: and he says, what do i give to you? and jacob says, you do not give me anything; if you do this thing for me, i turn back; i have delight; i watch your flock;
target_text: hèia laban karèi ne, aku nèngu na, de sèmi èèna na, ja'a b'ae èu tasamia? ka yakob dhaa, peka na, to'o ku, hia ia ka ja'a ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa badha-manu to'o ku, ja'a ladhe-leru taruu, sad'i mu tao ku j'ara èci.

source_text: i pass through all your flock today to turn aside every speckled and spotted sheep from there, and every brown sheep among the lambs, and speckled and spotted among the goats-and it has been my hire;
target_text: ladhe mo'o, deo ne'e kahèi, ja'a laku asa badha-manu to'o sèi, ho hag'e si. mia dhu dènge boe katèd'a aa dènge boe karata, sèra sa unu to'o ku taruu. te ngaa mia dhu dènge katèd'a aa dhu karata, hia mi ja'a. dènge kahib'i-kalèbho dhu mèdhi, ja'a kora aa'i si. se'e se, hud'i laa j'aj'i mi bab'ae rui-j'aj'èra ja'a.

source_text: and my righteousness has answered for me in the day to come, when it comes in for my hire before your face-everyone which is not speckled and spotted among my goats, and brown among my lambs-it is stolen with me.
target_text: d'ai lod'o limuri, pe to'o me'a ja'a ne sab'a dènge mola, do aad'o. sad'i lake more, mai ho mu parisa badha-manu ja'a. ladhe mu abhu kahib'i-ka'ia dhu dènge boe katèd'a, aa dhu karata boe, do, kahib'i-kalèbho dhu pudhi, èèna na, dhu me'a le èèna, ja'a mana'u badha-manu to'o.

source_text: and laban says, behold, o that it were according to your word;
target_text: ka laban d'èi kahèi, aku nèngu na, oo! j'ara na sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: and he turns aside during that day the striped and the spotted male goats, and all the speckled and the spotted female goats, everyone that has white in it, and every brown one among the lambs, and he gives into the hand of his sons,
target_text: te ngaa ètu d'ara lod'o èèna kahèi, laban hag'e dènge badha dhu katèd'a, dhu karata, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho dhu mèdhi. ka na pangèd'u mi ana na si, ho ladhe-leru.

source_text: and sets a journey of three days between himself and jacob; and jacob is feeding the rest of the flock of laban.
target_text: hèia eo rèti ka badha se asa era èci dhu kaj'èu na tèlu lod'o kako haga nèti era yakob si. ka yakob madhenge ka badha dhu ata se.

source_text: and jacob takes to himself a rod of fresh poplar and almond and plane-tree, and peels in them white peelings, making bare the white that is on the rods,
target_text: èla èèna ka, yakob poro nare dadana aaj'u nèti aj'u tèlu rupa. ka na caci pakarata ka'uri aj'u sèra, tao strep-strep.

source_text: and sets up the rods which he has peeled in the gutters in the watering troughs where the flock comes to drink, in front of the flock, that they may conceive in their coming to drink;
target_text: hèia aj'u dhu strep-strep se, na tèke asa d'ara karab'a kahib'i. badha se dhu tema le pa'ango aa paleo ètu era èèna.

source_text: and the flocks conceive at the rods, and the flock bears striped, speckled, and spotted ones.
target_text: de ladhe badha se paleo ètu madha aj'u strep-strep se, ra matana ana dhu rèu ra katèd'a dènge karata.

source_text: and jacob has parted the lambs, and he puts the face of the flock toward the striped, also all the brown in the flock of laban, and he sets his own droves by themselves, and has not set them near laban's flock.
target_text: ka ladhe badha laban se neo paleo, yakob patangare si asa kahib'i dhu katèd'a dènge karata sèra. hèia ana dhu ra matana sa rèu ra katèd'a dènge karata kahèi. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, badha na asa ae. ka na pacèri eele si nèti badha laban sèra.

source_text: and it has come to pass, whenever the strong ones of the flock conceive, that jacob sets the rods before the eyes of the flock in the gutters, to cause them to conceive by the rods,
target_text: ropa badha dhu èra neo paleo, yakob nare kadhèli aj'u dhu strep-strep sèra, tao mi d'ara karab'a ètu madha si.

source_text: and when the flock is feeble, he does not set them; and the feeble ones have been laban's, and the strong ones jacob's.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe kahib'i dhu roe dènge malaka-god'a neo paleo, yakob soro tèke si. ka badha dhu roe, sèra unu to'o na laban. aa mia dhu èra, sèra unu nèngu.

source_text: and the man increases very exceedingly, and has many flocks, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and donkeys.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e ne, yakob j'aj'i dhèu kaja-su'i. ka kahib'i-ka'ia na, kahib'i-kalèbho na, onta na, keled'ei na, dènge ènu na bhèni-mone, udhu sobhu-sobhu.

source_text: and he hears the words of laban's sons, saying, jacob has taken all that our father has; indeed, from that which our father has, he has made all this glory;
target_text: ca tèka, yakob tadèngi lii padhai ana-ana laban se, aku rèngu na, kakaja-sasu'i yakob sèra, lula na kao nare aa'i mèdha-panyau ama èdhi.

source_text: and jacob sees the face of laban, and behold, it is not with him as before.
target_text: yakob nèdhi kahèi rèhu to'o laban mare heka, aa be'a heka dènge ne, sèmi uru èèna.

source_text: and yhwh says to jacob, return to the land of your fathers, and to your family, and i am with you.
target_text: hèia lamatua peka dènge yakob, d'ai le lod'o, ho èu lèpa asa ina dènge ama mu. ja'a palere-lere dènge èu.

source_text: and jacob sends and calls for rachel and for leah to the field to his flock;
target_text: ka yakob hia dhèu lasi paroa rahel dènge lea, sèna ka mai paraga dènge ne ètu era ani badha, ètu d'ara mamoo.

source_text: and says to them, i am beholding your father's face-that it is not toward me as before, and the god of my father has been with me,
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, limuri ne, ja'a ladhe-ladhe na, ama miu na rèhu na mare heka dènge ja'a. aa babe'a na mi ja'a, sèmi heka uru èèna. te ngaa ama lamatua dhu ama ku sogo-tagu èèna, palere-lere dènge ja'a.

source_text: and you have known that with all my power i have served your father,
target_text: miu dua mi se me'a le, nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a j'aj'i kuli ètu ama miu!

source_text: and your father has played on me, and has changed my hire ten times; and god has not permitted him to do evil with me.
target_text: te ngaa sèmi èèna, d'ara na la'e kahèi, ka na kapod'e-kabèli taruu ja'a. ka na ub'a rui-j'aj'èra ja'a, canguru hari kèna. masi ka sèmi èèna, ama lamatua j'aga pa'èra ja'a.

source_text: if he says thus: the speckled are your hire, then all the flock bore speckled ones; and if he says thus: the striped are your hire, then all the flock bore striped;
target_text: lod'o ama miu peka na, ‘badha dhu rèu ra katèd'a sèra j'aj'i mi unu èu, ' ho ladhe lod'o badha se matana, ana dhu katèd'a hua-hua. lod'o leo hari, na peka, ‘badha dhu karata sèra, j'aj'i mi unu èu, ' ka badha se matana ana karata aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and god takes away the substance of your father, and gives to me.
target_text: ama lamatua ad'u sèmi èèna na, sèna ka nare aa'i badha-manu ama miu èèna, ho hia mi ja'a.

source_text: and it comes to pass at the time of the flock conceiving, that i lift up my eyes and see in a dream, and behold, the male goats, which are going up on the flock, are striped, speckled, and spotted;
target_text: ca tèka, ropa badha se paleo, ja'a kèdhi ètu d'ara nii, dhu peka na, badha mone aa'i-aa'i dhu paleo, abhu dhu katèd'a aa dhu karata hèi.

source_text: and the messenger of god says to me in the dream, jacob, and i say, here i am.
target_text: ka ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga paroa ja'a, peka na, ‘yakob! ' hèia ja'a dhaa, ‘tasamia, lamatua? '

source_text: and he says, now lift up your eyes and see that all the male goats which are going up on the flock are striped, speckled, and spotted, for i have seen all that laban is doing to you;
target_text: ka na lii, ‘ladhe ku laa! badha mone dhu paleo sèra, dhodhoka dhu karata dènge katèd'a di. ja'a ka ad'u sèra sa, lula ja'a dhu kèdhi le, ngaa dhu laban tao mi dedha èu.

source_text: i am the god of bethel where you have anointed a standing pillar, where you have vowed a vow to me; now, arise, go out from this land, and return to the land of your birth.
target_text: ja'a ne, ama lamatua, dhu pad'elo iisi mi èu ètu betel èèna. ètu era nèi, èu patitu hadhu, ka mu bhori èi mènyi ètu dedha na, ka èu sogo-tagu ja'a. ka èu pa'èki lii pajaji dènge ja'a ètu nèi. de kèd'i ka, tèke eele ka rai ne'e ne, lamu ka asa kabarai ina-ama èu. '

source_text: and rachel answers-leah also-and says to him, have we yet a portion and inheritance in the house of our father?
target_text: hèia rahel dènge lea b'ala lii na, aku rèngu na, la'a ma! ji'i dènge heka pusaka ngaa-ngaa nèti ama ji'i laban.

source_text: have we not been reckoned strangers to him? for he has sold us, and he also utterly consumes our money;
target_text: nèbhu nare sange ne'e, mone heka ne tao ji'i sèmi dhèu leo kara sa. na pahie eele le ji'i se. ka na'e aa'i le kab'ua-kadheli ji'i se.

source_text: for all the wealth which god has taken away from our father, it is ours, and our children's; and now, all that god has said to you-do.
target_text: de mèdha-panyau dhu ama lamatua nare sèra nèti ama ji'i laban, aa'i-aa'i sèra j'aj'i le unu èdhi dènge ana-ana èdhi se. de ladhe aku lamatua tasa mera mia, te'a dhoka madhutu di!

source_text: and jacob rises, and lifts up his sons and his wives on the camels, and leads all his livestock, and all his substance which he has acquired, the livestock of his getting, which he has acquired in padan-aram, to go to his father isaac, to the land of canaan.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob lalau mèdha-panyau na. hèia na paca'e ana-dhèu èmu na asa dedha onta lasi, aa na eo nèti badha-manu na aa'i-aa'i, dènge mèdha-panyau dhu na abhu ètu padan aram, ho lasi asa rai kana'an.

source_text: and laban has gone to shear his flock, and rachel steals the teraphim which her father has;
target_text: lod'o èèna, laban dhu la'e g'ute rèu kahib'i-kalèbho na. ka rahel mana'u nare patung mèdha sogo-tagu ama na.

source_text: and jacob deceives the heart of laban the aramean, because he has not declared to him that he is fleeing;
target_text: aa yakob si lasi palangu boe lii dènge to'o na.

source_text: and he flees, he and all that he has, and rises, and passes over the river, and sets his face toward the mount of gilead.
target_text: na bau nèti aa'i mèdha-panyau na, ka ra kako pamèri-mèri, lasi re loko efrat, asa ledhe gilead.

source_text: and it is told to laban on the third day that jacob has fled,
target_text: rarai yakob si èèna d'ai tèlu lod'o ku, heka laban ne'a kèna.

source_text: and he takes his brothers with him, and pursues after him a journey of seven days, and overtakes him in the mount of gilead.
target_text: hèia laban oru nare ka dhèu-dhèu na, lasi bate yakob si. d'ai pidhu lod'o ku, heka ra paraga dènge si ètu ledhe gilead.

source_text: and god comes to laban the aramean in a dream of the night and says to him, take heed to yourself lest you speak with jacob from good to evil.
target_text: ka d'ara mèda èèna, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi laban ètu d'ara nii. na peka na, laban! ladhe èu padhai lii dènge yakob, j'aga paie hèb'a èu na.

source_text: and laban overtakes jacob; and jacob has fixed his tent in the mountain; and laban with his brothers have fixed theirs in the mount of gilead.
target_text: mèda èèna, yakob si dhu patitu paleo ètu ledhe gilead. aa laban si patitu unu ra kaj'èu boe nèti era èèna kahèi.

source_text: and laban says to jacob, what have you done that you deceive my heart, and lead away my daughters as captives of the sword?
target_text: èle ka, laban mai paraga dènge yakob. hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka, èu rai mèti ana bhèni ja'a se, dènge boe lii ugu-ge'e sa hèi? mu tao si sèmi dhèu dhu èu segi ètu d'ara papara-pakèj'i.

source_text: why have you hidden yourself to flee, and deceive me, and have not declared to me, and i send you away with joy and with songs, with tambourine and with harp,
target_text: èu ne ad'a aad'o, palangu boe sa hèi dènge ja'a! ladhe èu peka dènge ja'a be'a-be'a, ele boe ja'a tao sisi-kau, ho ta'a-tinu boko-boko, ho lere miu dènge lii sod'a, heka ji'i patabuli miu kèna.

source_text: and have not permitted me to kiss my sons and my daughters? now you have acted foolishly in doing so;
target_text: sasala èu èci hari ka, èu hia boe ja'a uu ana-èpu ja'a hèi. tatao èu ne goa titu kèna!

source_text: my hand is to god to do evil with you, but the god of your father last night has spoken to me, saying, take heed to yourself from speaking with jacob from good to evil.
target_text: carui boe, ladhe ja'a ne neo paj'èra èu! te ngaa malo-malo ka mèda-mèda na, ama lamatua dhu ama mu sogo-tagu èèna, kai ja'a peka na, ladhe ja'a padhai lii dènge èu, ja'a hud'i j'aga paie-iie ku hèb'a ja'a.

source_text: and now, you have certainly gone, because you have been very desirous for the house of your father; why have you stolen my gods?
target_text: mema, ja'a dhu ke'a le, èu pakèd'i lula èu dhu neo le lèpa. te ngaa tasamia ka, èu mana'u mèti patung mèdha sogo-tagu ja'a?

source_text: and jacob answers and says to laban, because i was afraid, for i said, lest you violently take away your daughters from me;
target_text: hèia yakob b'ala, aku nèngu na, to'o baku nasa ku dènge ja'a! ja'a pakèd'i mau-mau èèna, lula ja'a mage dhoka mo'o boe ja'a kèti ana-ana se!

source_text: with whomsoever you find your gods-he must not live; before our brothers discern for yourself what is with me, and take to yourself: and jacob has not known that rachel has stolen them.
target_text: te ngaa yakob dhu ne'a nare boe, na dhèu èmu na rahel ka dhu mana'u nèti. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, to'o! mèdha sogo-tagu èèna, mu tenge ne! ladhe mèdhi ètu cee, huku pamadhe ne. parisa aa'i mèu-mèu. ladhe abhu kahèi pusaka to'o dhu leo, more aa'i si. hud'i laa, dhèu se'e se j'aj'i sakasii.

source_text: and laban goes into the tent of jacob, and into the tent of leah, and into the tent of the two handmaidens, and has not found; and he goes out from the tent of leah, and goes into the tent of rachel.
target_text: hèia laban la'e parisa ka asa d'ara paleo se èci-èci. na la'e uru asa d'ara paleo yakob. èle ka, la'e asa d'ara paleo lea. èle ka, la'e asa d'ara paleo ènu se dua ra. te ngaa abhu boe ngaa-ngaa. paleo rahel limuri tèka.

source_text: and rachel has taken the teraphim, and puts them in the furniture of the camel, and sits on them; and laban feels all the tent, and has not found;
target_text: te ngaa rahel dhu huni le mèdha sogo-tagu sèra ètu d'ara lalaka onta. ka na madhèdi ètu dedha. d'ai d'ara paleo ne, laban tenge paie-iie, te ngaa na rage boe.

source_text: and she says to her father, let it not be displeasing in the eyes of my lord that i am not able to rise at your presence, for the way of women is on me; and he searches, and has not found the teraphim.
target_text: hèia rahel peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ama mage mu nasa kahèi. te ja'a bisa boe titu, lula ja'a abhu hèru. masi ka sèmi èèna, laban tenge taruu, te ngaa abhu boe mèdha sogo-tagu sèra.

source_text: and it is displeasing to jacob, and he strives with laban; and jacob answers and says to laban, what is my transgression? what my sin, that you have burned after me?
target_text: ka yakob nasa, hèia na pajèka dènge laban, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne tao bhelu ngaa mi to'o? ka to'o mai bate ja'a, sèmi dhu ja'a ne, dhèu bhelu-katub'a sa!

source_text: for you have felt all my vessels: what have you found of all the vessels of your house? set here before my brothers, and your brothers, and they decide between us both.
target_text: mèdha-panyau ja'a, to'o ceb'e eele si. de mu abhu ngaa? more ka mai tèke mi madha ne, sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ti tèdhi. aa hud'i laa, dhèu se'e ka dhu pama'ète mèdha èèna unu cee.

source_text: these twenty years i am with you: your ewes and your female goats have not miscarried, and the rams of your flock i have not eaten;
target_text: dua nguru tèu kèna, ja'a sab'a kuli mi to'o. lod'o ja'a madhenga badha-manu to'o, ci'u sa legu boe. aa ku'a kèdhi boe ci'u sa hèi!

source_text: the torn i have not brought to you-i repay it-from my hand you seek it; i have been deceived by day, and i have been deceived by night;
target_text: ladhe badha hui-hahi hui, kadhi pamadhe badha to'o ci'u, ja'a peka boe, te ngaa ja'a gati. aa ladhe dhèu mana'u, to'o pua ja'a gati, masi ka ja'a sala boe.

source_text: i have been thus: drought has consumed me in the day, and frost by night, and my sleep wanders from my eyes.
target_text: ladhe re mèu, madha lod'o ai pamango ja'a. aa ladhe mèda, ja'a maringi rig'i-rig'i. ja'a pasaruru boe ciki sa, toke mèu rai, lula madhenge badha-manu to'o.

source_text: this is to me twenty years in your house: i have served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock; and you change my hire ten times;
target_text: mema tare'a, dua nguru tèu èèna! ja'a sab'a canguru èpa tèu, sèna ka abhu ana bhèni to'o, dhèu dua se. ka ja'a sab'a hari èna tèu, sèna ka ja'a unu badha-manu se'e. j'aj'i kuli nèbhu nare sange èèna, te ngaa to'o pakura rui-j'aj'èra ja'a d'ai canguru hari.

source_text: unless the god of my father, the god of abraham, and the fear of isaac, had been for me, surely now you had sent me away empty; god has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and reproves last night.
target_text: malo-malo ka, dènge ama lamatua, dhu baki ku abraham, dènge ama ku isak, dhu sogo-tagu ne. ladhe na leru boe ja'a ne, ele boe to'o hia ja'a lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u. te ngaa ama lamatua dhu pa'abhe boe musi madha na mi j'aj'èra ja'a, aa na tao madha-dhilu mi sasab'a-la'a ja'a aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, mèda deo na, na mai kai to'o, sèna ka baku lii sakaa dènge ja'a.

source_text: and laban answers and says to jacob, the daughters are my daughters, and the sons my sons, and the flock my flock, and all that you are seeing is mine; and to my daughters-what do i to these today, or to their sons whom they have born?
target_text: ropa nanene nare lii padhai yakob, ka laban dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! bhèni dua se, ana ja'a. ana dhu ra matana se, aa'i-aa'i ra èpu ja'a. badha-manu aa'i-aa'i se, unu ja'a. aa'i-aa'i dhu èu ladhe mèdhi ètu se'e se, unu ja'a. te ngaa ja'a neo tao si, tasamia? ja'a bisa boe magee si.

source_text: and now, come, let us make a covenant, i and you, and it has been for a witness between me and you.
target_text: de be'a risi, èdhi dua ti pa'èki lii pajaji. sèna ka lii pajaji èèna ka dhu èki èdhi dua ti.

source_text: and jacob takes a stone, and lifts it up for a standing pillar;
target_text: hèia yakob nare ka hadhu aae cue, na patitu ètu èèna, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha.

source_text: and jacob says to his brothers, gather stones, and they take stones, and make a heap; and they eat there on the heap;
target_text: hèia yakob pua dhèu sab'a na, lasi udhu hadhu. ka ra madhèdi ra'a-rinu ètu era èèna, padètu dènge hadhu sèra.

source_text: and laban calls it jegar-sahadutha; and jacob has called it galeed.
target_text: hèia laban pangare hadhu udhu sèra, yegar sahaduta. te ngaa yakob pangare na, galeed.

source_text: and laban says, this heap is witness between me and you today; therefore has he called its name galeed;
target_text: ka laban padhai lii, aku nèngu na, hadhu udhu se, j'aj'i sakasii mi èdhi dua ti. nèti èèna ka, era èèna ngara na, galeed.

source_text: mizpah also, for he said, yhwh watches between me and you, for we are hidden from one another;
target_text: laban pangare kahèi era èèna, mispa dhu sasoa na ‘era j'aga dhu dedha', lula na peka na, pe èèna na, lamatua ka dhu j'aga èdhi dua ti, ho masi ka dua ti pakaj'èu, baku kako eele lii pajaji ne.

source_text: if you afflict my daughters, or take wives beside my daughters-there is no man with us-see, god is witness between me and you.
target_text: ladhe èu tao karehe ana ja'a se, do leo-èmu dènge bhèni leo hari, tatu ja'a ke'a boe. te ngaa mu sanèd'e! ama lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii mi èdhi dua ti.

source_text: and laban says to jacob, behold, this heap, and behold, the standing pillar which i have cast between me and you; this heap is witness, and the standing pillar is witness, that i do not pass over this heap to you, and that you do not pass over this heap and this standing pillar to me-for evil;
target_text: èu ladhe ku hadhu dhu patitu ne, dènge hadhu dhu udhu se. sanèd'e, hadhu se'e ka dhu j'aj'i mi too dènge lane. èu bisa boe kako seli hadhu se, ho tao bhelu mi ja'a. aa ja'a kahèi bisa boe kako seli hadhu se, ho tao bhelu mi èu.

source_text: the god of abraham and the god of nahor, judges between us-the god of their father, and jacob swears by the fear of his father isaac.
target_text: dua ti pa'èki lii pajaji ne, dènge kolongara ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èdhi. nuka ama lamatua nèti baki mu abraham dènge baki ja'a nahor. nèngu èèna ka, dhu j'aj'i hakim, sèna ka pama'ète lii èdhi dua ti. ropa nanene nare, hèia yakob j'oka soo-subha dènge kolongara ama lamatua, dhu ama na isak sogo-tagu.

source_text: and jacob sacrifices a sacrifice on the mountain, and calls to his brothers to eat bread, and they eat bread, and lodge on the mountain;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob roro badha, ho j'aj'i mi korban hia mi lamatua ètu ledhe èèna. hèia na paroa dhèu aa'i-aa'i mai ra'a-rinu pa'èci, ka ra beke d'ai lod'o rea.

source_text: and jacob has gone on his way, and messengers of god come on him;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob si kako taruu. hèia ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga sèra mai paraga dènge ne.

source_text: and jacob says, when he has seen them, this is the camp of god; and he calls the name of that place two camps.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi si, na lii, aku nèngu na, era ne'e ne, sèmi era ae sordad'u lamatua! nèti èèna ka, era èèna na pangare na, mahanaim dhu sasoa na ‘dua era ae iisi'.

source_text: and jacob sends messengers before him to his brother esau, toward the land of seir, the field of edom,
target_text: ka yakob pua dhèu na pèri-pèri lasi uuru asa rai edom nuka seir, sèna ka lasi peka dènge a'a na esau, ho ne'a mamai na.

source_text: and commands them, saying, thus you say to my lord, to esau, thus said your servant jacob: i have sojourned with laban, and i linger until now;
target_text: hèia yakob peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, lami peka dènge a'a ku esau, sèmi ne'e: ‘lamatua esau! ènu mu yakob, hia ji'i ngèti lii karej'e-karae mi a'a na. peka na, karèi nèti ja'a pakèd'i, toke sange ne'e ne, ja'a pea ètu d'ara èmu to'o laban.

source_text: and i have ox, and donkey, flock, and manservant, and maidservant, and i send to declare to my lord, to find grace in his eyes.
target_text: limuri ne, ènu lamatua na dènge le unu sapi, keled'ei, rupa-rupa kahib'i, dènge ènu bhèni-mone. ja'a hia uru dhèu se'e dhiu, ho peka dènge a'a ku, mamai ja'a ne. ja'a sanao sèna ka a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge d'ara kateme. ' èle ka dhèu se lasi.

source_text: and the messengers return to jacob, saying, we came to your brother, to esau, and he is also coming to meet you, and four hundred men with him;
target_text: ropa dhèu se lèpa hari mai, ra lolo dènge yakob, aku rèngu na, ji'i paraga le dènge a'a mu esau. nuka na mai re limuri nèi, dènge dhèu na èpa ngasu dhèu mone, neo mai paraga dènge èu.

source_text: and jacob fears exceedingly, and is distressed, and he divides the people who are with him, and the flock, and the herd, and the camels, into two camps,
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare, sangasa yakob rèbha-rèbha, aa na madha'u ae. ka na hag'e eele dhèu na dènge badha-manu j'aj'i mi dua kaboko.

source_text: and says, if esau comes to one camp, and has struck it-then the camp which is left has been for an escape.
target_text: na pangee, ladhe esau mai, ho na age kaboko dhu uru, na kaboko dhu limuri bisa rai, tenge sod'a.

source_text: and jacob says, god of my father abraham and god of my father isaac, yhwh who says to me, return to your land and to your family, and i do good with you:
target_text: hèia yakob manèngi-mangaj'i, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua! èu j'aj'i lamatua nèti baki ja'a abraham, aa nèti ama ku isak. nanene ku lii manèngi ja'a la! uru èèna, lamatua ka dhu hia ja'a lèpa asa a'ari ja'a, ètu kabarai ne'e. lamatua ka dhu moa tèke, peka na pe lamatua uri pamola j'ara.

source_text: i have been unworthy of all the kind acts and of all the truth which you have done with your servant-for with my staff i passed over this jordan, and now i have become two camps.
target_text: ja'a ne madhutu mola-mola na, bisa boe abhu sasue dènge mamako lamatua. uru èèna, lod'o ja'a pège loko yarden, ja'a kèti dhoka tatea di. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a lèpa kèti dènge dhèu dua nau, aa dènge badha-manu ae.

source_text: please deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of esau: for i am fearing him, lest he come and has struck me-mother beside sons;
target_text: ja'a mangingi, mage dhoka a'a ja'a esau, mai pare pamadhe ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua hia mamuri mi ja'a, dènge ana-dhèu èmu-kamali aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: and you have said, i certainly do good with you, and have set your seed as the sand of the sea, which is not numbered because of the multitude.
target_text: lamatua dhu jaji tèke, èèna na pala-bagi mi dedha ja'a mamèngi ae-ae, aa hia ana-èpu ja'a bèba-kacanga, sama sèmi salae ètu nebhe dhasi, dhu dhèu ige rare boe.

source_text: and he lodges there during that night, and takes from that which is coming into his hand, a present for his brother esau:
target_text: èle ka, yakob si j'unu ètu era èèna. asa bèli èèna, na hag'e badha pèri-pèri ngi'u ho rèti hia a'a na.

source_text: female goats two hundred, and male goats twenty, ewes two hundred, and rams twenty,
target_text: na pili nare kahib'i rena dua ngasu ngi'u, kahib'i mone dua nguru ngi'u, kahib'i-kalèbho rena dua ngasu ngi'u, kahib'i-kalèbho mone dua nguru ngi'u,

source_text: suckling camels and their young ones thirty, cows forty, and bullocks ten, female donkeys twenty, and foals ten;
target_text: onta rena tèlu nguru ngi'u dènge ana susu, sapi rena èpa nguru ngi'u, canguru ngi'u sapi mone, keled'ei rena dua nguru ngi'u, dènge canguru ngi'u keled'ei mone.

source_text: and he gives into the hand of his servants every drove by itself, and says to his servants, pass over before me, and a space you put between drove and drove.
target_text: ka na hag'e ka badha se, èci-èci ka dènge anga na. hèia na papala ka, èci-èci dènge ana madhenge na. ka na peka dènge dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, miu kako uuru. pe ja'a dhiu. te ngaa mi palaladha ho kaboko èci pakaj'èu nèti kaboko dhu leo sèra.

source_text: and he commands the first, saying, when my brother esau meets you, and has asked you, saying, whose are you? and to where do you go? and whose are these before you?
target_text: ka na peka dènge kaboko dhu uuru tèka, aku nèngu na, ladhe a'a ku esau paraga dènge èu, aa na karèi, peka na, ‘èu lamu mia? èu ne, ènu nèti cee? badha-manu se, unu cee? '

source_text: then you have said, your servant jacob's: it is a present sent to my lord, to esau; and behold, he also is behind us.
target_text: na mi dhaa, peka na, ‘badha-manu se, unu ènu mu, yakob. na pa'adhu hia a'a na, esau. te ngaa nèngu nuka nèti limuri nèi. '

source_text: and he commands also the second, also the third, also all who are going after the droves, saying, according to this manner do you speak to esau in your finding him, and you have also said, behold, your servant jacob is behind us; for he said, i pacify his face with the present which is going before me, and afterward i see his face; it may be he lifts up my face;
target_text: lii sèmi èèna, na peka kahèi dènge dhèu madhenga badha cahag'e sèra hèi, aku nèngu na, ladhe mi paraga dènge a'a ku esau, mi hia ne badha-manu se. aa mi peka dènge ne, ja'a re limuri. lula madhutu a'abhu yakob, na hia badha se aa'i-aa'i mi esau, èèna na esau sèmi nèngu dènge be'a.

source_text: and the present passes over before his face, and he has lodged during that night in the camp.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na hia uuru rèti badha se. te ngaa mèda èèna, nèngu pea ètu èèna era.

source_text: and he rises in that night, and takes his two wives, and his two maidservants, and his eleven children, and passes over the passage of jabbok;
target_text: mèda na, yakob kèd'i, ka na pua dhèu èmu na dhèu dua, dènge dhèu èmu piara dhèu dua, dènge ana na dhèu canguru èci sèra, lasi uuru pège asa cabèka loko yabok.

source_text: and he takes them, and causes them to pass over the brook, and he causes that which he has to pass over.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai ca bèka loko, ka na hia aa'i mèdha-panyau na asa nèi.

source_text: and jacob is left alone, and one wrestles with him until the ascending of the dawn;
target_text: te ngaa yakob pea ka mesa-mesa ètu èèna. hèia dhèu mone èci mai, ka dua ra palèka d'ai oe mèu.

source_text: and he sees that he is not able for him, and he comes against the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of jacob's thigh is disjointed in his wrestling with him;
target_text: ropa mone ne ne'a na nèngu segi boe yakob, ka na kalabhe mi kolo keja yakob, ka gage na tabod'a eele nèti era na.

source_text: and he says, send me away, for the dawn has ascended: and he says, i do not send you away, except you have blessed me.
target_text: hèia mone ne lii, aku nèngu na, patabuli ja'a, te ciki hari, lod'o rea kèna. te ngaa, aku yakob na, èu hia ja'a mèngi-nale, heka ja'a patabuli èu kèna!

source_text: and he says to him, what is your name? and he says, jacob.
target_text: ka mone ne karèi ne, ngara èu ne, cee? na dhaa, peka na, yakob.

source_text: and he says, your name is no longer called jacob, but israel; for you have reigned with god and with men, and prevail.
target_text: hèia mone ne lii hari, aku nèngu na, èu ngara heka yakob. te ngaa mulai nèti deo ne'e ne, dhèu paroa èu, isra'el, lula èu lab'a le dhèu rai-haha dènge ama lamatua, ka èu segi. ngara isra'el sasoa na ‘dhu palèka dènge ama lamatua'.

source_text: and jacob asks and says, please declare your name; and he says, why is this, you ask for my name? and he blesses him there.
target_text: ka yakob karèi ne, èu peka ku ngara èu la. te ngaa mone ne peka na, èu neo me'a ngara ja'a, tao ngaa? hèia na hia mèngi-nale mi yakob ètu era èèna.

source_text: and jacob calls the name of the place peniel: for i have seen god face to face, and my life is delivered;
target_text: ka yakob padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a kèdhi le ama lamatua madha dènge madha, te ngaa ja'a mamuri era. nèti èèna ka, yakob pangare era èèna, peniel, dhu sasoa na, ‘rèhu lamatua'.

source_text: and the sun rises on him when he has passed over penuel, and he is halting on his thigh;
target_text: ropa yakob tèke eele era èèna, lod'o dhu rea le. te ngaa na kako ged'a, lula gage na tabod'a.

source_text: therefore the sons of israel do not eat the sinew which shrank, which is on the hollow of the thigh, to this day, because he came against the hollow of jacob's thigh, against the sinew which shrank.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, toke d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu isra'el ra'a boe sisi isi lasona, lula lamatua kalabhe patabod'a eele gage bèi-baki ra yakob.

source_text: and jacob lifts up his eyes, and looks, and behold, esau is coming, and with him four hundred men; and he divides the children to leah, and to rachel, and to the two maidservants;
target_text: ètu d'ara lod'o èèna kahèi, yakob ladhe nèdhi esau, dènge dhèu na èpa ngasu sèra, mai asa rèngu. ka na papala ana na mi ina ra èci-èci.

source_text: and he sets the maidservants and their children first, and leah and her children behind, and rachel and joseph last.
target_text: na hia dhèu èmu piara sèra dènge ana ra kako uuru. èle ka, lea dènge ana-ana na, heka rahel dènge ana na yusuf limuri tèka.

source_text: and he himself passed over before them, and bows himself to the earth seven times, until his drawing near to his brother,
target_text: te ngaa yakob kako uuru nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. ropa na padètu dènge a'a na, na patitu kètu urutuu, ka na pacud'u d'ai rai pidhu hari.

source_text: and esau runs to meet him, and embraces him, and falls on his neck, and kisses him, and they weep;
target_text: te ngaa lod'o esau ladhe nèdhi ari na, rai dènge ka, la'e liku nare yakob. dua ra paliku dènge pa'uu. hèia dua ra tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: and he lifts up his eyes, and sees the women and the children, and says, what are these to you? and he says, the children with whom god has favored your servant.
target_text: ropa esau nèdhi bhèni dènge ana-ana si, ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, se'e se, cee ka se'e? ka yakob peka, rèngu se'e se, dhu ama lamatua pala-bagi hia ja'a, ènu a'a ku ne.

source_text: and the maidservants draw near, they and their children, and bow themselves;
target_text: hèia dhèu èmu piara na, dènge ana niki ra lasi pahaha iisi ètu madha esau.

source_text: and leah also draws near, and her children, and they bow themselves; and afterward joseph has drawn near with rachel, and they bow themselves.
target_text: èle ka, lea dènge ana-ana na, lasi pahaha iisi mi esau kahèi. dhu lasi limuri, yusuf dènge ina na rahel lasi pahaha iisi mi esau kahèi.

source_text: and he says, what to you is all this camp which i have met? and he says, to find grace in the eyes of my lord.
target_text: èle èèna ka, esau karèi, aku nèngu na, èu pa'adhu badha pèri nau sèi, èu neo tao ngaa? hèia yakob dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e, a'a! ja'a hia mi a'a ku, sèna ka a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge d'ara taleo.

source_text: and esau says, i have abundance, my brother, that which you have, let it be for yourself.
target_text: te ngaa esau peka, ja'a dènge mèdha-panyau ae kahèi. de hia ia ka ja'a ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and jacob says, no, please, now if i have found grace in your eyes, then you have received my present from my hand, because that i have seen your face, as the seeing of the face of god, and you are pleased with me;
target_text: te ngaa yakob b'ala, peka na, baku, a'a. a'a ku hud'i sèmi la mèdha se, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge d'ara taleo. te ropa a'a ku b'ui mari, ka ja'a sèmi dhu kèdhi b'ui mari nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: please receive my blessing which is brought to you, because god has favored me, and because i have all things; and he presses on him, and he receives it,
target_text: de ja'a manèngi, a'a ku sèmi la mèdha-panyau dhu kab'ua aad'o se. lula ama lamatua be'a titu kèna dènge ja'a ne. nèti èèna ka, na hia ja'a unu ngaa-ngaa se aa'i-aa'i. lula yakob pamako taruu, no'o do no'o boe èèna ka, esau sèmi nare kahèi.

source_text: and says, let us journey and go on, and i go on before you.
target_text: hèia esau peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, miu pa'èra ho lati palere. ja'a lere miu.

source_text: and he says to him, my lord knows that the children are tender, and the suckling flock and the herd are with me; when they have beaten them one day, then all the flock has died.
target_text: te ngaa aku yakob na, hud'i laa, a'a! a'a ku ladhe mèdhi unu mu. ana mu se, ana iiki ae era. rèngu se dhae èra èèna mèka. aa badha ae ka dhu heka matana. ladhe ta pakaseti si kako pamèri, ètu d'ara ca lod'o, èèna na madhe aa'i si.

source_text: please let my lord pass over before his servant, and i lead on gently, according to the foot of the work which is before me, and to the foot of the children, until i come to my lord, to seir.
target_text: de be'a risi, a'a ku si kako uuru. pe ji'i kako mau-mau dhiu. ladhe èèna na, ja'a dhiu ngad'o a'a ku ètu seir.

source_text: and esau says, please let me place with you some of the people who are with me; and he said, why is this? i find grace in the eyes of my lord.
target_text: hèia esau lii hari, na peka, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a tèke eele dhèu ja'a se cahag'e, sèna ka pad'elo j'ara hia miu. te ngaa, aku yakob na, hud'i laa, a'a, ee! sad'i ja'a ke'a le, a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge be'a.

source_text: and esau turns back on that day on his way to seir;
target_text: tadèngi nare, esau pakèd'i ka, tèke eele si, lèpa asa seir.

source_text: and jacob has journeyed to succoth, and builds a house for himself, and has made shelters for his livestock, therefore he has called the name of the place succoth.
target_text: te ngaa nèti era èèna, yakob la'e asa sukot. d'ai nèi, na tao èmu dènge oka hia badha aa'i-aa'i ra. nèti èèna ka, era èèna ra pangare na sukot dhu sasoa na ‘èmu pea taha'.

source_text: and jacob comes safe to the city of shechem, which is in the land of canaan, in his coming from padan-aram, and encamps before the city,
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu boe ka, yakob si kako nèti padan aram, lasi d'ai rae sikem ètu rai kana'an dènge sod'a-mole. hèia ra patitu paleo, sèna ka ra pea padètu dènge rae èèna.

source_text: and he buys the portion of the field where he has stretched out his tent, from the hand of the sons of hamor, father of shechem, for one hundred kesitah;
target_text: rai dhu yakob patitu paleo ne, hèli nare nèti hemor, ana sikem. kab'ua rai ne, ca ngasu doi iia.

source_text: and he sets up there an altar, and proclaims at it god-the god of israel.
target_text: ètu era ne, na pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban. ka na pangare era ne'e, el-elohe-isra'el, dhu sasoa na ‘ama lamatua nèti isra'el'.

source_text: and dinah, daughter of leah, whom she has borne to jacob, goes out to look on the daughters of the land,
target_text: ca lod'o, dina, ana bhèni yakob dènge lea, la'e pangad'o dènge bhèni anga-aangalai na ètu rae èèna.

source_text: and shechem, son of hamor the hivite, a prince of the land, sees her, and takes her, and lies with her, and humbles her;
target_text: dhèu aae kabarai ne, ngara na hemor, nèti suku hewi. ngara ana mone na, sikem. ca tèka, sikem ladhe nèdhi dina, ka rai nèti ne, hèia na tao pakarehe ne.

source_text: and his soul cleaves to dinah, daughter of jacob, and he loves the young person, and speaks to the heart of the young person.
target_text: sikem d'èi madhe-madhe dina ne. ka na solo mako, sèna ka dina no'o dènge ne.

source_text: and shechem speaks to his father hamor, saying, take for me this girl for a wife.
target_text: hèia sikem peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ama! lamu karèi dina hia ja'a, sèna ka ja'a madhèdi dènge ne.

source_text: and jacob has heard that he has defiled his daughter dinah, and his sons were with his livestock in the field, and jacob kept silent until their coming.
target_text: tatao sikem ne, yakob dhu tadèngi le, te ngaa na mau-mau, aa tao boe ngaa-ngaa. te lod'o èèna, ana mone na sèra, ètu d'ara pad'a madhenge badha rèngu. ka na mate si mai ku.

source_text: and hamor, father of shechem, goes out to jacob to speak with him;
target_text: lod'o èèna, hemor, ama sikem, mai padhai lii dènge yakob, ho neo karèi dina hia sikem.

source_text: and the sons of jacob came in from the field when they heard, and the men grieve themselves, and it is very displeasing to them, for folly he has done against israel, to lie with the daughter of jacob-and so it is not done.
target_text: ètu talora dua ra padhue-padhai era, ana-ana yakob lèpa nèti d'ara pad'a. ropa ra tadèngi sikem dhu tao pakarehe le ana hèni ra, ka d'ara ra pèd'a, ka ra nasa bia. ka ra peka, madha j'ara dhu sèmi ne'e ne, lèke boe ètu isra'el. de ji'i se sèmi boe dhèu tao bhelu-katub'a sèmi èèna.

source_text: and hamor speaks with them, saying, shechem, my son, his soul has cleaved to your daughter; please give her to him for a wife,
target_text: ka hemor pamako yakob, aku nèngu na, ana ja'a sikem d'èi tare'a-re'a ana èu dina. de ja'a manèngi d'ara èu, sèna ka mo'o la, paleo ana bhèni èu dènge ne.

source_text: and join in marriage with us; you give your daughters to us, and you take our daughters for yourselves,
target_text: ladhe mo'o ana-ana èdhi se paleo iisi-aanga ra. ana-ana mone nèti miu, madhèdi dènge ana-ana bhèni nèti ji'i. sèmi èèna kahèi, ana-ana mone ji'i madhèdi dènge ana-ana bhèni miu.

source_text: and you dwell with us, and the land is before you; dwell and trade in it, and have possessions in it.
target_text: sèna ka èdhi pea pa'oru pa'èci ètu d'ara rai ne'e. sad'i miu d'èi era mia èèna ka, mi pea la dènge boe ngaa-ngaa. mi d'aga, sèna ka abhu kakaja ètu ne'e.

source_text: and shechem says to her father and to her brothers, let me find grace in your eyes, and that which you say to me, i give; multiply on me dowry and gift exceedingly, and i give as you say to me, and give to me the young person for a wife.
target_text: hèia sikem peka dènge ama dina dènge a'a na sèra, peka na, miu se, sad'i manèngi ngaa, ja'a dhoka madhutu di. masi ka miu manèngi doi pamèu madha, dènge kab'ua pèri-pèri èèna ka, ja'a hia. sad'i mo'o ja'a leo dènge ana hèni miu.

source_text: and the sons of jacob answer shechem and his father hamor deceitfully, and they speak because he defiled their sister dinah,
target_text: te ngaa ana-ana yakob se re'a le, sikem dhu tao pakarehe ana hèni ra dina. hèia ra karihu-kahadhu, ka ra bèle, peka mi sikem dènge ama na hemor,

source_text: and say to them, we are not able to do this thing, to give our sister to one who has a foreskin, for it is a reproach to us.
target_text: aku rèngu na, ji'i bisa boe hia ana hèni ji'i leo dènge dhèu dhu suna boe. te èèna na, era makae ji'i èèna!

source_text: only for this we consent to you: if you are as we, to have every male of you circumcised,
target_text: te ngaa j'ara na sèmi ne'e: miu se, hud'i sama ku sèmi ji'i, mone aa'i-aa'i ra, ana iiki, dhèu kapai, hud'i suna ku.

source_text: then we have given our daughters to you, and we take your daughters for ourselves, and we have dwelt with you, and have become one people;
target_text: ladhe miu madhutu j'ara ne'e, èdhi heka paleo kèna. aa ji'i pea ètu rai ne'e hèi, sèna ka èdhi j'aj'i mi èci.

source_text: and if you do not listen to us to be circumcised, then we have taken our daughter, and have gone.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu madhutu boe dad'èi ji'i, aa mo'o boe suna, ji'i ngare hari ana hèni ji'i, ho kèd'i eele rai ne'e.

source_text: and their words are good in the eyes of hamor, and in the eyes of shechem, hamor's son;
target_text: hèia hemor dènge ana na sikem ro'o kahèi.

source_text: and the young man did not delay to do the thing, for he had delight in jacob's daughter, and he is honorable above all the house of his father.
target_text: te ngaa sikem no'o heka mate, lula d'ara na d'èi ae dina. dhèu isi rai ètu èèna pakab'ua sikem ne titu kèna.

source_text: and hamor comes-his son shechem also-to the gate of their city, and they speak to the men of their city, saying,
target_text: ka hemor dènge sikem lasi asa era pama'ète lii, ètu hèb'a tedhe rae èèna, hèia ra padhue lii ne dènge kabarai sèra. ra peka, aku rèngu na,

source_text: these men are peaceable with us; then let them dwell in the land, and trade in it; and the land, behold, is wide before them; their daughters let us take to ourselves for wives, and our daughters give to them.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! dhèu isra'el se, d'èi mamuri mera-milu dènge èdhi. de hud'i laa ta pea pa'èci dènge rèngu ètu dedha-rai ne'e. rai ne taleo, de èdhi bisa pea pa'èci aa'i-aa'i ti. èdhi se bisa leo dènge ana bhèni rèngu. aa rèngu bisa madhèdi dènge ana bhèni èdhi kahèi.

source_text: only for this do the men consent to us, to dwell with us, to become one people, in every male of us being circumcised, as they are circumcised;
target_text: lii manèngi rèngu dhoka èci di, nèti èdhi se. ra manèngi, èdhi mone se aa'i-aa'i hud'i suna ku, madhutu ad'a rèngu.

source_text: their livestock, and their substance, and all their beasts-are they not ours? only let us consent to them, and they dwell with us.
target_text: ladhe èdhi se pab'ali le dènge rèngu, èèna na badha-manu dènge mèdha-panyau ra j'aj'i unu èdhi. de be'a risi èdhi to'o la madhutu dad'èi ra. mai sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ti suna! mo'o, sina ma?

source_text: and to hamor, and to his son shechem, do all those going out of the gate of his city listen, and every male is circumcised, all those going out of the gate of his city.
target_text: ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra sa, sèmi lii padhai lii hemor dènge ana na sikem. hèia dhèu mone aa'i-aa'i ètu rai èèna suna palere-lere.

source_text: and it comes to pass, on the third day, in their being pained, that two of the sons of jacob, simeon and levi, dinah's brothers, take each his sword, and come in against the city confidently, and slay every male;
target_text: d'ara lod'o ka tèlu, ropa rèngu dhu suna se, nu'a ra dhu pèd'a era, ka ana mone dina, simeon dènge lewi, rare samala ra, kako mau-mau, lasi asa d'ara kota. ka dua ra pare pamadhe aa'i-aa'i dhèu mone sèra.

source_text: and hamor, and his son shechem, they have slain by the mouth of the sword, and they take dinah out of shechem's house, and go out.
target_text: hemor dènge sikem, ra pare pamadhe kahèi. hèia ra rèti dènge ka dina nèti d'ara èmu sikem, lèpa èmu rèngu.

source_text: jacob's sons have come in on the wounded, and they spoil the city, because they had defiled their sister;
target_text: aa ana yakob dhu cahag'e sèra, maso asa d'ara kota èèna, ra parama rèti aa'i mèu-mèu isi kabarai èèna. ra nasa, lula dhèu tao pakarehe ana hèni ra ètu èèna.

source_text: their flock and their herd, and their donkeys, and that which is in the city, and that which is in the field, have they taken;
target_text: ra parama rèti mèdha-panyau dhèu nèti d'ara èmu ra, dènge eo rèti badha-manu aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara pad'a.

source_text: and all their wealth, and all their infants, and their wives they have taken captive, and they spoil also all that is in the house.
target_text: rèti aa'i bhèni dènge ana-ana, aa parame rare aa'i mèdha dhu kab'ua nèti kabarai ne.

source_text: and jacob says to simeon and to levi, you have troubled me, by causing me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the canaanite, and among the perizzite: and i am few in number, and they have been gathered against me, and have struck me, and i have been destroyed, i and my house.
target_text: ropa yakob ne'a j'ara dhu j'aj'i èèna, na peka dènge simeon dènge lewi, miu dua mi se, goa ngaa ka ne'e? miu paj'èra ja'a! èèna na, dhèu kana'an dènge dhèu peris dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ètu dedha rai ne'e, tèka d'ara dènge èdhi se. rèngu se, dhèu ae-ae. te ngaa èdhi se, dhèu ciki di. ladhe rèngu se mai age èdhi, na, ra palaho aa'i èdhi.

source_text: and they say, does he make our sister as a harlot?
target_text: te ngaa ana se dhaa dènge lii nasa, peka na, ama! ama pangee na hud'i laa ji'i soro tèke si, sèna ka ra tao ana hèni ji'i ne, bhèni kajeo!

source_text: and god says to jacob, rise, go up to bethel, and dwell there, and make there an altar to god, who appeared to you in your fleeing from the face of your brother esau.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua padhai lii dènge yakob, peka na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu pad'elo iisi mi èu, lod'o èu rai nèti madha a'a mu esau. kèd'i, lamu dènge ka asa betel. ladhe d'ai nèi, mu patitu mei korban hia ja'a. aa pea dènge ka ètu èèna.

source_text: and jacob says to his household, and to all who are with him, turn aside the gods of the stranger which are in your midst, and cleanse yourselves, and change your garments; and we rise, and go up to bethel, and i make there an altar to god, who is answering me in the day of my tribulation, and is with me in the way that i have gone.
target_text: ka yakob peka dènge isi èmu na aa'i-aa'i, aku nèngu na, aa'i-aa'i ti lati dènge ka asa betel. uru èèna, lod'o ja'a ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, ama lamatua ka dhu ladhe-leru ja'a ètu èèna. ja'a neo tao mei korban ètu nèi. de mi core eele mèdha sogo-tagu miu. aa mi pamèu iisi mi, ho mi gati mèdha-papake leo, te èdhi neo pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: and they give to jacob all the gods of the stranger that are in their hand, and the rings that are in their ears, and jacob hides them under the oak which is by shechem;
target_text: ka ra oru mèdha sogo-tagu, dènge ate-ate ra aa'i-aa'i ra. hèia yakob dhènu mèdha se aa'i-aa'i ra ètu kapua aj'u aae ca kapua dhu padètu dènge rae sikem.

source_text: and they journey, and the terror of god is on the cities which are around them, and they have not pursued after the sons of jacob.
target_text: ropa yakob dènge dhèu na aa'i-aa'i pakèd'i nèti sikem, ama lamatua hia d'ara madha'u mi dhèu-dhèu dhu pea ètu d'ara rae-rae dhu padètu dènge rae sikem, ka ra bani boe tao karehe mi yakob si.

source_text: and jacob comes to luz which is in the land of canaan it is bethel, he and all the people who are with him,
target_text: ka yakob si d'ai dènge sod'a ètu betel dhu uru èèna, ngara na lus, ètu rai kana'an.

source_text: and he builds there an altar, and proclaims at the place the god of bethel: for there had god been revealed to him, in his fleeing from the face of his brother.
target_text: ètu ne'e, yakob pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban. ka na pangare era ne, el betel, sasoa na ‘betel unu ama lamatua', lula uru èèna ama lamatua pad'elo iisi mi yakob ètu era èèna, lod'o nèngu rai nèti madha a'a na.

source_text: and deborah, rebekah's nurse, dies, and she is buried at the lower part of bethel, under the oak, and he calls its name oak of weeping.
target_text: padètu dènge rae betel, abhu aj'u aae ca kapua, ngara na alon bakut. sasoa na ‘aj'u tangi dhèu madhe'. pake ngara ne, lod'o debora, ina dhu lalau-lalo'o ribka, madhe, ka padhane ètu karasa aj'u èèna.

source_text: and god appears to jacob again, in his coming from padan-aram, and blesses him;
target_text: lod'o yakob lèpa nèti padan aram, ama lamatua pad'elo hari iisi na, ka hia na berkat.

source_text: and god says to him, your name is jacob: your name is no longer called jacob, but israel is your name; and he calls his name israel.
target_text: hèia lamatua peka dènge ne, nèti deo ne'e ne, èu ngara heka yakob, te ngaa isra'el.

source_text: and god says to him, i am god almighty; be fruitful and multiply, a nation and an assembly of nations is from you, and kings from your loins go out;
target_text: ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele. de èu matana pa'ae-ae, aa ana-èpu èu sèmi èèna kahèi. bèli-camèd'a, suku-suku mai nèti ana-èpu èu. aa nèti ana-èpu èu sèra, cèu dhèu aae-dhèu aae.

source_text: and the land which i have given to abraham and to isaac-to you i give it, indeed to your seed after you i give the land.
target_text: rai dhu pangèd'u mi baki mu abraham, dènge ama mu isak, ja'a hia mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu.

source_text: and god goes up from him, in the place where he has spoken with him. and jacob sets up a standing pillar in the place where he has spoken with him, a standing pillar of stone, and he pours on it an oblation, and he pours on it oil;
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua peka nare, yakob patitu dènge hadhu ètu era èèna, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha ho na baku bhèlu eele lii lamatua. ka na bhori èi anggor dènge èi mènyi mi dedha hadhu na, hèia na mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: and jacob calls the name of the place where god spoke with him bethel.
target_text: era èèna, na pangare ‘betel'.

source_text: and they journey from bethel, and there is yet a distance of land before entering ephratha, and rachel bears, and is sharply pained in her bearing;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob si pakèd'i nèti betel. ropa rèngu kaj'èu èèna mèka nèti rae efrata nuka betlehem èèna, rahel dhu d'ai le lod'o nara iisi na. te ngaa nara iisi carui, hèia na roe titu kèna.

source_text: and it comes to pass, in her being sharply pained in her bearing, that the midwife says to her, do not fear, for this also is a son for you.
target_text: ka ropa na pèngu stenga madhe, dhèu ai tadha peka dènge ne, pa'èra d'ara èu, te mora iisi hari ana mone ca dhèu! de baku paroe iisi.

source_text: and it comes to pass in the going out of her soul for she died, that she calls his name ben-oni; and his father called him benjamin;
target_text: lod'o rahel oe ma'ète a'ae, na pangare ana ne, ben-oni, dhu sasoa na ‘ana nèti j'aj'èra ja'a'. ka heka na madhe kèna. te ngaa yakob hia ana ne ngara benyamin, dhu sasoa na ‘ana ai g'ana'.

source_text: and rachel dies, and is buried in the way to ephratha, which is beth-lehem,
target_text: ka ra padhane rahel ètu sebhe j'ara dhu la'e asa efrata, dhu limuri ne, ngara na betlehem.

source_text: and jacob sets up a standing pillar over her grave; which is the standing pillar of rachel's grave to this day.
target_text: hèia yakob pudhi lutu bhatu ètu ro'a dhèu èmu na èèna. d'ai sange ne'e, ro'a rahel ne era.

source_text: and israel journeys, and stretches out his tent beyond the tower of edar;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob pea boe mi ca era sa. ca tèka, na patitu paleo ètu sebhe manara eder.

source_text: and it comes to pass in israel's dwelling in that land, that reuben goes, and lies with his father's concubine bilhah; and israel hears.
target_text: lod'o rèngu ètu era èèna, ruben j'unu dènge bilha, dhèu èmu piara ama na. èèna ka, yakob ne'a j'ara ne'e kahèi. ana mone yakob, canguru dua dhèu.

source_text: and the sons of jacob are twelve. sons of leah: jacob's firstborn reuben, and simeon, and levi, and judah, and issachar, and zebulun.
target_text: ana-ana nèti lea, nuka: ruben ana uuru yakob, simeon, lewi, yahuda, isaskar, dènge sebulon.

source_text: sons of rachel: joseph and benjamin.
target_text: ana-ana rahel, nuka: yusuf dènge benyamin.

source_text: and sons of bilhah, rachel's maidservant: dan and naphtali.
target_text: ana-ana nèti bilha, ènu rahel: dan dènge naftali.

source_text: and sons of zilpah, leah's maidservant: gad and asher. these are sons of jacob, who have been born to him in padan-aram.
target_text: aa ana-ana nèti silpa, ènu lea, nuka: gad dènge aser. rara iisi ana se ètu padan aram.

source_text: and jacob comes to his father isaac, at mamre, the city of arba which is hebron, where abraham and isaac have sojourned.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob la'e ngad'o ama na isak asa mamre, dhu dètu dènge kiryat-arba dhu limuri ne, ngara na hebron. uru èèna, baki na abraham pea ètu èèna.

source_text: and the days of isaac are one hundred and eighty years, and isaac expires, and dies, and is gathered to his people, aged and satisfied with days; and his sons esau and jacob bury him.
target_text: umur isak d'ai ca ngasu aru nguru tèu, heka madhe kèna. ka ana na esau dènge yakob padhane ne.

source_text: and these are the generations of esau, who is edom.
target_text: ne'e ne, ana-èpu esau. ngara esau dhu leo, edom.

source_text: esau has taken his wives from the daughters of canaan: adah daughter of elon the hittite, and aholibamah daughter of anah, daughter of zibeon the hivite,
target_text: esau leo dènge ana bhèni kana'an dhèu dua. èci dhèu het, ana bhèni nèti elon, ngara na ada. dhèu èmu na èci hari, dhèu hewi, ngara na oholibama. ama na, ngara na anah, aa baki na sibeon.

source_text: and bashemath daughter of ishmael, sister of nebajoth.
target_text: esau leo kahèi dènge ana ismael, ngara na basmat. ana mone basmat, ngara na nebayot.

source_text: and adah bears to esau, eliphaz; and bashemath has borne reuel;
target_text: ada, dhèu èmu uuru esau, nara iisi elifas. basmat matana rahuel.

source_text: and aholibamah has borne jeush, and jaalam, and korah. these are sons of esau, who were born to him in the land of canaan.
target_text: aa oholibama matana yeus, yalam dènge kora. ana esau aa'i-aa'i ra sèra rara iisi si ètu rai kana'an.

source_text: and esau takes his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his livestock, and all his beasts, and all his substance which he has acquired in the land of canaan, and goes into the country from the face of his brother jacob;
target_text: ca tèka, esau pidha asa rai leo cue dhu kaj'èu nèti yakob. la'e nèti aa'i bhèni-ana niki, dhèu-dhèu sab'a, badha-manu, dènge mèdha-panyau na.

source_text: for their substance was more abundant than to dwell together, and the land of their sojournings was not able to bear them because of their livestock;
target_text: esau pacèri dènge yakob, lula badha-manu ra dènge mèdha-panyau ra ae d'ai seli. nèti èèna ka, era pea rèngu katata ètu rai èèna.

source_text: and esau dwells in mount seir: esau is edom.
target_text: hèia esau nuka edom la'e pea ètu ledhe ètu seir.

source_text: and these are the generations of esau, father of edom, in mount seir.
target_text: se'e se, ana-èpu esau dhu ra peka na ‘dhèu edom'. rèngu pea ètu era ledhe seir.

source_text: these are the names of the sons of esau: eliphaz son of adah, wife of esau; reuel son of bashemath, wife of esau. and the sons of eliphaz are teman, omar, zepho, and gatam, and kenaz; and timnath has been concubine to eliphaz son of esau, and she bears to eliphaz, amalek; these are sons of adah wife of esau. and these are sons of reuel: nahath and zerah, shammah and mizzah; these were sons of bashemath wife of esau.
target_text: ada, dhèu èmu esau, nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na elifas. elifas ne, ana mone na, dhèu lèmi, nuka: teman, omar, sefo, gatam dènge kenas. dhèu èmu piara elifas, ngara na timna. nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na amalek. dhèu èmu esau, basmat, nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na rehuel. rehuel abhu ana mone dhèu èpa, nuka: nahat, sera, syama, dènge misa.

source_text: and these have been the sons of aholibamah daughter of anah, daughter of zibeon, wife of esau; and she bears to esau, jeush and jaalam and korah.
target_text: dhèu èmu esau, oholibama, ana nèti anah, aa èpu nèti sibeon, nara iisi ana mone dhèu tèlu, nuka: yeus, yalam, dènge kora.

source_text: these are chiefs of the sons of esau: sons of eliphaz, firstborn of esau: chief teman, chief omar, chief zepho, chief kenaz, chief korah, chief gatam, chief amalek; these are chiefs of eliphaz, in the land of edom; these are sons of adah.
target_text: ana-èpu esau se pahag'a lème, ka j'aj'i mi suku ae-ae. èci-èci ka dènge kapala suku ra. ana-ana elifas, dhu ana uuru nèti esau, j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku teman, suku omar, suku sefo, suku kenas, suku kora, suku gatam dènge suku amalek. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se'e, ana-èpu nèti esau dènge dhèu èmu na ada.

source_text: and these are sons of reuel son of esau: chief nahath, chief zerah, chief shammah, chief mizzah; these are chiefs of reuel, in the land of edom; these are sons of bashemath wife of esau.
target_text: ana-ana rehuel, dhu ana nèti esau, j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku nahat, suku sera, suku syama, dènge suku misa. aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu esau dènge dhèu èmu na, basmat.

source_text: and these are sons of aholibamah wife of esau: chief jeush, chief jaalam, chief korah; these are chiefs of aholibamah daughter of anah, wife of esau.
target_text: ana-ana nèti esau dènge dhèu èmu na, oholibama, j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku yeus, suku yalam, dènge suku kora.

source_text: these are sons of esau who is edom, and these their chiefs.
target_text: suku se'e aa'i-aa'i ra nèti ana-èpu esau.

source_text: these are sons of seir the horite, the inhabitants of the land: lotan, and shobal, and zibeon, and anah, and dishon, and ezer, and dishan; these are chiefs of the horites, sons of seir, in the land of edom.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu dhèu hori èci, ngara na seir. ana-ana na pahag'a palème rai, ka j'aj'i suku ae-ae. èci-èci ka dènge kapala suku na. èle èèna ka, ana-ana na se j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku lotan, suku sobal, suku sibeon, suku anah, suku dison, suku eser, dènge suku disan.

source_text: and the sons of lotan are hori and heman; and a sister of lotan is timna.
target_text: ana lotan nuka: hori dènge heman. ana hèni lotan, nuka timna.

source_text: and these are sons of shobal: alvan and manahath, and ebal, shepho and onam.
target_text: ana-ana sobal, nuka: alwan, manahat, ebal, sefo, dènge onam.

source_text: and these are sons of zibeon, both ajah and anah: it is anah that has found the imim in the wilderness, in his feeding the donkeys of his father zibeon.
target_text: ana-ana nèti sibeon, nuka: aya, dènge anah. anah ne'e ka dhu rage madha èi pana ètu d'ara mamoo, lod'o na madhenga keled'ei ama na.

source_text: and these are sons of anah: dishon, and aholibamah daughter of anah. and these are sons of dishon: hemdan, and eshban, and ithran, and cheran.
target_text: ana bhèni nèti anah, nuka oholibama. aa ana mone na, nuka, dison. ana-ana dison, nuka: hemdan, esban, yitran, dènge keran.

source_text: these are sons of ezer: bilhan, and zaavan, and akan.
target_text: ana-ana eser, nuka: bilhan, saawan, dènge akan.

source_text: these are sons of dishan: uz and aran.
target_text: ana-ana disan, nuka: us, dènge aran.

source_text: these are chiefs of the horite: chief lotan, chief shobal, chief zibeon, chief anah, chief dishon, chief ezer, chief dishan: these are chiefs of the horite in reference to their chiefs in the land of seir.
target_text: de kapala-kapala suku nèti dhèu hori sèra, nuka: lotan, sobal, sibeon, anah, dison, eser, dènge disan. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se pea ètu rai seir.

source_text: and these are the kings who have reigned in the land of edom before the reigning of a king over the sons of israel.
target_text: lod'o dhu kabarai isra'el dènge mèka dhèu aae, te ngaa ètu rai edom dènge le dhèu aae. ngara dhèu aae se, dhutu-dhutu, nuka:

source_text: and bela son of beor reigns in edom, and the name of his city is dinhabah;
target_text: ra ded'e bela, ana nèti beor, j'aj'i dhèu aae ètu kota dinhaba.

source_text: and bela dies, and jobab son of zerah from bozrah reigns in his stead;
target_text: ropa bela madhe, ra ded'e yobab ho gati ne, j'aj'i dhèu aae. ama na, ngara na sera, nèti rae bosra.

source_text: and jobab dies, and husham from the land of the temanite reigns in his stead.
target_text: ropa yobab madhe, ra ded'e husam ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. husam ne, nèti rai dhèu teman.

source_text: and husham dies, and hadad son of bedad reigns in his stead who strikes midian in the field of moab, and the name of his city is avith;
target_text: ropa husam madhe, ra ded'e hadad ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. ama na, ngara na bedad, nèti rae awit. nèngu ka dhu segi dhèu midian, lod'o ra pamusu ètu moab.

source_text: and hadad dies, and samlah of masrekah reigns in his stead;
target_text: ropa hadad madhe, ra ded'e samla ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. nèngu ne, nèti rae masreka.

source_text: and samlah dies, and saul from rehoboth of the river reigns in his stead;
target_text: ropa samla madhe, ra ded'e saul ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. saul èèna, nèti rae rehobot, dhu ètu sebhe loko.

source_text: and saul dies, and ba‘al-hanan son of achbor reigns in his stead;
target_text: ropa saul madhe, ra ded'e baal-hanan ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. ama na, ngara na akbor.

source_text: and ba‘al-hanan son of achbor dies, and hadar reigns in his stead, and the name of his city is pau; and his wife's name is mehetabel daughter of matred, daughter of me-zahab.
target_text: ropa baal-hanan madhe, ra ded'e hadar ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. hadar ne, nèti rae pau. aa dhèu èmu na, ngara mehetabel. ama mehetabel, ngara na matret. aa baki na, mesahab.

source_text: and these are the names of the chiefs of esau, according to their families, according to their places, by their names: chief timnah, chief alvah, chief jetheth, chief aholibamah, chief elah, chief pinon, chief kenaz, chief teman, chief mibzar, chief magdiel, chief iram: these are chiefs of edom, in reference to their dwellings, in the land of their possession; he is esau father of edom.
target_text: de kapala-kapala suku dhu j'aj'i nèti ana-èpu esau, nuka: timna, alwa, yetet, oholibama, ela, pinon, kenas, teman, mibsar, magdiel, dènge iram. rèngu se èci-èci pangare rai ra madhutu ngara rèngu unu ra. de aa'i-aa'i se'e, lii lolo nèti ana-èpu esau, dhèu edom èèna.

source_text: and jacob dwells in the land of his father's sojournings-in the land of canaan.
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lole nèti yakob si. ca tèka ka, yakob la'e pea hari asa rai kana'an. èèna, era pea ama na isak nèti uru ka.

source_text: these are the generations of jacob: joseph, a son of seventeen years, has been enjoying himself with his brothers among the flock and he is a youth, with the sons of bilhah, and with the sons of zilpah, his father's wives, and joseph brings in an account of their evil to their father.
target_text: tèu èèna, ana yakob èci, nèti dhèu èmu na rahel, ngara na yusuf. yusuf ne'e, ropa umur na d'ai canguru pidhu tèu, nèngu dènge a'a na si, tema le j'aga kahib'i-kalèbho rèngu. a'a na sèra, ana nèti ina leo hari, ngara na bilha dènge silpa. te ngaa yusuf ne'e tuka tenge lii mi dedha a'a na si, ho la'e pana'e ama na.

source_text: and israel has loved joseph more than any of his sons, for he is a son of his old age, and has made for him a long coat;
target_text: lod'o dhu rara iisi yusuf na, ama na dhu heka le. nèti èèna ka, na sue yusuf ne risi eele nèti ana-ana na leo sèra. ca lod'o ka, yakob j'au kodho madhera èci dhu saraga bia hia yusuf.

source_text: and his brothers see that their father has loved him more than any of his brothers, and they hate him, and have not been able to speak to him peaceably.
target_text: ropa a'a na si ladhe-ladhe la'a na ama na sue risi yusuf, hèia ra mulai tèka d'ara dènge ne, ro'o boe padhai lii dènge ne.

source_text: and joseph dreams a dream, and declares to his brothers, and they add still more to hate him. and he says to them, please hear this dream which i have dreamed: that, behold, we are binding bundles in the midst of the field, and behold, my bundle has arisen, and has also stood up, and behold, your bundles are all around, and they bow themselves to my bundle.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka yusuf nii. kèd'i nèti bhèj'i ka, na lolo dènge a'a na si lii nii deo na, aku nèngu na, we! mi nanene ku la! ja'a nii, na èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, èki are ètu d'ara oka. kabèdhi laa, are dhu ja'a èki titu dhoo-dhoo. te ngaa are miu, oke mere are ja'a deo na, ka pacud'u mi unu ja'a. ra nanene rare sèmi èèna, hèia a'a na se'e tabha nasa hari dènge ne.

source_text: and his brothers say to him, do you certainly reign over us? do you certainly rule over us? and they add still more to hate him, for his dreams, and for his words.
target_text: hèia ra jèke ne, aku rèngu na, we! èu ngee na, èu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai kèna, ho neo paredha ji'i, do? taga na lolo lii nii ne'e, hèia asa ra nasa dènge ne.

source_text: and he dreams yet another dream, and recounts it to his brothers, and says, behold, i have dreamed a dream again, and behold, the sun and the moon, and eleven stars, are bowing themselves to me.
target_text: nèbhu boe, yusuf nii hari ca tèka. na lolo hari dènge a'a na si, aku nèngu na, we! ja'a nii hari, sèmi ne'e ka. ja'a kèdhi madha lod'o, hèru, dènge hua-hètu canguru èci. aa'i-aa'i sèra, pahaha iisi mi ja'a.

source_text: and he recounts to his father, and to his brothers; and his father pushes against him, and says to him, what is this dream which you have dreamed? do we certainly come, i, and your mother, and your brothers-to bow ourselves to you, to the earth?
target_text: hèia yusuf lolo hari lii nii deo na dènge ama na, aa dènge a'a na sèra. ka ama na jèke ne, aku nèngu na, lii nii ngaa, kèna! èu ngee na, ja'a dènge ina mu, dènge a'ari èu sèra, mai uu kabaj'èla èu, do? èu nia ae le èèna, nga!

source_text: and his brothers are zealous against him, and his father has watched the matter.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, a'a na sèra tèka d'ara bia dènge ne. te ngaa ama na pangee taruu lii nii èèna ètu d'ara na.

source_text: and his brothers go to feed the flock of their father in shechem,
target_text: ca tèka ka, a'a yusuf sèra rèti kahib'i-kalèbho ama na, asa era j'u'u dètu dènge rae sikem.

source_text: and israel says to joseph, are your brothers not feeding in shechem? come, and i send you to them; and he says to him, here i am;
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, ama na peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, a'a mu si j'aga kahib'i-kalèbho dètu dènge sikem. de èu pa'èra, ho lamu ladhe ku si la. ka yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a laku, ama.

source_text: and he says to him, now go see the peace of your brothers, and the peace of the flock, and bring me back word; and he sends him from the valley of hebron, and he comes to shechem.
target_text: hèia ama na peka hari, aku nèngu na, èu lamu ladhe a'a mu si, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho èdhi. ladhe ra samia na, mai peka dènge ja'a. ka yusuf pakèd'i ka nèti d'ara pad'a hebron, la'e taruu d'ai sikem.

source_text: and a man finds him, and behold, he is wandering in the field, and the man asks him, saying, what do you seek?
target_text: d'ai nèi, na tenge a'a na si, palème d'ara pad'a èèna. na paraga dènge dhèu mone èci, ka dhèu èèna karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu tenge ngaa?

source_text: and he says, i am seeking my brothers, please declare to me where they are feeding.
target_text: yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a tenge a'a ja'a. rèngu eo kahib'i-kalèbho dètu ètu era ne'e. de ama, èu paraga dènge si, do aad'o?

source_text: and the man says, they have journeyed from this, for i have heard some saying, let us go to dothan, and joseph goes after his brothers, and finds them in dothan.
target_text: hèia, dhèu deo na peka, aku nèngu na, ra aad'o heka ètu ne'e. te ja'a tadèngi, ra peka na lasi padètu dènge rae dotan. hèia yusuf la'e taruu, ka paraga dènge si ètu rae dotan.

source_text: and they see him from afar, even before he draws near to them, and they conspire against him to put him to death.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi yusuf nèti kaj'èu, ra padhue rare lii èci neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: and they say to one another, behold, this man of the dreams comes;
target_text: èci peka dènge èci, aku rèngu na, miu ladhe ku la! mone eele tuka nii na, nuka mai nèi!

source_text: and now, come, and we slay him, and cast him into one of the pits, and have said, an evil beast has devoured him; and we see what his dreams are.
target_text: de mai ho ti pamadhe ne. ho èèna na, ti core eele ne asa d'ara madha èi madhe èèna. ladhe d'ai èmu na, ti peka dènge ama peka na, badha hui ra'e ne. ho èèna na, ti ladhe sèku, lii nii na sèra sa mia!

source_text: and reuben hears, and delivers him out of their hand, and says, let us not strike the life;
target_text: ropa nanene èèna, hèia a'a na ruben tenge j'ara ho patabuli eele yusuf. hèia na kai ari na si, aku nèngu na, we! èdhi baku pamadhe ne!

source_text: and reuben says to them, shed no blood; cast him into this pit which is in the wilderness, and do not put forth a hand on him, in order to deliver him out of their hand, to bring him back to his father.
target_text: be'a risi èdhi kèpe ne, ti tao asa d'ara madha èi madhe nèi. ètu èèna, era dhu dhèu aad'o, de èci sa rèdhi boe ne. sad'i baku pasuti raa na. na peka sèmi èèna, lula na tenge j'ara ho patalale yusuf, ho hia na lèpa hari èmu.

source_text: and it comes to pass, when joseph has come to his brothers, that they strip joseph of his coat, the long coat which is on him,
target_text: ropa yusuf d'ai madha a'a na si, ra kèpe ne, ka ra rèbhi eele kodho dhu saraga aae ètu ua na.

source_text: and take him and cast him into the pit, and the pit is empty, there is no water in it.
target_text: ka ra nuni pa'oro ne, hèia ra tule ne asa d'ara madha èi madhe èèna.

source_text: and they sit down to eat bread, and they lift up their eyes, and look, and behold, a caravan of ishmaelites coming from gilead, and their camels carrying spices, and balm, and myrrh, going to take them down to egypt.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lèpa, lasi ra'a-rinu. ètu talora ra'a-rinu, kabèdhi la ra ladhe rèdhi dhèu canau mai re èèna. dhèu sèra kako rèti dènge badha onta ra, hue dènge mèdha d'aga, sèmi raa aj'u hèu mèngi, bubhu-bubhu dènge èi na'i rupa-rupa. dhèu sèra sa, dhèu ismael, dhu mai nèti rae gilead neo lasi kaj'èu d'ai masir.

source_text: and judah says to his brothers, what gain when we slay our brother, and have concealed his blood?
target_text: èle èèna hèia, yahuda peka dènge a'ari na sèra, aku nèngu na, ee! be'a risi sèmi ne'e. èdhi baku pamadhe ne. a'oto na ngaa? tasa mera mia èèna ka, èdhi bisa boe pahuni raa na.

source_text: come, and we sell him to the ishmaelites, and our hands are not on him, for he is our brother-our flesh; and his brothers listen.
target_text: be'a risi èdhi pahie ne dènge dhèu ismael sèi. èdhi tao ne samia èèna ka oo, nèngu ne'e ari d'èlu èdhi. nèti èèna ka, baku èdhi pamadhe ne! aa'i-aa'i ra d'èi kahèi dènge lii yahuda èèna.

source_text: and midianite merchantmen pass by and they draw out and bring up joseph out of the pit, and sell joseph to the ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver, and they bring joseph into egypt.
target_text: ropa dhèu d'aga sèra d'ai era èèna, hèia a'a yusuf sèra lasi ère rare ne, nèti d'ara madha èi madhe deo na. ka ra pahie ne mi dhèu ismael sèra dènge kab'ua dua nguru bua doi pudhi. ka dhèu ismael sèra rèti yusuf asa rai masir.

source_text: and reuben returns to the pit, and behold, joseph is not in the pit, and he tears his garments,
target_text: lod'o ra pahie yusuf ne, ruben ne'a boe. ropa na la'e patigi sa d'ara madha èi madhe na, capa na kabèdhi, ladhe la'a na yusuf aad'o heka ètu d'ara. nèti èèna ka, na ciu pamae kodho ètu ngi'u na, lula d'ara na pèd'a ae titu kèna.

source_text: and he returns to his brothers and says, the boy is not, and i-to where am i going?
target_text: hèia na la'e sa ari na si, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ira ii! ari èdhi aad'o heka ètu era èèna! ja'a tao samia hari?

source_text: and they take the coat of joseph, and slaughter a kid of the goats, and dip the coat in the blood,
target_text: hèia ra roro kahib'i ci'u, ka rare kodho yusuf dhu saraga aae èèna, cèb'u sa d'ara raa kahib'i deo na.

source_text: and send the long coat, and they bring it to their father, and say, we have found this; please discern whether it is your son's coat or not.
target_text: hèia ra lèpa ka rèti dènge kodho deo na, pad'elo dènge ama na, ka ra peka, aku rèngu na, ama! ji'i pili ngare kodho ne'e. ama ku ladhe sèku la. tao-tao ne'e kodho ari ji'i yusuf.

source_text: and he discerns it and says, my son's coat! an evil beast has devoured him; torn-joseph is torn!
target_text: ropa nèdhi kodho deo na, yakob tadhe dènge. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ira ii! ne'e kodho ana ja'a. èle boe badha hui ra'e ana ja'a. ira iiii! ana ja'a madhe le!

source_text: and jacob tears his raiment, and puts sackcloth on his loins, and becomes a mourner for his son many days,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yakob ciu pamae kodho ètu ngi'u na, ka na pake karo, taga nèti d'ara na susa titu kèna. na tangi lii ooi-ooi sène nare lod'o nèbhu aae.

source_text: and all his sons and all his daughters rise to comfort him, and he refuses to comfort himself, and says, for i go down to my son mourning, to sheol, and his father weeps for him.
target_text: ana na, ana mone dènge ana bhèni sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, mai padhai lii pakarej'e d'ara ama ra, te ngaa tao rare boe ne. aku nèngu na, aad'o! sasusa ja'a ne bisa d'ai madhe kèti. te ja'a bisa boe bhèlu ana èci ne'e. mema d'ara yakob j'èra taruu, lula na ngee nèdhi ana na yusuf dhu madhe èèna.

source_text: and the midianites have sold him to egypt, to potiphar, a eunuch of pharaoh, head of the executioners.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o dhu yakob ètu d'ara susa era, dhèu d'aga sèra d'ai le masir. d'ai nèi, ka lasi pahie eele yusuf dènge dhèu kapai èci ètu nèi, ngara na potifar. dhèu ne'e komedhaa j'aga nèti dhèu aae masir.

source_text: and it comes to pass, at that time, that judah goes down from his brothers, and turns aside to a man, an adullamite, whose name is hirah;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yahuda tèke eele a'ari na, ka la'e pea dènge angalai na èci, ngara na hira, ètu rae adulam.

source_text: and judah sees there the daughter of a man, a canaanite, whose name is shuah, and takes her, and goes in to her.
target_text: ètu èèna, dhèu mone èci, dhèu kana'an, ngara na sua. yahuda d'èi ana bhèni na èci, ka nare j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. dhèu èmu yahuda ne'e nara iisi ana mone pagod'o-pagod'o dhèu pèri-pèri.

source_text: and she conceives, and bears a son, and he calls his name er;
target_text: ana uuru èèna, ngara na er.

source_text: and she conceives again, and bears a son, and calls his name onan;
target_text: ana ka dua, ngara na onan.

source_text: and she adds again, and bears a son, and calls his name shelah; and he was in chezib in her bearing him.
