target_text: aa ana ka tèlu, ngara na sela. lod'o ina na nara iisi sela na, yahuda si pidha le asa rae kesib.

source_text: and judah takes a wife for er, his firstborn, and her name is tamar;
target_text: ropa ana mone uuru, dhu ngara na er èèna kapai, ka ama na la'e tenge dhèu hia ne. ngara ana bhèni na tamar. ka dua ra j'aj'i paleo èmu.

source_text: and er, judah's firstborn, is evil in the eyes of yhwh, and yhwh puts him to death.
target_text: lula er ne, bhelu-katub'a, ka ama lamatua huku pamadhe ne. nèti èèna ka, nèngu dènge boe kolo.

source_text: and judah says to onan, go in to the wife of your brother, and marry her, and raise up seed to your brother;
target_text: hèia yahuda paroe nare ana mone ka dua na, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, onan! a'a mu er madhe, dènge boe ana. madhutu ad'a èdhi na, èu hud'i leo hari ku dènge dhèu èmu a'a mu ne. sèna ka èu bisa hia kolo hia a'a mu.

source_text: and onan knows that the seed is not reckoned his; and it has come to pass, if he has gone in to his brother's wife, that he has destroyed it to the earth, so as not to give seed to his brother;
target_text: mema onan ne'a le ad'a sèmi ne'e. te ngaa na no'o boe hia kolo mi a'a na er. nèti èèna ka, ladhe rèngu j'unu pa'èci, na pasuti eele hua hini nèngu asa li'u, sèna ka tamar baku dènge babia.

source_text: and that which he has done is evil in the eyes of yhwh, and he puts him also to death.
target_text: taga tatao onan sèmi ne'e ka, lamatua nasa bia dènge ne. nèti èèna ka, lamatua huku pamadhe ne kahèi.

source_text: and judah says to his daughter-in-law tamar, abide as a widow at your father's house, until my son shelah grows up; for he said, lest he die-even he-like his brothers; and tamar goes and dwells at her father's house.
target_text: ropa yahuda nèdhi ana mone na dua sèra dhu leo dènge tamar madhe sèmi èèna, hèia yahuda madha'u. ka na pangee mage dhoka ana mone ka tèlu èèna, leo hari dènge tamar na madhe kahèi. nèti èèna ka, la'e peka dènge tamar, aku nèngu na, be'a risi èu lèpa hari asa d'ara adhe-aai ina dènge ama mu. ladhe ana ja'a sela kapai, na èu lèpa hari mai ho leo dènge ne. hèia tamar lèpa dènge ka.

source_text: and the days are multiplied, and the daughter of shuah, judah's wife, dies; and judah is comforted, and goes up to his sheep-shearers, he and hirah his friend the adullamite, to timnath.
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu hèia, dhèu èmu yahuda madhe. na j'èra toke d'ai pa'èle lod'o sasusa na. ka na la'e gale nare angalai na hira, ka lasi asa rae timna. ètu èèna, dhèu rame-rame g'ute rèu kahib'i-kalèbho ho pahia.

source_text: and it is declared to tamar, saying, behold, your husband's father is going up to timnath to shear his flock;
target_text: dhèu lolo dènge tamar, peka na, to'o mu la'e leru dhèu g'ute rèu kahib'i-kalèbho ètu rae timna.

source_text: and she turns aside the garments of her widowhood from off her, and covers herself with a veil, and wraps herself up, and sits in the opening of enayim, which is by the way to timnath, for she has seen that shelah has grown up, and she has not been given to him for a wife.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana limuri yahuda, ngara na sela, kapai le. te ngaa tamar ne'a le, na, to'o na no'o boe paleo sela dènge ne. nèti èèna ka, tamar tenge j'ara neo katèju hak nèngu. na bhoke eele mèdha-papake bhèni balu ètu ngi'u na, ka na silu mèdha-papake dhu be'a. na pake salalu pahutu kètu dènge rèhu na. ka la'e madhèdi ètu hèb'a tedhe sebhe j'ara rae enaim, dhu biasa dhèu kako re èèna lasi rae timna.

source_text: and judah sees her, and reckons her for a harlot, for she has covered her face,
target_text: ropa yahuda kako re èèna, na ladhe nèdhi dhèu bhèni èci madhèdi ètu èèna. na neo laa na dhèu bhèni kajeo, te tamar dhu lalau iisi dènge mèdha-papake saraga, aa pahutu rèhu na kahèi.

source_text: and he turns aside to her by the way and says, please come, let me come in to you, for he has not known that she is his daughter-in-law; and she says, what do you give to me, that you may come in to me?
target_text: yahuda ne'a nare boe na dhèu bhèni na, dhèu èmu ana na dhu madhe sèra. hèia na kako la'e padètu dènge bhèni deo na ka, na peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, ee! sèmi ja'a dènge èu na, èu manèngi ca ngaa? hèia tamar dhaa, aku nèngu na, èèna nèti d'ara d'èi ama.

source_text: and he says, i send a kid of the goats from the flock. and she says, do you give a pledge until you send it?
target_text: aku yahuda na, sa mia! sèmi ja'a hia èu kahib'i ci'u? hèia tamar dhaa hari, aku nèngu na, bisa ama. sad'i ama hia ku ja'a mèdha èci ho ja'a kèd'u. pe pèri lod'o ho ama pa'adhu kahib'i èèna mai oo, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: and he says, what is the pledge that i give to you? and she says, your seal, and your ribbon, and your staff which is in your hand; and he gives to her, and goes in to her, and she conceives to him; and she rises, and goes, and turns aside her veil from off her, and puts on the garments of her widowhood.
target_text: hèia yahuda karèi hari, aku nèngu na, de ja'a tèka mèdha ngaa mi èu? tamar dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama tèke eele cap, dènge dhari dhu ama inu, dènge tatea dhu ama kèpe èèna hèi. nanene nare ka, yahuda hia mèdha sèra la'e. hèia dua ra lasi bhèj'i ka. èle èèna ka, tamar lèpa la'e èmu. d'ai èmu ka, na bhoke mèdha-papake saraga dènge salalu, ka gati dènge mèdha-papake bhèni balu. nèti èèna ka, tamar dènge babia.

source_text: and judah sends the kid of the goats by the hand of his friend the adullamite, to receive the pledge from the hand of the woman, and he has not found her.
target_text: nèbhu boe hèia, yahuda manèngi tolong angalai na hira, aku nèngu na, èu mèti kahib'i ne'e hia dhèu bhèni kajeo dhu ètu enaim èèna, ho mèti hari mèdha ja'a dhu ètu nèngu sèra. lod'o hira la'e d'ai nèi, na karèi palème, te ngaa paraga boe dènge bhèni èèna.

source_text: and he asks the men of her place, saying, where is the separated one-she in enayim, by the way? and they say, there has not been in this place a separated one.
target_text: ka na karèi dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, eee! miu mèdhi dhèu bhèni kajeo dhu biasa madhèdi ètu hèb'a tedhe èèna, do? na ètu mia, ee? dhèu sèra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama, ètu ne'e bhèni kajeo aad'o!

source_text: and he turns back to judah and says, i have not found her; and the men of the place also have said, there has not been in this place a separated one,
target_text: hèia hira lèpa hari peka dènge yahuda, aku nèngu na, ja'a paraga boe dènge bhèni èèna. ja'a tenge palème, te ngaa dhèu ètu sèra peka aku rèngu na, ètu rae èèna bhèni kajeo aad'o.

source_text: and judah says, let her take to herself, lest we become despised; behold, i sent this kid, and you have not found her.
target_text: yahuda dhaa, aku nèngu na, hud'i ka la, nèngu abhu mèdha sèra! sad'i dhèu baku pamakae èdhi! ja'a neo b'ae, te ngaa èdhi paraga boe dènge bhèni èèna na.

source_text: and it comes to pass about three months after, that it is declared to judah, saying, your daughter-in-law tamar has committed fornication; and also, behold, she has conceived by fornication: and judah says, bring her out-and she is burned.
target_text: ropa d'ai tèlu hèru hèia, dhèu lasi lolo dènge yahuda, peka na, dhèu èmu ana èu na tao ngi'u na sèmi dhèu bhèni kajeo. ka na dènge babia le. nanene nare èèna hèia, yahuda nasa bia. hèia na pua dhèu, aku nèngu na, lami nuni pa'oro ne mai, ho labhu asa d'ara ai la'e!

source_text: she is brought out, and she has sent to her husband's father, saying, to a man whose these are, i am pregnant; and she says, please discern whose these are-the seal, and the ribbons, and the staff.
target_text: ka dhèu lasi ka nuni rèti tamar mai. te ngaa na pad'elo cap dènge tatea èèna. ka na pua dhèu lasi peka dènge to'o na, aku nèngu na, parisa ku mèdha se'e. dhèu dhu unu cap dènge tatea ne'e ka dhu ad'u-ue tatao ne'e, ka ja'a dènge babia ne.

source_text: and judah discerns and says, she has been more righteous than i, because that i did not give her to my son shelah; and he has not added to know her again.
target_text: ropa nèdhi mèdha se'e, yahuda tadhe dènge, na mèdha sèra unu nèngu. hèia na padhai lii dènge ka, aku nèngu na, mema dhèu bhèni ne'e sala boe. ja'a ka dhu sala. madhutu iia na, ja'a ka dhu paleo bhèni ne'e dènge ana ja'a sela. te ngaa ja'a ka ko'o boe. karèi nèti èèna ka, yahuda pa'èci heka dènge tamar.

source_text: and it comes to pass in the time of her bearing, that behold, twins are in her womb;
target_text: d'ai hèru ka tamar nara iisi ana dhèu dua.

source_text: and it comes to pass in her bearing, that one gives out a hand, and the midwife takes and binds on his hand a scarlet thread, saying, this has come out first.
target_text: lod'o tamar nara iisi na, kabèdhi laa ana èci pacèu uuru kacui-aai èci sa li'u mai. ka dhèu ai tadha dhu panara iisi na nare loa hèngu mea, ka èki mi kanau riti na. bhèni na peka, aku nèngu na, ana uuru ka ne'e.

source_text: and it comes to pass as he draws back his hand, that behold, his brother has come out, and she says, what! you have broken forth-the breach is on you; and he calls his name perez;
target_text: te ngaa ana èèna ère hari kacui-aai na sa d'ara. hèia, ana èci na kalua uuru hari. nèdhi sèmi èèna hèia, bhèni ai tadha èèna peka, aku nèngu na, waa! èu èra titu kèna! nèti èèna ka, èu paseti ho kalua uuru sa li'u. bhèni na pangare ne, peres, dhu sasoa na, ‘paseti sa li'u'.

source_text: and afterward his brother has come out, on whose hand is the scarlet thread, and he calls his name zerah.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhu èki dènge loa hèngu mea deo na kalua. ra pangare ne sera sasoa na ‘mea gèu-gèu'.

source_text: and joseph has been brought down to egypt, and potiphar, a eunuch of pharaoh, head of the executioners, an egyptian man, buys him out of the hands of the ishmaelites who have brought him there. and yhwh is with joseph, and he is a prosperous man, and he is in the house of his lord the egyptian,
target_text: dhèu ismael sèra rèti yusuf d'ai masir, hèia ra pahie eele ne dènge dhèu kapai èci ètu nèi, ngara na potifar. dhèu ne'e komedhaa sordad'u dhu j'aga ètu dhèu aae masir. yusuf j'aj'i ènu ètu èmu potifar. ètu èèna, lamatua dènge yusuf, ka sasab'a ngaa dhu na tao, nèti babe'a hua-hua.

source_text: and his lord sees that yhwh is with him, and all that he is doing yhwh is causing to prosper in his hand,
target_text: dhèu kapai ne'e ladhe-ladhe na, sasab'a yusuf nèti babe'a hua, ka na ngee ètu d'ara na, lamatua tare'a-re'a dènge yusuf.

source_text: and joseph finds grace in his eyes and serves him, and he appoints him over his house, and all that he has he has given into his hand.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, komedhaa ne'e d'èi yusuf, ka na lèka ne. hèia na ded'e ne j'aj'i madho ètu èmu na. aa, na hia ne paredha d'ara èmu nèngu, sèmi èèna kahèi, mèdha-panyau na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and it comes to pass from the time that he has appointed him over his house, and over all that he has, that yhwh blesses the house of the egyptian for joseph's sake, and the blessing of yhwh is on all that he has, in the house, and in the field;
target_text: lula yusuf pea ètu èèna, ka lamatua hia mamuri hua iia mi lamatua èmu, dhèu masir èèna. isi èmu na, mèdha-panyau na, oka-tedhe na, aa sasab'a-la'a na, j'aj'i dènge be'a.

source_text: and he leaves all that he has in the hand of joseph, and he has not known anything that he has, except the bread which he is eating. and joseph is of a handsome form, and of a handsome appearance.
target_text: lula potifar ladhe-ladhe la'a na yusuf sab'a dènge be'a, ka na pangee heka ngaa-ngaa, dhoka na'a-ninu di. yusuf ne, mone iia.

source_text: and it comes to pass after these things, that his lord's wife lifts up her eyes to joseph and says, lie with me;
target_text: na pea ètu èèna nèbhu mèka. te ngaa dhèu èmu potifar na, d'èi yusuf. ka na mai pamako ne ho dua ra j'unu pa'èci.

source_text: and he refuses and says to his lord's wife, behold, my lord has not known what is with me in the house, and all that he has he has given into my hand;
target_text: te ngaa yusuf no'o boe. ka na peka sèmi ne'e ka, baku ina ee! ja'a ne, ènu potifar, dhu na pangèd'u le koasa ho ja'a tao ai-hèb'a mi sasab'a nèngu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: none is greater in this house than i, and he has not withheld from me anything, except you, because you are his wife; and how will i do this great evil? then i have sinned against god.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu ne'e, abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu koasa risi nèti ja'a. aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu d'ara èmu ne'e, na saraka mi kacui-aai ja'a. dhodhoka ina ku di, aad'o. tasamia ka, ja'a bisa tao j'ara karehe ne'e. èèna lèke boe dènge dad'èi ama lamatua!

source_text: and it comes to pass at her speaking to joseph day by day, that he has not listened to her, to lie near her, to be with her;
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, dhèu èmu potifar ne pakaseti taruu bèli-bèli. te ngaa yusuf ne tao boe madha-dhilu dènge ne.

source_text: and it comes to pass about this day, that he goes into the house to do his work, and there is none of the men of the house there in the house,
target_text: ca tèka, yusuf kako la'e asa d'ara èmu, ho sab'a sasab'a nèngu. lod'o èèna, dhèu leo aad'o èci sa ètu èmu.

source_text: and she catches him by his garment, saying, lie with me; and he leaves his garment in her hand, and flees, and goes outside.
target_text: ka dhèu èmu potifar na raga mai ka, na kèpe kodho yusuf, ka na ère ne, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, mai! ata dhodhoka èdhi dua ti. de mai ho ti j'unu. te ngaa yusuf d'èi boe. ka na parui, hèia kodho na bhoke eele nèti ua na, ka na rai asa li'u. aa kodho deo na ètu kacui-aai bhèni èèna era.

source_text: and it comes to pass, when she sees that he has left his garment in her hand, and flees outside,
target_text: ropa dhèu èmu potifar ladhe laa, na, yusuf rai li'u le la'e, aa kodho na tèke eele,

source_text: that she calls for the men of her house, and speaks to them, saying, see, he has brought a man to us, a hebrew, to play with us; he has come in to me, to lie with me, and i call with a loud voice, and it comes to pass, when he hears that i have lifted up my voice and call, that he leaves his garment near me, and flees, and goes outside.
target_text: hèia na paroa dhèu sab'a sèra, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, we! miu mai ladhe ku laa! deo na, ana mone dhèu ibrani na, maso sa d'ara kama ja'a. na neo pamakae ja'a. malo ka ja'a pa'oo, ka na rai, tèke eele kodho na ètu ja'a ne. dhèu èmu ja'a ne, nèti dhèu bhelu asa d'ara èmu, ho hia èdhi ta'e makae!

source_text: and she places his garment near her, until the coming in of his lord to his house.
target_text: bhèni na kèpe pa'ère kodho èèna, toke d'ai dhèu èmu na lèpa.

source_text: and she speaks to him according to these words, saying, the hebrew servant whom you have brought to us, has come in to me to play with me;
target_text: ropa dhèu èmu na nare d'ara èmu, na lolo peka na, a'a! dhèu ibrani dhu mèti mai sa èmu ne'e, deo na maso asa d'ara kama ja'a, neo pakarehe ja'a!

source_text: and it comes to pass, when i lift my voice and call, that he leaves his garment near me, and flees outside.
target_text: malo ka ja'a pa'oo, paroa ana sab'a se'e. hèia na rai tèke eele kodho na, ka ne'e.

source_text: and it comes to pass, when his lord hears the words of his wife, which she has spoken to him, saying, according to these things has your servant done to me, that his anger burns;
target_text: tadèngi nare lii lolo dhèu èmu na, potifar nasa bia.

source_text: and joseph's lord takes him, and puts him to the round-house, a place where the king's prisoners are bound; and he is there in the round-house.
target_text: hèia na paredha ka dhèu lasi kèpe yusuf. ka ra pamaso asa d'ara bèdho dhèu aae.

source_text: and yhwh is with joseph, and stretches out kindness to him, and puts his grace in the eyes of the chief of the round-house;
target_text: te ngaa lamatua bhèlu boe yusuf. nèti èèna ka, lamatua ladhe-leru ne taruu, ka kapala ètu d'ara bèdho èèna, sue yusuf ae titu kèna.

source_text: and the chief of the round-house gives into the hand of joseph all the prisoners who are in the round-house, and of all that they are doing there, he has been doer;
target_text: na lèka yusuf, ka hia ne j'aj'i madho ho laladhe ana bèdho sèra aa'i-aa'i ra. aa, hia na lalau sasab'a ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: the chief of the round-house does not see anything under his hand, because yhwh is with him, and that which he is doing yhwh is causing to prosper.
target_text: lula lèka ne, ka kapala èmu bèdho na, tao heka ai-hèb'a mi ngaa-ngaa ètu d'ara bèdho èèna. lamatua ladhe-leru taruu yusuf, nèti èèna ka, sasab'a ngaa ètu d'ara bèdho na kako dènge be'a.

source_text: and it comes to pass, after these things-the butler of the king of egypt and the baker have sinned against their lord, against the king of egypt; and pharaoh is angry against his two eunuchs, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers, and puts them in confinement in the house of the chief of the executioners, into the round-house, the place where joseph is a prisoner,
target_text: ètu d'ara bèdho èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu dua, dhu uru na j'aj'i kapala urusan ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae masir. èci lalau dhua èi dhèu aae. aa èci hari lalau roti dhèu aae. dua ra tao pasala dhèu aae. nèti èèna ka, dhèu aae nasa, ka na pamaso si asa d'ara bèdho. dua ra pea ètu era èci dènge yusuf.

source_text: and the chief of the executioners charges joseph with them, and he serves them; and they are in confinement for some days.
target_text: kapala èmu bèdho na, paredha yusuf lalau dhèu dua se'e. ra ètu d'ara bèdho na, ele boe ca tèu do dua tèu le.

source_text: and they dream a dream both of them, each his dream in one night, each according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker whom the king of egypt has, who are prisoners in the round-house.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka, dua ra nii. ca dhèu ka dènge nii na. aa, lii nii dua sèra, èci-èci ka dènge sasoa na.

source_text: and joseph comes to them in the morning, and sees them, and behold, they are morose;
target_text: bèli mad'ae èèna, yusuf ladhe na dua ra rèhu susa.

source_text: and he asks pharaoh's eunuchs who are with him in confinement in the house of his lord, saying, why are your faces sad today?
target_text: ka na karèi si, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka mad'ae ne'e, miu dua mi roe-roe?

source_text: and they say to him, we have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it; and joseph says to them, are interpretations not with god? please recount to me.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, peka na, mèda deo na, ji'i nii. te ngaa ji'i nge'a boe sasoa na samia! hèia yusuf peka dènge dua ra, aku nèngu na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne'e, èci sa re'a boe sasoa nii, dhodhoka ama lamatua di. de miu lolo ku laa. pe èèna ho ja'a karèi sasoa nèti lamatua.

source_text: and the chief of the butlers recounts his dream to joseph and says to him, in my dream, then behold, a vine is before me!
target_text: hèia dhèu dhu lalau dhua èi hia dhèu aae èèna, lolo uuru peka na, ètu d'ara nii, ja'a ladhe kèdhi aj'u anggor ca kapua.

source_text: and in the vine are three branches, and it is as it were flourishing; gone up has its blossom, its clusters have ripened grapes;
target_text: aj'u anggor ne dadana nèngu tèlu di. aj'u na muri mai ka dènge rèu, hela, dènge hua giru-gari dhu madhasa.

source_text: and pharaoh's cup is in my hand, and i take the grapes and press them into the cup of pharaoh, and i give the cup into the hand of pharaoh.
target_text: aa ja'a kèd'u galaa dhu dhèu aae biasa pake ninu. ja'a puu hua anggor, ka pacèli èi sa d'ara galaa deo na. hèia kèti asa dhèu aae, hia na ninu.

source_text: and joseph says to him, this is its interpretation: the three branches are three days;
target_text: tadèngi nare hèia, yusuf peka dènge ne sèmi ne'e ka, ama, ee. sasoa nii na sèmi ne'e ka: dadana tèlu, sasoa na di tèlu lod'o ka.

source_text: yet, within three days pharaoh lifts up your head, and has put you back on your station, and you have given the cup of pharaoh into his hand, according to the former custom when you were his butler.
target_text: ètu d'ara tèlu lod'o ne, dhèu aae kalua eele ama nèti d'ara bèdho ne'e. ho na hia hari, ama lalau dhua èi hia dhèu aae sèmi uru na.

source_text: surely if you have remembered me with you, when it is well with you, and have please done kindness with me, and have made mention of me to pharaoh, then you have brought me out from this house,
target_text: ladhe ama abhu babe'a sèmi èèna, baku bhèlu ja'a, ee? ladhe ama sue ja'a, peka dènge dhèu aae kalua eele ja'a nèti era ne'e.

source_text: for i was really stolen from the land of the hebrews; and here also i have done nothing that they have put me in the pit for.
target_text: te ja'a ne, madhutu madha j'ara na dhu mola, rèngu se rare ja'a dènge laka-seti, nèti rae dhèu ibrani. d'ai era ne'e, ja'a tao boe sasala ngaa èci sa. te ngaa rèngu pamaso ja'a asa d'ara bèdho ne'e. rèngu tao ja'a sèmi dhèu bhelu-katub'a sa.

source_text: and the chief of the bakers sees that he has interpreted good, and he says to joseph, i also am in a dream, and behold, three baskets of white bread are on my head,
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sasoa nii ne'e be'a mi dedha angalai na, hèia dhèu èci dhu lalau roti na, lolo hari nii nèngu, peka na, ari yusuf. nii ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a tèd'u soe pagod'o-god'o tèlu.

source_text: and in the highest basket are of all kinds of pharaoh's food, work of a baker; and the birds are eating them out of the basket, from off my head.
target_text: ètu d'ara soe re dedha tèka na, pènu dènge koki dhèu aae, dhu rupa ae titu kèna. te ngaa manu-bhui lela mai ka ra'e aa'i koki d'ara soe dhu ètu kètu ja'a na.

source_text: and joseph answers and says, this is its interpretation: the three baskets are three days;
target_text: ropa yusuf tadèngi nare, ka na dhaa, peka na, sasoa lii nii ama, sèmi ne'e ka: soe tèlu sèra, sama kahèi dènge tèlu lod'o.

source_text: yet, within three days pharaoh lifts up your head from off you, and has hanged you on a tree, and the birds have eaten your flesh from off you.
target_text: d'ara tèlu lod'o ne, mu ladhe, te dhèu aae pua dhèu mai poro rare kètu èu. ho èèna na, ra kadhoe ngi'u aae èu ètu agarii. hèia manu-bhui tutu ra'e aa'i sisi èu.

source_text: and it comes to pass, on the third day, pharaoh's birthday, that he makes a banquet to all his servants, and lifts up the head of the chief of the butlers, and the head of the chief of the bakers among his servants,
target_text: ropa d'ai tèlu lod'o, dhu lèke dènge lod'o hari jadi dhèu aae, na tao tatao dhu kapai hia dhèu kapai na aa'i-aa'i sèra. na paredha ho dhèu lasi kalua eele dhèu dua sèra nèti d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and he puts back the chief of the butlers to his butlership, and he gives the cup into the hand of pharaoh;
target_text: ka na hia hari mone dhu lalau dhua èi na, sab'e sasab'a nèngu uru na.

source_text: and the chief of the bakers he has hanged, as joseph has interpreted to them;
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu lalau roti dhèu aae èèna, ra poro eele kètu na, ka ra kadhoe ngi'u na, sama sèmi ngaa dhu yusuf peka dènge rèngu dua ra.

source_text: and the chief of the butlers has not remembered joseph, but forgets him.
target_text: te ngaa mone dhu lalau dhua èi dhèu aae ne, sanèd'e heka yusuf. na bhèlu eele lii moa yusuf.

source_text: and it comes to pass, at the end of two years of days that pharaoh is dreaming, and behold, he is standing by the river,
target_text: pe d'ai dua tèu risi sa, hèia dhèu aae masir nii. na nii na, nèngu dhu titu ètu sebhe loko nil.

source_text: and behold, from the river coming up are seven cows, of beautiful appearance, and fat in flesh, and they feed among the reeds;
target_text: kabèdhi laa, nèngu nèdhi sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu kabèb'u bia. ka'uri ra kale'e. ra kalua nèti d'ara loko, ka ra'a j'u'u ètu sebhe loko èèna.

source_text: and behold, seven other cows are coming up after them out of the river, of bad appearance, and lean in flesh, and they stand near the cows on the edge of the river,
target_text: nèbhu boe, sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu leo hari, kalua nèti d'ara loko deo na. ngi'u sapi sèra malaka-god'a. ra titu padètu dènge sapi kabèb'u sèra.

source_text: and the cows of bad appearance and lean in flesh eat up the seven cows of beautiful appearance, and fat-and pharaoh awakens.
target_text: hèia sapi malaka pidhu ngi'u sèra, dhèle aa'i pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u sèra. hèia dhèu aae kabèdhi, ka na marèi dènge.

source_text: and he sleeps, and dreams a second time, and behold, seven ears are coming up on one stalk, fat and good,
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu aae bhèj'i luu hari. ka na nii hari ca tèka. lii nii na sèmi ne'e ka: nèngu ladhe nèdhi are pidhu huri dhu isi pènu, bhodho nèti laa are dhu sub'u.

source_text: and behold, seven ears, thin, and blasted with an east wind, are springing up after them;
target_text: èle èèna ka, nèdhi hari are pidhu huri dhu isi aad'o, aa dhu kamale dhae-dhae sène, lèke lai ngèlu dhu pana.

source_text: and the thin ears swallow the seven fat and full ears-and pharaoh awakens, and behold, a dream.
target_text: ka pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o sèra, dhèle aa'i pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu deo sa. hèia dhèu aae kabèdhi ka nèti bhèj'i. heka nèngu ne'a kèna, nèngu dhu nii hari di.

source_text: and it comes to pass in the morning, that his spirit is moved, and he sends and calls all the enchanters of egypt, and all its wise men, and pharaoh recounts to them his dream, and there is no interpreter of them to pharaoh.
target_text: mad'ae aae èèna, d'ara isi na be'a boe. hèia, na paredha dhèu lasi paroa aa'i dhèu ai tadha dènge dhèu d'èlu-mèu, ètu rai masir mai paraga dènge ne. ka na lolo lii nii na sèra dènge si. te ngaa dhèu èci sa bisa boe peka sasoa lii nii deo sa mi dhèu aae.

source_text: and the chief of the butlers speaks with pharaoh, saying, i mention my sin this day:
target_text: ka mone dhu lalau dhua èi dhèu aae èèna, heka sanèd'e nèdhi yusuf kèna. hèia la'e peka dènge dhèu aae, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a mangaku sala.

source_text: pharaoh has been angry against his servants, and puts me in confinement in the house of the chief of the executioners, me and the chief of the bakers;
target_text: uru èèna, dhu ama ku nasa dènge ja'a, dènge angalai ku èci na, ka pamaso ji'i asa d'ara bèdho,

source_text: and we dream a dream in one night, i and he, each according to the interpretation of his dream we have dreamed.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka, ji'i dua mi nii. èci-èci ka dènge nii na. aa sasoa nii se'e, sama boe kahèi.

source_text: and there is with us a youth, a hebrew, servant to the chief of the executioners, and we recount to him, and he interprets to us our dreams, to each according to his dream has he interpreted,
target_text: ètu d'ara bèdho na, abhu ana mone ibrani èci. kapala èmu bèdho nedhe ana mone ne, j'aj'i kapala urusan ho lalau ji'i. ji'i lolo lii nii ji'i dènge ne, ka na peka sasoa lii nii sèra dènge ji'i.

source_text: and it comes to pass, as he has interpreted to us so it has been, me he put back on my station, and him he hanged.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama dhèu aae ded'e hari ja'a. aa angalai ja'a na, abhu huku madhe. se'e se j'aj'i sama sèmi ngaa dhu ana mone ibrani na peka.

source_text: and pharaoh sends and calls joseph, and they cause him to run out of the pit, and he shaves, and changes his garments, and comes to pharaoh.
target_text: nanene nare lii ne'e hèia, dhèu aae pua dhèu lasi lai-lai rare yusuf nèti d'ara bèdho mai. ka yusuf pamèu iisi na, aa na gati mèdha-papake na, ka na la'e paraga dènge dhèu aae.

source_text: and pharaoh says to joseph, i have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it, and i have heard concerning you, saying, you understand a dream to interpret it,
target_text: ropa na d'ai madha hèia, dhèu aae peka, ja'a nii, te ngaa dhèu èci sa re'a boe sasoa lii nii sèra. te ngaa dhèu peka na èu me'a.

source_text: and joseph answers pharaoh, saying, without me-god answers pharaoh with peace.
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae. ja'a èèna ka oo, ke'a boe ngaa-ngaa kahèi. dhoka ama lamatua di dhu ne'a, ho na peka sasoa lii nii sa, dènge lèke. na neo peka lii dhu be'a mi ama dhèu aae.

source_text: and pharaoh speaks to joseph: in my dream, behold, i am standing by the edge of the river,
target_text: hèia dhèu aae lolo ka, lii nii sèra dènge ne, aku nèngu na, ètu d'ara nii èèna, ja'a titu ètu sebhe loko nil.

source_text: and behold, out of the river coming up are seven cows, fat in flesh, and of beautiful form, and they feed among the reeds;
target_text: ja'a ladhe la'a na sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu kabèb'u bia, dènge ka'uri dhu kale'e. ra kalua nèti d'ara loko mai, ka ra'a j'u'u ètu sebhe loko èèna.

source_text: and behold, seven other cows are coming up after them, thin, and of very bad form, and lean in flesh; i have not seen like these in all the land of egypt for badness.
target_text: hèia sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu leo mai hari. rèngu se'e dhu malaka-god'a. ètu rai masir ne'e, ja'a kèdhi mèka sapi dhu malaka-god'a sèmi èèna!

source_text: and the lean and the bad cows eat up the first seven fat cows,
target_text: dhu pamalaa ja'a, pidhu sapi dhu malaka-god'a sèra, kabèdhi laa dhèle aa'i pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u se.

source_text: and they come in to their midst, and it has not been known that they have come in to their midst, and their appearance is bad as at the commencement; and i awake.
target_text: sapi dhu malaka sèra dhèle aa'i, te ngaa ngi'u ra malaka taruu sèmi èèna ka. hèia ja'a kabèdhi dènge ka.

source_text: and i see in my dream, and behold, seven ears are coming up on one stalk, full and good;
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a bhèj'i luu hari, ka nii hari ca tèka. ja'a kèdhi pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu, kalua nèti laa are ca kapua dhu sub'u.

source_text: and behold, seven ears, withered, thin, blasted with an east wind, are springing up after them;
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi hari, pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o, aa dhu kamale dhae-dhae, lèke lai ngèlu pana.

source_text: and the thin ears swallow the seven good ears; and i tell it to the enchanters, and there is none declaring it to me.
target_text: ka pidhu huri are dhu bèdhu sèra dhèle aa'i pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu sèra. èle èèna ka, ja'a kèd'i nèti bhèj'i. ka ja'a lolo lii nii se'e mi dhèu d'èlu-mèu se'e, te ngaa èci sa bisa boe peka sasoa lii nii sèra.

source_text: and joseph says to pharaoh, the dream of pharaoh is one: that which god is doing he has declared to pharaoh;
target_text: hèia yusuf padhai lii, peka na, ama dhèu aae! lii nii dua sèra, sasoa na dhoka èci di. ama lamatua peka le, mi ama dhèu aae, ngaa dhu na neo tao.

source_text: the seven good cows are seven years, and the seven good ears are seven years, the dream is one;
target_text: sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u, dènge pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu sèra, sasoa na, tèu dhu bècu-manèsa pidhu tèu. sasoa ra dhoka èci di.

source_text: and the seven thin and bad cows which are coming up after them are seven years, and the seven empty ears, blasted with an east wind, are seven years of famine;
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, pidhu sapi dhu malaka-god'a, dènge pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o, sasoa na, tèu manganga pidhu tèu.

source_text: this is the thing which i have spoken to pharaoh: god has shown pharaoh what he is doing.
target_text: de lamatua dhu peka mema le, ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. èèna sama kahèi, dènge ngaa dhu ja'a peka deo na.

source_text: behold, seven years are coming of great abundance in all the land of egypt,
target_text: ladhe bèli-camèd'a, ètu rai masir ne'e, d'ara pidhu tèu, èdhi abhu bècu-manèsa palème rae.

source_text: and seven years of famine have arisen after them, and all the plenty is forgotten in the land of egypt, and the famine has finished the land, and the plenty is not known in the land because of that famine afterward, for it is very grievous.
target_text: èle èèna na, heka èdhi abhu manganga d'ara pidhu tèu. d'ara pidhu tèu na, manganga madèu aae. toke èdhi abhu boe nganga'a calamusi sa, ètu dedha rai masir ne'e. dhèu aa'i-aa'i manganga ae titu kèna, ka ra bhèlu eele uru na dhu rèngu abhu le babècu pidhu tèu.

source_text: and because of the repeating of the dream to pharaoh twice, surely the thing is established by god, and god is hurrying to do it.
target_text: de ladhe ama dhèu aae abhu nii dua hari, sasoa na, ama lamatua ka dhu ator tèke. nèbhu heka, ngaa dhu na ator ne, j'aj'i kèna.

source_text: and now, let pharaoh provide a man, intelligent and wise, and set him over the land of egypt;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: be'a risi ama dhèu aae tenge dhèu d'èlu-mèu èci, dhu bisa tao ai-hèb'a la'a dènge be'a. aa ded'e ne, ho ladhe-leru kabarai ne'e dènge be'a.

source_text: let pharaoh make and appoint overseers over the land, and receive a fifth of the land of egypt in the seven years of plenty,
target_text: d'ara pidhu tèu dhu bècu èèna, be'a risi ama dhèu aae ded'e hari dhèu, ho ra oru-pakaboko nganga'a dhu risi eele. nganga'a dhu risi sèra, bagi mi lèmi ho tèke ca pala.

source_text: and they gather all the food of these good years that are coming, and heap up grain under the hand of pharaoh-food in the cities; and they have kept it,
target_text: ana kabarai ne'e, hud'i madhutu dènge be'a paredha ama dhèu aae, ho pakaboko are-are dhu risi eele, nèti rae-rae ètu rai masir ne'e. aa ra soli sa d'ara soka ho j'aga paie.

source_text: and the food has been for a store for the land, for the seven years of famine which are in the land of egypt; and the land is cut off by the famine.
target_text: sèna ka pidhu tèu dhu manganga nèi mai te, èdhi dhu sadia le nganga'a. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, èci sa madhe boe manganga.

source_text: and the thing is good in the eyes of pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants,
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai lii yusuf ne, dhèu aae dènge dhèu kapai sèra, sèmi ngaa dhu na peka dènge dhèu aae èèna.

source_text: and pharaoh says to his servants, do we find like this, a man in whom the spirit of god is?
target_text: ka dhèu aae padhai lii, peka na, roh ama lamatua hia le koasa mi yusuf ne'e. nèti èèna ka, èdhi abhu heka dhèu dhu risi nèti nèngu.

source_text: and pharaoh says to joseph, after god's causing you to know all this, there is none intelligent and wise as you;
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, ama lamatua peka dènge èu, ngaa-ngaa se'e aa'i-aa'i. nèti sèmi ne'e ka, heka ji'i nge'a kèna èu ne'e tare'a-re'a dhèu mèu. aa mamèu èu ne, risi eele dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: you are over my house, and at your mouth do all my people kiss; only in the throne i am greater than you.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo ne'e kahèi ja'a ded'e èu j'aj'i ai g'ana ja'a. sèna ka èu j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu d'ara èmu ja'a. aa ana kabarai ja'a nanene lii paredha èu. dhoka ja'a di dhu risi nèti èu.

source_text: and pharaoh says to joseph, see, i have put you over all the land of egypt. and pharaoh turns aside his seal-ring from off his hand, and puts it on the hand of joseph, and clothes him with garments of fine linen, and places a chain of gold on his neck,
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae puru eele kadheli dhu dènge cap nèti ai na, ka na pasaluu mi ai yusuf. ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, dènge ne'e ne, ja'a ded'e èu, j'aj'i ai g'ana ja'a ètu rai masir. hèia na papake kodho madhera dhu milu èci mi yusuf, aa na pa'inu rate hualaa cakoko mi ladha-goro na.

source_text: and causes him to ride in the second chariot which he has, and they proclaim before him, bow the knee! and he set him over all the land of egypt.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae hia hari yusuf kareta ka dua nèngu. ka na hia dhèu lasi uuru, ho pa'oo peka na, we! patalele j'ara oo! pahaha iisi mliu! dhèu kapai neo re ne'e! dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu aae ded'e le yusuf, j'aj'i ai g'ana na ètu rai masir.

source_text: and pharaoh says to joseph, i am pharaoh, and without you a man does not lift up his hand and his foot in all the land of egypt;
target_text: hèia dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, sèmi ne'e. èu dhu me'a le ja'a ne dhèu aae. te ngaa ja'a peka le dènge ana kabarai masir aa'i-aa'i, peka na, ladhe èu hia boe ijin, rèngu bisa boe tao ngaa èci sa.

source_text: and pharaoh calls joseph's name zaphnath-paaneah, and he gives to him asenath daughter of poti-pherah, priest of on, for a wife, and joseph goes out over the land of egypt.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu aae pangare yusuf madhutu ngara masir, na safnat panea. aa, na hia yusuf madhèdi dènge ana bhèni èci, ngara na asnat. ama dhèu èmu na, ngara na potifera. nèngu ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i ama agama ètu d'ara kota on. dènge j'ara ne'e, yusuf j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu rai masir.

source_text: and joseph is a son of thirty years in his standing before pharaoh king of egypt, and joseph goes out from the presence of pharaoh, and passes over through all the land of egypt;
target_text: lod'o na j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu rai masir, umur nèngu tèlu nguru tèu le. hèia na kako palème rai masir.

source_text: and the land makes in the seven years of plenty by handfuls.
target_text: ètu d'ara pidhu tèu dhu bècu-manèsa ne'e, oka-tedhe pènu dènge nganga'a.

source_text: and he gathers all the food of the seven years which have been in the land of egypt, and puts food in the cities; the food of the field which is around each city has he put in its midst;
target_text: hèia yusuf kaboko nganga'a dhu risi, ka na tèka paia si. ètu era mia dhu na pakaboko nganga'a, ètu èèna kahèi na soli asa d'ara soka.

source_text: and joseph gathers grain as sand of the sea, multiplying exceedingly, until he has ceased to number, for there is no number.
target_text: are dhu pakaboko nare, ae titu kèna. èci èèna ka, dènge salae ètu nebhe dhasi, ka dhèu uku rare heka.

source_text: and to joseph were born two sons before the year of famine comes, whom asenath daughter of poti-pherah, priest of on, has borne to him,
target_text: d'ai mèka tèu manganga, dhèu èmu yusuf, asnat nara iisi le ana mone dhèu dua.

source_text: and joseph calls the name of the firstborn manasseh: for god has made me to forget all my labor, and all the house of my father;
target_text: ka yusuf padhai lii, peka na, ama lamatua tao j'ara ne'e, sèna ka pabhèlu ja'a nèti j'aj'èra dhu lod'o ja'a kalua nèti d'ara èmu ama ku. nèti èèna ka, ana uuru, na pangare ne manase dhu sasoa na ele boe ‘bhèlu'.

source_text: and the name of the second he has called ephraim: for god has caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.
target_text: lod'o na abhu ana ka dua, na padhai lii hari, peka na, ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae d'ai seli ètu era ne'e. te ngaa sasue dènge ladhe-leru ama lamatua ka, ja'a abhu ana ètu ne'e. ka na pangare ana ne'e efraim.

source_text: and the seven years of plenty are completed which have been in the land of egypt,
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, èle pidhu tèu dhu bècu-manèsa na.

source_text: and the seven years of famine begin to come, as joseph said, and famine is in all the lands, but in all the land of egypt has been bread;
target_text: aa pidhu tèu manganga madèu d'ai kèna, sama sèmi dhu uru èèna yusuf peka le. ètu era leo, dhèu manganga le. te ngaa rae-rae ètu masir nganga'a ae era.

source_text: and all the land of egypt is famished, and the people cry to pharaoh for bread, and pharaoh says to all the egyptians, go to joseph; that which he says to you-do.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, kabarai masir manganga kahèi. ka lasi asa dhèu aae ho ra manèngi nganga'a. aa dhèu aae pua si lasi asa yusuf, sèna ka ra madhutu paredha yusuf.

source_text: and the famine has been over all the face of the land, and joseph opens all places which have grain in them, and sells to the egyptians; and the famine is severe in the land of egypt,
target_text: te ngaa rai manganga ètu mia-mia asa tabha, toke d'ai rae-rae ètu rai masir. nèti èèna ka, yusuf bhoke aa'i soka nganga'a sèna ka pahie dènge dhèu masir.

source_text: and all the earth has come to egypt, to buy, to joseph, for the famine was severe in all the earth.
target_text: lula manganga ae titu kèna, ka dhèu nèti mia-mia mai hèli nganga'a ètu yusuf ètu rai masir.

source_text: and jacob sees that there is grain in egypt, and jacob says to his sons, why do you look at each other?
target_text: tèu èèna, yakob tadèngi dhèu palolo na abhu are ètu masir. ka na peka dènge ana na si, aku nèngu na, ana ee! miu nga tao madhèdi mau-mau ka laa?

source_text: he also says, behold, i have heard that there is grain in egypt, go down there, and buy for us from there, and we live and do not die;
target_text: ja'a tadèngi na ètu masir pahia nganga'a. hua iia lami hèli, sèna ka èdhi baku madhe manganga.

source_text: and the ten brothers of joseph go down to buy grain in egypt,
target_text: ka a'a yusuf canguru dhèu se'e pa'èra ka, lasi hèli nganga'a asa masir.

source_text: and benjamin, joseph's brother, jacob has not sent with his brothers, for he said, lest harm meet him.
target_text: te ngaa yakob hia boe ari yusuf dhu ngara na benyamin, la'e dènge a'a na si. te, na pangee, mage dhoka, ana ne'e abhu hari j'aj'èra ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: and the sons of israel come to buy in the midst of those coming, for the famine has been in the land of canaan,
target_text: lula dhèu ae nèti mia-mia tadèngi le abhu nganga'a ètu masir, ka ra lasi hèli asa nèi. manganga ne d'ai le rai kana'an kahèi. ka ana-ana yakob se, lasi hèli kahèi asa masir.

source_text: and joseph is the ruler over the land, he who is selling to all the people of the land, and joseph's brothers come and bow themselves to him-face to the earth.
target_text: tèu èèna, yusuf j'aj'i ai g'ana dhèu aae masir. ladhe dhèu nèti mia-mia mai hèli are, yusuf ka dhu pahia. nèti èèna ka, lod'o a'a na si d'ai nèi, rèngu patitu kètu urutuu, ho tab'e yusuf toke rèhu rèngu oe d'ai rai.

source_text: and joseph sees his brothers, and discerns them, and makes himself strange to them, and speaks sharp things with them, and says to them, from where have you come? and they say, from the land of canaan-to buy food. and joseph discerns his brothers, but they have not discerned him,
target_text: ropa yusuf ladhe nèdhi a'a na si, na tadhe le èèna. te ngaa yusuf tao iisi sèmi dhèu masir. nèti èèna ka, rèngu tadhe boe ne hèi. hèia na jèka si, aku nèngu na, ee! miu se nèti mia? hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ji'i se nèti kana'an. ji'i mai hèli nganga'a sa ama wakil.

source_text: and joseph remembers the dreams which he dreamed of them and says to them, you are spies; you have come to see the nakedness of the land.
target_text: hèia yusuf sanèd'e lii nii na uru na. ka na pamadha'u si, aku nèngu na, ja'a lèka boe! miu se'e dhèu mata-mata. miu mai tenge rahasia rai masir, ho èèna na mai musu rai ji'i!

source_text: and they say to him, no, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food;
target_text: te ngaa ra dhaa peka na, aad'o, ama! ji'i se'e dhoka ana pua-paleha nèti ama di. tare'a-re'a ji'i mai sa ne'e ne, neo hèli nganga'a di. leo nèti èèna, aad'o.

source_text: we are all of us sons of one man, we are right men; your servants have not been spies;
target_text: ji'i aa'i-aa'i se'e, ana nèti ca ama di. ji'i mai mata-mata boe rai ama ku si ne'e. ji'i se'e dhèu be'a.

source_text: and he says to them, no, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land;
target_text: te ngaa yusuf jèka si dènge lii mèdhu hari, peka na, he! omo koso! baku kapod'e-kabèli ja'a. miu se'e tare'a-re'a dhèu bhelu. miu mai tenge rahasia rai ne'e!

source_text: and they say, your servants are twelve brothers; we are sons of one man in the land of canaan, and behold, the young one is with our father today, and one is not.
target_text: ka ra peka, aad'o ama! ji'i se'e ana pua-paleha ama ku di. ji'i mai nèti rai kana'an. ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi nèti ca ama, canguru dua dhèu. ari ji'i dhu limuri tèka, pea dènge ama ji'i. aa ari ji'i èci aad'o heka!

source_text: and joseph says to them, this is that which i have spoken to you, saying, you are spies,
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o! lèke sèmi lii ja'a deo na! miu se'e dhèu mata-mata.

source_text: by this you are proved: as pharaoh lives, if you go out from this-except by your young brother coming here;
target_text: na! karèi sèmi èèna, na miu hia ku tadha èci, sèna ka ja'a ke'a lii padhai lii miu deo sa, tare'a, do aad'o. ja'a subha ee! ladhe ari miu dhu limuri na, d'ai boe ne'e, miu èci sa bisa boe kalua nèti rai ne'e!

source_text: send one of you, and let him bring your brother, and you, remain bound, and let your words be proved, whether truth be with you: and if not, as pharaoh lives, surely you are spies;
target_text: de hua iia miu pua dhèu èci la'e, ho nèti ari miu dhu limuri èèna asa ne'e mai. aa miu dhu leo se, ja'a taha. ja'a neo ke'a miu se'e peka tare'a, do aad'o. ladhe aad'o, miu se'e tare'a-re'a mata-mata.

source_text: and he gathers them into confinement for three days.
target_text: ka yusuf pua taha si d'ara bèdho tèlu lod'o.

source_text: and joseph says to them on the third day, do this and live; i fear god!
target_text: d'ai lod'o ka tèlu, yusuf la'e padhai lii dènge ra ètu d'ara bèdho, peka na, ja'a ne'e, ca dhèu dhu madha'u dènge lamatua. aa ja'a madhutu dad'èi na taruu. sèna ka miu mamuri, ja'a neo patabuli miu. te ngaa hud'i dènge ku lii pajaji.

source_text: if you are right men, let one of your brothers be bound in the house of your confinement, and you, go, carry in grain for the famine of your houses,
target_text: ladhe miu se'e tare'a padhai lii dhu mola, miu pad'elo ku ngaa èci j'aj'i mi tadha. j'ara na sèmi ne'e: ja'a taha ca dhèu ètu d'ara bèdho ne'e. dhèu leo lèpa ho mèti nganga'a hia a'ari miu, te ra tatae miu lami mèti nganga'a.

source_text: and you bring your young brother to me, and your words are established, and you do not die; and they do so.
target_text: d'ai nèi, miu mèti ari miu dhu limuri èèna mai asa ne'e, ho j'aj'i bukti, tare'a miu se'e dhèu be'a. sèna ka ja'a baku huku pamadhe miu. ropa ra tadèngi rare ne'e, ra d'èi kahèi sèmi èèna.

source_text: and they say to one another, truly we are guilty concerning our brother, because we saw the distress of his soul, in his making supplication to us, and we did not listen: therefore this distress has come on us.
target_text: ka ra padhue-padhai ka èci dènge èci, peka na, waa! ne'e ne, èdhi heka abhu b'ala kèna, lula sala dhu èdhi ad'u-ue mi dedha ari èdhi uru na. èdhi ladhe tèdhi nèngu j'èra titu kèna, d'ai na manèngi sasue èdhi, te ngaa èdhi pusi boe ne. nèti èèna ka, èdhi abhu j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne.

source_text: and reuben answers them, saying, did i not speak to you, saying, do not sin against the boy? and you did not listen; and his blood also, behold, it is required.
target_text: hèia ruben pasanèd'e si, peka na, we! ari-ari ja'a, ee! uru na ja'a kai le miu, ho baku paj'èra ana èèna, si? te ngaa miu-miu se'e ka dhu mo'o boe nanene lii ja'a. nèti èèna ka, lod'o ne'e èdhi dui tare raa ari èdhi yusuf èèna.

source_text: and they have not known that joseph understands, for the interpreter is between them;
target_text: rèngu padhai lii ae-ae sèmi èèna, re'a boe na yusuf ne'a lii rèngu kahèi. lod'o yusuf padhai lii dènge rèngu, na pake lii masir, ho èèna na dhèu leo lole hari pake lii ibrani.

source_text: and he turns around from them, and weeps, and turns back to them, and speaks to them, and takes simeon from them, and binds him before their eyes.
target_text: tadèngi ra padhai lii sèmi èèna hèia, yusuf kèd'i eele si, la'e tangi asa era leo. tangi nare, la'e hari pa'èci dènge si. ka na pua dhèu èki simeon ètu madha a'ari na sèra.

source_text: and joseph commands, and they fill their vessels with grain, also to put back the money of each of them into his sack, and to give to them provision for the way; and one does to them so.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf paredha dhèu sab'a sèra, ho soli are asa d'ara karo a'a na si. aa tao hari doi kab'ua are sèra, asa d'ara karo ra èci-èci. ra tèke ètu hèb'a karo sèra. na pua dhèu sab'a se'e, ho hia si dènge gee. ka dhèu sab'a se'e lalau ka, madhutu ngaa dhu yusuf paredha.

source_text: and they lift up their grain on their donkeys, and go from there,
target_text: èle ka, a'a na si hua karo nganga'a sèra asa dedha badha keled'ei. ka ra pakèd'i dènge ka.

source_text: and the one opens his sack to give provender to his donkey at a lodging-place, and he sees his money, and behold, it is in the mouth of his bag,
target_text: ropa d'ai talora j'ara, ra ae. dhèu èci bhoke karo na, ho neo ani keled'ei na. na ladhe la'a na, doi na ètu dedha are, ètu d'ara karo èèna.

source_text: and he says to his brothers, my money has been put back, and also, behold, in my bag: and their heart goes out, and they tremble, to one another saying, what is this god has done to us!
target_text: capa na cag'ag'a! hèia na paroa a'a na si, peka na, irii! miu mai ladhe ku laa! madhe èdhi kèna. ra tao hari doi ja'a asa d'ara karo ne. ladhe rèdhi èèna ka, ra ele ngangee, aa madha'u bia. ka ra papeka ka, aku rèngu na, ama lamatua tao èdhi samia ka ne?

source_text: and they come to their father jacob, to the land of canaan, and they declare to him all the things meeting them, saying,
target_text: hèia ra kako taruu ka, lasi d'ai kana'an. d'ai nèi ka, ra lolo dènge ama ra, ngaa dhu rèngu paraga ètu rai masir.

source_text: the man, the lord of the land, has spoken with us sharp things, and makes us as spies of the land;
target_text: ra lolo, peka na, ama, ee! ai g'ana dhèu aae masir èèna, bhelu titu kèna. na jèka taruu ji'i. na peka na ji'i la'a j'aj'i mata-mata ho neo pa'ele iie rai masir.

source_text: and we say to him, we are right men, we have not been spies,
target_text: ka ji'i dhaa, peka na, ‘aad'o! ji'i se'e padhai lii mola-mola. ji'i mata-mata boe.

source_text: we are twelve brothers, sons of our father, one is not, and the young one is today with our father in the land of canaan.
target_text: ji'i se'e, dhèu be'a-be'a. ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi, j'aj'i nèti ca ama, dhèu canguru dua. te ngaa èci madhe le. aa ari dhu limuri èèna, dènge ama ji'i ètu kana'an. '

source_text: and the man, the lord of the land, says to us, by this i know that you are right men-leave one of your brothers with me, and take for the famine of your houses and go,
target_text: na peka hari, aku nèngu na, ‘ja'a neo kèdhi, na, miu se'e dhèu be'a, do aad'o! miu èci, pea mi ne'e. aa leo lèpa mèti nganga'a hia a'ari miu, sèna ka ra baku madhe manganga.

source_text: and bring your young brother to me, and i know that you are not spies, but you are right men; i give your brother to you, and you trade with the land.
target_text: hud'i miu mèti ku ari miu èèna mai sa ne'e, heka ja'a ke'a kèna, tare'a-re'a miu se'e dhèu be'a, mata-mata boe. èèna na, heka ja'a patabuli dhèu miu dhu ja'a taha ne. aa dènge sèmi èèna, ja'a heka ko'o kèna, miu kako palème dedha rai ne'e. '

source_text: and it comes to pass, they are emptying their sacks, and behold, the bundle of each man's silver is in his sack, and they see their bundles of silver, they and their father, and are afraid;
target_text: lolo èle hèia, heka ra bhoke karo-karo rèngu dhu pènu dènge are sèra. te ngaa ra cag'ag'a ladhe la'a na doi rèngu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, ètu hèb'a karo. rèdhi sèmi èèna, yakob dènge ana-ana na madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: and their father jacob says to them, you have bereaved me; joseph is not, and simeon is not, and benjamin you take-all these things have been against me.
target_text: hèia yakob padhai lii dènge si, peka na, miu se, pa'ele le ana-ana ja'a. yusuf aad'o heka. sèmi èèna kahèi, simeon. ne'e miu neo mèti hari benyamin kèna? miu se'e, tare'a-re'a neo paj'èra ja'a!

source_text: and reuben speaks to his father, saying, you put to death my two sons, if i do not bring him to you; give him into my hand, and i bring him back to you;
target_text: hèia ruben peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ama, ee! pangèd'u laa benyamin asa ja'a mai. ja'a tago kore. ja'a jaji kèna mi ama ku, èèna ja'a kèti hari na mai. te ngaa ladhe aad'o, na ja'a hia ana ja'a, mone dhèu dua sèra ho ama pamadhe aa'i si.

source_text: and he says, my son does not go down with you, for his brother is dead, and he by himself is left; when harm has met him in the way in which you go, then you have brought down my grey hairs in sorrow to sheol.
target_text: te ngaa yakob dhaa hari, peka na, bisa boe! miu bisa boe mèti benyamin. te a'a na yusuf, madhe le. ne'e, di nèngu ka mesa na. ladhe na abhu calaka ètu j'ara, miu tabha babia mi ja'a, toke madhe kèti.

source_text: and the famine is severe in the land;
target_text: tèu èèna, ètu rai kana'an asa tabha manganga.

source_text: and it comes to pass, when they have finished eating the grain which they brought from egypt, that their father says to them, return, buy for us a little food.
target_text: isi èmu yakob ra'a aa'i le nganga'a dhu ca hari na, ana na si lasi hèli ètu masir. ka na padhai lii dènge ana na si, be'a risi lami hari hèli nganga'a asa rai masir.

source_text: and judah speaks to him, saying, the man protesting protested to us, saying, you do not see my face without your brother being with you;
target_text: te ngaa yahuda b'ala, peka na, ama, ca hari na ai g'ana dhèu aae masir dhu pasanèd'e le ji'i, aku nèngu na, ji'i bisa boe pad'elo rèhu mi nèngu, ladhe ji'i ngèti boe ari ji'i dhu limuri, benyamin èèna.

source_text: if you are sending our brother with us, we go down, and buy for you food,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama ku hud'i laa hia ji'i ngèti benyamin. heka ji'i bisa la'a hèli nganga'a hia ama ku kèna.

source_text: and if you are not sending-we do not go down, for the man said to us, you do not see my face without your brother being with you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ama patabuli boe nèngu, ji'i oo la'a boe kahèi. lula dhèu masir na peka le sèmi èèna.

source_text: and israel says, why did you do evil to me, by declaring to the man that you had yet a brother?
target_text: hèia yakob jèke si, peka na, nga tao ka miu lolo dènge dhèu èèna, peka na, miu dènge ari èci era? miu tenge j'ara ho paj'èra tabha ja'a!

source_text: and they say, the man asked diligently concerning us, and concerning our family, saying, is your father yet alive? have you a brother? and we declare to him according to the tenor of these things; do we certainly know that he will say, bring down your brother?
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, baku nasa ama, ee! te lula dhèu ne, karèi taruu-taruu neo ne'a a'ari èdhi. na karèi peka na, ‘tasamia? ama mi era, do? miu dènge hari ari dhèu mone dhu leo, do? ' sèmi èèna na, ji'i dhaa tasamia hari? pakaseti ka ji'i dhaa ka laa, dènge mola-mola. te pe, cee ne'a na pua ji'i ngèti hari ari ji'i sa nèi?

source_text: and judah says to his father israel, send the youth with me, and we arise, and go, and live, and do not die, both we, and you, and our infants. i am guarantor for him, from my hand you require him; if i have not brought him to you, and set him before you-then i have sinned against you all the days;
target_text: ka yahuda padhai lii hari, aku nèngu na, ama hud'i patabuli ku benyamin la'e dènge ji'i. ja'a jaji mema, ladhe j'aj'i ngaa-ngaa mi ngi'u ari ji'i ne'e, ja'a ka dhu gati ne. ladhe ja'a kèti heka nèngu mai asa d'ara kacui-aai ama ku dènge mamuri, hud'i laa sasala na ama ku pasae mi dedha ja'a toke madhe. nèti èèna ka, ama ku hia la, ho ji'i sama-sama la'a dènge ne, te ji'i neo pakèd'i kèna. de karohe mai lati ka, sèna ka cahag'e baku madhe manganga.

source_text: for if we had not lingered, surely now we had returned these two times.
target_text: ladhe sèmi èdhi mate boe panèbhu sèmi ne'e, na, èdhi lati-mai dua hari le.

source_text: and their father israel says to them, if so, now, do this: take of the praised thing of the land in your vessels, and take down to the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices and myrrh, nuts and almonds;
target_text: hèia ama ra padhai lii, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, miu nanene! lami mere isi rai èdhi dhu be'a risi, sèmi: dhua nasu oni, bubhu-bubhu, raa aj'u hèu mèngi, èi na'i salap, kanari dènge kab'ui dhu leo sèra. ho sèna ka mèti hia ai g'ana dhèu aae masir èèna. aa peka dènge ne, ne'e ne tadha mata.

source_text: and double money take in your hand, even the money which is brought back in the mouth of your bags, you take back in your hand, it may be it is an oversight.
target_text: aa miu mèti doi risi eele nèti ca hari ni, sèna ka miu bisa hia hari doi kab'ua are uru sèra la'a, dhu miu mèdhi ètu d'ara karo miu sèra. tao-tao dhèu sèra re'a boe, ka tèka sala.

source_text: and take your brother, and rise, return to the man;
target_text: miu mèti ari mu. de èèna na lèpa hari lai-lai!

source_text: and god almighty give to you mercies before the man, so that he has sent to you your other brother and benjamin; and i, when i am bereaved-i am bereaved.
target_text: ja'a sanao-maena, sèna ka, ama lamatua dhu dènge koasa kapai risi eele èèna, sab'a mi d'ara ai g'ana dhèu aae masir èèna, sèna ka na sue miu. aa na hia hari benyamin dènge simeon lèpa palere dènge miu. te, ladhe ana ja'a se ele, hud'i laa ja'a pasae j'aj'èra ne'e taruu.

source_text: and the men take this present, double money also they have taken in their hand, and benjamin; and they rise, and go down to egypt, and stand before joseph;
target_text: hèia lasi pakaboko tadha mata sèra dènge doi, ka lasi asa masir. rèti kahèi dènge benyamin. d'ai nèi ka lasi paraga dènge yusuf.

source_text: and joseph sees benjamin with them and says to him who is over his house, bring the men into the house, and slaughter an animal, and make ready, for the men eat with me at noon.
target_text: ropa yusuf nèdhi benyamin dènge a'a na si, na pua kapala urusan na, aku nèngu na, lere mèti dhèu se'e sa èmu ja'a! ho èèna na, pare sapi ci'u, mi pananasu nganga'a dhu be'a. sèna ka lod'o nètu none, ra'a dènge ja'a.

source_text: and the man does as joseph has said, and the man brings in the men into the house of joseph,
target_text: hèia kapala urusan èèna, tao sama sèmi lii paredha yusuf èèna. na lere nèti dhèu sèra asa èmu yusuf.

source_text: and the men are afraid because they have been brought into the house of joseph, and they say, for the matter of the money which was put back in our bags at the commencement are we brought in-to roll himself on us, and to throw himself on us, and to take us for servants-our donkeys also.
target_text: ropa ra kako lasi èmu èèna, a'a na sèra madha'u bia. ètu talora j'ara, ra papeka, aku rèngu na, we! nga tao ka na pua rèti èdhi sa ne'e? mage dhoka na neo pasusa èdhi. lula doi dhu ra tao hari asa d'ara karo èdhi ca hari na. ra sangaja rèti èdhi sa ne'e, sèna ka ra kèpa èdhi j'aj'i ènu nèngu. ho èèna na, ra parama rara keled'ei èdhi sèra.

source_text: and they come near to the man who is over the house of joseph, and speak to him at the opening of the house,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ropa ra dètu èmu yusuf na, ra padhai lii dènge kapala urusan èèna, peka na,

source_text: and say, o my lord, we really come down at the commencement to buy food;
target_text: ama! baku nasa dènge ji'i, te ca hari na dhu ji'i mai hèli nganga'a ètu ne'e.

source_text: and it comes to pass, when we have come to the lodging-place, and open our bags, that behold, each one's money is in the mouth of his bag, our money in its weight, and we bring it back in our hand; and other money have we brought down in our hand to buy food; we have not known who put our money in our bags.
target_text: ropa ji'i lèpa d'ai talora j'ara, ji'i ae ngara iisi, ho bhèj'i ciki. hèia ji'i bhoke karo ho neo panga'a badha. ladhe la'a na, doi bab'ae ji'i èci-èci ka ètu d'ara karo sèra. ji'i nge'a boe cee ka dhu tao la'a! nèti èèna ka, ji'i ngèti hari doi sèra ka se'e. ji'i manèngi sèna ka ama ku baku nasa. aa ji'i ngèti doi ka risi kahèi, neo hèli hari nganga'a.

source_text: and he says, peace to you, do not fear: your god and the god of your father has given to you hidden treasure in your bags, your money came to me; and he brings out simeon to them.
target_text: hèia kapala urusan èèna dhaa, aku nèngu na, mau-mau, baku madha'u! ele boe lamatua miu èèna ka dhu hia miu berkat ètu d'ara karo sèra. ca hari na, ja'a sèmi le doi miu aa'i-aa'i. miu pakèlu boe! d'ai èmu ka, na patalale simeon pa'èci dènge rèngu.

source_text: and the man brings in the men into joseph's house, and gives water, and they wash their feet; and he gives provender for their donkeys,
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra lasi asa d'ara èmu yusuf. hèia kapala urusan èèna hia èi ho ra rase haga ra. aa na ani keled'ei si hèi.

source_text: and they prepare the present until the coming of joseph at noon, for they have heard that there they eat bread.
target_text: ka na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, ladhe èèna na, lod'o nètu miu mi'a dènge ai g'ana dhèu aae. d'ara ra tatae yusuf lèpa, rèngu lalau paie tadha mata ra sèra.

source_text: and joseph comes into the house, and they bring to him the present which is in their hand, into the house, and bow themselves to him, to the earth;
target_text: ropa yusuf d'ai èmu, aa'i-aa'i ra patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha na. ka ra j'ole tadha mata sa hia ne.

source_text: and he asks of them of peace and says, is your father well? the aged man of whom you have spoken, is he yet alive?
target_text: hèia yusuf karèi si, peka na, tasamia? miu be'a-be'a, do? tasamia dènge ama miu dhu heka èèna? na be'a-be'a, do?

source_text: and they say, your servant our father is well, he is yet alive; and they bow, and pay respect.
target_text: ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ènu ama dhu heka na, dhu ama matana ji'i, be'a-be'a. hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu pahaha iisi hari mi yusuf.

source_text: and he lifts up his eyes and sees his brother benjamin, his mother's son, and says, is this your young brother, of whom you have spoken to me? and he says, god favor you, my son.
target_text: hèia yusuf ladhe palème, ka nèdhi ari na benyamin. rèngu dua ra se, ina-ama èci. hèia, aku nèngu na, ooo! ne'e ne ka ari miu dhu limuri, dhu ca hari na miu lolo èèna, do? ka na lii dènge benyamin, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! ja'a sanao, sèna ka ama lamatua hia èu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: and joseph hurries, for his bowels have been moved for his brother, and he seeks to weep, and enters the inner chamber, and weeps there;
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi benyamin ne, d'ara yusuf karej'e bia, lula na sue ari na ae titu kèna. na taha nare heka d'ara na. ka na kako eele si la'e sa d'ara kama na. ka na tangi ngob'i-ngob'i ètu èèna.

source_text: and he washes his face, and goes out, and refrains himself, and says, place bread.
target_text: tangi nare hèia, la'e riu katanga madha na. èle èèna ka, na pa'èra d'ara na, ka la'e hari paraga dènge si. hèia na pua dhèu sab'a sèra lasi lalau nganga'a.

source_text: and they place for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the egyptians who are eating with him by themselves: for the egyptians are unable to eat bread with the hebrews, for it is an abomination to the egyptians.
target_text: ra lalau nganga'a hia yusuf mei leo. aa a'ari na sèra ra'a mei leo. dhèu sab'a dhèu masir sèra, ra'a ètu mei rèngu mesa ra. lula dhèu masir sèra madenge ladhe madhèdi ra'a pa'èci dènge dhèu ibrani.

source_text: and they sit before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the young one according to his youth, and the men wonder one at another;
target_text: kapala urusan èèna ator sèna ka a'ari yusuf sèra, madhèdi patangara dènge yusuf. na ator hia si madhèdi mulai nèti a'a uru, padhutu-dhutu toke ari ra dhu limuri. ropa ra ladhe rèdhi j'ara madhèdi sèmi èèna, ra malaa.

source_text: and he lifts up gifts from before him to them, and the gift of benjamin is five hands more than the gifts of all of them; and they drink, indeed, they drink abundantly with him.
target_text: yusuf pua dhèu sab'a sèra, bagi nganga'a nèti mei nèngu, hia a'ari na sèra. aa'i-aa'i ra abhu nganga'a dhu ae sama. dhoka benyamin di abhu ae risi a'a na si lèmi hari. ka ra'a-rinu d'ai bècu.

source_text: and he commands him who is over his house, saying, fill the bags of the men with food, as they are able to carry, and put the money of each in the mouth of his bag;
target_text: ra'a-rinu rara hèia, yusuf paholo dènge kapala urusan na, aku nèngu na, ssst! èu lamu isi are asa d'ara karo dhèu sèi, papènu d'ai hèb'a. èle èèna na, èu tao hari doi ra, asa d'ara karo ra èci-èci.

source_text: and my cup, the silver cup, you put in the mouth of the bag of the young one, and his grain-money; and he does according to the word of joseph which he has spoken.
target_text: aa more moo hualaa pudhi ja'a èèna, ho tao asa d'ara hèb'a karo ari ra dhu limuri èèna. ka na la'e tao madhutu lii paredha yusuf.

source_text: the morning is bright, and the men have been sent away, they and their donkeys-
target_text: asa bèli d'ara cika lii sa, yusuf hia si lèpa. rèti nganga'a dènge keled'ei rèngu.

source_text: they have gone out of the city-they have not gone far off-and joseph has said to him who is over his house, rise, pursue after the men; and you have overtaken them, and you have said to them: why have you repaid evil for good?
target_text: ra lasi dhae kaj'èu mèka nèti d'ara kota, ka yusuf paredha kapala urusan, peka na, èu karohe lamu magèla si. ladhe paraga dènge si, èu peka sèmi ne'e: ‘nga tao ka miu pake d'ara aapa sèmi èèna mi ai g'ana dhèu aae? miu b'ala babe'a na dènge tatao karehe sèmi ne'e!

source_text: is this not that with which my lord drinks? and he observes diligently with it; you have done evil in that which you have done.
target_text: nga tao ka, miu mana'u mèti moo hualaa pudhi na? miu me'a boe, do? mèdha èèna na, na pake boe ho dhoka ninu di! te ngaa biasa na pake ho ne'a tasamia dènge mamuri dhèu. èèna, mèdha sogo-tagu! tatao miu ne, mema seli-kolane! '

source_text: and he overtakes them, and speaks to them these words,
target_text: èle èèna ka, kapala urusan èèna la'e magèle si toke abhu. ropa na raga si, hèia na peka sèmi ngaa dhu yusuf moa èèna.

source_text: and they say to him, why does my lord speak according to these words? far be it from your servants to do according to this word;
target_text: ka ra bari ne, aku rèngu na, ama peka ngaa èèna? ji'i subha. ji'i se'e bisa boe tao karehe sèmi èèna!

source_text: behold, the money which we found in the mouth of our bags we brought back to you from the land of canaan, and how do we steal from the house of your lord silver or gold?
target_text: ama, èu me'a era, si ma? doi-doi ca hari sa, dhu ètu d'ara karo ji'i sèra, ji'i hia hari le sa ama, to? tasamia ka ji'i bisa mana'u hualaa iia do hualaa pudhi ètu d'ara èmu dhèu kapai èèna! bisa boe!

source_text: with whomsoever of your servants it is found, he has died, and we also are to my lord for servants.
target_text: ama parisa la! ladhe abhu mèdha èèna ètu d'ara karo cee, na huku pamadhe ne! aa hud'i laa, ji'i dhu leo se'e, j'aj'i ènu èu.

source_text: and he says, now also, according to your words, so it is; he with whom it is found becomes my servant, and you are acquitted;
target_text: hèia kapala urusan na dhaa, peka na, aad'o! sèmi ne'e. ladhe abhu moo èèna ètu cee, na dhoka nèngu di j'aj'i ènu ja'a. miu dhu leo lèpa.

source_text: and they hurry and take down each his bag to the earth, and each opens his bag;
target_text: ra papuru ka karo sèra. ka ra bhoke dènge.

source_text: and he searches-at the eldest he has begun, and at the youngest he has completed-and the cup is found in the bag of benjamin;
target_text: hèia kapala urusan èèna parisa karo sèra èci-èci, mulai nèti karo unu a'a na, toke d'ai ari limuri tèka. ka nèdhi moo èèna, ètu d'ara karo benyamin.

source_text: and they tear their garments, and each loads his donkey, and they return to the city.
target_text: rèdhi sèmi èèna hèia, d'ara a'a na sèra j'èra ma'ète mae-mae sène. hèia ra paca'e hari ka karo deo sa asa dedha keled'ei, ka ra lèpa hari asa d'ara kota.

source_text: and judah and his brothers come to the house of joseph, and he is yet there, and they fall to the earth before him;
target_text: ropa ra d'ai èmu yusuf, na ètu èmu era. hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha na.

source_text: and joseph says to them, what is this deed that you have done? have you not known that a man like me diligently observes?
target_text: yusuf jèka si, aku nèngu na, he! nga tao ka miu tao ne'e mi ja'a! miu me'a boe, ja'a ne dhèu kapai ètu ne'e. ja'a pake na'i dhu bisa ke'a tatao dhèu, dhu dhèu leo re'a boe!

source_text: and judah says, what do we say to my lord? what do we speak? and how do we justify ourselves? god has found out the iniquity of your servants; behold, we are servants to my lord, both we, and he in whose hand the cup has been found;
target_text: hèia yahuda dhaa, aku nèngu na, irii! te ama lamatua pasabhoka kèna sasala èdhi. pe ji'i peka lii mia hari, ama? ji'i sili iisi sa mia hari? ladhe ama neo taha ari ji'i ne'e, na be'a risi, taha ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi. more ji'i aa'i-aa'i, j'aj'i mi ènu ama ka laa.

source_text: and he says, far be it from me to do this; the man in whose hand the cup has been found, he becomes my servant; and you, go up in peace to your father.
target_text: te ngaa yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o! abhu moo èèna ètu cee, na nèngu di dhu j'aj'i ènu ja'a. miu dhu leo, lèpa hari dènge mera-milu sa ama miu!

source_text: and judah comes near to him and says, o my lord, please let your servant speak a word in the ears of my lord, and do not let your anger burn against your servant-for you are as pharaoh.
target_text: hèia yahuda la'e padètu asa madha yusuf, ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ama wakil! ja'a ke'a koasa ama sama sèmi koasa dhèu aae! uru nèti èèna, ja'a manèngi ama baku nasa dènge ja'a. ja'a neo padhai lii ciki dènge ama.

source_text: my lord has asked his servants, saying, do you have a father or brother?
target_text: med'a na, ama karèi le ji'i, peka na, ‘ama miu, dènge ari miu dhu èci na, era do? '

source_text: and we say to my lord, we have a father, an aged one, and a child of old age, a little one; and his brother died, and he is left alone of his mother, and his father has loved him.
target_text: ka ji'i dhaa peka na, ‘ama ji'i heka d'ai seli le. aa ari ji'i dhu limuri èci. lod'o nara iisi ari ji'i ne'e, ama ji'i na heka le. ari ji'i dhu limuri ne'e dènge a'a d'èlu na èci, te ngaa na aad'o heka. ina ra madhe le. ka di nèngu ka mesa na. nèti èèna ka, ama ji'i ne sue ne titu kèna! '

source_text: and you say to your servants, bring him down to me, and i set my eye on him;
target_text: ka ama pua ho ji'i ngèti ari ji'i na mai, sèna ka ama nèdhi ne.

source_text: and we say to my lord, the youth is not able to leave his father, when he has left his father, then he has died;
target_text: ka ji'i dhaa na, ‘ana èèna, bisa boe tèke eele ama na mesa na. ladhe na tèke eele, na ama ji'i na tatu madhe dènge kèna. '

source_text: and you say to your servants, if your young brother does not come down with you, you do not add to see my face.
target_text: hèia ama dhaa na, ‘ladhe miu mèti boe ari miu na, baku mi pad'elo hari rèhu mi sa ne'e. '

source_text: and it comes to pass, that we have come up to your servant my father, that we declare to him the words of my lord;
target_text: èle èèna ka, ji'i lèpa. d'ai nèi ka, ji'i lolo lii dhu mu moa sèra dènge ama ji'i.

source_text: and our father says, return, buy for us a little food,
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu, nganga'a ji'i èla. hèia ama ji'i pua hari ji'i mai hèli nganga'a sa masir ne'e.

source_text: and we say, we are not able to go down; if our young brother is with us, then we have gone down; for we are not able to see the man's face, and our young brother not with us.
target_text: te ngaa ji'i dhaa na, ‘ama, ee! ji'i la'a heka sa nèi. te ai g'ana dhèu aae na dhu moa le, aku nèngu na, ladhe ji'i ngèti boe ari ji'i dhu limuri na, bisa heka ji'i pad'elo rèhu sa nèi. de ladhe ari ji'i la'e hèi, na heka ji'i la'a kèna. '

source_text: and your servant my father says to us, you have known that my wife bore two to me,
target_text: ama ji'i peka hari, aku nèngu na, ‘miu me'a kahèi, si ma? dhèu èmu ja'a rahel èèna, ana na dhoka dua di.

source_text: and one goes out from me, and i say, surely he is torn-torn! and i have not seen him since;
target_text: ana uuru èèna, aad'o heka. ele boe badha hui na'e aa'i le. nèti èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi heka rèhu na toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: when you have taken also this from my presence, and harm has met him, then you have brought down my grey hairs with evil to sheol.
target_text: ladhe miu mèti hari ana limuri ne, ho sèmi na abhu j'aj'èra, èèna miu paj'èra ja'a dhèu heka ne'e. ladhe sèmi èèna na, ja'a madhe dènge kèna. '

source_text: and now, at my coming to your servant my father, and the youth not with us and his soul is bound up in his soul, then it has come to pass, when he sees that the youth is not, that he has died, and your servants have brought down the grey hairs of your servant our father with sorrow to sheol;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama, ladhe ja'a lèpa kèti boe dènge ari ji'i ne, ama ji'i madhe dènge kèna. te samanga na dhu pa'èki dènge ana ne'e di. dènge ètu d'ara haheka na ne'e, ladhe ji'i tao ne tabha j'èra, tatu na madhe dènge kèna.

source_text: for your servant obtained the youth by guarantee to my father, saying, if i do not bring him to you-then i have sinned against my father all the days.
target_text: ngaa hari, ja'a moa le mi ama ku, peka na, ‘ja'a ka dhu tago ana ne'e. ladhe ja'a kèti heka ana ne'e mai sa madha ama, ja'a ka tago sasala na, toke d'ai ja'a madhe. '

source_text: and now, please let your servant abide instead of the youth as a servant to my lord, and the youth goes up with his brothers,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e, ama wakil: hud'i laa ja'a ka pea mi ne'e gati nèngu, sèna ka ja'a j'aj'i ènu ama wakil. hia ne lèpa dènge a'a na si.

source_text: for how do i go up to my father, and the youth not with me? lest i look on the evil which finds my father.
target_text: ladhe ana ne'e la'e boe, ja'a bisa boe lèpa kahèi. d'ara ja'a la'e boe ladhe j'aj'èra ama ji'i toke madhe.

source_text: and joseph has not been able to refrain himself before all those standing by him, and he calls, put out every man from me; and no man has stood with him when joseph makes himself known to his brothers,
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare lii yahuda na, d'ara yusuf roe bhilu, toke taha nare boe ètu madha dhèu sab'a na sèra. nèti èèna ka, na hia ra lasi asa li'u, sèna ka mesa na di, dènge a'ari na ètu d'ara èmu. dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu bisa patadhe iisi na, mi a'ari na sèra.

source_text: and he gives forth his voice in weeping, and the egyptians hear, and the house of pharaoh hears.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a se'e kalua asa li'u, ka yusuf tangi dènge d'ara pèd'a. lii tangi na mèdhu, ka dhèu-dhèu masir ètu li'u sèra tadèngi kahèi. mesa boe dhèu ètu li'u sèra, te dhèu ètu èmu dhèu aae tadèngi kahèi.

source_text: and joseph says to his brothers, i am joseph, is my father yet alive? and his brothers have not been able to answer him, for they have been troubled at his presence.
target_text: ka yusuf peka mola-mola dènge a'ari na si, aku nèngu na, a'ari, ee! ja'a ne'e ka yusuf èèna! ama ku mamuri era, do? ropa tadèngi rare, a'a na sèra madha'u titu kèna. ra bisa heka bhoke hèb'a padhai lii ngaa èci sa.

source_text: and joseph says to his brothers, please come near to me, and they come near; and he says, i am your brother joseph, whom you sold into egypt;
target_text: hèia yusuf paroa si, peka na, mai ku padètu-dètu dènge ja'a. ka ara lasi padètu sa madha yusuf. ka na peka hari, ja'a ne, yusuf, dhu uru èèna, miu pahia eele asa masir ne'e.

source_text: and now, do not be grieved, nor let it be displeasing in your eyes that you sold me here, for god has sent me before you to preserve life.
target_text: miu se tare'a pahie eele ja'a. te ngaa mage miu madha'u, aa baku peka cee ka dhu sala. lula ama lamatua ka dhu hia uuru ja'a mai sa ne'e. ho dènge j'ara ne'e, na pake ja'a ho hia mamuri mi dhèu ae. sèna ka baku madhe manganga.

source_text: because these two years the famine is in the heart of the land, and yet five years remain in which there is neither plowing nor harvest;
target_text: rai manganga ne heka dua tèu kèna. lèmi tèu era. bèli-camèd'a dhèu tao heka oka-tedhe, sèla heka, aa abhu heka nganga'a hèru èj'i lai.

source_text: and god sends me before you, to place a remnant of you in the land, and to give life to you by a great escape;
target_text: dènge j'ara dhu èdhi te'a boe ne, ama lamatua hia ja'a mai asa ne'e uru nèti miu. sèna ka, miu dènge ana-èpu miu abhu mamuri.

source_text: and now, you have not sent me here, but god, and he sets me for a father to pharaoh, and for lord to all his house, and ruler over all the land of egypt.
target_text: de dhu lèke, nèti boe tatao miu ka ja'a d'ai era ne'e, te ngaa tatao ama lamatua di. nèngu ka dhu hia ja'a j'aj'i ai g'ana dhèu aae masir. ka ja'a j'aj'i mi kapala urusan ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae. abhu boe dhèu leo èci sa dhu kapai risi nèti ja'a.

source_text: hurry, and go up to my father, then you have said to him, thus said your son joseph: god has set me for lord to all egypt; come down to me, do not stay,
target_text: de miu lami ka lai-lai ne, ho peka lii padhai lii ja'a ne dènge ama ku, sèmi ne'e: ‘yusuf, ana ama ku, mamuri era! nèngu j'aj'i le dhèu kapai ètu rai masir. na manèngi ama ku la'e lai-lai asa nèi.

source_text: and you have dwelt in the land of goshen, and been near to me, you and your sons, and your son's sons, and your flock, and your herd, and all that you have,
target_text: ho èèna na, ama pea ètu rai gosen padètu dènge nèngu. era na be'a aa taleo. sèna ka ama bisa piara kahib'i-kalèbho, kahib'i-ka'ia dènge sapi aa'i-aa'i ra. aa na manèngi kahèi ho ama la'e dènge ana-èpu, dènge isi èmu, dènge mèdha-panyau, ho pea taruu mi nèi.

source_text: and i have nourished you there-for yet are five years of famine-lest you become poor, you and your household, and all that you have.
target_text: ladhe ama pea ètu gosen, nèngu ladhe-leru ama ètu nèi. te rai manganga lèmi tèu era. sèna ka na tenge j'ara ho ama dènge ana-èpu, aa dènge badha-manu bisa mamuri dènge be'a. '

source_text: and behold, your eyes are seeing, and the eyes of my brother benjamin, that it is my mouth which is speaking to you;
target_text: yusuf peka nare hèia, na padhai lii hari, peka na, miu unu mi mèdhi le, si? aa èu kahèi, benyamin. ja'a ne'e, tare'a-re'a yusuf.

source_text: and you have declared to my father all my glory in egypt, and all that you have seen, and you have hurried, and have brought down my father here.
target_text: de miu peka dènge ama èdhi, na, ja'a ne'e dènge koasa kapai titu kèna, ètu kabarai masir ne'e. aa lolo dènge ama, ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu miu mèdhi le ètu ne'e. ho èèna na, karohe mèti ama sa ne'e mai!

source_text: and he falls on the neck of his brother benjamin, and weeps, and benjamin has wept on his neck;
target_text: èle èèna ka, liku nare ari na benyamin, hèia dua ra tangi.

source_text: and he kisses all his brothers, and weeps over them; and afterward his brothers have spoken with him.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, na liku nare a'a na si èci-èci, ka na uu si. ka heka ra bani padhai lii dènge ne kèna.

source_text: and the sound has been heard in the house of pharaoh, saying, the brothers of joseph have come; and it is good in the eyes of pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants,
target_text: ropa dhèu aae dènge dhèu-dhèu kapai na sèra, tadèngi rare a'ari yusuf mai asa masir, ra karej'e kahèi.

source_text: and pharaoh says to joseph, say to your brothers, this you do: load your beasts, and go, enter the land of canaan,
target_text: ka dhèu aae peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ari! peka dènge a'ari èu sèra, ho hua ka nganga'a asa dedha keled'ei rèngu, sèna ka rèti sa kana'an.
