source_text: and take your father, and your households, and come to me, and i give to you the good of the land of egypt, and you eat the fat of the land.
target_text: aa peka dènge si, rèti ama mu dènge ana-èpu aa'i-aa'i, mai pea sa ne'e. d'ai ne'e, pe ja'a hia rèngu rai, era dhu hèu mèngi risi, sèna ka rèngu bisa mamuri nèti isi rai èèna.

source_text: indeed, you have been commanded: this you do, take for yourselves out of the land of egypt, wagons for your infants, and for your wives, and you have brought your father, and come;
target_text: aa hia rèti mema dènge kareta pèri-pèri nèti ne'e, ho sèna ka hua ana iiki-ana iiki dènge ama mu.

source_text: and your eye has no pity on your vessels, for the good of all the land of egypt is yours.
target_text: baku ra pangee mèdha-panyau dhu rèngu bisa boe nedhe rèti, te, ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a ètu rai masir ne, èèna na j'aj'i unu rèngu.

source_text: and the sons of israel do so, and joseph gives wagons to them by the command of pharaoh, and he gives to them provision for the way;
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka yusuf hia si kareta pèri-pèri bua, dènge parèko ra'a j'ara, sama sèmi lii paredha dhèu aae. aa a'ari na pa'èra ka, ho lèpa madhutu lii paredha dhèu aae.

source_text: to all of them has he given-to each changes of garments, and to benjamin he has given three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of garments;
target_text: ka yusuf hia si mèdha-papake dhu hiu, ca dhèu ca pasa. te ngaa benyamin, na hia doi iia tèlu ngasu, dènge mèdha-papake dhu hiu, lèmi pasa.

source_text: and to his father he has sent thus: ten donkeys carrying of the good things of egypt, and ten female donkeys carrying grain and bread, even food for his father for the way.
target_text: yusuf pa'adhu mèdha-panyau dhu be'a risi nèti masir hia ama na. rèngu hua mi dedha keled'ei canguru ngi'u. sèmi èèna kahèi, na hia are, roti, dènge nganga'a ae-ae, dhu j'aj'i parèko j'ara, lod'o dhu rèngu mulai pakèd'i nèti kana'an asa masir. nganga'a se, ra hua ètu dedha keled'ei dhu leo hari canguru ngi'u.

source_text: and he sends his brothers away, and they go; and he says to them, do not be angry in the way.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na hia si lèpa, aa na moa si, aku nèngu na, miu baku patao-palaha ètu talora j'ara, ee!

source_text: and they go up out of egypt, and come to the land of canaan, to their father jacob,
target_text: hèia ra pakèd'i ka lasi sa ama ra ètu kana'an.

source_text: and they declare to him, saying, joseph is yet alive, and that he is ruler over all the land of egypt; and his heart ceases, for he has not given credence to them.
target_text: d'ai nèi ka, ra lolo dènge ama ra, peka na, ama! ana mu yusuf na, dhu mamuri era di. na j'aj'i le dhèu kapai, ka na paredha ètu rai masir! yakob tadèngi hiu-hiu na, loo-loo sène, te na lèka boe.

source_text: and they speak to him all the words of joseph, which he has spoken to them, and he sees the wagons which joseph has sent to carry him away, and the spirit of their father jacob lives;
target_text: te ngaa ropa na tadèngi nare lii lolo rèngu sèra, aa na ladhe nèdhi kareta dhu yusuf pa'adhu mai ho hua ne asa masir, heka na lèka kèna.

source_text: and israel says, enough! my son joseph is yet alive; i go and see him before i die.
target_text: hèia na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, hea! de ana ja'a dhu mamuri era di! ja'a heka karej'e kèna. ja'a hud'i laku kèdhi ku ne, heka ja'a madhe dènge karej'e kèna.

source_text: and israel journeys, and all that he has, and comes to beer-sheba, and sacrifices sacrifices to the god of his father isaac;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob si pa'èra ka mèdha ra, ka ra pakèd'i nèti kana'an. ropa ra d'ai rae barseba, ka na roro badha tao korban hia lamatua, dhu uru na ama na isak mangaj'i.

source_text: and god speaks to israel in visions of the night and says, jacob, jacob; and he says, here i am.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka na nii. ètu d'ara nii ne'e, na tadèngi na ama lamatua paroa ne, peka na, yakob! yakob! èu kèd'i ho nanene ku la! hèia na dhaa, peka na, nga tao, ama?

source_text: and he says, i am god, god of your father, do not be afraid of going down to egypt, for i set you there for a great nation;
target_text: ka lamatua peka na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu ama mu mangaj'i nèti uru ka. mage èu madha'u kahèi lamu masir. te èèna na, ja'a tao ana-èpu èu j'aj'i suku kapai ètu rai nèi.

source_text: i go down with you to egypt, and i also certainly bring you up, and joseph puts his hand on your eyes.
target_text: ja'a laku hèi masir sama-sama dènge èu. ho ladhe èèna na, ja'a kahèi dhu kèti hari ana-èpu èu lèpa asa rai kana'an ne'e. ropa èu madhe, na, ana mu yusuf madhèdi ètu baboa èu.

source_text: and jacob rises from beer-sheba, and the sons of israel carry away their father jacob, and their infants, and their wives, in the wagons which pharaoh has sent to carry him,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob dènge ana-ana na sèra, lasi taruu tèke eele rae barseba. ra paca'e ne dènge bhèni-ana iiki na asa kareta sèra dhu dhèu aae masir pa'adhu hia si.

source_text: and they take their livestock, and their goods which they have acquired in the land of canaan, and come into egypt-jacob, and all his seed with him, his sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, indeed, all his seed he brought with him into egypt.
target_text: rèti aa'i mèu-mèu mèdha-panyau dènge badha-manu dhu j'aj'i kakaja rèngu ètu rai kana'an. hèia yakob dènge ana-èpu na, bhèni-mone aa'i-aa'i ra pakèd'i ka lasi rai masir.

source_text: and these are the names of the sons of israel who are coming into egypt: jacob and his sons, jacob's firstborn, reuben.
target_text: ana-èpu yakob dhu madhutu lasi asa masir, nuka se'e: ruben, ana uuru na.

source_text: and sons of reuben: enoch, and phallu, and hezron, and carmi.
target_text: ana-ana na ka: henok, palu, hesron dènge karmi.

source_text: and sons of simeon: jemuel, and jamin, and ohad, and jachin, and zohar, and shaul son of the canaanite.
target_text: simeon, dènge ana-ana na: yemuel, yamin, ohat, yakin, dènge sohar. dènge saul kahèi, ana na nèti dhèu èmu na bhèni kana'an.

source_text: and sons of levi: gershon, kohath, and merari.
target_text: lewi, dènge ana-ana na: gerson, kehat, dènge merari.

source_text: and sons of judah: er, and onan, and shelah, and perez, and zerah and er and onan die in the land of canaan. and sons of perez are hezron and hamul.
target_text: yahuda, dènge ana-ana na: sela, peres, dènge sera. ana yahuda dhu leo, er dènge onan, madhe le ètu kana'an. na nèti dènge ana-ana peres, hesron dènge hamul.

source_text: and sons of issachar: tola, and phuvah, and job, and shimron.
target_text: isaskar, dènge ana-ana na: tola, pua, ayub, dènge simron.

source_text: and sons of zebulun: sered, and elon, and jahleel.
target_text: sebulon, dènge ana-ana na: seret, elon, dènge jahleel.

source_text: these are sons of leah whom she bore to jacob in padan-aram, and his daughter dinah; all the persons of his sons and his daughters are thirty-three.
target_text: rèngu se'e, ana-ana nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na lea, lod'o rèngu pea ètu mesopotamia. ana bhèni rèngu èci, ngara na dina. ana-èpu nèti yakob dènge lea, aa'i-aa'i ra tèlu nguru tèlu dhèu.

source_text: and sons of gad: ziphion, and haggi, shuni, and ezbon, eri, and arodi, and areli.
target_text: aa yakob abhu ana-ana dènge dhèu èmu dhu leo hari. nuka: gad, dènge ana-ana na: sifion, hagi, suni, esbon, eri, arodi dènge areli.

source_text: and sons of asher: jimnah, and ishuah, and isui, and beriah, and their sister serah. and sons of beriah: heber and malchiel.
target_text: aser, dènge ana-ana na: yimna, yiswa, yiswi, beria, dènge ana hèni ra èci, ngara na sera. beria, dènge ana le kahèi: heber dènge malkiel.

source_text: these are sons of zilpah, whom laban gave to his daughter leah, and she bears these to jacob-sixteen persons.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, canguru èna dhèu. ana-èpu nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na silpa. silpa ne'e ka dhu laban hia j'aj'i ènu nèti lea, dhèu èmu uru yakob na.

source_text: sons of rachel, jacob's wife: joseph and benjamin.
target_text: aa ana-ana nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na bhèni leo hari, ngara na rahel, nuka: yusuf dènge benyamin.

source_text: and born to joseph in the land of egypt whom asenath daughter of poti-pherah, priest of on, has borne to him are manasseh and ephraim.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf leo le dènge asnat ètu masir. ama asnat èèna, ama agama ètu kota on. ngara na, potifera. ana-ana yusuf dènge asnat: efraim dènge manase.

source_text: and sons of benjamin: belah, and becher, and ashbel, gera, and naaman, ehi, and rosh, muppim, and huppim, and ard.
target_text: benyamin madhutu hèi lasi masir dènge ana-ana na: bela, beker, asibel, gera, naaman, ehi, ros, mupim, hupim dènge aret.

source_text: these are sons of rachel, who were born to jacob; all the persons are fourteen.
target_text: ana-èpu yakob dènge dhèu èmu na rahel, canguru èpa dhèu.

source_text: and sons of dan: hushim.
target_text: dhèu èmu yakob èci hari, ngara na bilha. ana-ana ra, dan, dènge naftali. ana dan, ngara na husim.

source_text: and sons of naphtali: jahzeel, and guni, and jezer, and shillem.
target_text: ana nèti naftali: yasel, guni, yeser dènge silem.

source_text: these are sons of bilhah, whom laban gave to his daughter rachel; and she bears these to jacob-all the persons are seven.
target_text: yakob dènge dhèu èmu na bilha, ana-èpu rèngu dhèu pidhu. bilha ne, ènu nèti rahel, dhu na abhu nèti ama na laban.

source_text: all the persons who are coming to jacob to egypt, coming out of his thigh, apart from the wives of jacob's sons, all the persons are sixty-six.
target_text: de ana-èpu yakob dhu lasi masir, aa'i-aa'i ra dhèu èna nguru èna dhèu. se'e se, ige mèka dènge dhèu èmu nèti ana-ana nèngu sèra.

source_text: and the sons of joseph who have been born to him in egypt are two persons. all the persons of the house of jacob who are coming into egypt are seventy.
target_text: ladhe tabha dènge ana-ana yusuf dhu ina na nara iisi ètu masir dhèu dua, na yakob dènge ana-èpu aa'i-aa'i ra si, pidhu nguru dhèu.

source_text: and judah he has sent before him to joseph, to direct before him to goshen, and they come into the land of goshen;
target_text: ropa ra dètu dènge masir, yakob pua yahuda la'e uuru, paroa yusuf ho mai paraga dènge ne ètu gosen. ropa ra d'ai gosen,

source_text: and joseph harnesses his chariot, and goes up to meet his father israel, to goshen, and appears to him, and falls on his neck, and weeps on his neck again;
target_text: yusuf ca'e nare kareta na, mai paraga dènge ama na. ropa ra paraga, liku nare ama na, ka na tangi nèbhu bia.

source_text: and israel says to joseph, let me die this time, after my seeing your face, for you are yet alive.
target_text: hèia yakob padhai lii dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! ja'a unu ku kèdhi le èu. aa ja'a ke'a le èu mamuri era. de ladhe ja'a madhe èèna ka oo, ngaa-ngaa tao heka.

source_text: and joseph says to his brothers, and to the house of his father, i go up, and declare to pharaoh, and say to him, my brothers, and the house of my father who are in the land of canaan have come to me;
target_text: ka yusuf peka dènge a'ari na aa'i-aa'i, peka na, ja'a laku peka ku dènge dhèu aae, sèna ka ne'a na a'ari ja'a mai le nèti kana'an.

source_text: and the men are feeders of a flock, for they have been men of livestock; and their flock, and their herd, and all that they have, they have brought.
target_text: aa, pe ja'a peka kahèi dènge ne, miu biasa ani kahib'i-kalèbho dènge sapi. nèti èèna ka, miu mèti dènge badha-manu dènge mèdha-panyau miu nèti kana'an.

source_text: and it has come to pass, when pharaoh calls for you and has said, what are your works?
target_text: de ladhe dhèu aae paroa miu, ho na karèi miu biasa sab'a ngaa,

source_text: that you have said, your servants have been men of livestock from our youth, even until now, both we and our fathers, in order that you may dwell in the land of goshen, for the abomination of the egyptians is everyone feeding a flock.
target_text: na, miu dhaa ne peka na, miu se aa'i-aa'i mi nèti ana iiki ka mai piara badha, sama sèmi bèi-baki ji'i. sèna ka na pua miu pea ètu rai gosen. yusuf peka sèmi èèna, lula dhèu masir madenge pea pa'èci dènge ana madhutu badha.

source_text: and joseph comes and declares it to pharaoh, and says, my father, and my brothers, and their flock, and their herd, and all they have, have come from the land of canaan, and behold, they are in the land of goshen. and out of his brothers he has taken five men, and sets them before pharaoh;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf dènge a'ari na dhèu lèmi, lasi paraga dènge dhèu aae. d'ai madha dhèu aae, ka yusuf patadha si dènge dhèu aae, ka na peka na, ama dhèu aae! ama ku dènge a'ari ku mai le nèti kana'an. rèngu mai dènge kahib'i-kalèbho, sapi, dènge mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra. nuka ra ètu rai gosen nèi.

source_text: and pharaoh says to his brothers, what are your works? and they say to pharaoh, your servants are feeders of a flock, both we and our fathers;
target_text: dhèu aae karèi si, aku nèngu na, sasab'a miu ngaa? ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i se, ana madhutu badha, sama sèmi bèi-baki ji'i sèra.

source_text: and they say to pharaoh, we have come to sojourn in the land, for there is no pasture for the flock which your servants have, for the famine in the land of canaan is grievous; and now, please let your servants dwell in the land of goshen.
target_text: limuri ne'e, ètu rai ji'i kana'an, hèru hadhu madhera, ka nganga'a dènge j'u'u tèdhi heka. nèti èèna ka, ji'i mai taha asa kabarai ne'e. ngèti dènge badha-manu ji'i. de ji'i manèngi ama dhèu aae, ho hia ji'i pea ètu rai gosen, sèna ka ji'i piara badha ji'i ètu nèi.

source_text: and pharaoh speaks to joseph, saying, your father and your brothers have come to you:
target_text: hèia dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf sèmi ne'e: ama mu dènge a'ari mu ètu ne'e le.

source_text: the land of egypt is before you; cause your father and your brothers to dwell in the best of the land-they dwell in the land of goshen, and if you have known, and there are among them men of ability, then you have set them as heads over the livestock i have.
target_text: de hud'i laa rèngu tao kabarai ne'e, sama sèmi kabarai rèngu. madhutu kake'a ja'a, gosen èèna era dhu be'a risi nèti era leo ètu rai masir ne'e. de be'a risi rèngu pea ètu èèna ka la. aa ladhe rèngu cee dhu ladhe-leru badha dènge hua iia, na ja'a hia badha ja'a ho na piara si ètu èèna.

source_text: and joseph brings in his father jacob, and causes him to stand before pharaoh; and jacob blesses pharaoh.
target_text: èle èèna hèia, yusuf patadhe ama na dènge dhèu aae. ka yakob manèngi mi ama lamatua, sèna ka hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu aae.

source_text: and pharaoh says to jacob, how many are the days of the years of your life?
target_text: dhèu aae karèi yakob, aku nèngu na, ama umur pèri tèu kèna?

source_text: and jacob says to pharaoh, the days of the years of my sojournings are one hundred and thirty years; few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, and they have not reached the days of the years of the life of my fathers, in the days of their sojournings.
target_text: yakob dhaa, umur ja'a cangasu tèlu nguru tèu kèna, te ngaa ja'a pea boe mi ca era sa. bèi-baki ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe pakasame dènge rèngu, na umur ja'a kura nèti rèngu. te ngaa mamuri ja'a pènu dènge j'aj'èra.

source_text: and jacob blesses pharaoh, and goes out from before pharaoh.
target_text: hèia yakob manèngi parmisi neo lèpa. te ngaa kalua mèka nèti d'ara èmu, na manèngi hari ca tèka mi lamatua ho sèna ka hia berkat mi dhèu aae.

source_text: and joseph settles his father and his brothers, and gives a possession to them in the land of egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of rameses, as pharaoh commanded;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf pad'elo era pea hia a'ari na si ètu gosen, madhutu lii pua dhèu aae deo na. era èèna be'a titu kèna. ra pangare era èèna ‘rameses'. ka ama na dènge a'ari na sèra pea taruu ètu èèna.

source_text: and joseph nourishes his father, and his brothers, and all the house of his father with bread, according to the mouth of the infants.
target_text: hèia yusuf sadia nganga'a hia ama na, a'ari na, dènge ana dhèu èmu ra, aa'i-aa'i ra, nèti dhèu kapai toke d'ai ana susu.

source_text: and there is no bread in all the land, for the famine is very grievous, and the land of egypt and the land of canaan are feeble because of the famine;
target_text: taa èèna, rai manganga titu kèna, tèdhi boe nganga'a ca lamusi sa ètu mia-mia. nèti masir toke kana'an, dhèu-dhèu manganga roe ca palèpa, taga nèti ra'a-rinu heka. dhèu bisa heka sab'a ngaa-ngaa, lula manganga titu kèna.

source_text: and joseph gathers all the silver that is found in the land of egypt and in the land of canaan, for the grain that they are buying, and joseph brings the silver into the house of pharaoh.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu nèti d'ara rae-rae ètu masir, sèmi èèna kahèi dhèu-dhèu nèti d'ara rae-rae ètu kana'an, mai hèli nganga'a ètu yusuf. doi-doi dhu na sèmi sèra, na pakaboko aa'i ka, la'e tèke asa èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: and the silver is consumed out of the land of egypt and out of the land of canaan, and all the egyptians come to joseph, saying, give bread to us-why do we die before you, though the money has ceased?
target_text: tèu èèna, èla aa'i doi dhèu masir dènge dhèu kana'an ka ra bisa heka hèli nganga'a. hèia ra mai roma iisi mi yusuf, aku rèngu na, ama wakil! hia ku ji'i nganga'a ciki la, sèna ka ji'i baku madhe manganga. te doi ji'i, èla aa'i mèu-mèu le.

source_text: and joseph says, give your livestock; and i give to you for your livestock, if the money has ceased.
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, peka na, ladhe tare'a doi miu aad'o heka, na sèmi ne'e ka la! mèti badha miu, ho pasilu dènge nganga'a.

source_text: and they bring in their livestock to joseph, and joseph gives to them bread, for the horses, and for the livestock of the flock, and for the livestock of the herd, and for the donkeys; and he tends them with bread, for all their livestock, during that year.
target_text: ka dhèu se'e mai pasilu badha ra dènge nganga'a. badha-badha sèmi jara, kahib'i-ka'ia, kahib'i-kalèbho, sapi, dènge keled'ei. lula tèu èèna, yusuf dhu moa tèke le.

source_text: and that year is finished, and they come to him on the second year, and say to him, we do not hide from my lord, that since the money has been finished, and possession of the livestock is to my lord, there has not been left before my lord except our bodies, and our ground;
target_text: tèu mai na, rèngu mai hari sa madha yusuf, ka ra peka, ama wakil, ee! ji'i peka tare'a-re'a kèna. doi ji'i dènge badha ji'i ama pasilu aa'i-aa'i le. limuri ne'e, ji'i dènge heka ngaa-ngaa. dhu ètu ji'i dhodhoka ngi'u dènge rai ji'i di.

source_text: why do we die before your eyes, both we and our ground? buy us and our ground for bread, and we and our ground are servants to pharaoh; and give seed, and we live, and do not die, and the ground is not desolate.
target_text: baku tèke eele ji'i madhe manganga. te ladhe ji'i madhe na, cee ka dhu sab'a oka-tedhe se'e? de hua iia, ama wakil more ji'i, ho j'aj'i ènu mu. aa more aa'i rai ji'i kahèi. pe, èèna na, ama hia hini ho ji'i sèla hia ama. gaji dènge kab'ua rai ji'i, ama pasilu dènge nganga'a. sad'i ji'i baku madhe manganga.

source_text: and joseph buys all the ground of egypt for pharaoh, for the egyptians have each sold his field, for the famine has been severe on them, and the land becomes pharaoh's;
target_text: lula rai manganga ae, ka dhèu masir pahie aa'i rai rèngu. nèti èèna ka, yusuf hèli nara aa'i rai ètu masir j'aj'i mi pusaka dhèu aae.

source_text: as for the people, he has removed them to cities from the one end of the border of egypt even to its other end.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, dhèu masir aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i ènu nèti dhèu aae.

source_text: only the ground of the priests he has not bought, for the priests have a portion from pharaoh, and they have eaten their portion which pharaoh has given to them, therefore they have not sold their ground.
target_text: dhoka rai unu ama agama sèra di, yusuf hèli nare boe, te dhèu aae hia taruu dhèu se nganga'a na. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se pahie boe rai rèngu.

source_text: and joseph says to the people, behold, i have bought you today and your ground for pharaoh; behold, seed for you, and you have sown the ground,
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf peka dènge ana kabarai sèra, aku nèngu na, naa! miu j'aj'i le ènu nèti dhèu aae. ja'a hèli kore aa'i le, rai miu hia dhèu aae. de mere hini se'e ho lami sèla ka mi dedha rai sèra.

source_text: and it has come to pass in the increases, that you have given a fifth to pharaoh, and four of the parts are for yourselves, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for those who are in your houses, and for food for your infants.
target_text: ladhe miu puu-g'ètu na, bagi mi lèmi. ho ca pala hia dhèu aae. aa èpa pala sèra, miu tao hini dènge mi pake mi'a-minu dènge a'ari miu.

source_text: and they say, you have revived us; we find grace in the eyes of my lord, and have been servants to pharaoh;
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama pamamuri ji'i le, de ji'i manèngi tarima kasi. ji'i neo j'aj'i ènu nèti dhèu aae.

source_text: and joseph sets it for a statute to this day, concerning the ground of egypt, that pharaoh has a fifth; only the ground of the priests alone has not become pharaoh's.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yusuf tao madha j'ara ne'e, j'aj'i ad'a kabarai ètu masir. ladhe ra puru rare are na, ra bagi mi lèmi pala. ho ca pala rèngu hia mi dhèu aae. aa èpa pala rèngu abhu. te ngaa rai ama agama sèra, dhèu aae hèli boe. ad'a èèna, ra pake taruu.

source_text: and israel dwells in the land of egypt, in the land of goshen, and they have possession in it, and are fruitful, and multiply exceedingly;
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, dhèu isra'el pea taruu ka ètu masir, ètu rai gosen. ra j'aj'i dhèu kaja, aa ana-èpu rèngu asa tabha ae.

source_text: and jacob lives in the land of egypt seventeen years, and the days of jacob, the years of his life, are one hundred and forty-seven years.
target_text: ètu masir, yakob mamuri hari canguru pidhu tèu era. j'aj'i umur yakob aa'i-aa'i ra, cangasu èpa nguru pidhu tèu.

source_text: and the days of israel are near to die, and he calls for his son, for joseph, and says to him, now if i have found grace in your eyes, please put your hand under my thigh, and you have done kindness and truth with me; please do not bury me in egypt,
target_text: lod'o dètu na madhe èèna, na paroa yusuf, ka na padhai lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, ana yusuf! ja'a rasa na, mamuri ja'a madhera heka. nèbhu heka, lamatua paroa ja'a lèpa kèna. èèna ka ja'a manèngi sèna ka ladhe èu sue ja'a, èu subha sèna ka baku padhane ja'a ètu rai masir ne'e.

source_text: and i have lain with my fathers, and you have carried me out of egypt, and buried me in their burying-place. and he says, i do according to your word;
target_text: èu hud'i mèti ngi'u aae ja'a, ho padhane asa era ro'a bèi-baki èdhi. ho èu padhane ja'a ètu èèna. ne'e ne, dad'èi d'ara ama. ka yusuf dhaa ne, aku nèngu na, be'a ama! ladhe dad'èi ama ku kèna, na ja'a madhutu.

source_text: and he says, swear to me; and he swears to him, and israel bows himself on the head of the bed.
target_text: ka yakob padhai lii hari, peka na, de ladhe sèmi èèna, èu hud'i subha uuru ku, ho ke'a na èu madhutu dad'èi ama. hèia yusuf subha madhutu dad'èi yakob. ka yakob patitu kètu urutuu ètu dedha era j'unu na, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: and it comes to pass, after these things, that one says to joseph, behold, your father is sick; and he takes his two sons with him, manasseh and ephraim.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu lasi peka dènge yusuf na, ama na pèd'a aae. hèia la'e nèti dènge ana na, efraim dènge manase, sèna ka lasi ladhe baki ra yakob.

source_text: and one declares it to jacob and says, behold, your son joseph is coming to you; and israel strengthens himself, and sits on the bed.
target_text: ropa yakob tadèngi yusuf si mai le, ka na pakaseti madhèdi.

source_text: and jacob says to joseph, god almighty has appeared to me, in luz, in the land of canaan, and blesses me,
target_text: hèia na padhai lii dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ana yusuf, ee! ama lamatua dhu dènge koasa kapai risi na, uru èèna, na pad'elo le iisi na dènge ja'a ètu rae lus, ètu rai kana'an. ètu nèi, na moa tèke mi ja'a.

source_text: and says to me, behold, i am making you fruitful, and have multiplied you, and given you for an assembly of peoples, and given this land to your seed after you, a continuous possession.
target_text: na padhai lii, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia ana-èpu èu j'aj'i ae, ho rèngu j'aj'i suku dhu kapai. rai ne'e ne, ja'a hia j'aj'i unu rèngu, ho j'aj'i pusaka ra toke d'ai rai-haha èle. '

source_text: and now, your two sons, who are born to you in the land of egypt, before my coming to you to egypt, they are mine; ephraim and manasseh, as reuben and simeon, they are mine;
target_text: aa ana èu efraim dènge manase èèna, hak rèngu sèmi ne'e ka: lod'o dhu ja'a d'ai masir na, mere iisi le rèngu dua ra. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a tao rèngu sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a, sama sèmi ruben dènge simeon.

source_text: and your family which you have begotten after them are yours; by the name of their brothers they are called in their inheritance.
target_text: aa ladhe bèli-camèd'a èu abhu hari ana, na èèna di unu èu kèna. ja'a tao boe rèngu sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a. pe pusaka ra, rèngu abhu nèti a'a ra, efraim dènge manase.

source_text: and i-in my coming in from padan-aram rachel has died by me in the land of canaan, in the way, while yet a distance of land to enter ephrata, and i bury her there in the way of ephrata, which is beth-lehem.
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka èdhi sanèd'e ina mu rahel. lod'o ji'i mai nèti mesopotamia asa kana'an, d'ai talora j'ara, ina mu madhe ropa nara iisi aa'i. èèna na, ji'i dètu rae efrata ètu rai kana'an. lod'o èèna, ja'a susa d'ai seli. ka ja'a padhane ne ètu sebhe j'ara la'e asa rae efrata. limuri ne, rae èèna ra gati ngara na betlehem.

source_text: and israel sees the sons of joseph and says, who are these?
target_text: ropa yakob padhai lii nare sèmi èèna hèia, na boti kètu na, ladhe nèdhi ana-ana yusuf ètu èèna. hèia na karèi yusuf, aku nèngu na, se'e se, ana cee?

source_text: and joseph says to his father, they are my sons, whom god has given to me in this place; and he says, please bring them to me, and i bless them.
target_text: ka yusuf dhaa, se'e, ana dhu ama lamatua hia ja'a ètu masir. yakob peka hari, ladhe sèmi èèna, na hia ra mai padètu dènge ja'a, ho ja'a manèngi ama lamatua hia si mèngi-nale.

source_text: and the eyes of israel have been heavy from age-he is unable to see; and he brings them near to him, and he kisses them and cleaves to them;
target_text: yakob heka le, aa musi madha na ahu le. na ladhe nèdhi be'a heka. hèia yusuf nèti ana na sèra padètu asa madha yakob, ka na liku nare si, aa na uu si dua ra.

source_text: and israel says to joseph, i had not thought possible to see your face, and behold, god has also showed me your seed.
target_text: ka na peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a pangee na, ja'a bisa heka kèdhi rèhu èu. te ngaa ama lamatua, tao risi eele nèti ngaa dhu ja'a ngee, toke ja'a bisa kèdhi ana-ana èu kahèi.

source_text: and joseph brings them out from between his knees, and bows himself on his face to the earth;
target_text: hèia yusuf hari eele ana na dhèu dua sèra nèti madha yakob, ka na patitu kètu urutuu na, aa na pacud'u rèhu na d'ai rai, ètu madha ama na.

source_text: and joseph takes them both, ephraim in his right hand toward israel's left, and manasseh in his left toward israel's right, and brings them near to him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf kèd'i. na nare ana na dhèu dua sèra, ka na hia ra titu padètu-dètu dènge ama na. na patitu ana uuru na manase, re bèka g'ana yakob. aa ana ka dua, efraim, re bèka kariu yakob.

source_text: and israel puts out his right hand and places it on the head of ephraim, who is the younger, and his left hand on the head of manasseh; he has guided his hands wisely, for manasseh is the firstborn.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yakob soro ai na neo manèngi mèngi-nale hia ana dua sèra, na soro ai g'ana na mi kètu efraim, aa ai kariu mi kètu manase.

source_text: and he blesses joseph and says, god, before whom my fathers abraham and isaac habitually walked: god who is feeding me from my being to this day:
target_text: ka na manèngi ama lamatua hia berkat mi yusuf, peka na, baki mu isak, dènge ama na abraham, dua ra madhutu taruu dad'èi ama lamatua. ama lamatua ladhe-leru ja'a kahèi, nèti ana ngèru toke d'ai deo ne'e ne.

source_text: the messenger who is redeeming me from all evil blesses the youths, and my name is called on them, and the name of my fathers abraham and isaac; and they increase into a multitude in the midst of the land.
target_text: na pakaj'èu ja'a nèti rupa-rupa sasusa. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka na hia mèngi-nale mi ana èu se'e, dènge ana-èpu ra. aa ladhe ra manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, ra bhèlu boe ale kolongara baki abraham, kolongara isak, aa kolongara ja'a, sèna ka ana-èpu rèngu asa bèba-kacanga, ho j'aj'i kapai ètu rai-haha ne'e.

source_text: and joseph sees that his father sets his right hand on the head of ephraim, and it is wrong in his eyes, and he supports the hand of his father to turn it aside from off the head of ephraim to the head of manasseh;
target_text: te ngaa ropa yusuf ladhe nèdhi ama na tao ai g'ana na mi kètu efraim, hèia kèpe nare ai ama na, ho tao sa kètu a'a na manase.

source_text: and joseph says to his father, not so, my father, for this is the firstborn; set your right hand on his head.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ama na, ama, ee! baku tao sèmi èèna. nèngu ne, ari efraim. nèngu ana limuri. de ai g'ana ama hud'i tao sa kètu a'a na manase. lula èèna hak ana uuru.

source_text: and his father refuses and says, i have known, my son, i have known; he also becomes a people, and he also is great, and yet, his young brother is greater than he, and his seed is the fullness of the nations;
target_text: te ngaa ama na yakob d'èi boe. ka na peka na, ana, ee! ja'a ke'a. ladhe èèna na, manase j'aj'i èra, aa ana-èpu na tabha ae, ho j'aj'i suku kapai. te ngaa ari na efraim èèna, bèli-camèd'a kapai risi hari nèti nèngu. sèmi èèna kahèi ana-èpu na ae risi eele hari, ho ladhe èèna na, rèngu j'aj'i suku-suku dhu kapai aae.

source_text: and he blesses them in that day, saying, by you does israel bless, saying, god set you as ephraim and as manasseh; and he sets ephraim before manasseh.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ana se dua ra, ladhe dhèu isra'el manèngi ama lamatua ho hia mamèngi-nale mi dhèu, rèngu ale ngara miu dua mi hèi. ladhe èèna na, ra peka sèmi ne'e: ‘ji'i sanao sèna ka ama lamatua hia mamèngi-nale mi èu, sama sèmi na hia mi efraim dènge manase. ' dènge j'ara ne'e, yakob ale uuru ngara efraim nèti ngara a'a na manase.

source_text: and israel says to joseph, behold, i am dying, and god has been with you, and has brought you back to the land of your fathers;
target_text: èle èèna, hèia yakob padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, ana, ee! ja'a nèbhu heka madhe. te ngaa ama lamatua dènge miu, ho èèna na nèti hari miu asa era pea-palu'u bèi-baki miu.

source_text: and i have given to you one portion above your brothers, which i have taken out of the hand of the amorite by my sword and by my bow.
target_text: te ngaa ne'e ne, ja'a hia èu risi eele nèti a'ari èu. aa ja'a hia tabha èu, ledhe ètu rai kana'an èèna, dhu uru na ja'a kore nèti dhèu amori, lod'o ja'a segi rèngu ètu d'ara pamusu.

source_text: and jacob calls to his sons and says, be gathered together, and i declare to you that which happens with you in the latter end of the days.
target_text: hèia yakob pua ana na aa'i-aa'i ra pakaboko. ropa ra kaboko aa'i, na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, ana ja'a aa'i-aa'i! mai padètu dènge ja'a. te ja'a neo peka dènge miu j'ara mamuri mi èci-èci lod'o limuri.

source_text: be assembled, and hear, sons of jacob, || and listen to your father israel.
target_text: ka na peka mema dènge ana-ana na si, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e, ana-ana yakob! mai titu lingu mere ja'a. mi nanene, ama miu isra'el ne, neo padhai lii.

source_text: reuben! you are my firstborn, || my power, and beginning of my strength, || the abundance of exaltation, || and the abundance of strength;
target_text: ruben! èu ne, ana ja'a dhu uru tèka! èu ne'e tatea ja'a, dènge ai g'ana ja'a. dhèu pakab'ua risi èu.

source_text: unstable as water, you are not abundant; for you have gone up your father's bed; then you have defiled it: he went up my couch!
target_text: te ngaa d'ara èu èra boe, sama sèmi rii dhasi dhu la'e-mai la'e-mai. cag'ag'a laa, èu lamu j'unu dènge dhèu èmu ja'a, ka pakaj'alu era j'unu ama èu. tatao èu èèna ka, pamanahu eele kolongara ca dhèu a'a.

source_text: simeon and levi are brothers! instruments of violence-their espousals!
target_text: simeon dènge lewi! miu dua mi ca rupa. miu dua mi, malai titu kèna ded'e samala, ho paj'èra dhèu.

source_text: into their secret, do not come, o my soul! do not be united to their assembly, o my glory; for in their anger they slew a man, || and in their self-will eradicated a prince.
target_text: ladhe miu pare pama'ète kalua haga sapi, ho ra kapod'e reo-reo ètu era, na lèke dad'èi miu kèna. aa bhabhelu miu hari, ladhe miu kadhi ngutu, na mi pamadhe dhèu. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pahae boe lii padhai lii miu. aa ja'a d'èi boe tao madha-dhilu mi lii langu miu.

source_text: cursed is their anger, for it is fierce, || and their wrath, for it is sharp; i divide them in jacob, || and i scatter them in israel.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a dhoo bhelu-katub'a miu ne, te seli-kolane nga! dènge nanasa miu dhu dènge boe sasue ciki sa hèi. ladhe èèna na, miu pasae unu mi, bhelu-katub'a miu sèra. ho èèna na, lamatua ceb'e ana-èpu miu, asa g'ana asa kariu. ka ra paceb'a asa mia-mia, ètu dedha rai isra'el.

source_text: judah! your brothers praise you! your hand is on the neck of your enemies, || sons of your father bow themselves to you.
target_text: yahuda! ngara èu ne, sasoa na, ‘koa-kio'. a'ari èu èèna na ra koa èu, aa ra pacud'u kètu ho pakab'ua èu. èu ne, j'èli musu èu, toke ra bisa heka doa kètu.

source_text: a lion's whelp is judah, || for prey, my son, you have gone up; he has bent, he has crouched as a lion, || and as a lioness; who causes him to arise?
target_text: èu ne, sama sèmi singa ngèru dhu èra, ho tenge nganga'a unu mu. aa èu ne, sama sèmi singa mone, dhu tèku iisi neo bhèj'i; èci sa bani boe pagagai dènge èu. èu kahèi sèmi singa rena, dhu madhenge ana; èci sa bani boe gagu. èci èèna ka dènge èu. dhèu èci sa bani boe padadisi, aa bani boe tao macam-macam mi dedha èu.

source_text: the scepter does not turn aside from judah, || and a lawgiver from between his feet, || until his seed comes; and his is the obedience of peoples.
target_text: èèna na èu mèd'u paredha. ana-èpu èu oo rèd'u paredha padhutu-dhutu, toke abhu èci dhu hak nèngu risi eele nèti cahag'e, ho nèd'u paredha na. ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne'e, pahaha iisi ho nanene lii paredha nèngu hèi.

source_text: binding to the vine his donkey, || and to the choice vine the colt of his donkey, || he has washed in wine his clothing, || and in the blood of grapes his covering;
target_text: èèna na, èu ne mamuri dènge karej'e-karae. èu neo ngaa, na abhu. èu neo tao ngaa, na j'aj'i! aa ladhe èèna na, badha-manu, dènge isi rai nèti oka-tedhe èu, asa ae d'ai ceb'e lebhe eele hèi.

source_text: red are eyes with wine, || and white are teeth with milk!
target_text: nganga'a-nginu èu, dhu be'a hua, aa dhu èle boe.

source_text: zebulun dwells at a haven of the seas, || and he is for a haven of ships; and his side is to sidon.
target_text: sebolon! rai pusaka dhu èu unu, kapai seli, nèti nebhe dhasi toke d'ai too dènge kota sidon. kapa-kapa mai nèti mia-mia ho panahu dènge be'a ètu d'ara hèb'a-namo dhasi èu.

source_text: issachar is a strong donkey, || crouching between the two folds; and he sees rest, that it is good, || and the land, that it is pleasant, || and he inclines his shoulder to bear, || and is a servant for tribute.
target_text: isaskar! èu ne, sama sèmi keled'ei dhu èra, te ngaa èu kètu hadhu papake na aad'o. ladhe èu j'unu ètu talora j'ara, dhèu èci sa bisa boe pakèd'i èu ho kako taruu. te ngaa ladhe èu mèdhi rae ètu ca bèka nèi be'a, èci sa dhae pua mèka èèna ka, mu pasae mèti le mèdha-panyau èu ho lamu. tatu èu sama sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: dan judges his people, || as one of the tribes of israel;
target_text: dan! ngara èu ne, sasoa na, ‘dhèu pama'ète lii'. aa èu ne, dènge ana-èpu èu, ladhe bèli-camèd'a pama'ète lii nèti dhèu èu isra'el sèra, dènge boe bia ca bèka.

source_text: dan is a serpent by the way, a viper by the path, || which is biting the horse's heels, || and its rider falls backward.
target_text: aa èu ne, sama èci èèna ka dènge mege kaisao dhu j'unu ètu sebhe j'ara. dhèu ca'e jara ho èèna na, èu kadhi haga jara èèna nèti kabodho, toke dhèu manahu sa rai.

source_text: for your salvation i have waited, yhwh!
target_text: o lamatua! ja'a ke'a na èu hia mamuri mi ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: gad! a troop assaults him, || but he assaults last.
target_text: gad! ngara èu, lii na oe èci èèna ka dènge, ‘age'. ladhe èèna na, dhèu parapo mai age èu, te ngaa èu kabèli hari age si, ka mu segi si.

source_text: out of asher his bread is fat; and he gives delicacies of a king.
target_text: aser! ladhe èèna isi rai nèti oka-tedhe èu be'a risi, d'ai èu tao koki dhu be'a bia, ka dhèu aae-dhèu kapai mai hèli ètu èu.

source_text: naphtali is a doe sent away, || who is giving beautiful young ones.
target_text: naftali! èu ne sama sèmi rusa hui, dhu dhèu èci sa ator rare boe èu. ana-ana matana èu, bhèni iia dènge mone iia.

source_text: joseph is a fruitful son; a fruitful son by a fountain, || daughters step over the wall;
target_text: yusuf! èu ne, sama sèmi aj'u loro dhu dètu dènge madha èi. dadana na loro asa tembok dhu dedha aae.

source_text: and embitter him indeed, they have striven, || indeed, archers hate him;
target_text: abhu kahèi dhèu tèka d'ara dènge èu, sama èci èèna ka, dènge musu dhu neo kataki èu.

source_text: and his bow abides in strength, || and strengthened are the arms of his hands || by the hands of the mighty one of jacob, || from where is a shepherd, a son of israel.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua dhu ja'a mangaj'i na, bera-bera dènge èu. ho na pa'èra ai èu, ka èu kataki si hari, masi ka nèti kaj'èu èèna ka. èu segi si, lula ama lamatua dhu tolong èu. mema koasa na risi aa'i ngaa-ngaa! nèti èèna ka, nèngu j'aj'i era sarai ja'a, lula nèngu na ka dhu madhenge ja'a.

source_text: by the god of your father who helps you, || and the mighty one who blesses you, || blessings of the heavens from above, || blessings of the deep lying under, || blessings of breasts and womb-
target_text: aa nèngu madhenge èu kahèi. dènge na pala-bagi hia èu mèngi-nale nèti dedha-liru, nèti rai-haha, dènge berkat ho matana ana ae-ae dhu ngi'u èra.

source_text: your father's blessings have been mighty || above the blessings of my progenitors, || to the limit of the perpetual heights || they are for the head of joseph, || and for the crown of the one || separate from his brothers.
target_text: ledhe-ledhe ra ele boe. aa mamèngi-nale dhu ja'a peka mi èu ne, dedha risi nèti ledhe aa'i-aa'i ra. sèna ka hud'i laa berkat se aa'i-aa'i sabhori asa èu, lula èu ne risi nèti a'ari èu se aa'i-aa'i si.

source_text: benjamin! a wolf tears; in the morning he eats prey, || and at evening he apportions spoil.
target_text: benyamin! babani èu sama sèmi busa hui dhu manganga. mad'ae aae era, na kèd'i le èèna, ho bata-magèla badha hui, ho j'aj'i mi nganga'a na. aa, ladhe d'ai ka mèda, la'e papala dhu sisa hia mi ana-ana nèngu. babe'a ana-èpu èu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: all these are the twelve tribes of israel, and this is that which their father has spoken to them, and he blesses them; each according to his blessing he has blessed them.
target_text: sange ne'e ka, yakob peka dènge ana-ana na, tasa mera mia mamuri rèngu pala lod'o limuri, èci-èci ka dènge ana-èpu rèngu. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se'e ka, j'aj'i mi bèi-baki nèti canguru dua suku dhèu isra'el.

source_text: and he commands them and says to them, i am being gathered to my people; bury me by my fathers, at the cave which is in the field of ephron the hittite; in the cave which is in the field of machpelah, which is on the front of mamre, in the land of canaan, which abraham bought with the field from ephron the hittite for a possession of a burying-place;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob manèngi sèna ka ana-ana na pajaji mema, peka na, nèbhu heka, ja'a madhe. ladhe bèli-camèd'a ja'a madhe, na miu hud'i padhane ku ja'a asa d'ara ro'a baki ku abraham. ro'a ne, ètu d'ara loe padètu dènge rae makpela, dènge mamre ètu rai kana'an. uru na baki abraham ka dhu hèli loe dènge oka na, ho j'aj'i mi era ro'a nèngu. na hèli pama'ète nèti dhèu suku het, ngara na efron.

source_text: there they buried abraham and his wife sarah; there they buried isaac and his wife rebekah; and there i buried leah;
target_text: ètu era èèna, ra padhane baki èdhi abraham dènge bèi èdhi sara; ama ja'a isak dènge ina ku ribka ètu èèna kahèi. de èèna na, miu hud'i padhane ja'a mi era èèna, ètu sebhe ro'a dhèu èmu ja'a lea.

source_text: the purchase of the field and of the cave which is in it, is from sons of heth.
target_text: de mage mi bhèlu, padhane ja'a ètu d'ara loe dhu baki abraham ku hèli nare èèna.

source_text: and jacob finishes commanding his sons, and gathers up his feet to the bed, and expires, and is gathered to his people.
target_text: yakob padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, na bhèj'i dènge ka ètu dedha koi na, hèia na madhe dènge ka.

source_text: and joseph falls on his father's face, and weeps over him, and kisses him;
target_text: hèia yusuf liku nare ama na, ka na tangi. na uu ama na pèri-pèri hari.

source_text: and joseph commands his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father, and the physicians embalm israel;
target_text: ka na paredha dhèu dhu tuka urus dhèu madhe mai lalau ngi'u aae ama na dènge bubhu-bubhu, sèna ka baku ele iie.

source_text: and they fulfill for him forty days, for so they fulfill the days of the embalmed, and the egyptians weep for him seventy days.
target_text: sasab'a tuka lalau ngi'u aae ama na, d'ai èpa nguru lod'o, madhutu j'ara sasab'a rèngu. dhèu masir aa'i-aa'i madhutu tangi kahèi mamadhe yakob ne'e. ra beke pidhu nguru lod'o, tao sèmi dhèu kapai rèngu madhe.

source_text: and the days of his weeping pass away, and joseph speaks to the house of pharaoh, saying, now if i have found grace in your eyes, please speak in the ears of pharaoh, saying,
target_text: èle beke pidhu nguru lod'o, hèia yusuf peka dènge dhèu sab'a na sèra, mi nanene! mèti ku lii ja'a ne asa dhèu aae, peka sèmi ne'e:

source_text: my father caused me to swear, saying, behold, i am dying; in my burying-place which i have prepared for myself in the land of canaan, there you bury me; and now, please let me go up and bury my father, then i return;
target_text: ‘lod'o ama ku oe madhe, na moa sèna ka ja'a laku padhane ne asa rai kana'an. de ja'a manèngi ho ama dhèu aae hia ja'a ijin laku padhane ama ku. ladhe èle na, ja'a lèpa hari mai. '

source_text: and pharaoh says, go up and bury your father, as he caused you to swear.
target_text: ropa tadèngi, hèia dhèu aae dhaa, peka na, ladhe èu dhu moa le mi ama mu sèmi èèna na, lamu ho padhane ne ètu nèi.

source_text: and joseph goes up to bury his father, and all the servants of pharaoh go up with him, the elderly of his house, and all the elderly of the land of egypt,
target_text: ka yusuf pakèd'i ka, la'e padhane ama na. dhèu ae madhutu lasi dènge ne kahèi. sèmi kapala urusan nèti dhèu aae, dènge dhèu kapai aa'i-aa'i nèti masir.

source_text: and all the house of joseph, and his brothers, and the house of his father; only their infants, and their flock, and their herd, have they left in the land of goshen;
target_text: a'ari yusuf dènge dhèu-dhèu sab'a ra aa'i-aa'i, lasi padhane yakob. dhu ata ètu gosen dhoka dhèu èmu ra, ana iiki, dènge badha-manu ra di.

source_text: and there go up with him both chariot and horsemen, and the camp is very great.
target_text: sordad'u ae madhutu kahèi. cahag'e ca'e kareta, aa cahag'e hari ca'e jara. taga dhèu dhu madhutu na, ae d'ai seli, nèti èèna ka, rombongan dhu rèti dhèu madhe ne, madhera titu kèna.

source_text: and they come to the threshing-floor of atad, which is beyond the jordan, and they lament there, a lamentation great and very grievous; and he makes for his father a mourning seven days,
target_text: rèngu lasi, ka ra pège loko yarden ètu era èci, ngara na atad. era ne'e, dhèu biasa mai j'èli are. d'ai era ne'e, yusuf si tangi mamadhe ama na. aa ra beke hari pidhu mèda.

source_text: and the inhabitant of the land, the canaanite, sees the mourning in the threshing-floor of atad and says, a grievous mourning is this to the egyptians; therefore one has called its name the mourning of the egyptians, which is beyond the jordan.
target_text: ropa dhèu kana'an ètu sèra, ladhe na ra j'èra ae titu kèna, hèia ra papeka, aku rèngu na, we! miu laladhe ku laa! babeke mamadhe dhèu masir se, ra susa bia nga! j'ara tatangi rèngu sèmi nèi ni ka. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare era èèna, ngara na abel-misraim. sasoa na, ‘sasusa dhèu masir'.

source_text: and his sons do to him so as he commanded them,
target_text: hèia ana-ana yakob se, tao madhutu sèmi lii moa rèngu uru na.

source_text: and his sons carry him away to the land of canaan, and bury him in the cave of the field of machpelah, which abraham bought with the field for a possession of a burying-place, from ephron the hittite, on the front of mamre.
target_text: ka nedhe rèti ngi'u aae yakob na, lasi padhane asa d'ara loe dhu padètu dènge rae makpela dènge mamre. abraham hèli nare era ne'e nèti dhèu suku het, ngara na efron, ho j'aj'i mi era udhu rui rèngu.

source_text: and joseph turns back to egypt, he and his brothers, and all who are going up with him to bury his father, after his burying his father.
target_text: yusuf padhane nare ama na, hèia nèngu dènge a'ari na lèpa hari asa masir. sama-sama dènge dhèu leo dhu madhutu sèra.

source_text: and the brothers of joseph see that their father is dead, and say, perhaps joseph hates us, and certainly returns to us all the evil which we did with him.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai masir, a'a yusuf se mulai madha'u. lula ama rèngu aad'o heka, ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, we! ta pangee ku la! sèmi yusuf tèka d'ara dènge èdhi era, ho na b'ala tatao karehe èdhi mi nèngu uru èèna, na èdhi tasamia?

source_text: and they give a charge for joseph, saying, your father commanded before his death, saying,
target_text: hèia rare lii èci, ka ra hia lii la'e asa yusuf, peka na, ama wakil. ji'i sanèd'e era, lod'o ama èdhi mamuri era, na pua ji'i

source_text: thus you say to joseph: ah, now, please bear with the transgression of your brothers and their sin, for they have done you evil; and now, please bear with the transgression of the servants of the god of your father; and joseph weeps in their speaking to him.
target_text: ho padhai lii dènge ama wakil, peka na, ‘yusuf hud'i bhabhèlu eele ka sasala a'a na si. lula uru na ra paj'èra ne. ' ji'i nge'a kahèi ama èdhi ne, karèi nèti uru ka mai, na mangaj'i dhoka mi ama lamatua di. ji'i kahèi j'aj'i ana pajuu lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ji'i mai manèngi abho, lula uru na ji'i paj'èra le, ama wakil. ropa tadèngi lii ne'e, hèia yusuf tangi.

source_text: and his brothers also go and fall before him, and say, behold, we are to you for servants.
target_text: èle èèna ka, a'a na si mai unu ra, ka patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha na. hèia ra padhai lii, peka na, hud'i laa ama tao ji'i j'aj'i ènu ama.

source_text: and joseph says to them, do not fear, for am i in the place of god?
target_text: te ngaa yusuf padhai lii dènge ra, miu se a'a ja'a! miu baku madha'u ia ka! dhoka ama lamatua di, dhu dènge hak hia huku mi dhèu. te ja'a ne, aad'o.

source_text: as for you, you devised evil against me, but god devised it for good, in order to do as at this day, to keep alive a numerous people;
target_text: mema tare'a, uru na miu mere lii èci, ho neo paj'èra ja'a. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu ub'a eele tatao miu dhu karehe èèna, j'aj'i mi babe'a. nèti èèna ka, na ded'e ja'a j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu ne'e, sèna ka dhèu ae abhu mamuri dènge karej'e.

source_text: and now, do not fear: i nourish you and your infants; and he comforts them, and speaks to their heart.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu kèna! baku madha'u ia ka. ja'a pamoa dènge miu se, èèna na, ladhe-leru miu, dènge ana-èpu miu aa'i-aa'i ra. dènge lii padhai lii sèmi ne'e ne, yusuf pa'èra hari d'ara a'a na si.

source_text: and joseph dwells in egypt, he and the house of his father, and joseph lives one hundred and ten years,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf pea taruu ètu rai masir, dènge a'ari na si, aa'i-aa'i ra. nèngu mamuri d'ai cangasu canguru tèu.

source_text: and joseph looks on ephraim's sons of a third generation; sons also of machir, son of manasseh, have been born on the knees of joseph.
target_text: nèngu d'ai hari nèdhi ana-èpu efraim kahèi. aa na leru èpu manase, nuka ana-ana nèti makir.

source_text: and joseph says to his brothers, i am dying, and god certainly inspects you, and has caused you to go up from this land, to the land which he has sworn to abraham, to isaac, and to jacob.
target_text: yusuf peka mi a'a na si, aku nèngu na, a'a ku si ee! ja'a rasa na mamadhe ja'a dètu le! te ngaa ja'a parcaya, ama lamatua tatu ladhe-leru miu. bèli-camèd'a nèngu ka dhu lere miu kalua nèti rai ne'e. nèngu kahèi dhu nèti hari miu lèpa asa rai dhu na padhadha le pake lii subha, ho hia mi baki èdhi abraham, isak dènge ama èdhi yakob.

source_text: and joseph causes the sons of israel to swear, saying, god certainly inspects you, and you have brought up my bones from this place.
target_text: ka yusuf manèngi mi a'ari na si, sèna ka ra subha, peka na, miu hud'i jaji ku mi dedha ja'a. ladhe lod'o d'ai ama lamatua nèti hari miu asa rai kana'an, miu hud'i mèti ngi'u aae ja'a asa nèi.

source_text: and joseph dies, a son of one hundred and ten years, and they embalm him, and he is put into a coffin in egypt.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf madhe ètu masir, dènge umur nèngu cangasu canguru tèu. hèia ra tao bubhu mi ngi'u aae na. ka ra tao asa d'ara kopa.
